<h1 id="zoom-api">Zoom API v2.0.0</h1>

> Scroll down for code samples, example requests and responses. Select a language for code samples from the tabs above or the mobile navigation menu.

The Zoom API allows developers to access information from Zoom. You can use this API to build private services or public applications on the [Zoom App Marketplace](http://marketplace.zoom.us). To learn how to get your credentials and create private/public applications, read our [Authorization Guide](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/guides/authorization/credentials).
All endpoints are available via `https` and are located at `api.zoom.us/v2/`.

For instance you can list all users on an account via `https://api.zoom.us/v2/users/`.

Base URLs:

* <a href="https://api.zoom.us/v2">https://api.zoom.us/v2</a>

<a href="https://zoom.us/docs/en-us/zoom_api_license_and_tou.html">Terms of service</a>
Email: <a href="mailto:developersupport@zoom.us">Zoom Developers</a> 
Web: <a href="https://developer.zoom.us/">Zoom Developers</a>

# Authentication

* API Key (Bearer)
    - Parameter Name: **Authorization**, in: header.

- oAuth2 authentication. Client Credentials Flow for ChatBots

    - Flow: clientCredentials
    - Token URL = [https://api.zoom.us/oauth/token](https://api.zoom.us/oauth/token)

- oAuth2 authentication.

    - Flow: authorizationCode
    - Authorization URL = [https://zoom.us/oauth/authorize](https://zoom.us/oauth/authorize)
    - Token URL = [https://zoom.us/oauth/token](https://zoom.us/oauth/token)

<h1 id="zoom-api-accounts">Accounts</h1>

Account operations

## List sub accounts

<a id="opIdaccounts"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/accounts \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /accounts`

List all the sub accounts that have been created by a master account.<br><br>Zoom allows only [approved partners](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/master-account-apis) to use master APIs and manage sub accounts. Email the partner programs team at **partner-success@zoom.us** for more details.

<br>**Prerequisites:**<br>
* Pro or a higher paid account with master account option enabled. <br>

**Scope**: `account:read:admin`
<br>**[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`<br>



<h3 id="list-sub-accounts-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|page_size|query|integer|false|The number of records returned within a single API call.|
|page_number|query|integer|false|<br>**Deprecated** - This field has been deprecated and we will stop supporting it completely in a future release. Please use "next_page_token" for pagination instead of this field.<br><br>The page number of the current page in the returned records.|
|next_page_token|query|string|false|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "accounts": [
    {
      "account_name": "string",
      "account_type": "string",
      "created_at": "string [date-time]",
      "id": "string [uuid]",
      "owner_email": "string",
      "seats": "integer",
      "subscription_end_time": "string [date-time]",
      "subscription_start_time": "string [date-time]"
    }
  ],
  "page_count": "integer",
  "page_number": "integer",
  "page_size": "integer",
  "total_records": "integer"
}
```

<h3 id="list-sub-accounts-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Account list returned.|Inline|

<h3 id="list-sub-accounts-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|next_page_token|string|false|none|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|
|page_count|integer|false|none|The number of pages returned for the request made.|
|page_number|integer|false|none|**Deprecated**: This field has been deprecated. Please use the "next_page_token" field for pagination instead of this field.<br><br>The page number of the current results.|
|page_size|integer|false|none|The number of records returned with a single API call.|
|total_records|integer|false|none|The total number of all the records available across pages.|
|accounts|[object]|false|none|List of Account objects.|
|» account_name|string|false|none|Account name.|
|» account_number|string|false|none|Account Number of the account.|
|» account_type|string|false|none|Account type.|
|» created_at|string(date-time)|false|none|Account creation date and time.|
|» id|string|false|none|Account ID.|
|» owner_email|string|false|none|Account owner email.|
|» seats|integer|false|none|Account seats.|
|» subscription_end_time|string(date-time)|false|none|Account subscription end date and time.|
|» subscription_start_time|string(date-time)|false|none|Account subscription start date and time.|

## Create a sub account

<a id="opIdaccountCreate"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/accounts \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "account_name": "string",
    "email": "string",
    "first_name": "string",
    "last_name": "string",
    "options": {
      "billing_auto_renew": true,
      "meeting_connector_list": [
        "string"
      ],
      "pay_mode": "master",
      "room_connector_list": [
        "string"
      ],
      "share_mc": false,
      "share_rc": false
    },
    "password": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /accounts`

Create a sub account under a master account. Your account must be a master account in order to create sub accounts. 
<br><br>Zoom allows only [approved partners](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/master-account-apis) to use master APIs and manage sub accounts. Email the partner programs team at partner-success@zoom.us. for more details. Please note that the created account user will receive a confirmation email.<br><br>
<br>
**Prerequisites:**<br>
* Pro or a higher paid account with master account option enabled. <br>

**Scope**: `account:write:admin`<br>
**[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`<br>


 

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "account_name": "string",
  "email": "string",
  "first_name": "string",
  "last_name": "string",
  "options": {
    "billing_auto_renew": true,
    "meeting_connector_list": [
      "string"
    ],
    "pay_mode": "master",
    "room_connector_list": [
      "string"
    ],
    "share_mc": false,
    "share_rc": false
  },
  "password": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-sub-account-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|true|Account.|
|» account_name|body|string|false|Name of the account. If you do not provide a value for this field, by default, the value will be set as a concatenation of "first_name" and "last_name". |
|» email|body|string|true|User's email address.|
|» first_name|body|string|true|User's first name.|
|» last_name|body|string|true|User's last name.|
|» options|body|object|false|Account options object.|
|» » billing_auto_renew|body|boolean|false|Toggle whether automatic billing renewal is on or off.|
|» » meeting_connector_list|body|[string]|false|Specify the IP addresses of the Meeting Connectors that you would like to share with the sub account. Multiple values can be separated by comma. If no value is provided in this field, all the Meeting Connectors of a master account will be shared with the sub account.<br><br><br>**Note:** This option can only be used if the value of `share_mc` is set to `true`.|
|» » pay_mode|body|string|false|Payee:<br>`master` - master account holder pays.<br>`sub` - Sub account holder pays.|
|» » room_connector_list|body|[string]|false|Specify the IP addresses of the Room Connectors that you would like to share with the sub account. Multiple values can be separated by comma. If no value is provided in this field, all the Room Connectors of a master account will be shared with the sub account.<br><br><br>**Note:** This option can only be used if the value of `share_rc` is set to `true`.|
|» » share_mc|body|boolean|false|Enable/disable the option for a sub account to use shared [Meeting Connector(s)](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/201363093-Getting-Started-with-the-Meeting-Connector) that are set up by the master account. Meeting Connectors can only be used by On-prem users.|
|» » share_rc|body|boolean|false|Enable/disable the option for a sub account to use shared [Virtual Room Connector(s)](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/202134758-Getting-Started-With-Virtual-Room-Connector) that are set up by the master account. Virtual Room Connectors can only be used by On-prem users.|
|» password|body|string|true|User's password.<br><br>**Note:** If the account owner or admin has enabled [enhanced password requirements](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360034675592-Advanced-security-settings#h_fa9186e4-6818-4f7a-915c-2e25c19f0acd), the value provided in this field must meet those requirements. These requirements can be retrieved by calling the [Get Account Settings API](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/accounts/accountsettings) and referring to the `password_requirement` field present in the `security` object.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» » pay_mode|master|
|» » pay_mode|sub|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "created_at": "string",
  "id": "string",
  "owner_email": "string",
  "owner_id": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-sub-account-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|Account created.|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400`<br><br>**Error Code:**`300`<br> Your request could not be completed because the name contains an invalid word: {name}<br>**Error Code:** `1107`<br><br>Email domain is blocked.<br><br>**Error Code:** `1111`<br><br>Password should not contain repeated characters such as 'aaaaaa'. <br><br>Password should not contain consecutive characters such as 'abc','123'.<br><br>|None|
|409|Conflict|**HTTP Status Code:** `409`<br><br>**Error Code:** `1005`<br><br>Email $email has already been used.|None|

<h3 id="create-a-sub-account-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **201**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|created_at|string|false|none|Account created date time.|
|id|string|false|none|Account ID.|
|owner_email|string|false|none|Account owner email.|
|owner_id|string|false|none|Account owner ID.|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|201|Content-Location|string||Location of the created account.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

## Get sub account details

<a id="opIdaccount"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/accounts/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /accounts/{accountId}`

Get details of a sub account that is listed under a master account. Your account must be a master account in order to retrieve sub accounts' details. Zoom allows only [approved partners](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/master-account-apis) to use master APIs and create sub accounts. Email the partner programs team at **partner-success@zoom.us** for more details.

**Prerequisites:**
* Pro or a higher paid account with master account option enabled. <br>

**Scope**: `account:write:admin`<br>
**[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`<br>


 


<h3 id="get-sub-account-details-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|accountId|path|string|true|The account ID.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "created_at": "string [date-time]",
  "id": "string",
  "options": {
    "meeting_connectors": "string",
    "pay_mode": "string",
    "room_connectors": "string",
    "share_mc": "boolean",
    "share_rc": "boolean"
  },
  "owner_email": "string",
  "owner_id": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="get-sub-account-details-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code**: `200`<br><br>Account object returned.|Inline|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code**: `404`<br><br>**Error Code:** `2001`<br> Account does not exist: $subAccountId.|None|

<h3 id="get-sub-account-details-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|created_at|string(date-time)|false|none|Account creation date and time.|
|id|string|false|none|Account ID.|
|options|object|false|none|Account options object.|
|» billing_auto_renew|boolean|false|none|Toggle whether automatic billing renewal is on or off.|
|» meeting_connector_list|[string]|false|none|Specify the IP addresses of the Meeting Connectors that you would like to share with the sub account. Multiple values can be separated by comma. If no value is provided in this field, all the Meeting Connectors of a master account will be shared with the sub account.<br><br><br>**Note:** This option can only be used if the value of `share_mc` is set to `true`.|
|» pay_mode|string|false|none|Payee:<br>`master` - master account holder pays.<br>`sub` - Sub account holder pays.|
|» room_connector_list|[string]|false|none|Specify the IP addresses of the Room Connectors that you would like to share with the sub account. Multiple values can be separated by comma. If no value is provided in this field, all the Room Connectors of a master account will be shared with the sub account.<br><br><br>**Note:** This option can only be used if the value of `share_rc` is set to `true`.|
|» share_mc|boolean|false|none|Enable/disable the option for a sub account to use shared [Meeting Connector(s)](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/201363093-Getting-Started-with-the-Meeting-Connector) that are set up by the master account. Meeting Connectors can only be used by On-prem users.|
|» share_rc|boolean|false|none|Enable/disable the option for a sub account to use shared [Virtual Room Connector(s)](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/202134758-Getting-Started-With-Virtual-Room-Connector) that are set up by the master account. Virtual Room Connectors can only be used by On-prem users.|
|owner_email|string|false|none|Account owner email.|
|owner_id|string|false|none|Account owner ID.|
|vanity_url|string|false|none|Account Vanity URL|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|» pay_mode|master|
|» pay_mode|sub|

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:

## Disassociate a sub account

<a id="opIdaccountDisassociate"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/accounts/string \
  -X DELETE \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /accounts/{accountId}`

Disassociate a sub account from its master account. This will leave the sub account intact but it will no longer be associated with the master account.<br>  

**Prerequisites:**
* Pro or a higher paid account with master account option enabled. <br>
* The account making this API request must be a [master account](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/master-account-apis).<br><br>


**Scope**: `account:write:admin`<br>
**[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`<br>


 

<h3 id="disassociate-a-sub-account-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|accountId|path|string|true|The account ID.|

<h3 id="disassociate-a-sub-account-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|**HTTP Status Code**: `204`<br>Account deleted.|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code**: `404` <br> <br>**Error Code:** `2000`<br> You cannot disassociate a paid account. <br><br>**Error Code:** `2001`<br> Account does not exist: $subAccountId.|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

## Get locked settings

<a id="opIdgetAccountLockSettings"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/accounts/string/lock_settings \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /accounts/{accountId}/lock_settings`

[Account Locked Settings](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/115005269866) allow you turn settings on or off for all users in your account. No user except the account admin or account owner can change these settings. With lock settings, you force the settings on for all users.
Use this API to retrieve an account's locked settings. 

**Note:** This API can be used by Zoom Accounts that are on a Pro or a higher plan as well accounts that have master and sub accounts options enabled. <br><br>
**Prerequisites:**
* Pro or a higher paid account. <br>

**Scope**: `account:read:admin`.
<br> **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`<br>





**Scope:** account:read:admin

<h3 id="get-locked-settings-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|accountId|path|string|true|Unique Identifier of the account. To retrieve locked settings of the master account or a regular account, provide "me" as the value of this field. <br> To retrieve locked settings of a sub account, provide the Account ID of the sub account in this field.|
|option|query|string|false|`meeting_security`: Use this query parameter to view meeting security settings applied on the account.<br>|
|custom_query_fields|query|string|false|Provide the name of the field by which you would like to filter the response. For example, if you provide "host_video" as the value of this field, you will get a response similar to the following:<br><br>{<br>    "schedule_meeting": {<br>        "host_video": false<br>    }<br>}<br><br>You can provide multiple values by separating them with commas(example: "host_video,participant_video”).|

|» custom_data_center_regions|boolean|false|none|Displays whether or not custom [data center regions](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360042411451-Selecting-data-center-regions-for-hosted-meetings-and-webinars) have been selected for meetings/webinars hosted by the account.|
|» dscp_marking|boolean|false|none|Enable DSCP marking for signaling and media packets. (Default is 56 for audio, 40 for video, and 40 for signaling.) |

|» far_end_camera_control|boolean|false|none|Allow another user to take control of the camera during a meeting.|
|» feedback|boolean|false|none|Enable users to provide feedback to Zoom at the end of the meeting.|

`PATCH /accounts/{accountId}/lock_settings`

[Account Locked Settings](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/115005269866) allow you turn settings on or off for all users in your account. No user except the account admin or account owner can change these settings. With lock settings, you force the settings on for all users. Use this API to update an account's locked settings.

**Note:** This API can be used by Zoom Accounts that are on a Pro or a higher plan as well accounts that have master and sub accounts options enabled.<br><br>
**Prerequisites:**<br>
* Pro or a higher paid account. <br>

**Scope:** `account:write:admin`<br>
**[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`<br>

## Get managed domains

<a id="opIdaccountManagedDomain"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/accounts/string/managed_domains \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /accounts/{accountId}/managed_domains`

Get a sub account's [managed domains](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/203395207-What-is-Managed-Domain-).<br><br>

**Note:** This API can be used by Zoom Accounts that are on a Pro or a higher plan as well accounts that have master and sub accounts options enabled. <br><br>
To get managed domains of the master account, provide `me` as the value for accountId in the path parameter. Provide the sub account's Account ID as the value of accountId path parameter to get managed domains of the sub account.<br><br>
**Prerequisites:**<br>
* Pro or a higher paid account with master account option enabled. <br>

**Scope:** `account:read:admin`<br>
**[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`<br>





<h3 id="get-managed-domains-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|accountId|path|string|true|Unique Identifier of the account. To retrieve locked settings of the master account or a regular account, provide "me" as the value of this field. <br> To retrieve locked settings of a sub account, provide the Account ID of the sub account in this field.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "domains": [
    {
      "domain": "string",
      "status": "string"
    }
  ],
  "total_records": 0
}
```

<h3 id="get-managed-domains-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** `200`<br><br>Account managed domains returned.<br>**Error Code:** `200`<br><br>Only available for paid account.<br><br>|Inline|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404`<br><br>**Error Code**: `2001`<br><br>Account does not exist: $subAccountId.<br>|None|

<h3 id="get-managed-domains-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|domains|[object]|false|none|List of managed domain objects.|
|» domain|string|false|none|Domain name.|
|» status|string|false|none|Domain status.|
|total_records|integer|false|none|Total records.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

## Update options

<a id="opIdaccountOptionsUpdate"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/accounts/string/options \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "billing_auto_renew": true,
    "meeting_connector_list": [
      "string"
    ],
    "pay_mode": "master",
    "room_connector_list": [
      "string"
    ],
    "share_mc": false,
    "share_rc": false
  }'
```

`PATCH /accounts/{accountId}/options`

Update a sub account's options under the master account.<br> <aside>Your account must be a master account in order to update the options for sub accounts. Zoom only assigns this privilege to trusted partners. </aside>

**Prerequisites:**
* Pro or a higher paid account with master account option enabled.
* The account making this API request must be a [master account](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/master-account-apis).<br><br>

**Scope**: `account:write:admin`<br>
**[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`<br>


 

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "billing_auto_renew": true,
  "meeting_connector_list": [
    "string"
  ],
  "pay_mode": "master",
  "room_connector_list": [
    "string"
  ],
  "share_mc": false,
  "share_rc": false
}
```

<h3 id="update-options-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|accountId|path|string|true|The account ID.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» billing_auto_renew|body|boolean|false|Toggle whether automatic billing renewal is on or off.|
|» meeting_connector_list|body|[string]|false|Specify the IP addresses of the Meeting Connectors that you would like to share with the sub account. Multiple values can be separated by comma. If no value is provided in this field, all the Meeting Connectors of a master account will be shared with the sub account.<br><br><br>**Note:** This option can only be used if the value of `share_mc` is set to `true`.|
|» pay_mode|body|string|false|Payee:<br>`master` - master account holder pays.<br>`sub` - Sub account holder pays.|
|» room_connector_list|body|[string]|false|Specify the IP addresses of the Room Connectors that you would like to share with the sub account. Multiple values can be separated by comma. If no value is provided in this field, all the Room Connectors of a master account will be shared with the sub account.<br><br><br>**Note:** This option can only be used if the value of `share_rc` is set to `true`.|
|» share_mc|body|boolean|false|Enable/disable the option for a sub account to use shared [Meeting Connector(s)](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/201363093-Getting-Started-with-the-Meeting-Connector) that are set up by the master account. Meeting Connectors can only be used by On-prem users.|
|» share_rc|body|boolean|false|Enable/disable the option for a sub account to use shared [Virtual Room Connector(s)](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/202134758-Getting-Started-With-Virtual-Room-Connector) that are set up by the master account. Virtual Room Connectors can only be used by On-prem users.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» pay_mode|master|
|» pay_mode|sub|

> Example responses

> 204 Response

```json
{
  "meeting_connectors": "string",
  "pay_mode": "string",
  "room_connectors": "string",
  "share_mc": "boolean",
  "share_rc": "boolean"
}
```

<h3 id="update-options-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**Error Code:** `200`<br><br>The pay mode cannot be updated for a sub account which already has an existing plan.|None|
|204|No Content|**HTTP Status Code:** `204`<br><br>Account options updated.|None|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400`<br><br>**Error Code:** `2100`<br> The collection method cannot be changed after the purchase is complete.|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404`<br><br>**Error Code:** `2001`<br><br>Account does not exist: $subAccountId.|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

## Update the account owner

<a id="opIdupdateAccountOwner"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/accounts/string/owner \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "email": "user@example.com"
  }'
```

`PUT /accounts/{accountId}/owner`

The current account owner can [change the owner of an account](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/115005686983-Change-Account-Owner) to another user on the same account.<br> Use this API to change the owner of a sub account.
 
**Prerequisites**: <br>
* Account owner or admin permissions of an account.
* The account making this API request must be on a pro or a hiigher plan with [master account](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/master-account-apis) privilege.<br><br>

**Scopes:**  `account:write:admin` or `account:master`<br>**[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Heavy`<br>


<br> 

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "email": "user@example.com"
}
```

<h3 id="update-the-account-owner-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|accountId|path|string|true|Account Id of the account.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» email|body|string(email)|true|Email address of the new owner.|

> Example responses

> 204 Response

```json
null
```

<h3 id="update-the-account-owner-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|**HTTP Status Code:** `204`<br><br>Account owner updated.|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400`<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `200`<br><br>User is not an admin or is an API user or doesn’t belong to this account: {accountId}.<br><br>Cannot make a user outside of your account an owner.<br><br>Cannot update the role of an account owner.|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404`<br><br>**Error Code:** `2001`<br><br>Account does not exist: $subAccountId.<br><br>**Error Code:** `3201`<br><br>Cannot find a billing account for this: $accountId.<br><br>**Error Code:** `3211`<br><br>Cannot find a billing contact for this: $accountId.<br>|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

## Get settings

<a id="opIdaccountSettings"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/accounts/string/settings \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /accounts/{accountId}/settings`

Get the settings of an account.<br>
To get the settings of a master account, use `me` as the value for the `accountId` path parameter.<br><br>
 **Prerequisites**:
 * The account must be a paid account.<br>
**Scopes**: `account:read:admin`
<br> 
**[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`

<h3 id="get-settings-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|accountId|path|string|true|The account ID.|
|option|query|string|false|`meeting_authentication`: Use this query parameter to view [meeting authentication configuration](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360037117472-Authentication-Profiles-for-Meetings-and-Webinars) applied on the account.<br>`recording_authentication`: Use this query parameter to view [recording authentication configuration](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360037756671-Authentication-Profiles-for-Cloud-Recordings) applied on the account.<br>`security`: Use this query parameter to view security settings such as password requirements for user login, two factor authentication etc., applied on the account.<br><br>`meeting_security`: Use this query parameter to view meeting security settings applied on the account.<br>|
|custom_query_fields|query|string|false|Provide the name of the field by which you would like to filter the response. For example, if you provide "host_video" as the value of this field, you will get a response similar to the following:<br><br>{<br>    "schedule_meeting": {<br>        "host_video": false<br>    }<br>}<br><br>You can provide multiple values by separating them with commas(example: "host_video,participant_video”).|

|» consecutive_characters_length|integer|false|none|<br>Specify the max length of consecutive characters(abcde...) that can be used in a password.<br>If you set the value of this field to `0`, no restriction will be applied on consecutive characters. <br><br>If you would like to set this restriction, you can specify a number between 4 and 8 that define the maximum allowed length for consecutive characters in a password.<br><br>The max allowed length will be `n-1` where `n` refers to the value you provide for this field.  For instance, if you provide `4` as the value, there can only be a maximum of `3` consecutive characters in a password(example: abc1x@8fdh).|
|» have_special_character|boolean|false|none|If the value of this field is set to `true`, the password must have at least one special character(!, @, #...).|
|» minimum_password_length|integer|false|none|Specify a minimum length for the password. The password length can be from a minimum of 9 characters, up to 14 characters. If you provide `0` as the value of this field, this field will be disabled and not be used and the basic password length requirement (minimum of 8 characters) will be applied for the requirement.|
|» weak_enhance_detection|boolean|false|none|If the value of this field is set to `true`, user passwords will have to pass detection through a weak password dictionary in case hackers use simple passwords to sign in to your users’ accounts.|
|sign_again_period_for_inactivity_on_client|integer|false|none|Settings for User Sign In interval requirements after a period of inactivity. If enabled, this setting forces automatic logout of users in Zoom Client app after a set amount of time. <br><br><br>If this setting is disabled, the value of this field will be `0`. If the setting is enabled, the value of this field will indicate the **period of inactivity** in minutes after which, an inactive user will be automatically logged out of the Zoom Client. The value for the period of inactivity can be one of the following:<br><br><br>`5`: 5 minutes<br><br>`10`: 10 minutes<br><br>`15`: 15 minutes<br><br>`30`: 30 minutes<br><br>`45`: 45 minutes<br><br>`60`: 60 minutes<br><br>`90`: 90 minutes<br><br>`120`: 120 minutes<br>|
|sign_again_period_for_inactivity_on_web|integer|false|none|Settings for User Sign In interval requirements after a period of inactivity. If enabled, this setting forces automatic logout of users in Zoom Web Portal after a set amount of time. <br><br><br>If this setting is disabled, the value of this field will be `0`. If the setting is enabled, the value of this field will indicate the **period of inactivity** in minutes after which, an inactive user will be automatically logged out of the Zoom Web Portal. The value for the period of inactivity can be one of the following:<br><br><br>`5`: 5 minutes<br><br>`10`: 10 minutes<br><br>`15`: 15 minutes<br><br>`30`: 30 minutes<br><br>`60`: 60 minutes<br><br>`120`: 120 minutes<br><br>    <br><br>|
|sign_in_with_two_factor_auth|string|false|none|Settings for 2FA( [two factor authentication](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360038247071) ). The value can be one of the following:<br>`all`: Two factor authentication will be enabled for all users in the account.<br><br>`none`: Two factor authentication is disabled.<br><br>`group`: Two factor authentication will be enabled for users belonging to specific groups. If 2FA is enabled for certain groups, the group IDs of the group(s) will be provided in the `sign_in_with_two_factor_auth_groups` field.<br><br>`role`: Two factor authentication will be enabled only for users assigned with specific roles in the account. If 2FA is enabled for specific roles, the role IDs will be provided in the<br>`sign_in_with_two_factor_auth_roles` field.<br>|
|sign_in_with_two_factor_auth_groups|[string]|false|none|This field contains group IDs of groups that have 2FA enabled. This field is only returned if the value of `sign_in_with_two_factor_auth` is `group`|
|sign_in_with_two_factor_auth_roles|[string]|false|none|This field contains role IDs of roles that have 2FA enabled. This field is only returned if the value of `sign_in_with_two_factor_auth` is `role`.|

[Learn more](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/guides/stay-up-to-date/announcements#meeting-security).|
|» embed_password_in_join_link|boolean|false|none|If set to `true`, meeting passcode will be encrypted and included in the invite link to allow participants to join with just one click without having to enter the passcode.<br>|
|» encryption_type|string|false|none|Choose between enhanced encryption and [end-to-end encryption](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360048660871) when starting or a meeting. When using end-to-end encryption, several features (e.g. cloud recording, phone/SIP/H.323 dial-in) will be **automatically disabled**. <br><br>The value of this field can be one of the following:<br><br>`enhanced_encryption`: Enhanced encryption. Encryption is stored in the cloud if you enable this option. <br><br><br>`e2ee`: [End-to-end encryption](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360048660871). The encryption key is stored in your local device and can not be obtained by anyone else. Enabling this setting also **disables** the following features: join before host, cloud recording, streaming, live transcription, breakout rooms, polling, 1:1 private chat, and meeting reactions.|
|» end_to_end_encrypted_meetings|boolean|false|none|Allow use of end-to-end encryption for meetings. If set to `true`, you can specify the encryption type in `encryption_type` field.|
|» meeting_password|boolean|false|none|If set to `true`, all instant, and scheduled meetings that users can join via client, or room systems will be passcode-protected. The Personal Meeting ID (PMI) meetings are not included in this setting.|
|» meeting_password_requirement|object|false|none|Meeting/webinar [passcode requirements](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360033559832-Meeting-and-webinar-passwords#h_a427384b-e383-4f80-864d-794bf0a37604).|

|» » have_letter|boolean|false|none|If set to `true`, the passcode must contain at least 1 letter (such as a,b,c...).<br>|
|» » have_number|boolean|false|none|If set to `true`, the passcode must contain at least 1 number (such as 1,2,3...).|
|» » have_special_character|boolean|false|none|If set to `true`, the passcode must have at least 1 special character (!,@,#...).|
|» » have_upper_and_lower_characters|boolean|false|none|If set to `true`, the passcode must include both uppercase and lowercase characters.|

|» phone_password|boolean|false|none|Require passcode for participants joining by phone. If set to `true`, a numeric passcode will be required for participants joining by phone if your meeting has a passcode. For meeting with an alphanumeric passcode, a numeric version will be generated.|

`PATCH /accounts/{accountId}/settings`

Update the settings of a sub account that is under a master account.<br> To update the settings of the master account, use `me` as the value of the `accountId` path parameter.<br><br>
**Prerequisites**:
 * The sub account must be a paid account.<br>
**Scopes**: `account:write:admin`
<br>
**[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`

## Upload virtual background files

<a id="opIduploadVB"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/accounts/string/settings/virtual_backgrounds \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -F 'file=string'
```

`POST /accounts/{accountId}/settings/virtual_backgrounds`

Use this API to [upload virtual background files](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/210707503-Virtual-Background#h_01EJF3YFEWGT8YA0ZJ079JEDQE) for all users on the account to use. 


**Prerequisites:**<br>
* Virtual background feature must be [enabled](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/210707503-Virtual-Background#h_2ef28080-fce9-4ac2-b567-dc958afab1b7) on the account.
<br> **Scope:** `account:write:admin`<br><br>
**[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`<br>



> Body parameter

```yaml
file: string
```

<h3 id="upload-virtual-background-files-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|accountId|path|string|true|Unique identifier of the account.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» file|body|string|false|Provide the file's path here.|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "id": "_Tcj7354w6eHw",
  "is_default": false,
  "name": "u=mdbhhfg3y7&fm=2fdjs0.jpg",
  "size": 53434,
  "type": "image"
}
```

<h3 id="upload-virtual-background-files-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|**HTTP Status Code:** `201` **Created** <br><br>|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400` **Bad Request** <br><br>**Error Code:** `120`<br><br>No file uploaded, verify that a file has been uploaded.<br><br>File size cannot exceed 15M.<br><br>A maximum of 10 files are allowed for a user.<br><br>Only jpg/jpeg, gif or png image file can be uploaded.<br><br>|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404` **Not Found** <br><br>**Error Code:** `2001`<br><br>This account does not exist or does not belong to you: {accountId}.|None|

<h3 id="upload-virtual-background-files-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **201**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|false|none|Unique identifier of the file.|
|is_default|boolean|false|none|Indicates whether or not this file is the default virtual background file.|
|name|string|false|none|File name.|
|size|string|false|none|File size.|
|type|string|false|none|File type.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

## Delete virtual background files

<a id="opIddelVB"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/accounts/string/settings/virtual_backgrounds \
  -X DELETE \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /accounts/{accountId}/settings/virtual_backgrounds`

Delete existing virtual background file(s) from an account. 

**Prerequisites:**<br>
* Virtual background feature must be [enabled](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/210707503-Virtual-Background#h_2ef28080-fce9-4ac2-b567-dc958afab1b7) on the account.
<br> **Scope:** `account:write:admin`<br> <br> 
**[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`<br>



<h3 id="delete-virtual-background-files-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|file_ids|query|string|false|Provide the id of the file that is to be deleted. To delete multiple files, provide comma separated values for this field.|
|accountId|path|string|true|none|

<h3 id="delete-virtual-background-files-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|**HTTP Status Code:** `204` **No Content** <br><br>Deleted.<br>|None|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400` **Bad request** <br><br>**Error Code:** `300`<br><br>Invalid parameter: file_ids.|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404` **Not Found** <br><br>**Error Code:** `2001`<br><br>This account does not exist or does not belong to you: {accountId}.|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

## Get trusted domains

<a id="opIdaccountTrustedDomain"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/accounts/string/trusted_domains \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /accounts/{accountId}/trusted_domains`

Get trusted domains of a sub account. To get the trusted domains of a master account, use `me` as the value for the `accountId` path parameter.

**Prerequisites:**<br>
* The sub account must be a paid account.<br>
**Scope:** `account:read:admin`<br>
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`

<h3 id="get-trusted-domains-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|accountId|path|string|true|The account ID.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "trusted_domains": [
    "string"
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="get-trusted-domains-responses">Responses</h3>

|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** `200`<br><br>Account trusted domains returned<br><br>**Error Code:** `2001`<br> Account does not exist: $subAccountId.|Inline|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404`<br><br>**Error Code:** `2001`<br> Account does not exist: $subAccountId.|None|

<h3 id="get-trusted-domains-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|trusted_domains|[string]|false|none|List of trusted domains|

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth

<h1 id="zoom-api-billing">Billing</h1>

Billing operations

## Get billing information

<a id="opIdaccountBilling"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/accounts/string/billing \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /accounts/{accountId}/billing`

Get [billing information](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/201363263-About-Billing) of a sub account.<br><br>Only master accounts can use this API. Zoom allows only [approved partners](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/master-account-apis) to use master APIs and manage sub accounts' billing information. Email the partner programs team at **partner-success@zoom.us** for more details.<br>

**Prerequisites:**
* Pro or a higher paid account with master account option enabled. <br>

**Scope**:`billing:master`<br>
**[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`<br>



<h3 id="get-billing-information-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|accountId|path|string|true|The account ID.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "address": "string",
  "apt": "string",
  "city": "string",
  "country": "string",
  "email": "string",
  "first_name": "string",
  "last_name": "string",
  "phone_number": "string",
  "state": "string",
  "zip": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="get-billing-information-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** `200`<br><br>Account billing contact information returned.|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400`<br><br>**Error Code:** `2100`<br> <br>This sub account is on self pay mode.|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404`<br><br>**Error Code:** `2001`<br><br>Account does not exist: {subAccountId}.<br><br><br>|None|

<h3 id="get-billing-information-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

|city|string|true|none|Billing Contact's city.|

## Update billing information

<a id="opIdaccountBillingUpdate"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/accounts/string/billing \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "address": "string",
    "apt": "string",
    "city": "string",
    "country": "string",
    "email": "string",
    "first_name": "string",
    "last_name": "string",
    "phone_number": "string",
    "state": "string",
    "zip": "string"
  }'
```

`PATCH /accounts/{accountId}/billing`

Update [billing information](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/201363263-About-Billing) of a sub account.<br><br>
This API can only be used by master accounts that pay all billiing charges of their associated sub accounts. Zoom allows only [approved partners](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/master-account-apis) to use master APIs and manage sub accounts' billing information. Email the partner programs team at **partner-success@zoom.us** for more details.<br><br>

**Prerequisites:**
* Pro or a higher paid account with master account option enabled. <br>

**Scope**:`billing:master`<br>
**[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Heavy`<br>



> Body parameter

```json
{
  "address": "string",
  "apt": "string",
  "city": "string",
  "country": "string",
  "email": "string",
  "first_name": "string",
  "last_name": "string",
  "phone_number": "string",
  "state": "string",
  "zip": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="update-billing-information-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|accountId|path|string|true|The account ID.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» address|body|string|false|Billing Contact's address.|
|» apt|body|string|false|Billing Contact's apartment/suite.|
|» city|body|string|false|Billing Contact's city.|
|» country|body|string|false|Billing Contact's country.|
|» email|body|string|false|Billing Contact's email address.|
|» first_name|body|string|false|Billing Contact's first name.|
|» last_name|body|string|false|Billing Contact's last name.|
|» phone_number|body|string|false|Billing Contact's phone number.|
|» state|body|string|false|Billing Contact's state.|
|» zip|body|string|false|Billing Contact's zip/postal code.|

<h3 id="update-billing-information-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**Error Code:** `200`<br><br>Please subscribe a plan for this sub account first.|None|
|204|No Content|**HTTP Status Code:** `204`<br><br>Account billing contact information updated.|None|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400`<br><br>**Error Code:** `2100`<br><br>This sub account is on self pay mode.<br><br>Invalid country parameter: {country}.<br><br>Invalid state parameter: {state}.|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404`<br><br>**Error Code:** `2001`<br><br>Account does not exist: {subAccountId}.<br><br><br><br>|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

## List billing invoices

<a id="opIdaccountBillingInvoices"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/accounts/string/billing/invoices \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /accounts/{accountId}/billing/invoices`

List [invoices](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/207276556-Viewing-your-invoice-history#h_6710542f-23cc-4059-9cc7-ff02bec7314e) of a Zoom account.

To list a regular Zoom account's invoices or a master account's invoices, provide `me` as the value of the `accountId` path parameter. To list a sub account's invoices, provide the account ID of the sub account in the `accountId` path parameter. 

**Prerequisites:**
* Account must be enrolled in Pro or a higher plan.<br>

**Scope**:`billing:master`<br>**[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Heavy`<br>
**Additional Rate Limit:** You can make **one** API request per account(`accountId`) every **five** minutes until the daily limit is reached. This API has a daily limit of **6** requests per account(`accountId`).

<h3 id="list-billing-invoices-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|from|query|string(date)|false|Start date for the invoice query in `yyyy-mm-dd` format. The date range defined by the “from” and “to” parameters should not exceed one year. The range defined should fall within the past three years.<br>|
|to|query|string(date)|false|End date for the invoice query in `yyyy-mm-dd` format|
|accountId|path|string|true|The account ID.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "currency": "USD",
  "invoices": [
    {
      "balance": 2039,
      "due_date": "2020-08-07",
      "id": "2c92c12348d07e0580",
      "invoice_date": "2020-08-07",
      "invoice_number": "S8INsdf4534000001",
      "status": "Draft",
      "target_date": "2020-08-07",
      "tax_amount": 0,
      "total_amount": 2039
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="list-billing-invoices-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** `200`<br><br>Account billing invoice information returned.|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400`<br><br>**Error Code:** `200`<br><br>Only available for Paid account: {subAccountId}.<br>**Error Code:** `2001`<br><br>Account does not exist: {subAccountId}.|None|

<h3 id="list-billing-invoices-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|currency|string|false|none|Currency used in the invoice.|
|invoices|[object]|false|none|none|
|» balance|number(double)|false|none|The remaining balance of the invoice after all payments, adjustments, and refunds are applied.<br><br>|
|» due_date|string|false|none|The date by which the payment for this invoice is due.<br><br>|
|» id|string|false|none|Unique identifier of the invoice.|
|» invoice_date|string|false|none|The date when the invoice was generated.<br>|
|» invoice_number|string|false|none|Invoice number.|
|» status|string|false|none|Status of the invoice.|
|» target_date|string|false|none|This date is used to determine which charges are to be billed. All charges that are to be billed on this date or prior will be included in the invoice.<br>|
|» tax_amount|number(double)|false|none|Tax amount.|
|» total_amount|number(double)|false|none|Total invoice amount.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

## Get invoice details

<a id="opIdgetAccountBillingInvoice"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
```

`GET /accounts/{accountId}/billing/invoices/{invoiceId}`

Get detailed information about a specific [invoice](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/207276556-Viewing-your-invoice-history#h_6710542f-23cc-4059-9cc7-ff02bec7314e). <br>To retrieve a regular Zoom account's invoice details or a master account's invoice details, provide `me` as the value of `accountId` path parameter. To list a sub account's invoice details, provide the account ID of the sub account in the `accountId` path parameter. 

**Prerequisites:**
* Account must be enrolled in Pro or a higher plan. <br>

**Scope**:`billing:master`<br>
<br>**[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Heavy`<br>
**Additional Rate Limit:** You can make **one** API request every **thirty** minutes until the daily limit is reached. This API has a daily limit of **100** requests per **account**.

<h3 id="get-invoice-details-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|

|accountId|path|string|true|The account ID.|
|invoiceId|path|string|true|The invoice ID.|

## Update an additional plan

<a id="opIdaccountPlanAddonUpdate"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/accounts/string/plans/addons \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "hosts": 0,
    "type": "string"
  }'
```

`PUT /accounts/{accountId}/plans/addons`

Update an additional plan for a sub account.

This API can only be used by master accounts that pay all billiing charges of their associated Pro or higher sub accounts. Zoom allows only [approved partners](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/master-account-apis) to use master APIs and manage sub accounts' subscriptions. Email the partner programs team at **partner-success@zoom.us** for more details.<br><br>
<br>**Prerequisites:**<br>
* Pro or a higher plan with master account enabled.
* The sub account must be a paid account. The billing charges for the sub account must be paid by the master account.<br><br>

**Scopes**: `billing:master`<br>
**[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Heavy`<br>


 

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "hosts": 0,
  "type": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="update-an-additional-plan-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|accountId|path|string|true|The account ID.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» hosts|body|integer|true|Number of hosts for this plan.|
|» type|body|string|true|Account <a href="https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/other-references/plans">plan type.</a>|

<h3 id="update-an-additional-plan-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**Error Code:** `200`<br><br>Free trial and VIP accounts can't update sub plans.<br><br>You don’t have subscription for ({oldPlanCode}) yet.<br>|None|
|204|No Content|**HTTP Status Code:** `204`<br><br>Additional plan updated for the account.|None|
|300|Multiple Choices|**Error Code:** `300`<br><br>Plan types do not match, oldPlanType: {oldPlanType} newPlanType: {newPlanType}.|None|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400`<br><br>**Error Code:** `2100`<br><br>This sub account is on self pay mode.<br><br>Invalid Additional Plan Type: {newPlanCode}.<br><br>Cannot update Additional plan for a sub account under free plan.<br><br>Invalid plan type.<br><br>Account can’t buy this product.<br><br>Can not subscribe/update additional Audio Conferencing Pay As You Go Plan for a sub account whose base plan is not Business/Education plan.<br><br>Master accounts with bulk licenses cannot provision, update, or cancel plans for sub accounts using APIs, please use the billing portal or contact Support.<br><br>**Error Code:** `3261`<br><br>Failed to change sub plan of account:{accountId}.<br><br>Must subscribe to a major plan first.<br>|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404`<br><br>**Error Code:** `2001`<br><br>Account does not exist: {subAccountId}.<br><br>**Error Code:** `3200`<br><br>Cannot find Zuora subscription for account:{subAccountId}.<br>|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

## Cancel additional plans

<a id="opIdaccountPlanAddonCancel"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/accounts/string/plans/addons/status \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "action": "cancel",
    "comment": "string",
    "reason": 1,
    "type": "string"
  }'
```

`PATCH /accounts/{accountId}/plans/addons/status`

[Cancel additional plan](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/203634215-How-Do-I-Cancel-My-Subscription-) of a sub account. The cancellation does not provide refund for the current subscription. The service remains active for the current session.

This API can only be used by master accounts that pay all billiing charges of their associated Pro or higher sub accounts. Zoom allows only [approved partners](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/master-account-apis) to use master APIs and manage sub accounts' subscriptions. Email the partner programs team at **partner-success@zoom.us** for more details.<br><br>

**[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Heavy`<br>

**Prerequisites:**<br>
* Pro or a higher plan with master account option enabled.
* The sub account must be a paid account.<br>
**Scope:** `billing:master`<br>
 

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "action": "cancel",
  "comment": "string",
  "reason": 1,
  "type": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="cancel-additional-plans-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|accountId|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» action|body|string|false|The action that needs to be taken for this sub account. Value must be set to "cancel".|
|» comment|body|string|false|Additional comments about the cancellation decision.|
|» reason|body|integer|false|The reason for the cancellation of plan. Reason options:<br>`1` - I am no longer working remote.<br>`2` - I had challenges getting the support I needed.<br>`3` - Features in the Basic Free Plan are sufficient.<br>`4` - The expense is too high.<br>`5` - I purchased the wrong product.<br> `6` - Paid purchase not needed right now, will repurchase in the future.|
|» type|body|string|false|Plan [type](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/other-references/plans).|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» action|cancel|
|» reason|1|
|» reason|2|
|» reason|3|
|» reason|4|
|» reason|5|
|» reason|6|

> Example responses

> 204 Response

```json
null
```

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**Error Code:** `200`<br><br>You cannot cancel plan for a sub account that is under a free plan.<br><br>You cannot perform this action because you do not have a Zoom Phone subscription for this account.<br><br>Free trial and VIP accounts can not cancel plans of a sub account. Contact the Zoom Support team for details.<br><br>You don't have a plan subscription for ({planCode}) yet..|None|
|204|No Content|**HTTP Status Code:** `204`<br><br>Plan cancelled successfully. |Inline|
|300|Multiple Choices|**Error Code:** `300`<br><br>Plan type is required.|None|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400`<br> <br>**Error Code:** `2100`<br><br>This sub account is on self pay mode.<br><br>You cannot make cancellation requests for a bundle plan. Contact the Zoom Support team for details.<br><br>Master accounts with bulk licenses cannot provision, update, or cancel plans for sub accounts using APIs, please use the billing portal or contact Support.|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404`<br><br>**Error Code:** `1001`<br><br>User does not exist.<br><br>**Error Code:** `2001`<br> <br>Account does not exist: {subAccountId}.<br><br>|None|

[Cancel a base plan](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/203634215-How-Do-I-Cancel-My-Subscription-) for a sub account.

This API can only be used by master accounts that pay all billiing charges of their associated Pro or higher sub accounts. Zoom allows only [approved partners](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/master-account-apis) to use master APIs and manage sub accounts' subscriptions. Email the partner programs team at **partner-success@zoom.us** for more details.<br><br>

**Scopes**: `billing:master`<br> 
**[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Heavy`<br>
**Prerequisites:**<br>
* The sub account must have a Pro or a higher plan.
 

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "action": "string",
  "comment": "string",
  "reason": 1
}
```

<h3 id="cancel-a-base-plan-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|accountId|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» action|body|string|true|The action that needs to be taken for this sub account. Value must be set to "cancel".|
|» comment|body|string|false|Additional comments about the cancellation decision.|
|» reason|body|integer|false|The reason for the cancellation of plan. Reason options:<br>`1` - I am no longer working remote.<br>`2` - I had challenges getting the support I needed.<br>`3` - Features in the Basic Free Plan are sufficient.<br>`4` - The expense is too high.<br>`5` - I purchased the wrong product.<br> `6` - Paid purchase not needed right now, will repurchase in the future.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» reason|1|
|» reason|2|
|» reason|3|
|» reason|4|
|» reason|5|
|» reason|6|

> Example responses

> 204 Response

```json
{}
```

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**Error Code:** `200`<br><br>Cannot cancel plan for a sub account which is under free plan.<br><br>You don’t have a major subscription yet.<br><br>You should first cancel all additional subscriptions.<br><br>Free trial and VIP accounts can not cancel plans of a sub account. Contact the Zoom Support team for details.<br><br>You don't have a plan subscription for ({planCode}) yet.|None|
|204|No Content|**HTTP Status Code:** `204`<br><br>Plan cancelled successfully. |Inline|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400`<br><br>**Error Code:** `2100`<br><br>This sub account is paid by self.<br><br>You cannot make cancellation requests for a bundle plan. Contact the Zoom Support team for details.<br><br>Master accounts with bulk licenses cannot provision, update, or cancel plans for sub accounts using APIs, please use the billing portal or contact Support.|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404`<br><br>**Error Code:** `1001`<br>User does not exist. <br><br>**Error Code:** `2001`<br>This account does not exist or does not belong to this master account.<br><br><br>|None|

## Get plan usage

<a id="opIdgetPlanUsage"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/accounts/string/plans/usage \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /accounts/{accountId}/plans/usage`

Get information on usage of [plans](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/other-references/plans) of an account. This API supports regular accounts as well as master and sub accounts. To get plan usage of a regular account, use the `account:read:admin` scope and provide “me” as the value of the  `accountId` path parameter.To get plan usage of a master account, provide the keyword "me" as the value of the `accountId` path parameter and use the `billing:master` scope. To get plan usage of a sub account, provide the actual account Id of the sub account as the value of the `accountId` path parameter and use the `billing:master` scope. 

**Prerequisite**:<br>
Account type: master account on a paid Pro, Business or Enterprise plan.<br>
**Scope:** `billing:master` for master and sub accounts. `account:read:admin` for regular Zoom accounts.<br>
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Heavy`

<h3 id="get-plan-usage-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|accountId|path|string|true|none|

```json
{
  "plan_base": {
    "hosts": 2,
    "type": "monthly",
    "usage": 1
  },

      "hosts": 1,

      "usage": 1
    }

      "usage": 1
    }

  "plan_zoom_rooms": {
    "hosts": 1,
    "type": "zroom_monthly",
    "usage": 0
  }
}
```

## Download an invoice file

<a id="opIddownloadInvoicePDF"></a>

```bash
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
```

`GET /api/download/billing/invoices/{invoiceId}`

Download a [billed](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/201363263-About-Billing) invoice file of a Zoom account in PDF format. To download a regular account's invoice or a  master account's invoice, provide `me` as the value of `accountId` path parameter. To download a sub account's invoice, provide the account ID of the sub account in the `accountId` path parameter. 


**Prerequisites:**
* Account must be enrolled in Pro or a higher plan.<br>

**Scope**:`billing:master`<br>
**Rate Limit:** You can make **one** request to this API every **thirty** minutes until the daily limit is reached. This API has a daily limit of **100** requests per **account**.

```json
null
```

`GET /chat/channels/{channelId}`

Zoom chat [channels](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/200912909-Getting-Started-With-Channels-Group-Messaging-) allow users to communicate via chat in private or public groups. Use this API to get information about a specific channel.

**[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`

<p style="background-color:#e1f5fe; color:#01579b; padding:8px"> <b>Note: </b> This API only supports <b>user-managed</b> <a href="https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/guides/getting-started/app-types/create-oauth-app">OAuth app</a>.</p><br>


 

<h3 id="get-a-channel-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|channelId|path|string|true|Channel ID: Unique Identifier of a channel.|

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "id": "ut1234sgfsdf",
  "name": "Leah",
  "type": 1
}
```

<h3 id="get-a-channel-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** `200`<br><br>Channel returned.<br><br><br><br><br>|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400`<br><br>Bad Request<br><br>**Error Code:** `200`<br><br>Unauthorized request. You do not have permission to access this user's channel information.|None|
|404|Not Found|**Status Code:** `404`<br><br>Not found.<br><br>**Error Code:** `4130`<br><br>Channel does not exist: $channelId.|None|

<h3 id="get-a-channel-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|false|none|Channel Id.|
|name|string|false|none|Name of the channel.|
|type|integer|false|none|Type of the channel. The value can be one of the following:<br><br>`1`: Private channel. In this type of channel, members must be invited to join a channel.<br><br>`2`: Private channel with members that belong to one Zoom account. Members in this channel should be invited and the members should be from the same organization.<br><br>`3`: Public channel. Anyone can search for this channel and join the channel.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|1|
|type|2|
|type|3|

`POST /chat/channels/{channelId}/members/me`

A [channel](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/200912909-Getting-Started-With-Channels-Group-Messaging-) can have one or multiple members. The value can be one of the following:<br><br>`1`: **Private channel.** In this type of channel, members must be invited to join a channel.<br><br>`2`: **Private channel with users that belong to the same Zoom account**. Members in this channel should be invited and the members should be from the same organization.<br><br>`3`: **Public channel.** Anyone can search for this channel and join the channel. External members cannot be invited.<br><br>`4`: **New chat**. This is an instant channel which can be created by adding members to a new chat.<br><br>`5`: **Public channel**, similar to above, except members can invite members of other accounts.|
|next_page_token|string|false|none|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|
|page_size|integer|false|none|The number of records returned with a single API call.<br>Default value: 30.|
|total_records|integer|false|none|The total number of records found.|

OAuth

`POST /chat/users/{userId}/channels`

Zoom chat channels allow users to communicate via chat in private or public groups. Use this API to create a channel for a user.<br>
**Scopes**:`chat_channel:write` or `chat_channel:write:admin`<br>

<p style="background-color:#e1f5fe; color:#01579b; padding:8px"> <b>Note: </b> This API supports both user-managed apps and account-level apps. However, in an<b> account-level</b> <a href="https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/guides/getting-started/app-types/create-oauth-app">OAuth app</a>, to create a channel on behalf of another user in the same Zoom account, the user calling this API must have a <a href="https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/115001078646-Using-role-management#:~:text=Each%20user%20in%20a%20Zoom,owner%2C%20administrator%2C%20or%20member.&text=Role%2Dbased%20access%20control%20enables,needs%20to%20view%20or%20edit.">role</a> that has <b>Edit</b> permission for the Chat channels feature.</p><br>

 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`
 


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "members": [
    {
      "email": "user@example.com"
    }
  ],
  "name": "string",
  "type": 1
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-channel-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|userId|path|string|true|Unique identifier of the user.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» members|body|[object]|false|Member(s) to include in the channel. A max of 5 members can be added to the channel at once with this API.|
|» » email|body|string(email)|true|Member's email address.|
|» name|body|string|false|Name of the channel.|
|» type|body|integer|false|Type of the channel. The value can be one of the following:<br><br>`1`: Private channel. In this type of channel, members must be invited to join a channel.<br><br>`2`: Private channel with members that belong to one Zoom account. Members in this channel should be invited and the members should be from the same organization.<br><br>`3`: Public channel. Anyone can search for this channel and join the channel.<br><br>`4`: New chat. This is an instant channel which can be created by adding members to a new chat. |

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» type|1|
|» type|2|
|» type|3|

> Example responses

```json
  "id": "id8977ullamco",
  "jid": "nisi73624365536st",
  "name": "Happy Channel",
  "type": 1
}
```

<h1 id="zoom-api-chat-messages">Chat Messages</h1>

Chat Messages operations

## List user's chat messages

<a id="opIdgetChatMessages"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/chat/users/string/messages \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /chat/users/{userId}/messages`

A Zoom user can have conversations with other Zoom users via chat. Use this API to list the current user's chat messages between the user and an individual contact or a chat channel.<br> In the query parameter, you must provide either of the following:<br>
* `to_contact`: The email address of the contact with whom the user conversed by sending/receiving messages.
* `to_channel`: The channel ID of the channel to/from which the user has sent and/or received messages.

<br> **Specify a date** in the `date` query parameter to view messages from that date. If a date is not provided, the default value for the query will be the **current date**.<br>
<p style="background-color:#e1f5fe; color:#01579b; padding:8px"> <b>Note: </b> For an<b> account-level</b> <a href="https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/guides/getting-started/app-types/create-oauth-app">OAuth app</a>, this API can only be used on behalf of a user who is assigned with a <a href="https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/115001078646-Using-role-management#:~:text=Each%20user%20in%20a%20Zoom,owner%2C%20administrator%2C%20or%20member.&text=Role%2Dbased%20access%20control%20enables,needs%20to%20view%20or%20edit.">role</a> that has <b>View or Edit</b> permission for Chat Messages.</p><br>

<br>**Scopes:** `chat_message:read`, `chat_message:read:admin`<br>

 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`



<h3 id="list-users-chat-messages-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|to_contact|query|string|false|The email address of a chat contact with whom the current user chatted. Messages that were sent and/or received between the user and the contact is displayed.<br><br>Note: You must provide either `contact` or `channel` as a query parameter to retrieve messages either from an individual or a chat channel. |
|to_channel|query|string|false|The channel Id of a channel inside which the current user had chat conversations. Messages that were sent and/or received between the user and the channel is displayed.<br><br>Note: You must provide either `contact` or `channel` as a query parameter to retrieve messages either from an individual or a chat channel. |
|date|query|string(date)|false|The query date for which you would like to get the chat messages.|
|page_size|query|integer|false|The number of records returned with a single API call. |
|next_page_token|query|string|false|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|
|include_deleted_and_edited_message|query|string|false|**Optional** <br><br>Set the value of this field to `true` to include edited and deleted messages in the response.|
|userId|path|string|true|none|

You do not have permission to access this user's chat messages.<br><br>**Error Code:** `300` <br>The next page token is invalid or expired.<br><br>**Error Code:** `300` <br>Must provide either contact or channel parameter.<br><br>**Error Code:** `300` <br>Only provide past chat messages in recent 6 months.<br><br>|None|

|messages|[object]|false|none|List of message(s).|
|» date_time|string|false|none|The date-time at which the message was sent.|

|» message|string|false|none|The message content.|

|» sender|string|false|none|The email address of the sender of the message.|
|» status|string|false|none|This field indicates whether a message is an original message(unedited), an edited message or a deleted message.<br><br>This field is only returned if you set the value of `for include_deleted_and_edited_message` query parameter to `true`.|
|» timestamp|integer(int64)|false|none|The timestamp of the message in microseconds.|
