## Send a chat message

<a id="opIdsendaChatMessage"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/chat/users/string/messages \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "at_items": [
      {
        "at_contact": "string",
        "at_type": 1,
        "end_position": 0,
        "start_position": 0
      }
    ],
    "message": "string",
    "to_channel": "string",
    "to_contact": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /chat/users/{userId}/messages`

Send chat messages on Zoom to either an individual user who is in your contact list or to a [channel](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/200912909-Getting-Started-With-Channels-Group-Messaging-) of which you are a member. To send a message to a contact, provide the contact's email address in the `to_contact` field. Similary, to send a message to a channel, provide the Channel Id of the Channel in `to_channel` field.<br>
<br>**Scopes:** `chat_message:write`, `chat_message:write:admin`<br>
**[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`<br> <p style="background-color:#e1f5fe; color:#01579b; padding:8px"> <b>Note: </b> For an<b> account-level</b> <a href="https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/guides/getting-started/app-types/create-oauth-app">OAuth app</a>, this API can only be used on behalf of a user who is assigned with a <b><a href="https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/115001078646-Using-role-management#:~:text=Each%20user%20in%20a%20Zoom,owner%2C%20administrator%2C%20or%20member.&text=Role%2Dbased%20access%20control%20enables,needs%20to%20view%20or%20edit."> role</a> that has Edit permission for Chat Messages</b>.</p>



> Body parameter

```json
{
  "at_items": [
    {
      "at_contact": "string",
      "at_type": 1,
      "end_position": 0,
      "start_position": 0
    }
  ],
  "message": "string",
  "to_channel": "string",
  "to_contact": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="send-a-chat-message-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|userId|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» at_items|body|[object]|false|[Chat mentions](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360037567431-Using-chat-mentions-and-slash-commands) object. Use this object to include mentions in the message that will be sent to  a channel. |
|» » at_contact|body|string|false|This field is required if the value of `at_type` field is set to 1. <br><br>Email address of the contact. <br><br>|
|» » at_type|body|integer|false|Type of mention. You can use one of the following values:<br><br>* `1`: Mention a contact. <br><br>* `2`: Mention "all" to notify everyone in the channel.|
|» » end_position|body|integer|false|End position of the mention.<br><br>Example message: "@Shrijana How are you?"<br>In this case, the end position of the mention "@Shrijana" is 8. Hence, the value of this field will be 8.|
|» » start_position|body|integer|false|Start position of the mention("@") in the message string. <br><br>For example if you want to include the mention at the beginning of the message, the value for this field will be 0. <br><br>Example message: "@Shrijana How are you?"<br><br>|
|» message|body|string|true|The message to be sent.|
|» to_channel|body|string|false|The Channel Id of the channel where you would like to send a message.|
|» to_contact|body|string|false|The email address of the contact to whom you would like to send the message.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» » at_type|1|
|» » at_type|2|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "id": "ex35785hgdfjgt"
}
```

<h3 id="send-a-chat-message-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|**Status Code:** `201`<br><br>Message sent.|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400`<br><br>Bad request.<br><br>**Error Code:** `5301`<br><br>Message sending failed.|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404`<br><br>**Error Code**: `1001`<br><br>User does not exist: $to_contact.<br><br>**Error Code**: `4130`<br><br>Channel does not exist: $to_channel.|None|

<h3 id="send-a-chat-message-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **201**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|false|none|Message ID: Unique Identifier of the message.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

## Update a message

<a id="opIdeditMessage"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/chat/users/string/messages/string \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "message": "string",
    "to_channel": "string",
    "to_contact": "string"
  }'
```

`PUT /chat/users/{userId}/messages/{messageId}`

Each chat message has a unique identifier. Use this API to edit a chat message that you previously sent to either a contact or a channel in Zoom by providing the ID of the message as the value of the `messageId` parameter. The ID can be retrieved from List User's Chat Messages API. Additionally, as a query parameter, you must provide either the **email address** of the contact or the **Channel ID** of the channel where the message was sent. 

**Scope:** `chat_message:write`,`chat_message:write:admin`	<br>
**[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium` 

</b> For an<b> account-level</b> <a href="https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/guides/getting-started/app-types/create-oauth-app">OAuth app</a>, this API can only be used on behalf of a user who is assigned with a <b><a href="https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/115001078646-Using-role-management#:~:text=Each%20user%20in%20a%20Zoom,owner%2C%20administrator%2C%20or%20member.&text=Role%2Dbased%20access%20control%20enables,needs%20to%20view%20or%20edit."> role</a> that has Edit permission for Chat Messages</b>.</p>
**Scope:** `chat_message:write`, `chat_message:write:admin`<br>








> Body parameter

```json
{
  "message": "string",
  "to_channel": "string",
  "to_contact": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-message-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|messageId|path|string|true|Message ID: Unique Identifier of the message.|
|userId|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» message|body|string|false|The edited message.|
|» to_channel|body|string|false|The Channel ID of the channel where you sent the message.<br>You must provide either `to_contact` or `to_channel` parameter in the API request.<br> Channel ID can be retrieved from List User's Channels API. |
|» to_contact|body|string|false|The email address of the contact to whom the message was sent.<br><br>You must provide either `to_contact` or `to_channel` parameter in the API request.|

<h3 id="update-a-message-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|**HTTP Status Code:** `204`<br><br>Message updated successfully.|None|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400`<br><br>Bar request<br><br>**Error Code:** `200`<br><br>Only the sender of this message can make updates.<br><br>**Error Code:** `300`<br><br>Message does not exist: $messageId <br> Must provide either contact or channel parameter.<br>|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404`<br><br>**Error Code**: `1001`<br><br>User does not exist: $to_contact.<br><br>**Error Code**: `4130`<br><br>Channel does not exist: $to_channel.|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

## Delete a message

<a id="opIddeleteChatMessage"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/chat/users/string/messages/string \
  -X DELETE \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /chat/users/{userId}/messages/{messageId}`

Delete a chat message that you previously sent to a contact or a channel. In the query parameter, you must provide either of the following:<br>
* `to_contact`: The email address of the contact to whom you sent the message. Use this parameter to delete a message sent to an individual contact in Zoom.
* `to_channel`: The channel ID of the channel where you sent the message. Use this parameter to delete a message sent to a channel in Zoom.

<p style="background-color:#e1f5fe; color:#01579b; padding:8px"> <b>Note: </b> For an<b> account-level</b> <a href="https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/guides/getting-started/app-types/create-oauth-app">OAuth app</a>, this API can only be used on behalf of a user who is assigned with a <b><a href="https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/115001078646-Using-role-management#:~:text=Each%20user%20in%20a%20Zoom,owner%2C%20administrator%2C%20or%20member.&text=Role%2Dbased%20access%20control%20enables,needs%20to%20view%20or%20edit."> role</a> that has Edit permission for Chat Messages</b>.</p>

**Scope:** `chat_message:write`, `chat_message:write:admin`<br>

 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`

<h3 id="delete-a-message-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|messageId|path|string|true|Message ID|
|to_contact|query|string|false|The userId or email address of a chat contact to whom you previously sent the message.<br><br>Note: You must provide either `to_contact` or `to_channel` as a query parameter to delete a message that was previously sent to either an individual or a chat channel respectively. |
|to_channel|query|string|false|The channel Id of the channel where you would like to send the message.<br><br>You must provide either `to_contact` or `to_channel` as a query parameter to delete a message that was previously sent to either an individual or a chat channel |
|userId|path|string|true|none|

<h3 id="delete-a-message-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|**HTTP Status Code:** `204`<br><br>Message deleted.|None|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400`<br><br>Bad request.<br><br>**Error Code:** `200`<br><br>The contact or the channel parameter provided is invalid.<br><br>Only the sender of this message can make updates.<br><br>**Error Code:** `300`<br>Channel does not exist: $messageId<br>Must provide either contact or channel parameter.|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404`<br><br>**Error Code**: `1001`<br><br>User does not exist: $to_contact.<br><br>**Error Code**: `4130`<br><br>Channel does not exist: $to_channel.|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

<h1 id="zoom-api-chatbot-messages">Chatbot Messages</h1>

## Send chatbot messages

<a id="opIdsendchatbot"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/im/chat/messages \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "account_id": "string",
    "content": {},
    "is_markdown_support": true,
    "robot_jid": "string",
    "to_jid": "string",
    "user_jid": "string",
    "visible_to_user": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /im/chat/messages`

Send chatbot messages from your marketplace chatbot app.<br><br>
**Scopes:** `imchat:bot`<br>
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`<br>
**Authorization Flow**: Client Credentials Flow<br><br>
To get authorized, make a POST request to `/oauth/token` endpoint with grant type as `client_credentials`. <br>Use `https://api.zoom.us/oauth/token?grant_type=client_credentials` as the endpoint for the request. 
You will need to send your ClientID and Secret as a Basic base64 encoded AUthorization header. Ex. `Basic base64Encode({client_id}:{client_sceret})`<br><br> Next, use the token recieved (access_token) as a bearer token while making the POST /im/chat/messages request to send chatbot messages.<br><br>
Learn more about how to authorize chatbots in the [Chatbot Authorization](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/guides/chatbots/authorization) guide.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "account_id": "string",
  "content": {},
  "is_markdown_support": true,
  "robot_jid": "string",
  "to_jid": "string",
  "user_jid": "string",
  "visible_to_user": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="send-chatbot-messages-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» account_id|body|string|true|Account ID of the authorized account.|
|» content|body|object|true|JSON template describing how the message should be displayed for the user. For more information please see our ["Send Message" templates](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/guides/chatbots/sending-messages#example-request).|
|» is_markdown_support|body|boolean|false|**Optional**<br><br>Applies the markdown parser to your chatbot message if the value of this field is set to `true`.<br> To learn more, refer to the Chatbot message [markdown reference](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/guides/chatbots/customizing-messages/message-with-markdown).|
|» robot_jid|body|string|true|Robot JID created when enabling chatbot features on your marketplace app.|
|» to_jid|body|string|true|Unique JID of reciever. Can be a group or user.|
|» user_jid|body|string|false|**Optional**<br><br>The UserJID of the user on whose behalf the message is being sent. Use this field to prevent members of a channel from getting notifications that were set up by a user who has left the channel.|
|» visible_to_user|body|string|false|**Optional**<br>Allow a Chatbot to send a message to a group channel, but have only one designated person in that group channel see the message by providing the person's UserID in this field.|

<h3 id="send-chatbot-messages-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** `200` **OK**<br><br>Message Sent.|None|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400` **Bad Request**<br><br>**Error Code:** `7001`<br><br>Link does not support markdown format.<br><br>Edit message does not support markdown format.|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
Client_Credentials
</aside>

## Edit a chatbot message

<a id="opIdeditChatbotMessage"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/im/chat/messages/string \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "account_id": "string",
    "content": {},
    "is_markdown_support": true,
    "robot_jid": "string",
    "user_jid": "string"
  }'
```

`PUT /im/chat/messages/{message_id}`

Edit a message that was [sent](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/im-chat/sendchatbot) by your Chatbot app.<br> After sending a message using the Send Chatbot Message API, you must store the messageId returned in the response so that you can make edits to the associated message using this API.

**Scope:** `imchat:bot`<br>
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`<br>
**Authorization Flow**: Client Credentials Flow<br><br>
To get authorized, make a POST request to `/oauth/token` endpoint with grant type as `client_credentials`. <br>Use `https://api.zoom.us/oauth/token?grant_type=client_credentials` as the endpoint for the request. 
You will need to send your ClientID and Secret as a Basic base64 encoded AUthorization header. Ex. `Basic base64Encode({client_id}:{client_sceret})`<br><br> Next, use the token received (access_token) as a bearer token while making the PUT /im/chat/messages/{message_id} request to edit a chatbot message.<br><br>
Learn more about how to authotize chatbots in the [Chatbot Authorization](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/guides/chatbots/authorization) guide.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "account_id": "string",
  "content": {},
  "is_markdown_support": true,
  "robot_jid": "string",
  "user_jid": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="edit-a-chatbot-message-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|message_id|path|string|true|Unique Identifier of the message that needs to be updated. This should be retrieved from the response of [Send Chatbot Message API](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/im-chat/sendchatbot).|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» account_id|body|string|true|The AccountID of the Zoom account to which the message was sent. Retrieve this from the Chatbot request sent to your server as shown in the example [here]( https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/guides/chatbots/sending-messages).|
|» content|body|object|true|JSON template describing how the edited message should be displayed for the user. For more information please see our ["Send Message" templates](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/guides/chatbots/sending-messages#example-request).|
|» is_markdown_support|body|boolean|false|**Optional**<br><br>Enable or disable markdown parser to your chatbot message. Applies the markdown parser to your chatbot message if the value of this field is set to `true`.<br> To learn more, refer to the Chatbot message [markdown reference](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/guides/chatbots/customizing-messages/message-with-markdown).|
|» robot_jid|body|string|true|Robot JID created when enabling chatbot features on your marketplace app.|
|» user_jid|body|string|false|**Optional**<br><br>The UserJID of the user on whose behalf the message is being sent. Use this field to prevent members of a channel from getting notifications that were set up by a user who has left the channel.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "message_id": "201910tryyRFjM_main",
  "robot_jid": "v1pky3tyBBB5pl8q@xmpp.zoom.us",
  "sent_time": "2019-10-17 01:40:24",
  "to_jid": "xghfd@shj.zoom.us",
  "user_jid": "jnrgfjp6w@xmpp.zoom.us"
}
```

<h3 id="edit-a-chatbot-message-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** `200` **OK**<br><br>Message updated.|Inline|

<h3 id="edit-a-chatbot-message-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|message_id|string|false|none|Unique Identifier of the updated message,|
|robot_jid|string|false|none|The BotJID found in the Chat Subscription Section on the Features page of your App Dashboard.|
|sent_time|string(date-time)|false|none|The date and time at which the message was sent.|
|to_jid|string|false|none|The JID of the Channel or User to whom the message was sent.|
|user_jid|string|false|none|The UserJID of the user on whose behalf the message is being sent. Used to prevent members of a channel from getting notifications that were set up by a user who has left the channel.|

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
Client_Credentials


`DELETE /im/chat/messages/{message_id}`

Delete a message that was sent by your chatbot app.<br><br> **Scopes:** `imchat:bot`<br> **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`<br>**Authorization Flow**: Client Credentials Flow<br><br>To get authorized, make a POST request to `/oauth/token` endpoint with grant type as `client_credentials`. <br>Use `https://api.zoom.us/oauth/token?grant_type=client_credentials` as the endpoint for the request. 
You will need to send your ClientID and Secret as a Basic base64 encoded AUthorization header. Ex. `Basic base64Encode({client_id}:{client_sceret})`<br><br> Next, use the token received (access_token) as a bearer token while making the DELETE /im/chat/messages/{message_id} request to delete a message.<br><br>
Learn more about how to authotize chatbots in the [Chatbot Authorization](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/guides/chatbots/authorization) guide.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "account_id": "string",
  "robot_jid": "string",
  "user_jid": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="delete-a-chatbot-message-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|message_id|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» account_id|body|string|true|The AccountID of the Zoom account to which the message was sent. Retrieve this from the Chatbot request sent to your server as shown in the example [here]( https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/guides/chatbots/sending-messages).|
|» robot_jid|body|string|true|The BotJID found in the Chat Subscription Section on the Features page of your App Dashboard.|
|» user_jid|body|string|false|The UserJID of the user on whose behalf the message is being sent. Used to prevent members of a channel from getting notifications that were set up by a user who has left the channel.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "message_id": "20191017014024747_XYYRFjM_main",
  "robot_jid": "v1pky3qsaoqqwdfdsaf5pl8q@xmppdev.zoom.us",
  "sent_time": "2019-10-17 01:40:24",
  "to_jid": "xxx@conference.xmppdev.zoom.us",
  "user_jid": "jnr_3e_eq4cveeafp3qp6w@xmppdev.zoom.us"
}
```

<h3 id="delete-a-chatbot-message-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** `200` **OK**<br><br>Message deleted.|Inline|

<h3 id="delete-a-chatbot-message-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|message_id|string|false|none|Unique identifier of the message that was deleted.|
|robot_jid|string|false|none|The BotJID of the Chatbot app. It can be found in the Chat Subscription Section on the Features page of your App Dashboard|
|sent_time|string|false|none|The date and time at which the message was deleted.|
|to_jid|string|false|none|The JID of the Channel or User to whom the message was sent.|
|user_jid|string|false|none| The UserJID of the user on whose behalf the message was sent. Used to prevent members of a channel from getting notifications that were set up by a user who has left the channel.|

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
Client_Credentials

<h1 id="zoom-api-contacts">Contacts</h1>

Contacts operations

## List user's contacts

<a id="opIdgetUserContacts"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/chat/users/me/contacts \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /chat/users/me/contacts`

A user under an organization’s Zoom account has internal users listed under Company Contacts in the Zoom Client. A Zoom user can also add another Zoom user as a [contact](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/115004055706-Managing-Contacts). Call this API to list all the contacts of a Zoom user. Zoom contacts are categorized into "company contacts" and "external contacts". You must specify the contact type in the `type` query parameter. If you do not specify, by default, the type will be set as company contact.

<p style="background-color:#e1f5fe; color:#01579b; padding:8px"> <b>Note: </b> This API only supports <b>user-managed</b> <a href="https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/guides/getting-started/app-types/create-oauth-app">OAuth app</a>.</p><br>

**Scope**: `chat_contact:read`<br>

 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`

<h3 id="list-users-contacts-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|type|query|string|false|The type of contact. The value can be one of the following:<br>`company`: Contacts from the user's organization.<br>`external`: External contacts. |
|page_size|query|integer|false|The number of records returned with a single API call.|
|next_page_token|query|string|false|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "contacts": [
    {
      "email": "someemail@somemail.com",
      "first_name": "Brandon",
      "id": "44ABCDEfgjWHABBxw",
      "last_name": "Ghimire"
    }
  ],
  "next_page_token": "shdjksA4",
  "page_size": 10
}
```

<h3 id="list-users-contacts-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** `200`<br>List of user's contacts returned.|Inline|
|300|Multiple Choices|**Error Code:** `300`<br><br>The next page token is invalid or has expired.|None|

<h3 id="list-users-contacts-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|contacts|[object]|false|none|The contacts object.|
|» email|string(email)|false|none|Contact's email address.|
|» first_name|string|false|none|Contact's first name.|
|» id|string|false|none|Contact Id.|
|» last_name|string|false|none|Contact's last name.|
|next_page_token|string|false|none|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|
|page_size|integer|false|none|The number of records returned with a single API call.<br>Default value: 30.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

## Get user's contact details

<a id="opIdgetUserContact"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/chat/users/me/contacts/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /chat/users/me/contacts/{contactId}`

A user under an organization’s Zoom account has internal users listed under Company Contacts in the Zoom Client. A Zoom user can also add another Zoom user as a [contact](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/115004055706-Managing-Contacts). Call this API to get information on a specific contact of the Zoom user.

<p style="background-color:#e1f5fe; color:#01579b; padding:8px"> <b>Note: </b>This API only supports <b>user-managed</b> <a href="https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/guides/getting-started/app-types/create-oauth-app">OAuth app</a>.</p><br>

**Scope**: `chat_contact:read`<br>

 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`

<h3 id="get-users-contact-details-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|contactId|path|string|true|The user's contact Id or email address. The contact can be either a company contact or an external contact.|
|query_presence_status|query|boolean|false|The presence status of the contact. <br>Include this query parameter with a value of `true` to get the presence status of the contact in the response.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "email": "dhgdj@djkfhd.dhgfdh",
  "first_name": "Vikram",
  "id": "u487547sic45ing",
  "last_name": "Grg",
  "presence_status": "Do_Not_Disturb"
}
```

<h3 id="get-users-contact-details-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** `200`<br><br>Contact information returned.<br><br><br>|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400`<br><br>Bad request<br><br>**Error Code:** `5301`<br><br>Request to get the presence status of the chat contact failed.|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404`<br><br>**Error Code**: `1001`<br><br>User does not exist: $contactId|None|

<h3 id="get-users-contact-details-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|direct_numbers|[string]|false|none|Direct number(s) assigned to the contact.|
|email|string(email)|false|none|Contact's email address.|
|extension_number|string|false|none|Extension number of the contact.|
|first_name|string|false|none|Contact's first name|
|id|string|false|none|User ID of the contact.|
|last_name|string|false|none|Contact's last name|
|phone_number|string|false|none|Phone number of the contact.|
|presence_status|string|false|none|Contact's Presence Status in the Zoom Chat Client. The status can be one of the following: <br> `Do_Not_Disturb`<br> `Away`<br> `Available`<br> `Offline`|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|presence_status|Do_Not_Disturb|
|presence_status|Away|
|presence_status|Available|
|presence_status|Offline|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

## Search company contacts

<a id="opIdsearchCompanyContacts"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/contacts?search_key=string' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /contacts`

A user under an organization's Zoom account has internal users listed under Company Contacts in the Zoom Client. Use this API to search users that are in the company contacts of a Zoom account. Using the `search_key` query parameter, provide either first name, last name or the email address of the user that you would like to search for. Optionally, set `query_presence_status` to `true` in order to include the presence status of a contact. <br><br>

**Scopes:** `contact:read:admin`, `contact:read`<br>

 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium` 

<h3 id="search-company-contacts-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|search_key|query|string|true|Provide the keyword - either first name, last name or email of the contact whom you have to search for.|
|query_presence_status|query|string|false|Set `query_presence_status` to `true` in order to include the presence status of a contact in the response.|
|page_size|query|integer|false|The number of records to be returned with a single API call.|
|next_page_token|query|string|false|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "contacts": [
    {
      "direct_numbers": [
        111111,
        222222
      ],
      "email": "qui@djfsd.sdfjhdf",
      "extension_number": "010",
      "first_name": "John",
      "id": "isds324bdfsf",
      "im_group_id": "fhksdhfew34hjds",
      "im_group_name": "Engineering",
      "last_name": "Doe",
      "phone_number": "00000000",
      "presence_status": "Offline",
      "sip_phone_number": "11111111"
    }
  ],
  "next_page_token": " ",
  "page_size": 1
}
```

<h3 id="search-company-contacts-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** `200`<br><br>Contact returned successfully.|Inline|

<h3 id="search-company-contacts-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|contacts|[object]|false|none|none|
|» dept|string|false|none|Department of the contact as provided in the user's Zoom profile.|
|» direct_numbers|[string]|false|none|Direct Number(s) of a user who has Zoom Phone license assigned.|
|» email|string|false|none|Email address of the contact.|
|» extension_number|string|false|none|Extension Number of a user who has Zoom Phone license assigned.|

An IM Directory group is not the same as a channel. IM Directory allows administrators to assign users in their account to groups that display within the Contacts list on Zoom clients. |

An IM Directory group is not the same as a channel. IM Directory allows administrators to assign users in their account to groups that display within the Contacts list on Zoom clients. |
|» job_title|string|false|none|Department of the user as provided in the user's Zoom profile.|

<h1 id="zoom-api-cloud-recording">Cloud Recording</h1>

Cloud Recording operations

## List recordings of an account

<a id="opIdgetAccountCloudRecording"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/accounts/string/recordings \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /accounts/{accountId}/recordings`

List [Cloud Recordings](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/203741855-Cloud-Recording) available on an Account.

> To access a password protected cloud recording, add an "access_token" parameter to the download URL and provide [JWT](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/guides/getting-started/app-types/create-jwt-app) as the value of the "access_token".
<br>
**Prerequisites**:<br>
* A Pro or a higher paid plan with Cloud Recording option enabled.<br>
**Scopes**: `recording:read:admin` or `account:read:admin`

If the scope `recording:read:admin` is used, the Account ID of the Account must be provided in the `accountId` path parameter to list recordings that belong to the Account. This scope only works for sub accounts. 

To list recordings of a master account, the scope must be `account:read:admin` and the value of `accountId` should be `me`.<br>  **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`<br>


<h3 id="list-recordings-of-an-account-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|page_size|query|integer|false|The number of records returned within a single API call.|
|next_page_token|query|string|false|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|
|from|query|string(date-time)|false|The start date in UTC for the monthly range for which you would like to retrieve recordings. The maximum range can be a month. If no value is provided for this field, the default will be current date. For example, if you make the API request on June 30, 2020, without providing the “from” and “to” parameters, by default the value of 'from' field will be “2020-06-30” and the value of the 'to' field will be “2020-07-01”.|
|to|query|string(date-time)|false|The end date for the monthly range for which you would like to retrieve recordings. The maximum range can be a month.|
|accountId|path|string|true|Unique identifier of the account.|

> Example responses

## List archived files

<a id="opIdlistArchivedFiles"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/archive_files \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /archive_files`

Zoom’s [archiving solution](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360050431572-Archiving-Meeting-and-Webinar-data) allows account administrators to set up an automated mechanism to record, collect and archive meeting data to a 3rd party platform of their choice and hence, satisfy FINRA and/ or other compliance requirements.<br><br>
Use this API to retrieve archived meeting or webinar files of an account.

**Scope:** `recording:read:admin`<br>
**[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`<br><br>
**Prerequisites:** <br>
* Enable cloud recording.
* Follow the [enablement process](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360050431572-Archiving-Meeting-and-Webinar-data#h_01ENPBD3WR68D7FAKTBY92SG45) to access the archiving feature.

<h3 id="list-archived-files-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|page_size|query|integer|false|The number of records returned within a single API call.|
|next_page_token|query|string|false|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|
|from|query|string|false|Start date for the query in "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'" format. The duration for the query defined using the "from" and "to" parameters should not exceed 7 days as this API only provides a week's data at once.|
|to|query|string|false|End date for the query in "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'" format. |
|query_data_type|query|string|false|Query data type for `from` and `to`.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|query_data_type|meeting_start_time|
|query_data_type|archive_complete_time|

## Get meeting recordings

<a id="opIdrecordingGet"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/meetings/string/recordings \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /meetings/{meetingId}/recordings`

Get all the [recordings](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/203741855-Cloud-Recording#h_7420acb5-1897-4061-87b4-5b76e99c03b4) from a meeting or Webinar instance.<br><br> The recording files can be downloaded via the `download_url` property listed in the response.

> To access a password protected cloud recording, add an "access_token" parameter to the download URL and provide OAuth access token or [JWT](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/guides/getting-started/app-types/create-jwt-app) as the value of the "access_token".
<br>

**Scopes:** `recording:read:admin` `recording:read`<br>
 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`



<h3 id="get-meeting-recordings-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|meetingId|path|string|true|To get Cloud Recordings of a meeting, provide the meeting ID or meeting UUID. If the meeting ID is provided instead of UUID,the response will be for the latest meeting instance. <br><br>To get Cloud Recordings of a webinar, provide the webinar ID or the webinar UUID. If the webinar ID is provided instead of UUID,the response will be for the latest webinar instance. <br><br>If a UUID starts with "/" or contains "//" (example: "/ajXp112QmuoKj4854875=="), you must **double encode** the UUID before making an API request. |
|include_fields|query|string|false|Get the `download_access_token` field for downloading meeting recordings.|
|ttl|query|integer|false|Time to live (TTL) of the `download_access_token`. This is only valid if the `include_fields` query parameter contains `download_access_token`. The range is between 0-604800.|

Use the generated JWT token as the value of the `access_token` query parameter and include this query parameter at the end of the URL as shown in the example.**  <br><br><br>Example: `https://api.zoom.us/recording/download/{{ Download Path }}?access_token={{ JWT Token }}`<br><br>**Similarly, if the user has installed your OAuth app that contains recording scope(s), you can also use the user's [OAuth access token](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/guides/auth/oauth) to download the Cloud Recording.**<br><br><br>Example: `https://api.zoom.us/recording/download/{{ Download Path }}?access_token={{ OAuth Access Token }}`<br><br>|

The value of this field could be one of the following:<br><br>`MP4`: Video file of the recording.<br>`M4A` Audio-only file of the recording.<br>`TIMELINE`: Timestamp file of the recording in JSON file format. To get a timeline file, the "Add a timestamp to the recording" setting must be enabled in the [recording settings](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/203741855-Cloud-recording#h_3f14c3a4-d16b-4a3c-bbe5-ef7d24500048). The time will display in the host's timezone, set on their Zoom profile.<br><br> `TRANSCRIPT`: Transcription file of the recording in VTT format.<br> `CHAT`: A TXT file containing in-meeting chat messages that were sent during the meeting.<br>`CC`: File containing closed captions of the recording in VTT file format.<br>`CSV`: File containing polling data in csv format.<br><br><br><br><br>A recording file object with file type of either `CC` or `TIMELINE` **does not have** the following properties:<br><br>	`id`, `status`, `file_size`, `recording_type`, and `play_url`.|
|» id|string|false|none|The recording file ID. Included in the response of general query.|
|» meeting_id|string|false|none|The meeting ID. |
|» play_url|string|false|none|The URL using which a recording file can be played.|
|» recording_end|string|false|none|The recording end time. Response in general query.|
|» recording_start|string|false|none|The recording start time.|
|» recording_type|string|false|none|The recording type. The value of this field can be one of the following:<br>`shared_screen_with_speaker_view(CC)`<br>`shared_screen_with_speaker_view`<br>`shared_screen_with_gallery_view`<br>`speaker_view`<br>`gallery_view`<br>`shared_screen`<br>`audio_only`<br>`audio_transcript`<br>`chat_file`<br>`active_speaker`<br>`poll`|
|» status|string|false|none|The recording status.|
|download_access_token|string|false|none|JWT token for downloading the meeting recording.<br> This is only returned if the `include_fields` query parameter contains `download_access_token`.|

|---|---|

## Delete meeting recordings

<a id="opIdrecordingDelete"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/meetings/string/recordings \
  -X DELETE \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /meetings/{meetingId}/recordings`

Delete all recording files of a meeting.<br><br>

**Scopes:** `recording:write:admin` `recording:write`<br> 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`<br>
**Prerequisites**:
* Cloud Recording should be enabled on the user's account.<br>


<h3 id="delete-meeting-recordings-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|meetingId|path|string|true|To get Cloud Recordings of a meeting, provide the meeting ID or meeting UUID. If the meeting ID is provided instead of UUID,the response will be for the latest meeting instance. <br><br>To get Cloud Recordings of a webinar, provide the webinar ID or the webinar UUID. If the webinar ID is provided instead of UUID,the response will be for the latest webinar instance. <br><br>If a UUID starts with "/" or contains "//" (example: "/ajXp112QmuoKj4854875=="), you must **double encode** the UUID before making an API request. |
|action|query|string|false|The recording delete actions:<br>`trash` - Move recording to trash.<br>`delete` - Delete recording permanently.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|action|trash|
|action|delete|

|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404` <br><br>Meeting recording not found<br>**Error Code:** `1001` <br> User {userId} does not exist or does not belong to this account.<br><br>**Error Code:** `3301`<br>There is no recording for this meeting.<br>|None|

## List recording registrants

<a id="opIdmeetingRecordingRegistrants"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/meetings/0/recordings/registrants \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /meetings/{meetingId}/recordings/registrants`

Cloud Recordings of past Zoom Meetings can be made [on-demand](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360000488283-On-demand-Recordings). Users should be [registered](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/cloud-recording/meetingrecordingregistrantcreate) to view these recordings.

Use this API to list registrants of **On-demand Cloud Recordings** of a past meeting.<br>
**Scopes:** `recording:read:admin`, `recording:read`.<br>
 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`


<h3 id="list-recording-registrants-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|meetingId|path|integer(int64)|true|The meeting ID in **long** format. The data type of this field is "long"(represented as int64 in JSON).<br><br>While storing it in your database, store it as a **long** data type and **not as an integer**, as the Meeting IDs can be longer than 10 digits.|
|status|query|string|false|The registrant status:<br>`pending` - Registrant's status is pending.<br>`approved` - Registrant's status is approved.<br>`denied` - Registrant's status is denied.|
|page_size|query|integer|false|The number of records returned within a single API call.|
|page_number|query|integer|false|<br>**Deprecated** - This field has been deprecated and we will stop supporting it completely in a future release. Please use "next_page_token" for pagination instead of this field.<br><br>The page number of the current page in the returned records.|
|next_page_token|query|string|false|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|status|pending|
|status|approved|
|status|denied|

`POST /meetings/{meetingId}/recordings/registrants`

Cloud Recordings of past Zoom Meetings can be made [on-demand](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360000488283-On-demand-Recordings). Users should be [registered](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/cloud-recording/meetingrecordingregistrantcreate) to view these recordings.

Use this API to register a user to gain access to **On-demand Cloud Recordings** of a past meeting.<br>
**Scopes:** `recording:write:admin`, `recording:write`.<br>
 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`



> Body parameter

```json
{
  "address": "string",
  "city": "string",
  "comments": "string",
  "country": "string",
  "custom_questions": [
    {
      "title": "string",
      "value": "string"
    }
  ],
  "email": "string",
  "first_name": "string",
  "industry": "string",
  "job_title": "string",
  "last_name": "string",
  "no_of_employees": "string",
  "org": "string",
  "phone": "string",
  "purchasing_time_frame": "string",
  "role_in_purchase_process": "string",
  "state": "string",
  "zip": "string"
}
```

|---|---|---|---|---|
|meetingId|path|integer(int64)|true|The meeting ID in **long** format. The data type of this field is "long"(represented as int64 in JSON).<br><br>While storing it in your database, store it as a **long** data type and **not as an integer**, as the Meeting IDs can be longer than 10 digits.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» address|body|string|false|Registrant's address.|
|» city|body|string|false|Registrant's city.|
|» comments|body|string|false|A field that allows registrants to provide any questions or comments that they might have.|
|» country|body|string|false|Registrant's country. The value of this field must be in two-letter abbreviated form and must match the ID field provided in the [Countries](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/other-references/abbreviation-lists#countries) table.|
|» custom_questions|body|[object]|false|Custom questions.|
|» » title|body|string|false|none|
|» » value|body|string|false|none|
|» email|body|string|true|A valid email address of the registrant.|
|» first_name|body|string|true|Registrant's first name.|
|» industry|body|string|false|Registrant's Industry.|
|» job_title|body|string|false|Registrant's job title.|
|» last_name|body|string|false|Registrant's last name.|
|» no_of_employees|body|string|false|Number of Employees:<br>`1-20`<br>`21-50`<br>`51-100`<br>`101-500`<br>`500-1,000`<br>`1,001-5,000`<br>`5,001-10,000`<br>`More than 10,000`|
|» org|body|string|false|Registrant's Organization.|
|» phone|body|string|false|Registrant's Phone number.|
|» purchasing_time_frame|body|string|false|This field can be included to gauge interest of webinar attendees towards buying your product or service.<br><br>Purchasing Time Frame:<br>`Within a month`<br>`1-3 months`<br>`4-6 months`<br>`More than 6 months`<br>`No timeframe`|
|» role_in_purchase_process|body|string|false|Role in Purchase Process:<br>`Decision Maker`<br>`Evaluator/Recommender`<br>`Influencer`<br>`Not involved` |
|» state|body|string|false|Registrant's State/Province.|

## Get registration questions

<a id="opIdrecordingRegistrantsQuestionsGet"></a>

`GET /meetings/{meetingId}/recordings/registrants/questions`

For [on-demand](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360000488283-On-demand-Recordings) meeting recordings, you can include fields with questions that will be shown to registrants when they register to view the recording.

Use this API to retrieve a list of questions that are displayed for users to complete when registering to view the recording of a specific meeting.<br>
**Scopes:** `recording:read:admin`, `recording:read`<br>

 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`


<h3 id="get-registration-questions-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|meetingId|path|string|true|To get Cloud Recordings of a meeting, provide the meeting ID or meeting UUID. If the meeting ID is provided instead of UUID,the response will be for the latest meeting instance. <br><br>To get Cloud Recordings of a webinar, provide the webinar ID or the webinar UUID. If the webinar ID is provided instead of UUID,the response will be for the latest webinar instance. <br><br>If a UUID starts with "/" or contains "//" (example: "/ajXp112QmuoKj4854875=="), you must **double encode** the UUID before making an API request. |

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "custom_questions": [
    {
      "answers": [
        "Yes",
        "No"
      ],
      "required": false,
      "title": "Would you like us to contact you for a survey?",
      "type": "multiple"
    }
  ],
  "questions": [
    {
      "field_name": "address",
      "required": false
    }
  ]
}
```

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** `200`<br><br>Recording Registrant Question object returned.|Inline|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404`<br><br>Meeting recording or registrant not found.|None|

<h3 id="get-registration-questions-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|custom_questions|[object]|false|none|Array of Registrant Custom Questions|
|» answers|[string]|false|none|Answer choices for the question. Can not be used with Short answer type.|
|» required|boolean|false|none|State whether registrants are required to answer custom questions or not.|
|» title|string|false|none|Title of the question.|
|» type|string|false|none|The type of registration question and answers.|
|questions|[object]|false|none|Array of Registrant Questions|
|» field_name|string|false|none|Field name.|
|» required|boolean|false|none|State whether the field is required to be answered by the registrant or not.|

## Recover meeting recordings

<a id="opIdrecordingStatusUpdate"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/meetings/string/recordings/status \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "action": "recover"
  }'
```

`PUT /meetings/{meetingId}/recordings/status`

Zoom allows users to recover recordings from trash for up to 30 days from the deletion date. Use this API to recover all deleted [Cloud Recordings](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/203741855-Cloud-Recording) of a specific meeting.<br><br>
**Scopes**: `recording:write:admin` `recording:write`<br>
 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`<br>
**Prerequisites**:<br>
* A Pro user with Cloud Recording enabled.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "action": "recover"
}
```

<h3 id="recover-meeting-recordings-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|meetingId|path|string|true|To get Cloud Recordings of a meeting, provide the meeting ID or meeting UUID. If the meeting ID is provided instead of UUID,the response will be for the latest meeting instance. <br><br>To get Cloud Recordings of a webinar, provide the webinar ID or the webinar UUID. If the webinar ID is provided instead of UUID,the response will be for the latest webinar instance. <br><br>If a UUID starts with "/" or contains "//" (example: "/ajXp112QmuoKj4854875=="), you must **double encode** the UUID before making an API request. |
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» action|body|string|false|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» action|recover|

<h3 id="recover-meeting-recordings-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**Error Code:** `200`<br><br>You do not have the right permissions.|None|
|204|No Content|**HTTP Status Code:** `204` <br><br>Deleted recordings of the meeting recovered.|None|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400` <br><br>**Error Code:** `1010`<br><br>User does not belong to this account: {accountId}.|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404` <br><br>Meeting recording not found.<br> **Error Code:** `1001`<br>  User does not exist: {userId}.<br><br>**Error Code:** `3301`<br>There is no recording for this meeting.<br><br><br><br>|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

## List all recordings

<a id="opIdrecordingsList"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/users/string/recordings \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /users/{userId}/recordings`

When a user records a meeting or a webinar by choosing the **Record to the Cloud** option, the video, audio, and chat text are recorded in the Zoom cloud. 

Use this API to list all [Cloud recordings](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/203741855-Cloud-Recording) of a user.<br>
> To access a user's password protected cloud recording, add an "access_token" parameter to the download URL and provide either the [JWT](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/guides/getting-started/app-types/create-jwt-app) or the user's OAuth access token as the value of the "access_token" parameter. 
<br>

**Scopes:** `recording:read:admin` `recording:read`  <br>
 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`<br>
**Prerequisites:** 
* Pro or a higher plan.
* Cloud Recording must be enabled on the user's account.

<h3 id="list-all-recordings-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|userId|path|string|true|The user ID or email address of the user. For user-level apps, pass `me` as the value for userId.|
|page_size|query|integer|false|The number of records returned within a single API call.|
|next_page_token|query|string|false|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|
|mc|query|string|false|Query Metadata of Recording if an On-Premise Meeting Connector was used for the meeting.|
|trash|query|boolean|false|Query trash.<br>`true`: List recordings from trash.<br> `false`: Do not list recordings from the trash.<br> The default value is `false`. If you set it to `true`, you can use the `trash_type` property to indicate the type of Cloud recording that you need to retrieve. |
|from|query|string(date)|false|The start date in 'yyyy-mm-dd' UTC format for the date range for which you would like to retrieve recordings. The maximum range can be a month. If no value is provided for this field, the default will be current date. For example, if you make the API request on June 30, 2020, without providing the “from” and “to” parameters, by default the value of 'from' field will be “2020-06-30” and the value of the 'to' field will be “2020-07-01”. <br><br>**Note**: The "trash" files cannot be filtered by date range and thus, the "from" and "to" fields should not be used for trash files.|
|to|query|string(date)|false|End date in 'yyyy-mm-dd' 'yyyy-mm-dd' UTC format. |
|trash_type|query|string|false|The type of Cloud recording that you would like to retrieve from the trash. The value can be one of the following:<br><br>    `meeting_recordings`: List all meeting recordings from the trash.<br><br>    `recording_file`: List all individual recording files from the trash. |

> Example responses

> 200 Response


<h3 id="list-all-recordings-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

|» host_id|string|false|none|ID of the user set as host of meeting.|
|» id|string|false|none|Meeting ID - also known as the meeting number.|
|» recording_count|string|false|none|Number of recording files returned in the response of this API call.|
|» start_time|string(date-time)|false|none|The time at which the meeting started.|
|» topic|string|false|none|Meeting topic.|
|» total_size|string|false|none|Total size of the recording.|
|» type|string|false|none|Type of the meeting that was recorded.<br><br>Meeting Types:<br>`1` - Instant meeting.<br>`2` - Scheduled meeting.<br>`3` - Recurring meeting with no fixed time.<br>`8` - Recurring meeting with fixed time.|
|» uuid|string|false|none|Unique Meeting Identifier. Each instance of the meeting will have its own UUID.|
|» recording_files|[object]|false|none|List of recording file.|
|» » deleted_time|string|false|none|The time at which recording was deleted. Returned in the response only for trash query.|
|» » download_url|string|false|none|The URL using which the recording file can be downloaded. **To access a private or password protected cloud recording of a user in your account, you can use a [Zoom JWT App Type](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/guides/getting-started/app-types/create-jwt-app). Use the generated JWT token as the value of the `access_token` query parameter and include this query parameter at the end of the URL as shown in the example.**  <br><br><br>Example: `https://api.zoom.us/recording/download/{{ Download Path }}?access_token={{ JWT Token }}`<br><br>**Similarly, if the user has installed your OAuth app that contains recording scope(s), you can also use the user's [OAuth access token](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/guides/auth/oauth) to download the Cloud Recording.**<br><br><br>Example: `https://api.zoom.us/recording/download/{{ Download Path }}?access_token={{ OAuth Access Token }}`<br><br>|
|» » file_size|number|false|none|The recording file size.|
|» » file_type|string|false|none|The recording file type. The value of this field could be one of the following:<br><br>`MP4`: Video file of the recording.<br>`M4A` Audio-only file of the recording.<br>`TIMELINE`: Timestamp file of the recording in JSON file format. To get a timeline file, the "Add a timestamp to the recording" setting must be enabled in the [recording settings](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/203741855-Cloud-recording#h_3f14c3a4-d16b-4a3c-bbe5-ef7d24500048). The time will display in the host's timezone, set on their Zoom profile.<br><br> `TRANSCRIPT`: Transcription file of the recording in VTT format.<br> `CHAT`: A TXT file containing in-meeting chat messages that were sent during the meeting.<br>`CC`: File containing closed captions of the recording in VTT file format.<br>`CSV`: File containing polling data in csv format.<br><br><br><br><br>A recording file object with file type of either `CC` or `TIMELINE` **does not have** the following properties:<br><br>	`id`, `status`, `file_size`, `recording_type`, and `play_url`.|
|» » id|string|false|none|The recording file ID. Included in the response of general query.|
|» » meeting_id|string|false|none|The meeting ID. |
|» » play_url|string|false|none|The URL using which a recording file can be played.|
|» » recording_end|string|false|none|The recording end time. Response in general query.|
|» » recording_start|string|false|none|The recording start time.|
|» » recording_type|string|false|none|The recording type. The value of this field can be one of the following:<br>`shared_screen_with_speaker_view(CC)`<br>`shared_screen_with_speaker_view`<br>`shared_screen_with_gallery_view`<br>`speaker_view`<br>`gallery_view`<br>`shared_screen`<br>`audio_only`<br>`audio_transcript`<br>`chat_file`<br>`active_speaker`<br>`poll`|
|» » status|string|false|none|The recording status.|

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|» » status|completed|

## List Zoom meetings client feedback

<a id="opIddashboardClientFeedback"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/metrics/client/feedback?from=1970-01-01&to=1970-01-01' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /metrics/client/feedback`

Retrieve survey results from [Zoom meetings client feedback](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/115005855266-End-of-Meeting-Feedback-Survey#h_e30d552b-6d8e-4e0a-a588-9ca8180c4dbf). <br> You can specify a monthly date range for the dashboard data using the `from` and `to` query parameters. The month should fall within the last six months.

**Prerequisites:**
* Business or higher account
* [Feedback to Zoom](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/115005838023) enabled.

**Scope:** `account:read:admin`<br>

 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Heavy`

<h3 id="list-zoom-meetings-client-feedback-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|from|query|string(date)|true|Start date in 'yyyy-mm-dd' format. The date range defined by the "from" and "to" parameters should only be one month as the report includes only one month worth of data at once.|
|to|query|string(date)|true|End date.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json

      "feedback_name": "They could not hear us.",
      "participants_count": 2
    }
  ],
  "from": "2013-03-16",
  "to": "2013-04-16",
  "total_records": 2
}
```

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** `200`<br><br>Client Feedback details returned.|Inline|

|» participants_count|integer|false|none|The number of participants that upvoted the feedback.|
|from|string(date)|false|none|Start date for this report|

## List client meeting satisfaction

<a id="opIdlistMeetingSatisfaction"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/metrics/client/satisfaction \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /metrics/client/satisfaction`

If the [End of Meeting Feedback Survey](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/115005855266) option is enabled, attendees will be prompted with a survey window where they can tap either the **Thumbs Up** or **Thumbs Down** button that indicates their Zoom meeting experience. With this API, you can get information on the attendees' meeting satisfaction. Specify a monthly date range for the query using the from and to query parameters. The month should fall within the last six months.

To get information on the survey results with negative experiences (indicated by **Thumbs Down**), use the [Get Zoom Meetings Client Feedback API](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/dashboards/dashboardclientfeedbackdetail).<br>
**Scopes:** `dashboard:read:admin`<br>
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Heavy`

<h3 id="list-client-meeting-satisfaction-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|from|query|string(date)|false|The start date for the query in “yyyy-mm-dd” format. |
|to|query|string(date)|false|The end date for the query in “yyyy-mm-dd” format. |

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "client_satisfaction": [
    {
      "date": "2019-08-05",
      "good_count": 5,
      "none_count": 0,
      "not_good_count": 1,
      "satisfaction_percent": 100
    },
    {
      "date": "2019-08-06",
      "good_count": 0,
      "none_count": 0,
      "not_good_count": 0,
      "satisfaction_percent": 100
    }
  ],
  "from": "2019-08-05",
  "to": "2019-09-05",
  "total_records": 30
}
```

<h3 id="list-client-meeting-satisfaction-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** `200`<br><br>Client satisfaction data returned. |Inline|

<h3 id="list-client-meeting-satisfaction-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|client_satisfaction|[object]|false|none|none|
|» date|string(date)|false|none|Date of the report.|
|» good_count|integer|false|none|The total number of "thumbs up" received for this meeting.|
|» none_count|integer|false|none|The total number of attendees who didn't submit any response (neither thumbs up nor thumbs down).|
|» not_good_count|integer|false|none|The total number of "thumbs down" received for this meeting.|
|» satisfaction_percent|integer(int64)|false|none|Satisfaction Percentage.<br>The satisfaction percentage is calculated as `(good_count + none_count)` / `total_count`.|
|from|string(date)|false|none|Start date for this report in 'yyyy-mm-dd' format.|
|to|string(date)|false|none|End date for this report in 'yyyy-mm-dd' format.|
|total_records|integer|false|none|The total number of records available across all pages.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

## Get CRC port usage

<a id="opIddashboardCRC"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/metrics/crc?from=1970-01-01&to=1970-01-01' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /metrics/crc`

A Cloud Room Connector allows H.323/SIP endpoints to connect to a Zoom meeting. 

Use this API to get the hour by hour CRC Port usage for a specified period of time. <aside class='notice'>We will provide the report for a maximum of one month. For example, if "from" is set to "2017-08-05" and "to" is set to "2017-10-10", we will adjust "from" to "2017-09-10".</aside><br><br>
**Prerequisites:**<br>
* Business, Education or API Plan.
* Room Connector must be enabled on the account.<br><br>
**Scopes:** `dashboard_crc:read:admin`<br>
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Heavy` 

<h3 id="get-crc-port-usage-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|from|query|string(date)|true|Start date in 'yyyy-mm-dd' format. The date range defined by the "from" and "to" parameters should only be one month as the report includes only one month worth of data at once.|
|to|query|string(date)|true|End date.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "crc_ports_usage": [
    {
      "crc_ports_hour_usage": [
        {
          "hour": "sed",
          "max_usage": 8,
          "total_usage": 14
        }
      ],
      "date_time": "2019-05-01T15:13:39.424Z"
    }
  ],
  "from": "2019-04-03",
  "to": "2019-04-04"
}
```

<h3 id="get-crc-port-usage-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** `200`<br><br>CRC usage returned.<br><br>Only available for paid accounts that have enabled the Dashboard feature.|Inline|

<h3 id="get-crc-port-usage-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|from|string(date)|false|none|Start date for this report.|
|to|string(date)|false|none|End date for this report.|
|crc_ports_usage|[object]|false|none|none|
|» crc_ports_hour_usage|[object]|false|none|none|
|» » hour|string|false|none|Hour in the day, during which the CRC was used. For example if the CRC was used at 11 pm, the value of this field will be 23.|
|» » max_usage|integer|false|none|The maximum number of concurrent ports that are being used in that hour.|
|» » total_usage|integer|false|none|The total number of H.323/SIP connections in that hour.|
|» date_time|string(date-time)|false|none|The date and time of the port usage.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

## List meetings

<a id="opIddashboardMeetings"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/metrics/meetings?from=1970-01-01&to=1970-01-01' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /metrics/meetings`

List total live or past meetings that occurred during a specified period of time. This overview will show if features such as audio, video, screen sharing, and recording were being used in the meeting. You can also see the license types of each user on your account.<br> You can specify a monthly date range for the dashboard data using the `from` and `to` query parameters. The month should fall within the last six months.<br>
**Scopes:** `dashboard_meetings:read:admin`<br>
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Resource-intensive`<br><br>
**Prerequisites:** <br>
* Business or a higher plan.<br><br>

<h3 id="list-meetings-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|type|query|string|false|Specify a value to get the response for the corresponding meeting type. The value of this field can be one of the following:<br> <br>`past` - Meeting that already occurred in the specified date range.<br>`pastOne` - Past meetings that were attended by only one user. <br>`live` - Live meetings.<br><br><br><br>If you do not provide this field, the default value will be `live` and thus, the API will only query responses for live meetings.|
|from|query|string(date)|true|Start date in 'yyyy-mm-dd' format. The date range defined by the "from" and "to" parameters should only be one month as the report includes only one month worth of data at once.|
|to|query|string(date)|true|End date.|
|page_size|query|integer|false|The number of records returned within a single API call.|
|next_page_token|query|string|false|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|
|include_fields|query|string|false|Set the value of this field to "tracking_fields" if you would like to include tracking fields of each meeting in the response.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|type|past|
|type|pastOne|
|type|live|
|include_fields|tracking_fields|

```json
  "from": "string [date]",
  "meetings": [

      "duration": "string",
      "email": "string",
      "end_time": "string [date-time]",
      "has_3rd_party_audio": "boolean",
      "has_pstn": "boolean",
      "has_recording": "boolean",
      "has_screen_share": "boolean",
      "has_sip": "boolean",
      "has_video": "boolean",
      "has_voip": "boolean",
      "host": "string",
      "id": "integer",
      "participants": "integer",
      "start_time": "string [date-time]",
      "topic": "string",
      "user_type": "string",
      "uuid": "string [uuid]"
    }
  ],
  "next_page_token": "string",
  "page_count": "integer",
  "page_size": "integer",
  "to": "string [date]",
  "total_records": "integer"
}
```

|300|Multiple Choices|**Error Code:** `300`<br><br>The next page token is invalid or expired.|None|

## List meeting participants

<a id="opIddashboardMeetingParticipants"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/metrics/meetings/string/participants \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /metrics/meetings/{meetingId}/participants`

Get a list of participants from live or past meetings.<br><br>
If you do not provide the `type` query parameter, the default value will be set to `live` and thus, you will only see metrics for participants in a live meeting, if any meeting is currently being conducted. To view metrics on past meeting participants, provide the appropriate value for `type`. <br> You can specify a monthly date range for the dashboard data using the `from` and `to` query parameters. The month should fall within the last six months.

**Scopes:** `dashboard_meetings:read:admin`<br>
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Heavy`<br>
**Prerequisites:** Business or a higher plan.

<h3 id="list-meeting-participants-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|meetingId|path|string|true|The meeting ID or the meeting UUID.  If a meeting ID is provided in the request instead of a UUID, the response will be for the latest meeting instance.<br><br>If a UUID starts with "/" or contains "//" (example: "/ajXp112QmuoKj4854875==\"), you must **double encode** the UUID before making an API request.|
|type|query|string|false|The meeting types: <br>`past` - Past meetings.<br>`pastOne` - Past one user meetings.<br>`live` - Live meetings.|
|page_size|query|integer|false|The number of records returned within a single API call.|
|next_page_token|query|string|false|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|
|include_fields|query|string|false|Provide `registrant_id` as the value for this field if you would like to see the registrant ID attribute in the response of this API call. A registrant ID is a unique identifier of a [meeting registrant](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/meetings/meetingregistrants). This is not supported for `live` meeting types.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|type|past|
|type|pastOne|
|type|live|
|include_fields|registrant_id|

## List meeting participants QoS

<a id="opIddashboardMeetingParticipantsQOS"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/metrics/meetings/string/participants/qos \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /metrics/meetings/{meetingId}/participants/qos`

Get a list of meeting participants from live or past meetings along with the quality of service they recieve during the meeting such as connection quality for sending/receiving video, audio, and shared content.<br>If you do not provide the `type` query parameter, the default value will be set to `live` and thus, you will only see metrics for participants in a live meeting, if any meeting is currently being conducted. To view metrics on past meeting participants, provide the appropriate value for `type`.<br> <br> You can specify a monthly date range for the dashboard data using the `from` and `to` query parameters. The month should fall within the last six months.<br><br>
**Scopes:** `dashboard_meetings:read:admin`<br>
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Heavy`<br>
**Prerequisites:** <br>
* Business or a higher plan.

<h3 id="list-meeting-participants-qos-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|meetingId|path|string|true|The meeting ID or the meeting UUID.  If a meeting ID is provided in the request instead of a UUID, the response will be for the latest meeting instance.<br><br>If a UUID starts with "/" or contains "//" (example: "/ajXp112QmuoKj4854875==\"), you must **double encode** the UUID before making an API request.|
|type|query|string|false|The meeting types: <br>`past` - Past meetings.<br>`live` - Live Meetings.|
|page_size|query|integer|false|The number of items returned per page.|
|next_page_token|query|string|false|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|type|past|
|type|pastOne|
|type|live|
