## Get post meeting feedback

<a id="opIdparticipantFeedback"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/metrics/meetings/string/participants/satisfaction \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /metrics/meetings/{meetingId}/participants/satisfaction`

When a meeting ends, each attendee will be prompted to share their meeting experience by clicking either thumbs up or thumbs down. Use this API to retrieve the feedback submitted for a specific meeting. Note that this API only works for meetings scheduled after December 20, 2020.

**Prerequisites:**
* [Feedback to Zoom](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/115005838023) setting must be enabled by the participant prior to the meeting.
* The user making the API request must be enrolled in a Business or a higher plan.

<br> **Scope:** `dashboard_meetings:read:admiin`

**[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Heavy`<br>

<h3 id="get-post-meeting-feedback-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|meetingId|path|string|true|The meeting ID or the meeting UUID.  If a meeting ID is provided in the request instead of a UUID, the response will be for the latest meeting instance.<br><br>If a UUID starts with "/" or contains "//" (example: "/ajXp112QmuoKj4854875==\"), you must **double encode** the UUID before making an API request.|
|type|query|string|false|Specify a value to get the response for the corresponding meeting type. The value of this field can be one of the following:<br> <br>`past` - Meeting that already occurred in the specified date range.<br>`pastOne` - Past meetings that were attended by only one user. <br>`live` - Live meetings.<br><br><br><br>If you do not provide this field, the default value will be `live` and thus, the API will only query responses for live meetings.|
|next_page_token|query|string|false|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|
|page_size|query|integer|false|The number of records returned within a single API call.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|type|past|
|type|pastOne|
|type|live|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "next_page_token": "",
  "page_size": 1,
  "participants": [
    {
      "date_time": "2021-02-21T18:48:06.423Z",
      "email": "RB6iBb@aWlMmuZFPVjptyOCzNgpi.mx",
      "quality": "GOOD",
      "user_id": "aegr46312rum"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="get-post-meeting-feedback-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** `200`<br><br><br>|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400`<br><br>**Error Code:** `200`<br><br>Only available for paid accounts that have dashboard feature enabled.<br>|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404`<br><br>**Error Code:** `3001`<br><br>Meeting ID is invalid or not end.|None|

<h3 id="get-post-meeting-feedback-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|next_page_token|string|false|none|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|
|page_size|integer|false|none|The number of records returned within a single API call.|
|participants|[object]|false|none|none|
|» date_time|string(date-time)|false|none|Date and time at which the feedback was submitted.|
|» email|string(email)|false|none|Email address of the participant.|
|» quality|string|false|none|Feedback submitted by the participant. <br><br>* `GOOD`: Thumbs up.<br>* `NOT GOOD`: Thumbs down.|
|» user_id|string|false|none|User ID of the participant.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|» quality|GOOD|
|» quality|NOT GOOD|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

## Get sharing/recording details

<a id="opIddashboardMeetingParticipantShare"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/metrics/meetings/string/participants/sharing \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /metrics/meetings/{meetingId}/participants/sharing`

Retrieve the sharing and recording details of participants from live or past meetings.<br>
**Scopes:** `dashboard_meetings:read:admin`<br>
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Heavy`<br>
**Prerequisites:** <br>
* Business or a higher plan.

<h3 id="get-sharingrecording-details-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|meetingId|path|string|true|The meeting ID or the meeting UUID.  If a meeting ID is provided in the request instead of a UUID, the response will be for the latest meeting instance.<br><br>If a UUID starts with "/" or contains "//" (example: "/ajXp112QmuoKj4854875==\"), you must **double encode** the UUID before making an API request.|
|type|query|string|false|The meeting types: <br>`past` - Past meetings.<br>`live` - Live Meetings.|
|page_size|query|integer|false|The number of records returned within a single API call.|
|next_page_token|query|string|false|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceed the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|type|past|
|type|pastOne|
|type|live|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "next_page_token": "string",
  "page_count": "integer",
  "page_size": "integer",
  "participants": [
    {
      "details": [
        {
          "content": "string",
          "end_time": "string",
          "start_time": "string"
        }
      ],
      "id": "string",
      "user_id": "string",
      "user_name": "string"
    }
  ],
  "total_records": "integer"
}
```

<h3 id="get-sharingrecording-details-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** `200`<br><br>Meeting participants returned.|Inline|
|300|Multiple Choices|**Error Code:** `300`<br><br>Can not access webinar info, {meetingId}.|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404`<br><br>**Error Code:** `3001`<br><br>This meeting's detail info is not available or ID is not valid.|None|

<h3 id="get-sharingrecording-details-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|next_page_token|string|false|none|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|
|page_count|integer|false|none|The number of pages returned for the request made.|
|page_size|integer|false|none|The number of records returned within a single API call.|
|total_records|integer|false|none|The number of all records available across pages.|
|participants|[object]|false|none|Array of participants.|
|» details|[object]|false|none|Array of sharing and recording details.|
|» » content|string|false|none|Type of content shared.|
|» » end_time|string|false|none|End time of sharing.|
|» » start_time|string|false|none|Start time of sharing.|
|» id|string|false|none|Universally unique identifier of the Participant. It is the same as the User ID of the participant if the participant joins the meeting by logging into Zoom. If the participant joins the meeting without logging in, the value of this field will be blank.|
|» user_id|string|false|none|Participant ID. This is a unique ID assigned to the participant joining a meeting and is valid for that meeting only.|
|» user_name|string|false|none|Participant display name.|

OAuth

## Get meeting participant QoS

<a id="opIddashboardMeetingParticipantQOS"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/metrics/meetings/string/participants/string/qos \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /metrics/meetings/{meetingId}/participants/{participantId}/qos`

Retrieve the quality of service for participants from live or past meetings. This data indicates the connection quality for sending/receiving video, audio, and shared content. If nothing is being sent or received at that time, no information will be shown in the fields. <br><br>
**Scopes:** `dashboard_meetings:read:admin`<br>
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Heavy`

<h3 id="get-meeting-participant-qos-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|meetingId|path|string|true|The meeting ID or the meeting UUID.  If a meeting ID is provided in the request instead of a UUID, the response will be for the latest meeting instance.<br><br>If a UUID starts with "/" or contains "//" (example: "/ajXp112QmuoKj4854875==\"), you must **double encode** the UUID before making an API request.|
|participantId|path|string|true|Participant ID.|
|type|query|string|false|The meeting types: <br>`past` - Past meetings.<br>`live` - Live Meetings.|

|---|---|
|type|past|
|type|pastOne|

## List webinars

<a id="opIddashboardWebinars"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/metrics/webinars?from=1970-01-01&to=1970-01-01' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /metrics/webinars`

List all the live or past webinars from a specified period of time. <br><br>
**Scopes:** `dashboard_webinars:read:admin`<br>
**[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Resource-intensive`<br>
**Prerequisites:**<br>
* Business, Education or API Plan with Webinar add-on.




<h3 id="list-webinars-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|type|query|string|false|The webinar type.|
|from|query|string(date)|true|Start date in 'yyyy-mm-dd' format. The date range defined by the "from" and "to" parameters should only be one month as the report includes only one month worth of data at once.|
|to|query|string(date)|true|End date.|
|page_size|query|integer|false|The number of records returned within a single API call.|
|next_page_token|query|string|false|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|type|past|
|type|live|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "from": "string [date]",
  "next_page_token": "string",
  "page_count": "integer",
  "page_size": "integer",
  "to": "string [date]",
  "total_records": "integer",
  "webinars": [
    {
      "duration": "string",
      "email": "string",
      "end_time": "string [date-time]",
      "has_3rd_party_audio": "boolean",
      "has_pstn": "boolean",
      "has_recording": "boolean",
      "has_screen_share": "boolean",
      "has_sip": "boolean",
      "has_video": "boolean",
      "has_voip": "boolean",
      "host": "string",
      "id": "integer",
      "participants": "integer",
      "start_time": "string [date-time]",
      "topic": "string",
      "user_type": "string",
      "uuid": "string [uuid]"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="list-webinars-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** `200`<br><br>Meetings returned.<br><br>Only available for paid accounts that have enabled the Dashboard feature.|Inline|
|300|Multiple Choices|**Error Code:** `200`<br><br>The next page token is invalid or has expired.|None|

<h3 id="list-webinars-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|

|next_page_token|string|false|none|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|
|page_count|integer|false|none|The number of pages returned for the request made.|
|page_size|integer|false|none|The number of records returned within a single API call.|
|total_records|integer|false|none|The number of all records available across pages.|
|webinars|[object]|false|none|Array of webinar objects.|
|» custom_keys|[object]|false|none|Custom keys and values assigned to the Webinar.|
|» » key|string|false|none|Custom key associated with the Webinar.|
|» » value|string|false|none|Value of the custom key associated with the Webinar.|

|» has_video|boolean|false|none|Indicates whether or not video was used for the Webinar.|
|» has_voip|boolean|false|none|Indicates whether or not VoIP was used for the Webinar.|

## Get webinar details

<a id="opIddashboardWebinarDetail"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/metrics/webinars/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /metrics/webinars/{webinarId}`

Retrieve details from live or past webinars.<br><br>
**Scopes:** `dashboard_webinars:read:admin`<br>
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Heavy`<br>
**Prerequisites:**<br>
* Business, Education or API Plan with Webinar add-on.



<h3 id="get-webinar-details-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|

If a webinar ID is provided in the request instead of a UUID, the response will be for the latest webinar instance.<br><br>If a UUID starts with "/" or contains "//" (example: "/ajXp112QmuoKj4854875==\"), you must **double encode** the UUID before making an API request.|
|type|query|string|false|The webinar type.|

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|type|past|
|type|live|

## Get post webinar feedback

<a id="opIdparticipantWebinarFeedback"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/metrics/webinars/string/participants/satisfaction \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /metrics/webinars/{webinarId}/participants/satisfaction`

When a Webinar ends, each attendee will be prompted to share their Webinar experience by clicking either thumbs up or thumbs down. Use this API to retrieve the feedback submitted for a specific webinar. Note that this API only works for meetings scheduled after December 20, 2020.

**Prerequisites:**
* [Feedback to Zoom](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/115005838023) setting must be enabled by the participant prior to the meeting.
* The user making the API request must be enrolled in a Business or a higher plan.


<br> **Scope:** `dashboard_webinars:read:admin`

**[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Heavy`<br>

<h3 id="get-post-webinar-feedback-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|type|query|string|false|Specify a value to get the response for the corresponding meeting type. The value of this field can be one of the following:<br> <br>`past` - Meeting that already occurred in the specified date range.<br>`pastOne` - Past meetings that were attended by only one user. <br>`live` - Live meetings.<br><br><br><br>If you do not provide this field, the default value will be `live` and thus, the API will only query responses for live meetings.|
|page_size|query|integer|false|The number of records returned within a single API call.|
|next_page_token|query|string|false|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|
|webinarId|path|string|true|The webinar ID or the webinar UUID.  If a webinar ID is provided in the request instead of a UUID, the response will be for the latest webinar instance.<br><br>If a UUID starts with "/" or contains "//" (example: "/ajXp112QmuoKj4854875==\"), you must **double encode** the UUID before making an API request.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|type|past|
|type|pastOne|
|type|live|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "next_page_token": "",
  "page_size": 1,
  "participants": [
    {
      "date_time": "2021-02-21T18:48:06.423Z",
      "email": "RB6iBb@aWlMmuZFPVjptyOCzNgpi.mx",
      "quality": "GOOD",
      "user_id": "aegr46312rum"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="get-post-webinar-feedback-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** `200`<br><br><br>|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400`<br><br>**Error Code:** `200`<br><br>Only available for paid accounts that have dashboard feature enabled.<br>|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404`<br><br>**Error Code:** `3001`<br><br>Webinar ID is invalid or not end.|None|

<h3 id="get-post-webinar-feedback-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|next_page_token|string|false|none|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|
|page_size|integer|false|none|The number of records returned within a single API call.|
|participants|[object]|false|none|none|
|» date_time|string(date-time)|false|none|Date and time at which the feedback was submitted.|
|» email|string(email)|false|none|Email address of the participant.|
|» quality|string|false|none|Feedback submitted by the participant. <br><br>* `GOOD`: Thumbs up.<br>* `NOT GOOD`: Thumbs down.|
|» user_id|string|false|none|User ID of the participant.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|» quality|GOOD|
|» quality|NOT GOOD|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

## Get sharing/recording details

<a id="opIddashboardWebinarParticipantShare"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/metrics/webinars/string/participants/sharing \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /metrics/webinars/{webinarId}/participants/sharing`

Retrieve the sharing and recording details of participants from live or past webinars. <br><br>
**Scopes:** `dashboard_webinars:read:admin`<br>
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Heavy` <br>
**Prerequisites:**<br>
* Business, Education or API Plan with Webinar add-on.



<h3 id="get-sharingrecording-details-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|webinarId|path|string|true|The webinar ID or the webinar UUID.  If a webinar ID is provided in the request instead of a UUID, the response will be for the latest webinar instance.<br><br>If a UUID starts with "/" or contains "//" (example: "/ajXp112QmuoKj4854875==\"), you must **double encode** the UUID before making an API request.|
|type|query|string|false|The webinar type.|
|page_size|query|integer|false|The number of records returned within a single API call.|
|next_page_token|query|string|false|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceed the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|type|past|
|type|live|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "next_page_token": "string",
  "page_count": "integer",
  "page_size": "integer",
  "participants": [
    {
      "details": [
        {
          "content": "string",
          "end_time": "string",
          "start_time": "string"
        }
      ],
      "id": "string",
      "user_id": "string",
      "user_name": "string"
    }
  ],
  "total_records": "integer"
}
```

<h3 id="get-sharingrecording-details-1-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** `200`<br><br>Webinar participants returned.<br><br>Only available for paid accounts that have enabled the Dashboard feature.|Inline|
|300|Multiple Choices|**Error Code:** `300`<br><br>Can not access webinar info, {webinarId}.|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404`<br><br>**Error Code:** `3001`<br><br>This webinar's detail info is not available or ID is not valid.<br><br>This webinar has not ended yet.|None|

<h3 id="get-sharingrecording-details-1-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|next_page_token|string|false|none|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|
|page_count|integer|false|none|The number of pages returned for the request made.|
|page_size|integer|false|none|The number of records returned within a single API call.|
|total_records|integer|false|none|The number of all records available across pages.|
|participants|[object]|false|none|Array of participants.|
|» details|[object]|false|none|Array of sharing and recording details.|
|» » content|string|false|none|Type of content shared.|
|» » end_time|string|false|none|End time of sharing.|
|» » start_time|string|false|none|Start time of sharing.|
|» id|string|false|none|Universally unique identifier of the Participant. It is the same as the User ID of the participant if the participant joins the meeting by logging into Zoom. If the participant joins the meeting without logging in, the value of this field will be blank.|
|» user_id|string|false|none|Participant ID. This is a unique ID assigned to the participant joining a meeting and is valid for that meeting only.|
|» user_name|string|false|none|Participant display name.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

## Get webinar participant QoS

<a id="opIddashboardWebinarParticipantQOS"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/metrics/webinars/string/participants/string/qos \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /metrics/webinars/{webinarId}/participants/{participantId}/qos`

Retrieve details on the quality of service that participants from live or past webinars recieved.<br>This data indicates the connection quality for sending/receiving video, audio, and shared content. If nothing is being sent or received at that time, no information will be shown in the fields.<br>
**Scopes:** `dashboard_webinars:read:admin`<br>
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Heavy` <br>
**Prerequisites:** <br>
* Business, Education or API Plan with Zoom Rooms set up.


<h3 id="get-webinar-participant-qos-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|webinarId|path|string|true|The webinar ID or the webinar UUID.  If a webinar ID is provided in the request instead of a UUID, the response will be for the latest webinar instance.<br><br>If a UUID starts with "/" or contains "//" (example: "/ajXp112QmuoKj4854875==\"), you must **double encode** the UUID before making an API request.|
|participantId|path|string|true|Participant ID.|
|type|query|string|false|The webinar type.|

|---|---|
|type|past|
|type|live|

## List Zoom Rooms

<a id="opIddashboardZoomRooms"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/metrics/zoomrooms \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /metrics/zoomrooms`

List information on all Zoom Rooms in an account.<br><br>
**Scopes:** `dashboard_zr:read:admin`

 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Resource-intensive`<br>
 **Prerequisites:**<br>
* Business, Education or API Plan with Zoom Rooms set up.




<h3 id="list-zoom-rooms-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|page_size|query|integer|false|The number of records returned within a single API call.|
|page_number|query|integer|false|The page number of the current page in the returned records.|
|next_page_token|query|string|false|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "page_count": 1,
  "page_number": 1,
  "page_size": 30,
  "total_records": 1,
  "zoom_rooms": [
    {
      "account_type": "Work Email",
      "calendar_name": "ghjghdjd@sjdfhjdf.gjgg",
      "camera": "Integrated Webcam",
      "device_ip": "Computer : 10.10.26.49",
      "email": "ghjghdjd@sjdfhjdf.gjgg",
      "health": "critical",
      "id": "EbgjgjhghZY9wh0A",
      "issues": [
        "Zoom room is offline"
      ],
      "last_start_time": "2019-08-29T16:37:07Z",
      "microphone": "Microphone Array (Realtek Audio)",
      "room_name": "testZoomRoom",
      "speaker": "Speakers / Headphones (Realtek Audio)",
      "status": "Offline"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="list-zoom-rooms-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** `200`<br><br>List of Zoom rooms returned.<br><br>Only available for paid accounts that have enabled the Dashboard feature.|Inline|

<h3 id="list-zoom-rooms-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|next_page_token|string|false|none|none|
|page_count|integer|false|none|The number of pages returned for the request made.|
|page_number|integer|false|none|The page number of the current results.|
|page_size|integer|false|none|The number of records returned with a single API call.|
|total_records|integer|false|none|The total number of all the records available across pages.|
|zoom_rooms|[object]|false|none|Array of Zoom Rooms|
|» account_type|string|false|none|Zoom room email type.|
|» calender_name|string|false|none|Zoom calendar name.|
|» camera|string|false|none|Zoom room camera.|
|» device_ip|string|false|none|Zoom room device IP.|
|» email|string|false|none|Zoom room email.|
|» health|string|false|none|none|
|» id|string|false|none|Zoom room ID.|
|» issues|[string]|false|none|Zoom Room issues.|
|» last_start_time|string|false|none|Zoom room last start time.|
|» location|string|false|none|Zoom room location.|
|» microphone|string|false|none|Zoom room microphone.|
|» room_name|string|false|none|Zoom room name.|
|» speaker|string|false|none|Zoom room speaker.|
|» status|string|false|none|Zoom room status.|

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth

## Get top 25 issues of Zoom Rooms

<a id="opIddashboardZoomRoomIssue"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/metrics/zoomrooms/issues?from=1970-01-01&to=1970-01-01' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /metrics/zoomrooms/issues`

Get top 25 issues of Zoom Rooms.<br>
**Scopes:** `dashboard_zr:read:admin`<br>

 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Heavy`<br>
 **Prerequisites:**<br>
* Business, Education or API Plan with Zoom Rooms set up.



<h3 id="get-top-25-issues-of-zoom-rooms-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|from|query|string(date)|true|Start date in 'yyyy-mm-dd' format. The date range defined by the "from" and "to" parameters should only be one month as the report includes only one month worth of data at once.|
|to|query|string(date)|true|End date.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "from": "2019-08-15",
  "room_issues": [
    {
      "issue_name": "Controller disconnected",
      "zoom_rooms_count": 1
    },
    {
      "issue_name": "Controller is not charging",
      "zoom_rooms_count": 1
    }
  ],
  "to": "2019-09-15",
  "total_records": 2
}
```

<h3 id="get-top-25-issues-of-zoom-rooms-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** `200`<br><br>Zoom Room Issue details returned|Inline|

<h3 id="get-top-25-issues-of-zoom-rooms-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|from|string(date)|false|none|Start date for this report|
|to|string(date)|false|none|End date for this report|
|total_records|integer|false|none|The number of all records available across pages|
|issues|[object]|false|none|none|
|» issue_name|string|false|none|Issue Name.<br> The value of the this field could be one of the following:<br><br>* `Room Controller disconnected`<br><br>* `Room Controller connected`<br>* `Selected camera has disconnected`<br>* `Selected camera is reconnected`<br>* `Selected microphone has disconnected`<br>* `Selected microphone is reconnected`<br>* `Selected speaker has disconnected`<br>* `Selected speaker is reconnected`<br>* `Zoom room is offline`<br>* `Zoom room is online`<br>* `High CPU usage is detected`<br>* `Low bandwidth network is detected`<br>* `{name} battery is low`<br>* `{name} battery is normal`<br>* `{name} disconnected`<br>* `{name} connected`<br>* `{name} is not charging`<br><br>Possible values for {name}: <br><br>* Zoom Rooms Computer <br>* Controller<br>* Scheduling Display|
|» zoom_rooms_count|integer|false|none|Zoom Room Count of Issue|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

## Get Zoom Rooms details

<a id="opIddashboardZoomRoom"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/metrics/zoomrooms/string?from=1970-01-01&to=1970-01-01' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /metrics/zoomrooms/{zoomroomId}`

The Zoom Rooms dashboard metrics lets you know the type of configuration a Zoom room has and details on the meetings held in that room. 

Use this API to retrieve information on a specific room.<br><br>
**Scopes:** `dashboard_zr:read:admin`<br> <br>

 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Heavy`**Prerequisites:**<br>
* Business, Education or API Plan with Zoom Rooms set up.


<h3 id="get-zoom-rooms-details-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|zoomroomId|path|string|true|The Zoom room ID.|
|from|query|string(date)|true|Start date in 'yyyy-mm-dd' format. The date range defined by the "from" and "to" parameters should only be one month as the report includes only one month worth of data at once.|
|to|query|string(date)|true|End date.|
|page_size|query|integer|false|The number of records returned within a single API call.|
|next_page_token|query|string|false|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "account_type": "Work Email",
  "calendar_name": "testZoomRoom",
  "camera": "Integrated Webcam",
  "device_ip": "Computer : 10.10.10.10; Controller : 11.11.11.11",
  "email": "hdfjdfs@someemail.dhfdhfd",
  "health": "critical",
  "id": "fdjdsfdYYYYY",
  "issues": [
    "Zoom room is offline"
  ],
  "last_start_time": "2020-01-30T17:47:47Z",
  "live_meeting": {},
  "microphone": "Microphone Array (Realtek Audio)",
  "past_meetings": {
    "from": "2020-03-01",
    "meetings": [],
    "next_page_token": "",
    "page_count": 0,
    "page_size": 30,
    "to": "2020-03-02",
    "total_records": 0
  },
  "room_name": "testZoomRoom",
  "speaker": "Speakers / Headphones (Realtek Audio)",
  "status": "Offline"
}
```

<h3 id="get-zoom-rooms-details-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** `200`<br><br>Zoom room returned.<br><br>Only available for paid accounts that have enabled the Dashboard feature.|Inline|
|300|Multiple Choices|**Error Code:** `300`<br><br>The next page token is either invalid or has expired.|None|

## List call logs

<a id="opIdlistCallLogsMetrics"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/phone/metrics/call_logs \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /phone/metrics/call_logs`

Call logs provide a record of all incoming and outgoing calls over Zoom Phone in an account. 

Use this API to list monthly call logs metrics. You can use query parameters to filter the response by date, site and MOS(Mean Opinion Score) of the call. 

**Prerequisites:**
* Business, or Education account
* Zoom Phone license <br><br>

**Scopes:** `phone:read:admin`, `phone:write:admin`<br>
**Rate Limit Label:** `Heavy`

<h3 id="list-call-logs-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|from|query|string|false|Start date for the report in `yyyy-mm-dd` format. Specify a 30 day range using the `from` and `to` parameters as the response provides a maximum of a month worth of data per API request.|
|to|query|string|false|End date for the report in `yyyy-mm-dd` format.|
|site_id|query|string|false|Unique identifier of the [site](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360020809672-Managing-multiple-sites). Use this query parameter if you have enabled multiple sites and would like to filter the response of this API call by call logs of a specific phone site.|
|quality_type|query|string|false|Filter call logs by voice quality. Zoom uses MOS of 3.5 as a general baseline to categorize calls by call quality. A MOS greater than or equal to 3.5 means good quality, while below 3.5 means poor quality. <br><br>The value of this field can be one of the following:<br><br>* `good`: Retrieve call logs of the call(s) with good quality of voice.<br><br>* `bad`: Retrieve call logs of the call(s) with good quality of voice.<br><br>* `all`: Retrieve all call logs without filtering by voice quality. <br><br><br><br>|
|page_size|query|integer|false|The number of records returned within a single call.|
|next_page_token|query|string|false|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|

## List H.323/SIP devices

<a id="opIddeviceList"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/h323/devices \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /h323/devices`

A H.323 or SIP device can make a video call to a [Room Connector](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/201363273-Getting-Started-With-H-323-SIP-Room-Connector) to join a Zoom cloud meeting. A Room Connector can also call out to a H.323 or SIP device to join a Zoom cloud meeting. Use this API to list all H.323/SIP Devices on a Zoom account.<br><br>
**Scopes:** `h323:read:admin`<br>

 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`<br>

<h3 id="list-h323sip-devices-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|page_size|query|integer|false|The number of records returned within a single API call.|
|page_number|query|integer|false|<br>**Deprecated** - This field has been deprecated and we will stop supporting it completely in a future release. Please use "next_page_token" for pagination instead of this field.<br><br>The page number of the current page in the returned records.|
|next_page_token|query|string|false|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "devices": [
    {
      "encryption": "auto",
      "id": "abceHewahkrehwiK",
      "ip": "127.0.0.1",
      "name": "api_test_20190508",
      "protocol": "H.323"
    }
  ],
  "page_count": 1,
  "page_number": 1,
  "page_size": 1,
  "total_records": 1
}
```

<h3 id="list-h323sip-devices-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** `200`<br><br>List of H.323/SIP devices returned.<br><br>**Error Code:** `200`<br><br>No permission.|Inline|

<a id="opIdgroupCreate"></a>

```bash
curl https://example.com/groups \

  }'
```

`POST /groups`

Create a [group](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/204519819-Group-Management-) under an account. 

You can add a maximum of 100 groups in one account per day. If you go over, you will get an error. You can add a maximum of 5000 groups in one account.

**Prerequisite**: Pro or higher account.<br>
**Scopes**: `group:write:admin`<br>

```json
}
```

```json
  "name": "string",
  "total_members": "integer"
}
```

## Get locked settings

<a id="opIdgetGroupLockSettings"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/groups/string/lock_settings \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /groups/{groupId}/lock_settings`

Retrieve a [group's](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/204519819-Group-Management-) locked settings. If you lock a setting, the group members will not be able to modify it individually. <p style="background-color:#FEEFB3; color:#9F6000"><br>Note:</b> The `force_pmi_jbh_password` field under meeting settings is planned to be deprecated on September 22, 2019. This field will be replaced by another field that will provide the same functionality.</p>

**Prerequisite**: Pro, Business, or Education account<br>
**Scopes**: `group:read:admin`<br>

 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`

<h3 id="get-locked-settings-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|---|---|---|---|---|
|groupId|path|string|true|Id of the group.|
|option|query|string|false|Specify `meeting_security` as the value of this field if you would like to view security settings applied on a meeting hosted by the users in this group.|
|custom_query_fields|query|string|false|Provide the name of the field by which you would like to filter the response. For example, if you provide "host_video" as the value of this field, you will get a response similar to the following:<br><br>{<br>    "schedule_meeting": {<br>        "host_video": false<br>    }<br>}<br><br>You can provide multiple values by separating them with commas(example: "host_video,participant_video”).|

|» alternative_host_reminder|boolean|false|none|Notify the alternative host who is set or removed.|

|» cloud_recording_available_reminder|boolean|false|none|Notify host when cloud recording is available.|
|» jbh_reminder|boolean|false|none|Notify host when participants join the meeting before them.|

|in_meeting|object|false|none|none|
|» alert_guest_join|boolean|false|none|Allow participants who belong to your account to see that a guest (someone who does not belong to your account) is participating in the meeting/webinar.|
|» allow_show_zoom_windows|boolean|false|none|Show Zoom windows during screen share.|
|» annotation|boolean|false|none|Allow participants to use annotation tools to add information to shared screens.|
|» attendee_on_hold|boolean|false|none|Allow host to put attendee on hold.<br><br>**This field has been deprecated and is no longer supported.**|
|» auto_answer|boolean|false|none|Enable users to see and add contacts to 'auto-answer group' in the contact list on chat. Any call from members of this group will be automatically answered.|
|» auto_saving_chat|boolean|false|none|Automatically save all in-meeting chats.|
|» breakout_room|boolean|false|none|Allow host to split meeting participants into separate, smaller rooms.|

## Update locked settings

```bash
      "show_meeting_control_toolbar": true,
      "stereo_audio": true,
      "use_html_format_email": true,
      "virtual_background": true,
      "waiting_room": true,
      "whiteboard": true
    },
    "recording": {
      "account_user_access_recording": true,
      "auto_delete_cmr": true,
      "auto_recording": "string",
      "cloud_recording": true,
```

`PATCH /groups/{groupId}/lock_settings`

Update a [group's](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/204519819-Group-Management-) locked settings. If you lock a setting, the group members will not be able to modify it individually. <p style="background-color:#FEEFB3; color:#9F6000"><br>Note:</b> The `force_pmi_jbh_password` field under meeting settings is planned to be deprecated on September 22, 2019. This field will be replaced by another field that will provide the same functionality.</p>

**Prerequisite**: Pro, Business, or Education account<br>
**Scopes**: `group:write:admin`<br>

 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`

## List group members

<a id="opIdgroupMembers"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/groups/string/members \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /groups/{groupId}/members`

List the members of a [group](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/204519819-Group-Management-) under your account.

**Prerequisite**: Pro, Business, or Education account<br>
**Scopes**: `group:read:admin`<br>

 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`

<h3 id="list-group-members-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|groupId|path|string|true|The group ID.<br><br>Can be retrieved by calling [GET /groups](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/groups/groups).|
|page_size|query|integer|false|The number of records returned within a single API call.|
|page_number|query|integer|false|<br>**Deprecated** - This field has been deprecated and we will stop supporting it completely in a future release. Please use "next_page_token" for pagination instead of this field.<br><br>The page number of the current page in the returned records.|
|next_page_token|query|string|false|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "members": [
    {
      "email": "",
      "first_name": "Ram",
      "id": "3542342",
      "last_name": "Ghale",
      "type": 1
    }
  ],
  "page_count": 1,
  "page_number": 1,
  "page_size": 1,
  "total_records": 1
}
```

<h3 id="list-group-members-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** `200`<br> Only available for paid account,{accountId}.|Inline|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404`<br><br>Not found.<br><br>**Error Code:** `4130`<br><br>A group with this {groupId} does not exist.|None|

<h3 id="list-group-members-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|members|[object]|false|none|none|
|» email|string|false|none|User's email address.|
|» first_name|string|false|none|First name of the user.|
|» id|string|false|none|Unique Identifier of the user. |
|» last_name|string|false|none|Last name of the user.|
|» type|integer|false|none|User type: <br> `1` - Basic<br> `2` - Licensed<br> `3` - On-prem|
|next_page_token|string|false|none|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|
|page_count|integer|false|none|The number of pages returned from this request.|
|page_number|integer|false|none|The page number of the current results.|
|page_size|integer|false|none|The number of records returned from a single API call.|

## Update a group member

<a id="opIdupdateAGroupMember"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/groups/string/members/string \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "action": "move",
    "target_group_id": "string"
  }'
```

`PATCH /groups/{groupId}/members/{memberId}`

If a user is a member in multiple groups, you can [set a primary group](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/204519819-Group-Management-#h_d07c7dcd-4fd8-485a-b5fe-a322e8d21c09) for the user. The group member will use the primary group's settings by default. However, if settings are locked in other groups, those settings will continue to be locked for that user. By default, the primary group is the first group that user is added to.<br><br>
Use this API to perform either of the following tasks:
* Simultaneously remove a member from one group and move the member to a different group.
* Set a primary group for the user<br><br>
**Prerequisites:** 
* Pro or higher account<br> **Scopes:** `group:write:admin`

 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "action": "move",
  "target_group_id": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-group-member-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|groupId|path|string|true|Unique Identifier of the group. Can be retrieved by calling [GET /groups](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/groups/groups) API.<br> To change a member's primary group, provide the groupId of the member's current primary group as the value of this field.<br> To remove a member from one group and move the member to another group, provide the groupId of the group from which the member is to be moved.|
|memberId|path|string|true|Unique Identifier of the group member. Can be retrieved by calling the [List Group Members](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/groups/groupmembers) API.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» action|body|string|true|Specify the type of action to be performed:<br><br><br>`move`: Simultaneously remove a member from one group and move the member to a different group.<br><br>`set_primary`: Set a primary group for the user.<br>|
|» target_group_id|body|string|false|Can be retrieved by calling [GET /groups](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/groups/groups) API.<br><br><br>To move a user, use this field to specify the groupId of the group where the member is to be moved.<br><br><br>To set a primary group for the user, provide the groupId of the group which is going to be the primary group.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» action|move|
|» action|set_primary|

> Example responses

> 204 Response

```json
null
```

<h3 id="update-a-group-member-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|**HTTP Status Code:** `204` **No Content**<br><br>Group member updated.|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400` **Bad Request**<br><br>**Error Code:** `200`<br><br> Only available for Paid account, {accountId}.<br><br><br> **Error Code:** `300`<br><br> The target_group_id can not be empty.<br><br><br> **Error Code:** `1010`<br><br> Group does not belong to this account:{accountId}.<br><br><br>|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404` **Not Found**<br><br>**Error Code:** `4130`<br><br>A group with this {groupId} does not exist.|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

## Update a group's settings

<a id="opIdupdateGroupSettings"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/groups/string/settings \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "email_notification": {
      "alternative_host_reminder": true,
      "cancel_meeting_reminder": true,
      "cloud_recording_available_reminder": true,
      "jbh_reminder": true,
      "schedule_for_host_reminder": true
    },
    "in_meeting": {
      "alert_guest_join": true,
      "allow_show_zoom_windows": true,
      "annotation": true,
      "attendee_on_hold": false,
      "auto_answer": true,
      "auto_saving_chat": true,
      "breakout_room": true,
      "chat": true,
      "closed_caption": true,
      "co_host": true,
      "custom_data_center_regions": true,
      "data_center_regions": "EU",
      "e2e_encryption": true,
      "entry_exit_chime": "string",
      "far_end_camera_control": true,
      "feedback": true,
      "file_transfer": true,
      "group_hd": true,
      "non_verbal_feedback": true,
      "only_host_view_device_list": true,
      "original_audio": true,
      "polling": true,
      "post_meeting_feedback": true,
      "private_chat": true,
      "record_play_own_voice": true,
      "remote_control": true,
      "remote_support": true,
      "request_permission_to_unmute": true,
      "screen_sharing": true,
      "sending_default_email_invites": true,
      "show_browser_join_link": true,
      "show_device_list": true,
      "show_meeting_control_toolbar": true,
      "stereo_audio": true,
      "use_html_format_email": true,
      "virtual_background": true,
      "waiting_room": true,
      "whiteboard": true,
      "who_can_share_screen": "host",
      "who_can_share_screen_when_someone_is_sharing": "host"
    },
    "profile": {
      "recording_storage_location": {
        "allowed_values": [
          "string"
        ],
        "value": "string"
      }
    },
    "recording": {
      "account_user_access_recording": true,
      "archive": {
        "enable": true,
        "settings": {
          "audio_file": true,
          "cc_transcript_file": true,
          "chat_file": true,
          "chat_with_sender_email": true,
          "video_file": true
        },
        "type": 1
      },
      "auto_recording": "string",
      "cloud_recording": true,
      "cloud_recording_download": true,
      "cloud_recording_download_host": true,
      "host_delete_cloud_recording": true,
      "ip_address_access_control": {
        "enable": true,
        "ip_addresses_or_ranges": "string"
      },
      "local_recording": true,
      "prevent_host_access_recording": true,
      "record_audio_file": true,
      "record_gallery_view": true,
      "record_speaker_view": true,
      "recording_audio_transcript": true,
      "save_chat_text": true,
      "show_timestamp": true
    },
    "schedule_meeting": {
      "audio_type": "string",
      "embed_password_in_join_link": true,
      "force_pmi_jbh_password": true,
      "host_video": true,
      "join_before_host": true,
      "mute_upon_entry": true,
      "participant_video": true,
      "pstn_password_protected": true,
      "require_password_for_all_meetings": true,
      "require_password_for_instant_meetings": true,
      "require_password_for_pmi_meetings": "all",
      "require_password_for_scheduled_meetings": true,
      "require_password_for_scheduling_new_meetings": true,
      "upcoming_meeting_reminder": true
    },
    "telephony": {
```

`PATCH /groups/{groupId}/settings`

Update settings for a [group](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/204519819-Group-Management-).<p style="background-color:#FEEFB3; color:#9F6000"><br>Note:</b> The `force_pmi_jbh_password` field under meeting settings is planned to be deprecated on September 22, 2019. ## Upload virtual background files

<a id="opIduploadGroupVB"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/groups/string/settings/virtual_backgrounds \

```

`POST /groups/{groupId}/settings/virtual_backgrounds`

Use this API to [upload virtual background files](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/210707503-Virtual-Background#h_01EJF3YFEWGT8YA0ZJ079JEDQE) for all users in a group to use. 


**Prerequisites:**<br>
* Virtual background feature must be [enabled](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/210707503-Virtual-Background#h_2ef28080-fce9-4ac2-b567-dc958afab1b7) on the account.
<br> **Scope:** `group:write:admin`<br><br>
**[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`<br>


`

> Body parameter

```yaml
file: string
```

<h3 id="upload-virtual-background-files-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|groupId|path|string|true|Unique identifier of the group. Retrieve the value for this field by calling the [List groups](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/groups/groups) API.|
|file_ids|query|string|false|Provide the id of the file that is to be deleted. To delete multiple files, provide comma separated values for this field.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» file|body|string|false|Provide the file's path here.|

> 201 Response

```json
{

  "name": "u=mdbhhfg3y7&fm=2fdjs0.jpg",
  "size": 53434,
  "type": "image"
}
```

|---|---|---|---|

|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400` **Bad Request** <br><br>**Error Code:** `120`<br><br>No file uploaded, verify that a file has been uploaded.<br><br>File size cannot exceed 15M.<br><br>A maximum of 10 files are allowed for a user.<br><br>Only jpg/jpeg or png image file can be uploaded.<br><br>|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404` **Not Found** <br><br>**Error Code:** `1001`<br><br>User not exist.<br><br>User {email} not exist or not belong to this account.|None|

<h3 id="upload-virtual-background-files-1-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

## Get IM chat sessions

<a id="opIdimChatSessions"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/im/chat/sessions?from=1970-01-01&to=1970-01-01' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /im/chat/sessions`

<aside class="warning">
This operation is deprecated
</aside>

Retrieve IM Chat sessions for a specified period of time. <aside>Note: This API only supports Oauth2.</aside><br>
 
**Scopes:** `imchat:read, imchat:read:admin`<br>
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Heavy`
 
 Please see our [announcements page related to this deprecation](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/guides/stay-up-to-date/announcements#im-api-notice).

<h3 id="get-im-chat-sessions-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|from|query|string(date)|true|Start date in 'yyyy-mm-dd' format. The date range defined by the "from" and "to" parameters should only be one month as the report includes only one month worth of data at once.|
|to|query|string(date)|true|End date.|
|page_size|query|integer|false|The number of records returned within a single API call.|
|next_page_token|query|string|false|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "from": "2019-08-31",
  "next_page_token": "vsdfjesfdhs",
  "page_size": 30,
  "sessions": [
    {
      "last_message_sent_time": "2016-12-16T05:04:08.470Z",
      "name": "API overview meeting",
      "session_id": "dkhfgjd",
      "type": "Group"
    }
  ],
  "to": "2019-09-12"
}
```

<h3 id="get-im-chat-sessions-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** `200` <br><br>Archived IM chat sessions returned.|Inline|
|300|Multiple Choices|**Error Code:** `300` <br><br>The next page token is invalid or expired. <br><br>Report requested exceeds 6 month limit.|None|

<h3 id="get-im-chat-sessions-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|from|string(date)|false|none|Start date.|
|to|string(date)|false|none|End date.|
|next_page_token|string|false|none|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of the available result list exceeds the page size. The expiration period is 15 minutes.|
|page_size|integer|false|none|The amount of records returns within a single API call. |
|sessions|[object]|false|none|Array of session objects.|
|» last_message_sent_time|string(date-time)|false|none|Last message sent time.|
|» name|string|false|none|Meeting topic.|
|» session_id|string|false|none|IM chat session ID.|
|» type|string|false|none|IM chat session type.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|» type|Group|
|» type|1:1|

<h1 id="zoom-api-meetings">Meetings</h1>

Meeting operations

## Use in-Meeting recording controls

<a id="opIdinMeetingRecordingControl"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/live_meetings/string/events \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "method": "string"
  }'
```

`PATCH /live_meetings/{meetingId}/events`

Use this API to control the [in-meeting](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360021921032-In-Meeting-Controls) **recording features** such as starting a recording, stopping a recording, pausing a recording, and resuming a recording. This API only works for Cloud Recordings and not for local recordings.


**Prerequisite:**
* The meeting must be a live meeting.
* Cloud Recording must be enabled.
* The user using this API must either be the host or alternative host of the meeting.

**Scopes:** `meeting:write`, `meeting:write:admin`, `meeting:master`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "method": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="use-in-meeting-recording-controls-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|meetingId|path|string|true|Unique identifier of the live meeting.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» method|body|string|false|The method that you would like to control. The value of this field can be one of the following:<br>* `recording.start`: Provide this value if you would like to start the recording.<br><br><br>* `recording.stop`: Provide this value if you would like to stop the recording.<br><br><br>* `recording.pause`: Provide this value if you would like to pause the recording.<br><br><br>* `recording.resume`: Provide this value if you would like to resume the recording that was previously paused.<br><br><br><br>|

> Example responses

> 202 Response

```json
null
```

<h3 id="use-in-meeting-recording-controls-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|202|Accepted|**HTTP Status:** `202` **Accepted**<br>Request processed successfully.|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status:** `400` **Bad Request** <br><br><br>**Error Code:** `300`<br><br>* Meeting id does not exist.<br><br>* Invalid meeting id.<br><br>* Meeting does not exist.<br><br>* No permission.<br>|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404`<br><br>**Error Code:** `3001` <br> Meeting {meetingId} is not found or has expired.|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

|show_previous_occurrences|query|boolean|false|Set the value of this field to `true` if you would like to view meeting details of all previous occurrences of a [recurring meeting](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/214973206-Scheduling-Recurring-Meetings). |

<h3 id="get-a-meeting-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|assistant_id|string|false|none|Unique identifier of the scheduler who scheduled this meeting on behalf of the host. This field is only returned if you used "schedule_for" option in the [Create a Meeting API request](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/meetings/meetingcreate).|
|host_email|string(email)|false|none|Email address of the meeting host.|
|host_id|string|false|none|ID of the user who is set as host of meeting.|
|id|integer(int64)|false|none|[Meeting ID](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/201362373-What-is-a-Meeting-ID-): Unique identifier of the meeting in "**long**" format(represented as int64 data type in JSON), also known as the meeting number.|
|uuid|string|false|none|Unique meeting ID. Each meeting instance will generate its own Meeting UUID (i.e., after a meeting ends, a new UUID will be generated for the next instance of the meeting). You can retrieve a list of UUIDs from past meeting instances using [this API](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/meetings/pastmeetings) . Please double encode your UUID when using it for API calls if the UUID begins with a '/'or contains '//' in it.<br>|
|agenda|string|false|none|Meeting description|
|created_at|string(date-time)|false|none|Time of creation. |
|duration|integer|false|none|Meeting duration.|
|encrypted_password|string|false|none|Encrypted passcode for third party endpoints (H323/SIP).|
|h323_password|string|false|none|H.323/SIP room system passcode.|
|join_url|string|false|none|URL for participants to join the meeting. This URL should only be shared with users that you would like to invite for the meeting.|
|occurrences|[object]|false|none|Array of occurrence objects.|
|» duration|integer|false|none|Duration.|
|» occurrence_id|string|false|none|Occurrence ID: Unique Identifier that identifies an occurrence of a recurring webinar. [Recurring webinars](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/216354763-How-to-Schedule-A-Recurring-Webinar) can have a maximum of 50 occurrences.|
|» start_time|string(date-time)|false|none|Start time.|
|» status|string|false|none|Occurrence status.|
|password|string|false|none|Meeting passcode.|
|pmi|integer(int64)|false|none|Personal Meeting Id. Only used for scheduled meetings and recurring meetings with no fixed time.|
|recurrence|object|false|none|Recurrence object. Use this object only for a meeting with type `8` i.e., a recurring meeting with fixed time. |
|» end_date_time|string(date-time)|false|none|Select the final date on which the meeting will recur before it is canceled. Should be in UTC time, such as 2017-11-25T12:00:00Z. (Cannot be used with "end_times".)|
|» end_times|integer|false|none|Select how many times the meeting should recur before it is canceled. (Cannot be used with "end_date_time".)|
|» monthly_day|integer|false|none|Use this field **only if you're scheduling a recurring meeting of type** `3` to state which day in a month, the meeting should recur. The value range is from 1 to 31.<br><br>For instance, if you would like the meeting to recur on 23rd of each month, provide `23` as the value of this field and `1` as the value of the `repeat_interval` field. Instead, if you would like the meeting to recur every three months, on 23rd of the month, change the value of the `repeat_interval` field to `3`.|
|» monthly_week|integer|false|none|Use this field **only if you're scheduling a recurring meeting of type** `3` to state the week of the month when the meeting should recur. If you use this field, **you must also use the `monthly_week_day` field to state the day of the week when the meeting should recur.** <br>`-1` - Last week of the month.<br>`1` - First week of the month.<br>`2` - Second week of the month.<br>`3` - Third week of the month.<br>`4` - Fourth week of the month.|
|» monthly_week_day|integer|false|none|Use this field **only if you're scheduling a recurring meeting of type** `3` to state a specific day in a week when the monthly meeting should recur. To use this field, you must also use the `monthly_week` field. <br><br><br>`1` - Sunday.<br>`2` - Monday.<br>`3` - Tuesday.<br>`4` -  Wednesday.<br>`5` - Thursday.<br>`6` - Friday.<br>`7` - Saturday.|
|» repeat_interval|integer|false|none|Define the interval at which the meeting should recur. For instance, if you would like to schedule a meeting that recurs every two months, you must set the value of this field as `2` and the value of the `type` parameter as `3`. <br><br>For a daily meeting, the maximum interval you can set is `90` days. For a weekly meeting the maximum interval that you can set is  of `12` weeks. For a monthly meeting, there is a maximum of `3` months.<br><br>|
|» type|integer|true|none|Recurrence meeting types:<br>`1` - Daily.<br>`2` - Weekly.<br>`3` - Monthly.|
|» weekly_days|string|false|none|This field is required **if you're scheduling a recurring meeting of type** `2` to state which day(s) of the week the meeting should repeat. <br> <br> The value for this field could be a number between `1` to `7` in string format. For instance, if the meeting should recur on Sunday, provide `"1"` as the value of this field.<br><br> **Note:** If you would like the meeting to occur on multiple days of a week, you should provide comma separated values for this field. For instance, if the meeting should recur on Sundays and Tuesdays provide `"1,3"` as the value of this field.<br><br> <br>`1`  - Sunday. <br>`2` - Monday.<br>`3` - Tuesday.<br>`4` -  Wednesday.<br>`5` -  Thursday.<br>`6` - Friday.<br>`7` - Saturday.|

|» » method|string|false|none|Specify whether to allow users from specific regions to join this meeting; or block users from specific regions from joining this meeting. <br><br><br>`approve`: Allow users from specific regions/countries to join this meeting. If this setting is selected, the approved regions/countries must be included in the `approved_list`.<br><br><br>`deny`: Block users from specific regions/countries from joining this meeting. If this setting is selected, the approved regions/countries must be included in the `denied_list`|
|» audio|string|false|none|Determine how participants can join the audio portion of the meeting.<br>`both` - Both Telephony and VoIP.<br>`telephony` - Telephony only.<br>`voip` - VoIP only.|

|» authentication_option|string|false|none|Meeting authentication option id.|

|» breakout_room|object|false|none|Setting to [pre-assign breakout rooms](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360032752671-Pre-assigning-participants-to-breakout-rooms#h_36f71353-4190-48a2-b999-ca129861c1f4).|
|» » enable|boolean|false|none|Set the value of this field to `true` if you would like to enable the [breakout room pre-assign](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360032752671-Pre-assigning-participants-to-breakout-rooms#h_36f71353-4190-48a2-b999-ca129861c1f4) option.|
|» » rooms|[object]|false|none|Create room(s).|
|» » » name|string|false|none|Name of the breakout room.|
|» » » participants|[string]|false|none|Email addresses of the participants who are to be assigned to the breakout room.|
|» close_registration|boolean|false|none|Close registration after event date|
|» cn_meeting|boolean|false|none|Host meeting in China.|
|» contact_email|string|false|none|Contact email for registration|

|» custom_keys|[object]|false|none|Custom keys and values assigned to the meeting.|
|» » key|string|false|none|Custom key associated with the user.|

## Delete a meeting

<a id="opIdmeetingDelete"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/meetings/0 \
  -X DELETE \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /meetings/{meetingId}`

Delete a meeting.<br><br>
**Scopes:** `meeting:write:admin` `meeting:write`<br>

 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light` 



<h3 id="delete-a-meeting-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|meetingId|path|integer(int64)|true|The meeting ID in **long** format. The data type of this field is "long"(represented as int64 in JSON).<br><br>While storing it in your database, store it as a **long** data type and **not as an integer**, as the Meeting IDs can be longer than 10 digits.|
|occurrence_id|query|string|false|The meeting occurrence ID.|
|schedule_for_reminder|query|boolean|false|`true`: Notify host and alternative host about the meeting cancellation via email.<br>`false`: Do not send any email notification.|
|cancel_meeting_reminder|query|string|false|`true`: Notify registrants about the meeting cancellation via email. <br><br>`false`: Do not send any email notification to meeting registrants. <br><br>The default value of this field is `false`.|

<h3 id="delete-a-meeting-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|**HTTP Status Code**: `204` <br><br>Meeting deleted.|None|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code**: `400` <br><br>**Error Code**: `1010` <br><br>User does not belong to this account: {accountId}.<br><br>**Error Code**: `3000` <br>Cannot access meeting information.<br>Invalid occurrence_id.<br><br>**Error Code**: `3002` <br><br>Sorry, you cannot delete this meeting since it is in progress.<br>**Error Code**: `3003` <br>You are not the meeting host.<br><br>**Error Code**: `3007` <br>Sorry, you cannot delete this meeting since it has ended.<br>**Error Code**: `3018` <br><br>Not allowed to delete PMI.<br>**Error Code**: `3037` <br>Not allowed to delete PAC.<br><br><br><br>|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code**: `404` <br><br>Meeting not found.<br>**Error Code**: `1001` <br><br>User does not exist: {userId}.<br><br>**Error Code**: `3001` <br><br>Meeting with this {meetingId} is not found or has expired.|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

<h3 id="update-a-meeting-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|meetingId|path|integer(int64)|true|The meeting ID in **long** format. The data type of this field is "long"(represented as int64 in JSON).<br><br>While storing it in your database, store it as a **long** data type and **not as an integer**, as the Meeting IDs can be longer than 10 digits.|
|occurrence_id|query|string|false|Meeting occurrence id. Support change of agenda, start_time, duration, settings: {host_video, participant_video, join_before_host, mute_upon_entry, waiting_room, watermark, auto_recording}|
|body|body|object|true|Meeting|
|» schedule_for|body|string|false|Email or userId if you want to schedule meeting for another user.|
|» agenda|body|string|false|Meeting description.|
|» duration|body|integer|false|Meeting duration (minutes). Used for scheduled meetings only.|
|» password|body|string|false|Meeting passcode. Passcode may only contain the following characters: [a-z A-Z 0-9 @ - _ *] and can have a maximum of 10 characters.<br><br>**Note:** If the account owner or the admin has configured [minimum passcode requirement settings](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360033559832-Meeting-and-webinar-passwords#h_a427384b-e383-4f80-864d-794bf0a37604), the passcode value provided here must meet those requirements. <br><br>If the requirements are enabled, you can view those requirements by calling either the [Get User Settings API](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/users/usersettings) or the  [Get Account Settings](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/accounts/accountsettings) API. |
|» recurrence|body|object|false|Recurrence object. Use this object only for a meeting with type `8` i.e., a recurring meeting with fixed time. |
|» » end_date_time|body|string(date-time)|false|Select the final date on which the meeting will recur before it is canceled. Should be in UTC time, such as 2017-11-25T12:00:00Z. (Cannot be used with "end_times".)|
|» » end_times|body|integer|false|Select how many times the meeting should recur before it is canceled. (Cannot be used with "end_date_time".)|
|» » monthly_day|body|integer|false|Use this field **only if you're scheduling a recurring meeting of type** `3` to state which day in a month, the meeting should recur. The value range is from 1 to 31.<br><br>For instance, if you would like the meeting to recur on 23rd of each month, provide `23` as the value of this field and `1` as the value of the `repeat_interval` field. Instead, if you would like the meeting to recur every three months, on 23rd of the month, change the value of the `repeat_interval` field to `3`.|
|» » monthly_week|body|integer|false|Use this field **only if you're scheduling a recurring meeting of type** `3` to state the week of the month when the meeting should recur. If you use this field, **you must also use the `monthly_week_day` field to state the day of the week when the meeting should recur.** <br>`-1` - Last week of the month.<br>`1` - First week of the month.<br>`2` - Second week of the month.<br>`3` - Third week of the month.<br>`4` - Fourth week of the month.|
|» » monthly_week_day|body|integer|false|Use this field **only if you're scheduling a recurring meeting of type** `3` to state a specific day in a week when the monthly meeting should recur. To use this field, you must also use the `monthly_week` field. <br><br><br>`1` - Sunday.<br>`2` - Monday.<br>`3` - Tuesday.<br>`4` -  Wednesday.<br>`5` - Thursday.<br>`6` - Friday.<br>`7` - Saturday.|
|» » repeat_interval|body|integer|false|Define the interval at which the meeting should recur. For instance, if you would like to schedule a meeting that recurs every two months, you must set the value of this field as `2` and the value of the `type` parameter as `3`. <br><br>For a daily meeting, the maximum interval you can set is `90` days. For a weekly meeting the maximum interval that you can set is  of `12` weeks. For a monthly meeting, there is a maximum of `3` months.<br><br>|
|» » type|body|integer|true|Recurrence meeting types:<br>`1` - Daily.<br>`2` - Weekly.<br>`3` - Monthly.|
|» » weekly_days|body|string|false|This field is required **if you're scheduling a recurring meeting of type** `2` to state which day(s) of the week the meeting should repeat. <br> <br> The value for this field could be a number between `1` to `7` in string format. ## Perform batch poll creation

<a id="opIdcreateBatchPolls"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/meetings/string/batch_polls \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "questions": [
      {
        "answers": [
          "string"
        ],
        "name": "string",
        "type": "single"
      }
    ],
    "title": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /meetings/{meetingId}/batch_polls`

Polls allow the meeting host to survey attendees. Use this API to create batch [polls](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/213756303-Polling-for-Meetings) for a meeting.<br><br>

**Scopes**: `meeting:write:admin` `meeting:write`<br>
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`<br>
**Prerequisites**:<br>
* Host user type must be **Pro** or higher plan.
* Polling feature must be enabled in the host's account.
* Meeting must be a scheduled meeting. Instant meetings do not have polling features enabled.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "questions": [
    {
      "answers": [
        "string"
      ],
      "name": "string",
      "type": "single"
    }
  ],
  "title": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="perform-batch-poll-creation-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|meetingId|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|Batch Meeting poll object|
|» questions|body|[object]|false|none|
|» » answers|body|[string]|false|Possible answers for the question.|
|» » name|body|string|false|Name of the question.|
|» » type|body|string|false|Question type:<br>`single` - Single choice<br>`mutliple` - Multiple choice|
|» title|body|string|false|Meeting Poll Title.|

|» » type|single|
|» » type|multiple|

## Get meeting invitation

<a id="opIdmeetingInvitation"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/meetings/0/invitation \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /meetings/{meetingId}/invitation`

Retrieve the meeting invite note that was sent for a specific meeting.<br><br>
**Scopes:** `meeting:read:admin` `meeting:read`<br>

 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`



<h3 id="get-meeting-invitation-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|meetingId|path|integer(int64)|true|The meeting ID in **long** format. The data type of this field is "long"(represented as int64 in JSON).<br><br>While storing it in your database, store it as a **long** data type and **not as an integer**, as the Meeting IDs can be longer than 10 digits.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "invitation": "Shrijana G is inviting you to a scheduled Zoom meeting.\r\n\r\nTopic: MyTestMeeting\r\nTime: Jul 31, 2019 04:00 PM Pacific Time (US and Canada)\r\n\r\nJoin Zoom Meeting\r\nhttps://zoom.us/j/000000\r\n\r\nOne tap mobile\r\n+000000"
}
```

<h3 id="get-meeting-invitation-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** `200`<br><br>Meeting invitation returned.|Inline|

<h3 id="get-meeting-invitation-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|invitation|string|false|none|Meeting invitation.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

## Get live stream details

<a id="opIdgetLiveStreamDetails"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/meetings/string/livestream \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /meetings/{meetingId}/livestream`

Zoom allows users to [live stream a meeting](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/115001777826-Live-Streaming-Meetings-or-Webinars-Using-a-Custom-Service) to a custom platform. Use this API to get a meeting's live stream configuration details such as Stream URL, Stream Key and Page URL.<br><br>
**Prerequisites:**<br>
* Meeting host must be a licensed user with a Pro or higher plan.<br>
* Live streaming details must have been [configured](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/115001777826-Live-Streaming-Meetings-or-Webinars-Using-a-Custom-Service#h_01589a6f-a40a-4e18-a448-cb746e52ebc5) for the meeting.<br><br>
**Scopes:** `meeting:read:admin` `meeting:read`<br>

`PATCH /meetings/{meetingId}/livestream`

|body|body|object|true|Meeting|
|» page_url|body|string(uri)|false|The livestream page URL.|
|» stream_key|body|string|true|Stream name and key.|
