`PATCH /meetings/{meetingId}/livestream/status`

Zoom allows users to [live stream a meeting](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/115001777826-Live-Streaming-Meetings-or-Webinars-Using-a-Custom-Service) to a custom platform. Use this API to update the status of a meeting's live stream.<br><br>

{
  "action": "start",

    "active_speaker_name": true,

  }
}

|body|body|object|true|Meeting|
|» action|body|string|false|Update the status of a livestream.<br><br>The value can be one of the following:<br><br>`start`: Start a live stream. <br><br>`stop`: Stop an ongoing live stream.|

|» action|stop|

`GET /meetings/{meetingId}/polls`

Polls allow the meeting host to survey attendees. Use this API to list [polls](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/213756303-Polling-for-Meetings) of a meeting.<br><br>

* Meeting must be a scheduled meeting. Instant meetings do not have polling features enabled.

<h3 id="list-meeting-polls-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|meetingId|path|integer(int64)|true|The meeting ID in **long** format. The data type of this field is "long"(represented as int64 in JSON).<br><br>While storing it in your database, store it as a **long** data type and **not as an integer**, as the Meeting IDs can be longer than 10 digits.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "polls": [
    {
      "id": "YB33NcABCdg_g1AAAxTQ",
      "questions": [
        {
          "answers": [
            "Extremely useful",
            "Somewhat useful",
            "Not useful at all"
          ],
          "name": "How useful was this meeting?",
          "type": "multiple"
        }
      ],
      "status": "notstart",
      "title": "Meeting Usefulness"
    }
  ],
  "total_records": 1
}
```

<h3 id="list-meeting-polls-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** <br><br>List polls of a Meeting  returned|Inline|
|404|Not Found|**Error Code:** `404`<br>Meeting Poll not found|None|

<h3 id="list-meeting-polls-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|polls|[object]|false|none|Array of Polls|
|» id|string|false|none|ID of Poll|
|» status|string|false|none|Status of Poll:<br>`notstart` - Poll not started<br>`started` - Poll started<br>`ended` - Poll ended<br>`sharing` - Sharing poll results|
|» questions|[object]|false|none|Array of Polls|
|» » answers|[string]|false|none|Answers to the questions|
|» » name|string|false|none|Question to be asked to the attendees.|
|» » type|string|false|none|Poll Question & Answer type:<br>`single` - Single choice<br>`mutliple` - Multiple choice|
|» title|string|false|none|Title for the poll.|
|total_records|integer|false|none|The number of all records available across pages|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|» status|notstart|
|» status|started|
|» status|ended|
|» status|sharing|
|» » type|single|
|» » type|multiple|

A host or a user with admin permission can require [registration for a Zoom meeting](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/211579443-Registration-for-Meetings). Use this API to list users that have registered for a meeting.<br><br>

|status|query|string|false|The registrant status:<br>`pending` - Registrant's status is pending.<br>`approved` - Registrant's status is approved.<br>`denied` - Registrant's status is denied.|

`POST /meetings/{meetingId}/registrants`

Register a participant for a meeting.<br><br> Note that there is a maximum limit of 4999 registrants per meeting and users will see an error if the capacity has reached.

**Prerequisite:**<br>
* Host user type must be "Licensed".

**Scopes:** `meeting:write:admin` `meeting:write`
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "address": "string",
  "city": "string",
  "comments": "string",
  "country": "string",
  "custom_questions": [
    {
      "title": "string",
      "value": "string"
    }
  ],
  "email": "string",
  "first_name": "string",
  "industry": "string",
  "job_title": "string",
  "last_name": "string",
  "no_of_employees": "string",
  "org": "string",
  "phone": "string",
  "purchasing_time_frame": "string",
  "role_in_purchase_process": "string",
  "state": "string",
  "zip": "string",
  "language": "string",
  "auto_approve": true
}
```

|» role_in_purchase_process|body|string|false|Role in Purchase Process:<br>`Decision Maker`<br>`Evaluator/Recommender`<br>`Influencer`<br>`Not involved` |

  "registrants": [

      "id": "string"
    }
  ]
}

|meetingId|path|integer(int64)|true|The meeting ID in **long** format. The data type of this field is "long"(represented as int64 in JSON).<br><br>While storing it in your database, store it as a **long** data type and **not as an integer**, as the Meeting IDs can be longer than 10 digits.|
|occurrence_id|query|string|false|The meeting occurrence ID.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» action|body|string|true|Registrant Status:<br>`approve` - Approve registrant.<br>`cancel` - Cancel previously approved registrant's registration.<br>`deny` - Deny registrant.|
|» registrants|body|[object]|false|List of registrants.|
|» » email|body|string|false|none|
|» » id|body|string|false|none|

|» action|cancel|
|» action|deny|

|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404`<br><br>Meeting or registrant not found.<br>**Error Code:** `1001`<br><br>User does not exist: {userId}.<br><br>|None|

|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404`<br><br>Meeting not found.<br><br>**Error Code:** `1001`<br><br>Meeting host does not exist: {userId}.<br><br>|None|

## List past meeting's poll results

<a id="opIdlistPastMeetingPolls"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/past_meetings/string/polls \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /past_meetings/{meetingId}/polls`

[Polls](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/213756303-Polling-for-Meetings) allow the meeting host to survey attendees. Use this API to list poll results of a meeting.<br><br>

**Scopes**: `meeting:read:admin`, `meeting:read`<br>
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium` <br>
**Prerequisites**:<br>
* Host user type must be **Pro**.
* Meeting must be a scheduled meeting. Instant meetings do not have polling features enabled.

<h3 id="list-past-meetings-poll-results-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|meetingId|path|string|true|The meeting ID or the meeting UUID.  If a meeting ID is provided in the request instead of a UUID, the response will be for the latest meeting instance.<br><br>If a UUID starts with "/" or contains "//" (example: "/ajXp112QmuoKj4854875==\"), you must **double encode** the UUID before making an API request.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "id": 123456,
  "questions": [
    {
      "email": "myemail@jksdlfkjdf.djfk",
      "name": "Sam S",
      "question_details": [
        {
          "answer": "I am wonderful.",
          "question": "How are you?"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "start_time": "2019-02-01T12:34:12.660Z",
  "title": "Learn something new",
  "uuid": "gsdjfhsdfkhjdsf"
}
```

<h3 id="list-past-meetings-poll-results-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** `200` **OK**<br><br>Polls returned successfully.|Inline|

<h3 id="list-past-meetings-poll-results-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|integer(int64)|false|none|[Meeting ID](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/201362373-What-is-a-Meeting-ID-): Unique identifier of the meeting in "**long**" format(represented as int64 data type in JSON), also known as the meeting number.|
|questions|[object]|false|none|none|
|» email|string|false|none|Email address of the user who submitted answers to the poll.|
|» name|string|false|none|Name of the user who submitted answers to the poll. If "anonymous" option is enabled for a poll, the participant's polling information will be kept anonymous and the value of `name` field will be "Anonymous Attendee".|
|» question_details|[object]|false|none|none|
|» » answer|string|false|none|Answer submitted by the user.|
|» » date_time|string(date-time)|false|none|Date and time at which the answer to the poll was submitted.|
|» » polling_id|string|false|none|Unique identifier of the poll.|
|» » question|string|false|none|Question asked during the poll.|
|start_time|string(date-time)|false|none|The start time of the meeting.|
|uuid|string|false|none|Meeting UUID.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

## List meetings

<a id="opIdmeetings"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/users/string/meetings \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /users/{userId}/meetings`

List all the meetings that were scheduled for a user (meeting host). This API only supports scheduled meetings and thus, details on instant meetings are not returned via this API.<br><br>
**Scopes:** `meeting:read:admin` `meeting:read`<br>
 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`

<h3 id="list-meetings-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|userId|path|string|true|The user ID or email address of the user. For user-level apps, pass `me` as the value for userId.|
|type|query|string|false|The meeting types: <br>`scheduled` - This includes all valid past meetings (unexpired), live meetings and upcoming scheduled meetings. It is equivalent to the combined list of "Previous Meetings" and "Upcoming Meetings" displayed in the user's [Meetings page](https://zoom.us/meeting) on the Zoom Web Portal.<br>`live` - All the ongoing meetings.<br>`upcoming` - All upcoming meetings including live meetings.|
|page_size|query|integer|false|The number of records returned within a single API call.|
|next_page_token|query|string|false|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|
|page_number|query|string|false|The page number of the current page in the returned records.|

|---|---|
|type|scheduled|
|type|live|
|type|upcoming|

`POST /users/{userId}/meetings`

[Create a meeting](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/201362413-Scheduling-meetings) for a user. <br>This API has a daily rate limit of 100 requests per day. Therefore, only 100 **Create a Meeting** API requests are permitted within a 24 hour window for a user.<br>

<aside>The <code>start_url</code> of a meeting is a URL using which a host or an alternative host can start a meeting. The expiration time for the <code>start_url</code> field is two hours for all regular users. 
	
For custCreate meeting hosts( i.e., users created using the <code>custCreate</code> option via the [Create Users](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/users/usercreate) API), the expiration time of the <code>start_url</code> field is 90 days from the generation of the <code>start_url</code>.
	
For security reasons, the recommended way to retrieve the updated value for the <code>start_url</code> field programmatically (after expiry) is by calling the [Retrieve a Meeting API](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/meetings/meeting) and referring to the value of the <code>start_url</code> field in the response.</aside><br><br>
Scopes: `meeting:write:admin` `meeting:write`
 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`

<h3 id="create-a-meeting-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|userId|path|string|true|The user ID or email address of the user. For user-level apps, pass `me` as the value for userId.|
|body|body|object|true|Meeting object.|
|» agenda|body|string|false|Meeting description.|
|» duration|body|integer|false|Meeting duration (minutes). Used for scheduled meetings only.|
|» password|body|string|false|Passcode to join the meeting. By default, passcode may only contain the following characters: [a-z A-Z 0-9 @ - _ *] and can have a maximum of 10 characters.<br><br>**Note:** If the account owner or the admin has configured [minimum passcode requirement settings](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360033559832-Meeting-and-webinar-passwords#h_a427384b-e383-4f80-864d-794bf0a37604), the passcode value provided here must meet those requirements. <br><br>If the requirements are enabled, you can view those requirements by calling either the [Get User Settings API](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/users/usersettings) or the [Get Account Settings](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/accounts/accountsettings) API. |
|» recurrence|body|object|false|Recurrence object. Use this object only for a meeting with type `8` i.e., a recurring meeting with fixed time. |
|» » end_date_time|body|string(date-time)|false|Select the final date on which the meeting will recur before it is canceled. Should be in UTC time, such as 2017-11-25T12:00:00Z. (Cannot be used with "end_times".)|
|» » end_times|body|integer|false|Select how many times the meeting should recur before it is canceled. (Cannot be used with "end_date_time".)|
|» » monthly_day|body|integer|false|Use this field **only if you're scheduling a recurring meeting of type** `3` to state which day in a month, the meeting should recur. The value range is from 1 to 31.<br><br>For instance, if you would like the meeting to recur on 23rd of each month, provide `23` as the value of this field and `1` as the value of the `repeat_interval` field. Instead, if you would like the meeting to recur every three months, on 23rd of the month, change the value of the `repeat_interval` field to `3`.|
|» » monthly_week|body|integer|false|Use this field **only if you're scheduling a recurring meeting of type** `3` to state the week of the month when the meeting should recur. If you use this field, **you must also use the `monthly_week_day` field to state the day of the week when the meeting should recur.** <br>`-1` - Last week of the month.<br>`1` - First week of the month.<br>`2` - Second week of the month.<br>`3` - Third week of the month.<br>`4` - Fourth week of the month.|
|» » monthly_week_day|body|integer|false|Use this field **only if you're scheduling a recurring meeting of type** `3` to state a specific day in a week when the monthly meeting should recur. To use this field, you must also use the `monthly_week` field. <br><br><br>`1` - Sunday.<br>`2` - Monday.<br>`3` - Tuesday.<br>`4` -  Wednesday.<br>`5` - Thursday.<br>`6` - Friday.<br>`7` - Saturday.|
|» » repeat_interval|body|integer|false|Define the interval at which the meeting should recur. For instance, if you would like to schedule a meeting that recurs every two months, you must set the value of this field as `2` and the value of the `type` parameter as `3`. <br><br>For a daily meeting, the maximum interval you can set is `90` days. For a weekly meeting the maximum interval that you can set is  of `12` weeks. For a monthly meeting, there is a maximum of `3` months.<br><br>|
|» » type|body|integer|true|Recurrence meeting types:<br>`1` - Daily.<br>`2` - Weekly.<br>`3` - Monthly.|
|» » weekly_days|body|string|false|This field is required **if you're scheduling a recurring meeting of type** `2` to state which day(s) of the week the meeting should repeat. <br> <br> The value for this field could be a number between `1` to `7` in string format. For instance, if the meeting should recur on Sunday, provide `"1"` as the value of this field.<br><br> **Note:** If you would like the meeting to occur on multiple days of a week, you should provide comma separated values for this field. For instance, if the meeting should recur on Sundays and Tuesdays provide `"1,3"` as the value of this field.<br><br> <br>`1`  - Sunday. <br>`2` - Monday.<br>`3` - Tuesday.<br>`4` -  Wednesday.<br>`5` -  Thursday.<br>`6` - Friday.<br>`7` - Saturday.|
|» schedule_for|body|string|false|If you would like to schedule this meeting for someone else in your account, provide the Zoom user id or email address of the user here.|
|» settings|body|object|false|Meeting settings.|
|» » additional_data_center_regions|body|[string]|false|Enable additional [data center regions](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360042411451-Selecting-data-center-regions-for-hosted-meetings-and-webinars) for this meeting. Provide the value in the form of array of country code(s) for the countries which are available as data center regions in the [account settings](https://zoom.us/account/setting) but have been opt out of in the user settings. For instance, let's say that in your account settings, the data center regions that have been selected are Europe, Honkong, Australia, India, Latin America, Japan, China, United States,and Canada. The complete list of available data center regions for your account is: ["EU", "HK", "AU", "IN", "LA", "TY", "CN", "US", "CA"]. In [user settings](https://zoom.us/profile/setting), you have opted out of India(IN) and Japan(TY) for meeting and webinar traffic routing. If you would like, you can still include India and Japan as additional data centers for this meeting using this field. To include India and Japan as additional data center regions, you would provide ["IN", "TY"] as the value.|
|» » allow_multiple_devices|body|boolean|false|If set to `true`, attendees will be allowed to join a meeting from multiple devices.<br><br>**Note:** This setting is only applied for meetings that have enabled registration.|

|» » alternative_hosts_email_notification|body|boolean|false|Flag to determine whether to send email notifications to alternative hosts, default value is true.|

|» » approved_or_denied_countries_or_regions|body|object|false|Approve or block users from specific regions/countries from joining this meeting. <br>|
|» » » approved_list|body|[string]|false|List of countries/regions from where participants can join this meeting. |
|» » » denied_list|body|[string]|false|List of countries/regions from where participants can not join this meeting. |
|» » » enable|body|boolean|false|`true`: Setting enabled to either allow users or block users from specific regions to join your meetings. <br><br><br>`false`: Setting disabled.|
|» » » method|body|string|false|Specify whether to allow users from specific regions to join this meeting; or block users from specific regions from joining this meeting. <br><br><br>`approve`: Allow users from specific regions/countries to join this meeting. If this setting is selected, the approved regions/countries must be included in the `approved_list`.<br><br><br>`deny`: Block users from specific regions/countries from joining this meeting. If this setting is selected, the approved regions/countries must be included in the `denied_list`|
|» » audio|body|string|false|Determine how participants can join the audio portion of the meeting.<br>`both` - Both Telephony and VoIP.<br>`telephony` - Telephony only.<br>`voip` - VoIP only.|
|» » authentication_domains|body|string|false|Meeting authentication domains. |» » » enable|body|boolean|false|Set the value of this field to `true` if you would like to enable the [breakout room pre-assign](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360032752671-Pre-assigning-participants-to-breakout-rooms#h_36f71353-4190-48a2-b999-ca129861c1f4) option.|
|» » » rooms|body|[object]|false|Create room(s).|
|» » » » name|body|string|false|Name of the breakout room.|

|» » close_registration|body|boolean|false|Close registration after event date|
|» » cn_meeting|body|boolean|false|Host meeting in China.|
|» » contact_email|body|string|false|Contact email for registration|

<h3 id="create-a-meeting-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|**HTTP Status Code:** `201`<br><br>Meeting created.|Inline|
|300|Multiple Choices|**HTTP Status Code:** `300`<br><br>Invalid enforce_login_domains, separate multiple domains by semicolon.<br><br>A maximum of {rateLimitNumber} meetings can be created/updated for a single user in one day.<br>|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404` **Not Found**<br><br>User not found.<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `1001`<br> User {userId} not exist or not belong to this account.<br>|None|

<h3 id="create-a-meeting-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **201**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|assistant_id|string|false|none|Unique identifier of the scheduler who scheduled this meeting on behalf of the host. This field is only returned if you used "schedule_for" option in the [Create a Meeting API request](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/meetings/meetingcreate).|
|host_email|string(email)|false|none|Email address of the meeting host.|
|id|integer(int64)|false|none|[Meeting ID](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/201362373-What-is-a-Meeting-ID-): Unique identifier of the meeting in "**long**" format(represented as int64 data type in JSON), also known as the meeting number.|
|registration_url|string|false|none|URL using which registrants can register for a meeting. This field is only returned for meetings that have enabled registration.|
|agenda|string|false|none|Agenda|
|created_at|string(date-time)|false|none|The date and time at which this meeting was created.|
|duration|integer|false|none|Meeting duration.|
|h323_password|string|false|none|H.323/SIP room system password|
|join_url|string|false|none|URL for participants to join the meeting. This URL should only be shared with users that you would like to invite for the meeting.|
|occurrences|[object]|false|none|Array of occurrence objects.|
|» duration|integer|false|none|Duration.|
|» occurrence_id|string|false|none|Occurrence ID: Unique Identifier that identifies an occurrence of a recurring webinar. [Recurring webinars](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/216354763-How-to-Schedule-A-Recurring-Webinar) can have a maximum of 50 occurrences.|
|» start_time|string(date-time)|false|none|Start time.|

<h1 id="zoom-api-pac">PAC</h1>

PAC operations

## List a user's PAC accounts

<a id="opIduserPACs"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/users/string/pac \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /users/{userId}/pac`

[Personal Audio Conference](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/204517069-Getting-Started-with-Personal-Audio-Conference) (PAC) allows Pro or higher account holders to host meetings through PSTN (phone dial-in) only.<br>Use this API to list a user's PAC accounts.<br><br>
**Scopes:** `pac:read:admin` `pac:read`<br>
<br>
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`<br>
**Prerequisites:**<br>
* A Pro or higher plan with [Premium Audio Conferencing](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/204517069-Getting-Started-with-Personal-Audio-Conference) add-on.
* Personal Audio Conference must be enabled in the user's profile.

<h3 id="list-a-users-pac-accounts-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|userId|path|string|true|The user ID or email address of the user. For user-level apps, pass `me` as the value for userId.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "pac_accounts": [
    {
      "conference_id": "111111",
      "dedicated_dial_in_number": [
        {
          "country": "USA",
          "number": "123343434"
        }
      ],
      "global_dial_in_numbers": [
        {
          "country": "USA",
          "number": "434343434"
        }
      ],
      "listen_only_password": "hkgk",
      "participant_password": "ghdf"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="list-a-users-pac-accounts-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** `200` **OK**<br><br>PAC account list returned.|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400` **Bad Request**<br><br>**Error Code:** `2024`<br><br>User does not have PAC enabled.<br>|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404` **Not Found**<br><br>**Error Code:** `1001`<br><br>User does not exist: $userId.|None|

<h3 id="list-a-users-pac-accounts-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|pac_accounts|[object]|false|none|none|
|» conference_id|integer|false|none|Conference ID.|
|» dedicated_dial_in_number|[object]|false|none|List of dedicated dial-in numbers.|
|» » country|string|false|none|Country code.|
|» » number|string|false|none|Dial-in number: length is less than 16.|
|» global_dial_in_numbers|[object]|false|none|List of global dial-in numbers.|
|» » country|string|false|none|Country code.|
|» » number|string|false|none|Dial-in number: length is less than 16.|
|» listen_only_password|string|false|none|Listen-Only password: numeric value - length is less than 6.|
|» participant_password|string|false|none|Participant password: numeric value - length is less than 6.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

<h1 id="zoom-api-phone">Phone</h1>

## Update BYOC settings

<a id="opIdupdatePhoneSettings"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/accounts/string/phone/settings \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "byoc": {
      "enable": true
    }
  }'
```

`PATCH /accounts/{accountId}/phone/settings`

Only [master account owners](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/master-account-apis) can use this API to enable BYOC(Bring your own carrier) option for a sub account.<br>

**Scope**:<br>
* `phone:master` <br>

**Prerequisites**: <br>
* Business or enterprise Account.<br>

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "byoc": {
    "enable": true
  }
}
```

<h3 id="update-byoc-settings-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|accountId|path|string|true|Unique identifier of the sub account.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» byoc|body|object|false|none|
|» » enable|body|boolean|false|Set the value of this field to `true` to allow a sub account to add BYOC numbers from the Zoom web admin portal.|

> Example responses

> 204 Response

```json
null
```

<h3 id="update-byoc-settings-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|**Response HTTP code**: `204` **No Content.**<br><br>Updated successfully.<br><br>|Inline|
|401|Unauthorized|**HTTP Status Code:** `401`<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `124`<br><br>Account does not exist: {accountId}.|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

## Set up a Zoom Phone account

<a id="opIdsetUpAccount"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/accounts/string/phone/setup \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "emergency_address": {
      "address_line1": "string",
      "address_line2": "string",
      "city": "string",
      "country": "string",
      "state_code": "string",
      "zip": "string"
    },
    "extension_number": "800"
  }'
```

`POST /accounts/{accountId}/phone/setup`

After assigning a Zoom phone license to an account, an admin or account owner can proceed with the [initial Zoom phone set up](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360001297663-Getting-started-with-Zoom-Phone-admin-#h_5ae26a3a-290c-4a8d-b3b0-6384ed267b13) using this API.

**Scope**:<br>
* `phone:write:admin` `phone:write`

**Prerequisites**: <br>
* Pro or a higher paid account with master account option enabled.

<br>**[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`<br>



> Body parameter

```json
{
  "emergency_address": {
    "address_line1": "string",
    "address_line2": "string",
    "city": "string",
    "country": "string",
    "state_code": "string",
    "zip": "string"
  },
  "extension_number": "800"
}
```

<h3 id="set-up-a-zoom-phone-account-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|accountId|path|string|true|Unique identifier of the account.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» emergency_address|body|object|true|Specify emergency address for the account.|
|» » address_line1|body|string|true|Specify the street address.|
|» » address_line2|body|string|false|Specify any building number, floor number, or unit number.|
|» » city|body|string|false|City of the emergency address. Required or optional dependent on different countries.|
|» » country|body|string|true|Specify the two letter [country code](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/other-references/abbreviation-lists#countries) (Alpha-2 code in ISO-3166).|
|» » state_code|body|string|false|State code of the emergency address. Required or optional dependent on the country and state.|
|» » zip|body|string|false|Zip code of the emergency address. Required or optional dependent on different countries.|
|» extension_number|body|string|true|Specify extension number that will be associated with the owner of the account.|

<h3 id="set-up-a-zoom-phone-account-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|**HTTP Status Codes** `201`<br><br>Created.|None|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Response Code:** `400`<br><br><br>**Error Codes:** `300`<br><br>The extension number {0} that you entered is a reserved number and can not be used. Provide a different number and try again.<br><br>This account is not enrolled in a Zoom Phone plan. Subscribe to a Zoom Phone plan and try again.<br><br>The billing information could not be retrieved at this time. Retry the request again after a few seconds.<br><br>The country code you entered is invalid. Provide a valid country code and try again.<br><br>The state code you entered is invalid. Provide a valid state code and try again.<br><br>The city information you entered is invalid. Provide a valid city name and try again.<br><br>State code is required for this country.<br><br>City is required for this country.<br><br>Zip is required for this country.<br>|None|
|401|Unauthorized|**HTTP Status Code:** `401`<br><br>Unauthorized.<br><br><br>**Error Code:** <br><br>`124` Account does not exist: {accountId}.<br>|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

## Assign SIP trunks

<a id="opIdpostPhoneSIPTrunk"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/accounts/string/phone/sip_trunk/trunks \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "sip_trunks": [
      {
        "carrier_account": "string",
        "id": "string",
        "name": "master SIP Trunk name"
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /accounts/{accountId}/phone/sip_trunk/trunks`

Using this API, a [master account](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/master-account-apis) owner can assign SIP trunk(s) to a sub account.<br>

**Scope**:<br>
* `phone:master` <br>

**Prerequisites**:<br>
* Business or enterprise Account.<br>
<br>**[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`<br>



> Body parameter

```json
{
  "sip_trunks": [
    {
      "carrier_account": "string",
      "id": "string",
      "name": "master SIP Trunk name"
    }
  ]
}
```

## Get account's call logs

<a id="opIdaccountCallLogs"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/phone/call_logs \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /phone/call_logs`

Retrieve [call logs](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360021114452-Viewing-Call-Logs) for an account. 

**Scopes**: `phone:read:admin`<br>
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Heavy`<br>
**Prerequisite:**<br>
1. Business or Enterprise account<br>
2. A Zoom Phone license<br>
3. Account Owner and a [role](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/115001078646-Role-Based-Access-Control) with Zoom Phone Management<br>

<h3 id="get-accounts-call-logs-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|page_size|query|integer|false|The number of records returned within a single API call.|
|from|query|string|false|Start date from which you would like to get the call logs. The start date should be within past six months. <br><br><br>The API only returns data pertaining to a month. Thus, the date range(defined using "from" and "to" fields) for which the call logs are to be returned must not exceed a month.|
|to|query|string|false|The end date upto which you would like to get the call logs for. The end date should be within past six months.|
|type|query|string|false|The type of the call logs. The value can be either "all" or "missed".|
|next_page_token|query|string|false|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|
|path|query|string|false|Filter the API response by [path](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360021114452-Viewing-and-identifying-logs#h_646b46c6-0623-4ab1-8b8b-ea5b8bcef679) of the call. The value of this field can be one of the following: `voiceMail`, `message`, `forward`, `extension`, `callQueue`, `ivrMenu`, `companyDirectory`, `autoReceptionist`, `contactCenter`, `disconnected`, `commonAreaPhone`,<br>`pstn`, `transfer`, `sharedLines`, `sharedLineGroup`, `tollFreeBilling`, `meetingService`, `parkPickup`,<br>`parkTimeout`, `monitor`, `takeover`, `sipGroup`|
|time_type|query|string|false|Enables you to sort call logs by start or end time. Choose the sort time value. Values include `startTime` or `endTime`.|
|site_id|query|string|false|Unique identifier of the [site](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360020809672-Managing-multiple-sites). Use this query parameter if you have enabled multiple sites and would like to filter the response of this API call by call logs of a specific phone site.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|time_type|startTime|
|time_type|endTime|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "call_logs": [
    {
      "call_type": "voip",
      "callee_name": "somename",
      "callee_number": "34567889",
      "callee_number_type": "2",
      "caller_name": "ullamconame",
      "caller_number": "12345678",
      "caller_number_type": "1",
      "date_time": "2019-05-19T20:00:00Z",
      "direction": "inbound",
      "duration": 18677470,
      "id": "sjbkfdsbfsdf",
      "owner": {
        "extension_number": 1009,
        "id": "29QVgYBGRmOM5VlC0DmLgg",
        "name": "Not_Delete_CallQueue_Recording",
        "type": "callQueue"
      },
      "result": "no_answer"
    }
  ],
  "from": "2019-05-19",
  "page_count": 0,
  "page_number": 1,
  "page_size": 30,
  "to": "2019-05-20",
  "total_records": 0
}
```

<h3 id="get-accounts-call-logs-responses">Responses</h3>

|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404`<br><br>**Error Code:** `3001`<br><br>Error retrieving call logs.|None|

`PUT /phone/company_number`

The [main company number](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360028553691) can be used by external callers to reach your phone users (by dialing the main company number and the user's extension). It can also be used by phone users in your account as their caller ID while making calls.<br><br> Use this API to [change the main company number](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360028553691#h_82414c34-9df2-428a-85a4-efcf7f9e0d72) of an account.<br><br>

{
  "phone_number": "string"
}
```

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» phone_number|body|string|false|Provide either the unique identifier of the phone number (id) or the phone number itself in e164 format (e.g: +199955500123).|

> Example responses

```json
null
```

## List phone numbers

<a id="opIdlistAccountPhoneNumbers"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/phone/numbers \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /phone/numbers`

A Zoom account owner or admin can purchase phone numbers and assign them to Zoom phone users. Use this API to list all Zoom Phone numbers in a Zoom account. You can filter the response based on your needs by using query parameters.

**Prerequisites:**<br>
* Pro or higher plan with Zoom phone license<br>
**Scope:** `phone:read:admin`<br> 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`

<h3 id="list-phone-numbers-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|next_page_token|query|string|false|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|
|type|query|string|false|Query response by number assignment. The value can be one of the following:<br><br><br>`assigned`: The number has been assigned to either a user, a call queue, an auto-receptionist or a common area phone in an account. <br>`unassigned`: The number is not assigned to anyone.<br><br>`all`: Include both assigned and unassigned numbers in the response.<br><br>`byoc`: Include Bring Your Own Carrier (BYOC) numbers only in the response.|
|extension_type|query|string|false|The type of assignee to whom the number is assigned. The value can be one of the following:<br><br>`user`<br> `callQueue`<br> `autoReceptionist`<br><br>`commonAreaPhone`|
|page_size|query|integer|false|The number of records returned within a single API call.|
|number_type|query|string|false|The type of phone number. The value can be either `toll` or `tollfree`.|
|pending_numbers|query|boolean|false|Include or exclude pending numbers in the response. The value can be either `true` or `false`.|
|site_id|query|string|false|Unique identifier of the site. Use this query parameter if you have enabled multiple sites and would like to filter the response of this API call by a specific phone site. See [Managing multiple sites](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360020809672-Managing-multiple-sites) or [Adding a site](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360020809672-Managing-multiple-sites#h_05c88e35-1593-491f-b1a8-b7139a75dc15) for details.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|type|assigned|
|type|unassigned|
|type|all|
|extension_type|user|
|extension_type|callQueue|
|extension_type|autoReceptionist|
|extension_type|commonAreaPhone|
|number_type|toll|
|number_type|tollfree|

## Get call recordings

<a id="opIdgetPhoneRecordings"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/phone/recordings \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /phone/recordings`

List [call recordings](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360038521091-Accessing-and-sharing-call-recordings) of an account.<br>

**Scopes:**<br>
* `phone:read:admin` `phone:write:admin`

**Prerequisties:** <br>
* Pro or higher account with Zoom Phone license.
* Account owner or admin privileges.



<h3 id="get-call-recordings-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|page_size|query|integer|false|The number of records returned within a single API call. The default is **30**, and the maximum is **100**.|
|next_page_token|query|string|false|The current page number of returned records.|
|from|query|string|false|Start date and time in **yyyy-mm-dd** format or **yyyy-MM-dd’T’HH:mm:ss’Z’** format. The date range defined by the from and to parameters should only be one month as the report includes only one month worth of data at once.<br>|
|to|query|string|false|End date and time in **yyyy-mm-dd** format or **yyyy-MM-dd’T’HH:mm:ss’Z’** format, the same formats supported by the `from` parameter.<br><br>|
|owner_type|query|string|false|The owner type. The allowed values are null, `user`, or `callQueue`. The default is null. If null, returns all owner types.<br>|
|recording_type|query|string|false|The recording type. The allowed values are null, `OnDemand`, or `Automatic`. The default is null. If null, returns all recording types.<br>|
|site_id|query|string|false|The site ID. The default is `All sites`.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

      "callee_number_type": "external",
      "caller_name": "janedoe",
      "caller_number": "4085552222",
      "caller_number_type": "internal",
      "date_time": "2020-11-03T14:31:41Z",
      "direction": "inbound",
      "download_url": "https://zoom.us/v2/phone/recording/download/6FHBshghfd3t7-45476zKrw",
      "duration": 50,
      "id": "test",
      "owner": {
        "extension_number": "43765674",
        "id": "123",
        "name": "Tracy",
        "type": "user"
      },
      "recording_type": "OnDemand",
      "site": {
        "id": "dfhg35273d",
        "name": "string"
      }
    }
  ],
  "total_records": "1"
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
null
```

Provide a new name for the template and try again.<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `300`<br><br>Validation failed. You provided an incorrect value for the template type. Provide a valid value and try again.|Inline|

See [Managing multiple sites](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360020809672-Managing-multiple-sites) for details. ## Add a setting template

<a id="opIdaddSettingTemplate"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/phone/setting_templates \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "description": "string",
    "name": "string",
    "site_id": "string",
    "type": "user"
  }'
```

`POST /phone/setting_templates`

This API lets you create a Zoom Phone setting template for an account. Template type includes **User**, **Auto Receptionist**, or **Call Queue**. Settings include profile, policy and user settings. After creating a phone template, the settings defined via this request will become the default settings for an account.
<br><br>
**Scope**: 
* `phone:write:admin` `phone:write`


**Prerequisites**:
1. Business or enterprise Zoom account
2. A Zoom Phone license

<br>**[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`<br>


<br>

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "description": "string",
  "name": "string",
  "site_id": "string",
  "type": "user"
}
```

<h3 id="add-a-setting-template-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» description|body|string|false|A description of the template.|
|» name|body|string|true|The name of the template.|
|» site_id|body|string|false|Unique identifier of the site. Required only when multiple sites are enabled. See [Managing multiple sites](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360020809672-Managing-multiple-sites) for details.|
|» type|body|string|true|The type of template. Values include `user`, `group`, `autoReceptionist`, `commonarea`, or `interop`.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» type|user|
|» type|group|
|» type|autoReceptionist|
|» type|commonarea|
|» type|interop|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "description": "A description here...",
  "id": "123456",
  "name": "Name name",
  "type": "user"
}
```

<h3 id="add-a-setting-template-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|**HTTP Status Code:** `201`<br><br>Created Successfully.|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Response Code:** `400`<br><br>The template name you entered already exists. Provide a new name for the template and try again.<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `300`<br><br>Validation failed. You provided an incorrect value for the template type. Provide a valid value and try again.|None|
|401|Unauthorized|**HTTP Status Code:** `401`<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `124`<br><br>Account does not exist: {accountId}.|None|

## Update a setting template

<a id="opIdupdateSettingTemplate"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/phone/setting_templates/string \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "description": "string",
    "name": "string",
    "policy": {
      "ad_hoc_call_recording": {
        "enable": true,
        "recording_start_prompt": true,
        "recording_transcription": true
      },
      "auto_call_recording": {
        "enable": true,
        "recording_calls": "inbound",
        "recording_start_prompt": true,
        "recording_transcription": true
      },
      "sms": {
        "enable": true,
        "international_sms": true
      },
      "voicemail": {
        "allow_transcription": true,
        "enable": true
      }
    },
    "profile": {
      "area_code": "string",
      "country": "string"
    },
    "user_settings": {
      "audio_prompt_language": "string",
      "block_calls_without_caller_id": true,
      "call_handling": {
        "business_hours": {
          "business_hour_action": 0,
          "connect_to_operator": {
            "enable": true,
            "id": "string",
            "type": "user"
          },
          "custom_hours": [
            {
              "from": "00:00:00Z",
              "to": "00:00:00Z",
              "type": 1,
              "weekday": 1
            }
          ],
          "ring_type": 0,
          "ringing_duration": 15,
          "type": 1
        },
        "close_hours": {
          "close_hour_action": 0,
          "connect_to_operator": {
            "enable": true,
            "id": "string",
            "type": "user"
          },
          "max_wait_time": 15
        }
      },
      "desk_phone": {
        "pin_code": "string"
      },
      "hold_music": "default"
    }
  }'
```

`PATCH /phone/setting_templates/{templateId}`

Use this API to update or modify profile settings for the phone template. Template type includes **User**, **Auto Receptionist**, or **Call Queue**. After you've modified a template, click **User Settings** to set up settings for Call Handling, Desk Phone, and Others. <br>

**Scope**:<br>
* `phone:write:admin` or `phone:write`

**Prerequisites**: <br>
1. Business or Enterprise Account
2. A Zoom Phone license
<br>**[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`<br>

  },

    "block_calls_without_caller_id": true,

  }
}

## List BYOC SIP trunks

<a id="opIdlistBYOCSIPTrunk"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/phone/sip_trunk/trunks \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /phone/sip_trunk/trunks`

List [BYOC SIP trunks](https://zoom.us/docs/doc/Zoom-Bring%20Your%20Own%20Carrier.pdf) that are assigned to an account. 

**Scopes**:<br>
* `phone:write:admin` or `phone:master`<br>

**Prerequisites**:<br>
* Business or Enterprise Account
<br>**[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`<br>



<h3 id="list-byoc-sip-trunks-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|next_page_token|query|string|false|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|
|page_size|query|integer|false|The number of records returned within a single API call.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{

## Set up shared access

<a id="opIdaddUserSetting"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/phone/users/string/settings/string \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "voice_mail": {
      "access_user_id": "string",
      "delete": true,
      "download": true
    }
  }'
```

`POST /phone/users/{userId}/settings/{settingType}`

Phone users can access [shared voicemail inboxes](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360033863991-Sharing-and-controlling-access-to-a-voicemail-inbox) in the Zoom desktop client, web portal, or provisioned desk phone. Use this API to define the voicemail access permissions of a user.

To view these settings in the Zoom web portal, navigate to **Admin >Phone System Management> Users & Rooms**. Click the **Users** tab and select **User Settings**. Scroll down to **Voicemail & Call Recordings**.<br>

**Scope**:`phone:write:admin`<br>
<br>**[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`<br>



**Prerequisites**: <br>
Business or Enterprise Account

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "voice_mail": {
    "access_user_id": "string",
    "delete": true,
    "download": true
  }
}
```

<h3 id="set-up-shared-access-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|userId|path|string|true|Unique identifier of the user.|
|settingType|path|string|true|Corresponds to the setting item you wish to modify. Allowed values: `voice_mail`|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» voice_mail|body|object|false|Update the voicemail setting.|
|» » access_user_id|body|string|false|Specify the user ID of a user with whom to share voicemail access permissions. |
|» » delete|body|boolean|false|Specifies whether the user has delete permissions. The default is **false**.|
|» » download|body|boolean|false|Specifies whether the user has download permissions. The default is **false**.|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "access_user_id": "12",
  "permission": [
    {
      "delete": "false",
      "download": "false"
    }
  ],
  "voice_mail": "voicemailtest"
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
null
```

<h3 id="set-up-shared-access-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|**HTTP Status Code** `201` <br><br>Created Successfully.|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Response Code:** `400`<br><br>Voicemail option has been disabled.<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `300`<br><br>Invalid user sub setting type.<br><br>Voicemail has already been shared to the user.<br>|Inline|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404` <br><br><br>**Error Code:** `1001`<br><br>User does not exist: {userId}.|None|

<h3 id="set-up-shared-access-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **201**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|voice_mail|object|false|none|none|
|» access_user_id|string|false|none|The user that is allowed to access voicemail messages for the extension.|
|» delete|boolean|false|none|Specifies whether the user has delete permissions. The default is **false**.|
|» download|boolean|false|none|Specifies whether the user has download permissions. The default is **false**.|
|» shared_id|string|false|none|Unique identifier of the voicemail that the user can access.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

null
```

<h3 id="remove-shared-access-responses">Responses</h3>

|---|---|---|---|

|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Codes** `404`<br><br>Voicemail option has been disabled.<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `300`<br><br>Invalid user sub setting type.<br>|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Codes** `404`<br><br>Shared voicemail does not exist:{shared_id}<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `1001`<br><br>User does not exist: {userId}<br>|None|

    "name": "string",
    "site_id": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /phone/auto_receptionists`

Auto receptionists answer calls with a personalized recording and routes calls to a phone user, call queue, common area phone, voicemail or an IVR system. Use this API to add an [auto receptionist](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360021121312-Managing-Auto-Receptionists-and-Interactive-Voice-Response-IVR-) to a Zoom Phone.<br>

**Prerequisites:**<br>
* Pro or higher account with Zoom Phone license.<br>
**Scopes:** `phone:write:admin` <br> 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`



> Body parameter

```json
{
  "name": "string",
  "site_id": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="add-an-auto-receptionist-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» name|body|string|true|Provide a name to help identify the auto receptionist.|
|» site_id|body|string|false|Unique identifier of the site where the auto receptionist is to be assigned. This field is required only if you have [multiple sites](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360020809672-Managing-Multiple-Sites) enabled.|

> Example responses

|---|---|---|---|

|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400` **Bad Request**<br><br>**Error Code:** `300` **Validation failed.**<br><br>* Multiple Site is disabled.<br><br>* Site does not exist.<br><br><br>|None|

<h3 id="add-an-auto-receptionist-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **201**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|extension_number|integer|false|none| Extension number assigned to the auto receptionist.|
|id|string|false|none|Auto receptionist ID. Unique Identifier of the auto receptionist.|

`PATCH /phone/auto_receptionists/{autoReceptionistId}`

An auto receptionist answers calls with a personalized recording and routes calls to a phone user, call queue, common area phone, or voicemail. An auto receptionist can also be set up so that it routes calls to an interactive voice response (IVR) system to allow callers to select the routing options.<br>
Use this API to [change information](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360021121312-Managing-Auto-Receptionists-and-Interactive-Voice-Response-IVR-#h_1d5ffc56-6ba3-4ce5-9d86-4a1a1ee743f3) such as display name and extension number assigned to the main auto receptionist.<br><br>

 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`

  "extension_number": 0,

|body|body|object|false|none|
|» extension_number|body|integer|false|Extension number to be assigned to the auto receptionist. If site code is enabled, provide the short extension number instead.|
|» name|body|string|false|Display name of the auto receptionist.|

> Example responses

null

AutoReceptionist does not exist, AutoReceptionistId: {autoReceptionistId}<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `400`<br><br>Invalid short number length.<br><br>Invalid full extension number length.<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `10001`<br><br>Number {extensionNumber} is a reserved extension number.<br><br>Extension number {extensionNumber} is already used.<br><br>|None|

<h1 id="zoom-api-phone-blocked-list">Phone Blocked List</h1>

## List blocked lists

<a id="opIdlistBlockedList"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/phone/blocked_list \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /phone/blocked_list`

A Zoom account owner or a user with admin privilege can block phone numbers for phone users in an account. Blocked numbers can be inbound (numbers will be blocked from calling in) and outbound (phone users in your account won't be able to dial those numbers). Blocked callers will hear a generic message stating that the person they are calling is not available.<br>Use this API to list all the blocked lists in an acccount.<br>
**Prerequisites:**
* Pro or higher account plan with Zoom phone license<br>
**Scope:** `phone:read:admin`<br> 


 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`

<h3 id="list-blocked-lists-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|next_page_token|query|string|false|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|
|page_size|query|integer|false|The total number of records returned from a single API call.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "blocked_list": [
    {
      "block_type": "inbound",
      "comment": "Blocked numbers starting with 777",
      "id": "7buyurtKc0Zw",
      "match_type": "prefix",
      "phone_number": "1777",
      "status": "active"
    },
    {
      "block_type": "inbound",
      "comment": "Blocked an unknown caller",
      "id": "cYDtrtyrgyQw",
      "match_type": "phoneNumber",
      "phone_number": "600040404",
      "status": "active"
    }
  ],
  "next_page_token": "",
  "page_size": 30,
  "total_records": 2
}
```

<h3 id="list-blocked-lists-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** `200` **OK**<br><br>Blocked list returned successfully.|Inline|

<h3 id="list-blocked-lists-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|blocked_list|[object]|false|none|none|
|» block_type|string|false|none|Block type.<br><br>`inbound`: The blocked number or numbers with the specifie prefix are prevented from calling in to phone users.<br><br><br>`outbound`: The phone users  are prevented from calling the blocked number or numbers with the specified prefix.|
|» comment|string|false|none|Provide a comment to help you identify the blocked number or prefix.|
|» id|string|false|none|Unique identifier of the blocked list.|
|» match_type|string|false|none|Indicates the match type for the blocked list. The values can be one of the following:<br><br>`phoneNumber`: Indicates that only a specific phone number that is shown in the `phone_number` field is blocked.<br><br><br>`prefix`: Indicates that all numbers starting with prefix that is shown in the `phone_number` field are blocked.|
|» phone_number|string|false|none|The phone number to be blocked if you passed "phoneNumber" as the value for the `match_type` field. If you passed "prefix" as the value for the `match_type` field, provide the prefix of the phone number here including the country code. For example, entering 1905 blocks numbers with country code 1 and area code 905. |
|» status|string|false|none|Indicates whether the blocking is active or inactive. <br><br>`active`: The blocked list is active.<br><br>`inactive`: The blocked list is inactive.|
|next_page_token|string|false|none|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|
|page_size|integer|false|none|The total number of records returned from a single API call.|
|total_records|integer|false|none|The total number of records found for this query.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|» block_type|inbound|
|» block_type|outbound|
|» match_type|phoneNumber|
|» match_type|prefix|
|» status|active|
|» status|inactive|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

## Create a blocked list

<a id="opIdaddAnumberToBlockedList"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/phone/blocked_list \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "block_type": "inbound",
    "comment": "string",
    "match_type": "phoneNumber",
    "phone_number": "string",
    "status": "active"
  }'
```

`POST /phone/blocked_list`

A Zoom account owner or a user with admin privilege can block phone numbers for phone users in an account. Blocked numbers can be inbound (numbers will be blocked from calling in) and outbound (phone users in your account won't be able to dial those numbers). Blocked callers will hear a generic message stating that the person they are calling is not available.<br>Use this API to create a blocked list and add a number to that blocked list.<br>
**Prerequisites:**
* Pro or higher account plan with Zoom phone license<br>
**Scope:** `phone:write:admin`<br> 


 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "block_type": "inbound",
  "comment": "string",
  "match_type": "phoneNumber",
  "phone_number": "string",
  "status": "active"
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-blocked-list-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» block_type|body|string|false|State whether you want the block type to be inbound or outbound.<br><br>`inbound`: Pass this value to prevent the blocked number or prefix from calling in to phone users.<br><br>`outbound`: Pass this value to prevent phone users from calling the blocked number or prefix.|
|» comment|body|string|false|Provide a comment to help you identify the blocked number or prefix.|
|» match_type|body|string|false|Specify the match type for the blocked list. The values can be one of the following:<br><br><br>`phoneNumber`: Choose this option (Phone Number Match) if you want to block a specific phone number. Then, in the `phone_number` field, provide the phone number along with the country code.<br><br><br>`prefix`: Choose this option (Prefix Match) if you want to block all numbers with a specific country code and area code. Next, in the `phone_number` field, enter a country code as part of the prefix. For example, entering 1907 blocks numbers with country code 1 and area code 907.|
|» phone_number|body|string|false|The phone number to be blocked if you passed "phoneNumber" as the value for the `match_type` field. If you passed "prefix" as the value for the `match_type` field, provide the prefix of the phone number here including the country code. For example, entering 1905 blocks numbers with country code 1 and area code 905. |
|» status|body|string|false|Enable or disable the blocking. One of the following values are allowed:<br><br>`active`: Keep the blocking active.<br><br>`inactive`: Disable the blocking.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» block_type|inbound|
|» block_type|outbound|
|» match_type|phoneNumber|
|» match_type|prefix|
|» status|active|
|» status|inactive|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "id": "dhfhfhnim"
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-blocked-list-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|**HTTP Status Code:** `201` **Created**<br><br>Number added to the blocked list successfully.|Inline|
|409|Conflict|**HTTP Status Code:** `409` **Conflict**<br><br><br>Blocked number already exists.|None|

Status Code **201**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

|id|string|false|none|Unique identifier of the blocked list.|

OAuth
</aside>

## Update a blocked list

<a id="opIdupdateBlockedList"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/phone/blocked_list/string \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "block_type": "inbound",
    "comment": "string",
    "match_type": "phoneNumber",
    "phone_number": "string",
    "status": "active"
  }'
```

`PATCH /phone/blocked_list/{blockedListId}`

A Zoom account owner or a user with admin privilege can block phone numbers for phone users in an account. Blocked numbers can be inbound (numbers will be blocked from calling in) and outbound (phone users in your account won't be able to dial those numbers). Blocked callers will hear a generic message stating that the person they are calling is not available.<br>Use this API to update information on the blocked list.<br>
**Prerequisites:**
* Pro or higher account plan with Zoom phone license<br>
**Scope:** `phone:write:admin`<br> 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`



> Body parameter

```json
{
  "block_type": "inbound",
  "comment": "string",
  "match_type": "phoneNumber",
  "phone_number": "string",
  "status": "active"
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-blocked-list-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|blockedListId|path|string|true|Unique Identifier of the blocked list.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» block_type|body|string|false|State whether you want the block type to be inbound or outbound.<br><br>`inbound`: Pass this value to prevent the blocked number or prefix from calling in to phone users.<br><br>`outbound`: Pass this value to prevent phone users from calling the blocked number or prefix.|
|» comment|body|string|false|Provide a comment to help you identify the blocked number or prefix.|
|» match_type|body|string|false|Specify the match type for the blocked list. The values can be one of the following:<br><br><br>`phoneNumber`: Choose this option (Phone Number Match) if you want to block a specific phone number. Then, in the `phone_number` field, provide the phone number along with the country code.<br><br><br>`prefix`: Choose this option (Prefix Match) if you want to block all numbers with a specific country code and area code. Next, in the `phone_number` field, enter a country code as part of the prefix. For example, entering 1907 blocks numbers with country code 1 and area code 907.|
|» phone_number|body|string|false|The phone number to be blocked if you passed "phoneNumber" as the value for the `match_type` field. If you passed "prefix" as the value for the `match_type` field, provide the prefix of the phone number here including the country code. For example, entering 1905 blocks numbers with country code 1 and area code 905. |
|» status|body|string|false|Enable or disable the blocking. One of the following values are allowed:<br><br>`active`: Keep the blocking active.<br><br>`inactive`: Disable the blocking.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» block_type|inbound|
|» block_type|outbound|
|» match_type|phoneNumber|
|» match_type|prefix|
|» status|active|
|» status|inactive|

> Example responses

> 204 Response

```json
null
```

<h3 id="update-a-blocked-list-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|**HTTP Status Code:** `204` **No Content**<br><br>Blocked list updated successfully.<br>|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400` **Bad Request**<br><br>Blocked number (Id: {blockedListId}) does not exist.<br>|None|
|409|Conflict|**HTTP Status Code:** `409` **Conflict**<br><br><br>Blocked number already exists.|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

## Create a call queue

<a id="opIdcreateCallQueue"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/phone/call_queues \

  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "description": "string",
    "extension_number": 0,
    "members": {
      "common_area_phone_ids": [
        "string"
      ],
      "users": [
        {
          "email": "user@example.com",
          "id": "string"
        }
      ]
    },
    "name": "string",
    "site_id": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /phone/call_queues`

Call queues allow you to route incoming calls to a group of users. For instance, you can use call queues to route calls to various departments in your organization such as sales, engineering, billing, customer service etc.<br> Use this API to [create a call queue](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360021524831-Managing-Call-Queues#h_e81faeeb-9184-429a-aaea-df49ff5ff413).<br> You can add phone users or common area phones to call queues.

**Prerequisites:**<br>
* Pro, Business, or Education account
* Account owner or admin permissions
* Zoom Phone license<br>
**Scopes:** `phone:write:admin`<br> 


 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "description": "string",
  "extension_number": 0,
  "members": {
    "common_area_phone_ids": [
      "string"
    ],
    "users": [
      {
        "email": "user@example.com",
        "id": "string"
      }
    ]
  },
  "name": "string",
  "site_id": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-call-queue-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» description|body|string|false|Description for the Call Queue.|
|» extension_number|body|integer|false|Phone extension number for the site.<br><br><br>If a site code has been [assigned](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360020809672-Managing-Multiple-Sites#h_79ca9c8f-c97b-4486-aa59-d0d9d31a525b) to the site, provide the short extension number instead of the original extension number..|
|» members|body|object|false|A list of one or more phone users to be included in the call queue. Provide either users or common area phone(s). Provide at least one user in the users object.|
|» » common_area_phone_ids|body|[string]|false|**Optional**<br><br>Unique identifier of the [Common Area Phone](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360028516231-Managing-Common-Area-Phones). This can be retrieved from the List Common Area Phones API.|
|» » users|body|[object]|false|Users object. Provide either the id (userId) field or the email address of the user.|
|» » » email|body|string(email)|false|Email address of the user. This can be retrieved from the [List Users](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/users/users) API.|
|» » » id|body|string|false|User Id of the user. This can be retrieved from the [List Users](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/users/users) API.|
|» name|body|string|true|Name of the Call Queue.|
|» site_id|body|string|true|Unique identifier of the site. Required only if [multiple sites](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360020809672-Managing-Multiple-Sites) have been enabled. This can be retrieved from the [List Phone Sites](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/phone-site/listphonesites) API.|

|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404` **Not Found**<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `1001`<br><br> User not found: {userId}<br>|None|

|id|string|false|none|Unique Identifier of the Call Queue.|

## List devices

<a id="opIdlistPhoneDevices"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/phone/devices?type=assigned' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /phone/devices`

List all the [desk phone devices](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360021119092) that are configured with Zoom Phone on an account. To view devices that have not yet been assigned to a user, set the value of the `type` query parameter as `unassigned` and to view devices that have been assigned, set the value as `assigned`.<br><br>
**Scopes:** `phone:read:admin`
 <br>
**Prerequisites:**<br>
* Pro or a higher account with Zoom Phone license
* Account owner or admin permissions<br>

 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`

<h3 id="list-devices-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|type|query|string|true|State of the device. The value should be either `assigned` to list devices that have been assigned to user(s) or `unassigned` to list devices that have not yet been assigned to any user in the Zoom account.|
|next_page_token|query|string|false|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|
|page_size|query|integer|false|The number of records returned within a single API call.|

}

curl https://example.com/phone/devices \

`POST /phone/devices`

By default, all Zoom Phone users can make and receive calls using the Zoom desktop and mobile applications. Additionally, if a desk phone is required, use this API to [add a desk phone and assign it](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360021119092#h_5ca07504-68a8-4c3d-ad0e-c1d3594436da) to a user.

**Prerequisites:**<br>
* Pro or a higher account with Zoom Phone license
* Account owner or admin permissions
* [Supported device](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360001299063-Zoom-Voice-Supported-Devices)<br>
**Scopes:** `phone:write:admin`<br> 


 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "assigned_to": "string",
  "display_name": "string",
  "mac_address": "string",
  "model": "string",
  "type": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="add-a-device-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» assigned_to|body|string|false|User ID or email address of the user to whom this device is to be assigned. The User ID and the email of the user can be retrieved using the [List Users](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/users/users) API.|
|» display_name|body|string|true|Display name of the desk phone.|
|» mac_address|body|string|true|The MAC address of the desk phone.<br> <br>Note: If you're using a wireless phone, enter the wired MAC address, not the wireless MAC address.|
|» model|body|string|false|Model name of the device.|
|» type|body|string|false|Manufacturer (brand) name of the device.|

> Example responses

```json
null
```

|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404` **Not Found**<br><br>**Error Code:** `1001`<br><br>User not found: {userId}<br>|None|

## Update a device

`PATCH /phone/devices/{deviceId}`

|» mac_address|body|string|false|The MAC address of the desk phone.<br> <br>Note: If you're using a wireless phone, enter the wired MAC address, not the wireless MAC address.|

<h1 id="zoom-api-phone-reports">Phone Reports</h1>

## Get operation logs report

<a id="opIdgetPSOperationLogs"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/phone/reports/operationlogs \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /phone/reports/operationlogs`

The **Phone System operation logs report** allows account owners and admins to view monthly Zoom phone related admin operation details. 

Use this API to retrieve the **Phone System Operation Logs Report**. Account owners and admins can also access this information by logging into their Zoom accounts and navigating to [Phone System Operation Logs](https://zoom.us/pbx/page/report/operations#/report/operation-logs).<br><br> **Scopes:** `phone:read:admin`, `phone:write:admin` <br> **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Heavy`<br>
<br> **Prerequisites:** <br>
* Account must be enrollled in Pro or a higher plan
* Account must be enrolled in a [Zoom Phone](https://zoom.us/pricing/zoom-phone) plan



<h3 id="get-operation-logs-report-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|from|query|string|false|Start date in 'yyyy-mm-dd' format. The date range defined by the "from" and "to" parameters should only be one month as the report provides only one month worth of data per API request.|
|to|query|string|false|End date in 'yyyy-mm-dd' format.|
|category_type|query|string|false|Filter the response by the category of the action performed. By default, the value of this field is "all" and thus, the response will include log of all operations for the defined period.<br><br>To only include response for a specific category type, provide a value for `category_type` from this [table](http://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/phone-operation-categories ).|
|page_size|query|integer|false|The number of records returned within a single API call.|
|next_page_token|query|string|false|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "from": "2020-08-01",
  "next_page_token": "abcD3944YsoYPB12",
  "operation_logs": [
    {
      "action": "UPDATE",
      "category_type": "Phone Number",
      "operation_detail": "Unbind Phone Number +1112222 From Not_Delete_CallQueue_Recording",
      "operator": "apbchd@mail123a.com",
      "time": "2020-08-24T06:15:12Z"
    },
    {
      "action": "DELETE",
      "category_type": "Phone Number",
      "operation_detail": "Delete Phone Number +123456 From abc.zoom.us",
      "operator": "apbchd@mail123a.com",
      "time": "2020-08-24T06:13:30Z"
    },
    {
      "action": "ADD",
      "category_type": "Device",
      "operation_detail": "Add Device testDevice",
      "operator": "apbcdef@mail123a.com",
      "time": "2020-08-11T03:13:17Z"
    },
    {
      "action": "UPDATE",
      "category_type": "Phone Number",
      "operation_detail": "Assign Phone Number +120000123 to Sam Mendes(abcdaccount@someaccount.com)",
      "operator": "apapbchd@mail123a.com",
      "time": "2020-08-06T08:29:45Z"
    }
  ],
  "page_size": 15,
  "to": "2020-08-30",
  "total_records": 16
}
```

<h3 id="get-operation-logs-report-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** `200`<br><br>Report returned.|Inline|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404`<br><br>**Error Code**: `124`<br> Account does not exist: {accountId}.|None|

<h3 id="get-operation-logs-report-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|next_page_token|string|false|none|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of the available result list exceeds the page size. The expiration period is 15 minutes.|
|page_size|integer|false|none|The amount of records returns within a single API call. |
|operation_logs|[object]|false|none|Array of operation log objects|
|» action|string|false|none|Action that was performed.|
|» category_type|string|false|none|Category type of the operation.|
|» operation_detail|string|false|none|Operation detail.|
|» operator|string|false|none|The user who performed the operation.|
|» time|string(date-time)|false|none|The time at which the operation was performed.|
