`GET /phone/shared_line_groups`

A [shared line group](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360038850792) allows Zoom Phone admins to share a phone number and extension with a group of phone users or common area phones. This gives members of the shared line group access to the group's direct phone number and voicemail. Use this API to list all the Shared Line Groups.

**Prerequisties:** <br>
* Pro or higher account with Zoom Phone license.
* Account owner or admin privileges  <br>

**Scopes:** `phone:read:admin`, `phone:write:admin`

 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`

|next_page_token|query|string|false|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|

## Create a shared line group

<a id="opIdcreateASharedLineGroup"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/phone/shared_line_groups \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "description": "string",
    "display_name": "string",
    "extension_number": 0,
    "site_id": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /phone/shared_line_groups`

A [shared line group](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360038850792) allows Zoom Phone admins to share a phone number and extension with a group of phone users or common area phones. This gives members of the shared line group access to the group's direct phone number and voicemail. Use this API to create a shared line group.

**Prerequisties:** <br>
* Pro or higher account with Zoom Phone license.
* Account owner or admin privileges 

**Scopes:** `phone:write:admin`
 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "description": "string",
  "display_name": "string",
  "extension_number": 0,
  "site_id": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-shared-line-group-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» description|body|string|false|Provide a description for the shared line group.|
|» display_name|body|string|true|Provide a name to help identify the shared line group.|
|» extension_number|body|integer|false|Extension number to be assigned to the shared line group. If a [site code has been assigned](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360020809672#h_79ca9c8f-c97b-4486-aa59-d0d9d31a525b) to the site, provide the short extension number |
|» site_id|body|string|false|Unique identifier of the [site](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360020809672-Managing-multiple-sites) that you would like to use for the shared line group. You will only be able to add members that belong to this site to the shared line group.<br><br>This field is required only if the [multiple sites](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360020809672-Managing-multiple-sites) option has been enabled for the account.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
null
```

<h3 id="create-a-shared-line-group-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** `200` **OK** <br><br>Shared Line Group created successfully.<br>|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400` **Bad Request** <br><br>**Error Code:** `300` **Validation Failed** <br><br>* Multiple Site has not been enabled for this account.<br><br>* Site does not exist. <br><br><br>**Error Code:** `400` <br><br>Extension number {extensionNumber} is already used.<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `409` <br><br>Invalid short number length. <br><br>Number {extensionNumber} is a reserved extension number.<br><br><br>|None|

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

`PATCH /phone/shared_line_groups/{sharedLineGroupId}`

A [shared line group](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360038850792) allows Zoom Phone admins to share a phone number and extension with a group of phone users or common area phones. This gives members of the shared line group access to the group's direct phone number and voicemail. Use this API to update information of a Shared Line Group. 
**Prerequisties:** <br>
* Pro or higher account with Zoom Phone license.
* Account owner or admin privileges 

**Scopes:** `phone:write:admin`

 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "display_name": "string",
  "extension_number": 0,
  "primary_number": {
    "id": "string",
    "number": "string"
  },
  "status": "active",
  "timezone": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-shared-line-group-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|sharedLineGroupId|path|string|true|Unique identifier of the shared line group that is to be updated.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» display_name|body|string|false|Display Name of the Shared Line Group.|
|» extension_number|body|integer|false|Extension number assigned to the Shared Line Group.|
|» primary_number|body|object|false|If you have multiple direct phone numbers assigned to the shared line group, select a number from those numbers as the primary number. The primary number shares the same line as the extension number. This means if a caller is routed to the shared line group through an auto receptionist, the line associated with the primary number will be used. A pending number cannot be used as a Primary Number.|
|» » id|body|string|false|Phone Number ID. Unique Identifier of the Phone Number.|
|» » number|body|string|false|Phone Number that you would like to assign as the primary number for this Shared Line Group.|
|» status|body|string|false|Status of the Shared Line Group.|
|» timezone|body|string|false|Timezone to be used for the Business Hours. A value should be provided from the IDs listed [here](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/other-references/abbreviation-lists#timezones).|

|» status|inactive|

`POST /phone/shared_line_groups/{sharedLineGroupId}/members`

A [shared line group](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360038850792) allows Zoom Phone admins to share a phone number and extension with a group of phone users or common area phones. This gives members of the shared line group access to the group's direct phone number and voicemail. Use this API to [add members](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360038850792-Setting-up-shared-line-groups#h_7cb42370-48f6-4a8f-84f4-c6eee4d9f0ca) to a Shared Line Group. Note that a member can only be added to one shared line group.

* Pro or higher account with Zoom Phone license.
* A valid Shared Line Group
* Account owner or admin privileges 

**Scopes:** `phone:write:admin`


 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "members": {
    "common_area_phone_ids": [
      "string"
    ],
    "users": [
      {
        "email": "string",
        "id": "string"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

<h3 id="add-members-to-a-shared-line-group-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|sharedLineGroupId|path|string|true|Unique Identifier of the shared line group.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» members|body|object|false|Members can comprise of users on the account as well as common area phones. You can add a maximum of 10 members at once.|
|» » common_area_phone_ids|body|[string]|false|Unique identifier(s) of the Common Area Phone. |
|» » users|body|[object]|false|Zoom Phone users on the account.|
|» » » email|body|string|false|Email address of the user.|
|» » » id|body|string|false|Unique identifier of the user.|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
null
```

<h3 id="add-members-to-a-shared-line-group-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|**HTTP Status Code:** `201` **Created** <br>Members added successfully.|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400` **Bad Request** <br><br>Members of a shared line group should come from same site.<br><br>A shared line group can only contain {0} members at most.<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `300` **Validation Failed**<br><br>* Shared line group (id: {sharedLingGroupId}) does not exist.<br><br>|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404` **Not Found** <br><br>Device does not exist in the system.<br><br>**Error Code:** `1001`<br><br>User not found: {userId}.<br><br><br>|None|

`POST /phone/sites`

Sites allow you to organize Zoom Phone users in your organization. Use this API to create a [Site](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360020809672).<br>
**Prerequisites:**<br>
* Multiple Sites must be [enabled](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360020809672-Managing-Multiple-Sites#h_05c88e35-1593-491f-b1a8-b7139a75dc15).
* Pro or a higher account with Zoom Phone enabled.
**Scope:** `phone:write:admin`<br> 
 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`



> Body parameter

```json
{
  "auto_receptionist_name": "string",
  "default_emergency_address": {
    "address_line1": "string",
    "address_line2": "string",
    "city": "string",
    "country": "st",
    "state_code": "string",
    "zip": "string"
  },
  "name": "string",
  "short_extension": {
    "length": 3
  },
  "site_code": 0
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-phone-site-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» auto_receptionist_name|body|string|true|Display name of the [auto-receptionist](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360021121312-Managing-Auto-Receptionists-and-Integrated-Voice-Response-IVR-) for the site.|
|» default_emergency_address|body|object|false|none|
|» » address_line1|body|string|true|Address Line 1 of the  [emergency address](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360021062871-Setting-an-Emergency-Address) consisting of house number and street name.|
|» » address_line2|body|string|false|Address Line 2 of the [emergency address](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360021062871-Setting-an-Emergency-Address) consisting of Building number, floor number, unit, etc.|
|» » city|body|string|true|City of the [emergency address](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360021062871-Setting-an-Emergency-Address).|
|» » country|body|string|true|Two lettered country code (Aplha-2 code in ISO-3166) standard of the Site's [emergency address](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360021062871-Setting-an-Emergency-Address).|
|» » state_code|body|string|true|State Code of the [emergency address](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360021062871-Setting-an-Emergency-Address).|
|» » zip|body|string|true|Zip Code of the [emergency address](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360021062871-Setting-an-Emergency-Address).|
|» name|body|string|true|Name of the Site.|
|» short_extension|body|object|false|Short extension of the phone site.|
|» » length|body|integer|false|Specify the length of short extension numbers for the site.<br><br>Since there is a default 6-digit limit on extensions, the short extension can be 2 to 5 digits and the length of site code added to the length of short extension can not exceed a value of `6` (i.e., length of `site_code`+ length of `short_extension` should always be less than or equal to 6).|
|» site_code|body|integer|false|Identifier for a site. If site code is enabled, this field is required.<br><br>|

> Example responses

> 204 Response

## Delete a phone site

<a id="opIddeletePhoneSite"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/phone/sites/string?transfer_site_id=string' \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /phone/sites/{siteId}`

Sites allow you to organize Zoom Phone users in your organization. Use this API to delete a specific [site](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360020809672) in a Zoom account. To delete a site, in the query parameter, you must provide the Site ID of another site where the assets of current site (users, numbers and phones) can be transferred to.  You cannot use this API to delete the main site.

**Prerequisites:** <br>
* Account must have a Pro or a higher plan with Zoom Phone license. 
* [Multiple Sites](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360020809672-Managing-Multiple-Sites) must be enabled.<br>
**Scope:** `phone:write:admin`
<br> 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`



<h3 id="delete-a-phone-site-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|siteId|path|string|true|Unique Identifier of the Site.|
|transfer_site_id|query|string|true|The Site ID of another site where the assets of the current site (users, numbers and phones) can be transferred to.|

> Example responses

> 204 Response

```json
null
```

<h3 id="delete-a-phone-site-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|

|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400` **Bad Request**<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `400`<br><br>Unable to transfer to the same site.<br><br>Main company number can not change {phoneNumber}.<br><br>Site does not exist.|None|
|409|Conflict|**HTTP Status Code:** `409` **Conflict**<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `409`<br><br>Conflict target extension number, try later.|None|

OAuth

## List common area phones

<a id="opIdlistCommonAreaPhones"></a>

```bash
curl https://example.com/phone/common_area_phones \
```

`GET /phone/common_area_phones`

A common area phone can be provisioned by a Zoom account owner or a Zoom admin so that anyone in an organization can use it. For example, if your office has shared desks that don't belong to a specific employees, you could add a common area phone so that any person can use it.<br> Use this API to [list all common area phone](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360028516231-Managing-Common-Area-Phones) in an account.<br><br>**Prerequisites:**<br>
* Pro or a higher account with Zoom Phone license.
* Account owner or admin permissions.
* [Supported device](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360001299063-Zoom-Voice-Supported-Devices)<br><br>
**Scope:** `phone:read:admin`<br> 

 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`

<h3 id="list-common-area-phones-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|page_size|query|integer|false|The total number of records returned from a single API call.|
|next_page_token|query|string|false|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|

```json
      "id": "string",
      "mac_address": "string",
      "phone_numbers": [
        {
          "id": "string",
          "number": "string",
          "source": "string"
        }
      ],
      "site": {
        "id": "string",
        "name": "string"
      },
      "status": "string"
    }
  ],
  "next_page_token": "string",
  "page_size": "integer",
  "total_records": "integer"
}
```

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|

`POST /phone/common_area_phones`

A common area phone can be provisioned by a Zoom account owner or a Zoom admin so that anyone in an organization can use it. For example, if your office has shared desks that don't belong to a specific employees, you could add a common area phone so that any person can use it.<br> Use this API to [add a common area phone](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360028516231-Managing-Common-Area-Phones#h_2d0da347-c35a-4993-9771-e21aaa568deb).<br><br>
**Prerequisites:**<br>
* Pro or a higher account with Zoom Phone license.
* Account owner or admin permissions.
* [Supported device](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360001299063-Zoom-Voice-Supported-Devices)<br>
**Scope:** `phone:write:admin`<br>

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "description": "string",
  "display_name": "string",
  "extension_number": 0,
  "mac_address": "string",
  "model": "string",
  "site_id": "string",
  "time_zone": "string",
  "type": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="add-a-common-area-phone-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» description|body|string|false|Description for the common area phone.|
|» display_name|body|string|true|Display name of the Common area phone.|
|» extension_number|body|integer|true|Extension number assigned to the common area phone. If site code is enabled, provide the short extension number instead.|
|» mac_address|body|string|true|Mac Address (serial number) of the common area desk phone. These examples show the formats supported: `64-16-7f-37-90-92` or `64167f379092`|
|» model|body|string|false|Device Model name. Refer to the "Model Name" field in [this](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/other-references/zoomphone-supporteddevice) table.|
|» site_id|body|string|false|Unique identifier of the [site](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360020809672). This can be retrieved from the [List Phone Sites](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/phone-site/listphonesites) API.|
|» time_zone|body|string|false|[Timezone ID](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/other-references/abbreviation-lists) for the common area phone.|
|» type|body|string|true|Phone device manufacturer name. Refer to the "Manufacturer Name" field in [this](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/other-references/zoomphone-supporteddevice) table.|

```json
  "display_name": "Common Area Phone - lobby",
  "id": "comfgfd45um"
}
```

|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400` **Bad Request**<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `300`<br><br>Validation failed.<br><br>* Phone manufacturer does not exist.<br>* Phone model does not exist.<br>* Phone manufacturer is not supported.<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `400`<br><br>The MAC Address is invalid.<br>|None|

`PATCH /phone/common_area_phones/{commonAreaPhoneId}`

A common area phone can be provisioned by a Zoom account owner or a Zoom admin so that anyone in an organization can use it. For example, if your office has shared desks that don't belong to a specific employees, you could add a common area phone so that any person can use it.<br> Use this API to update details on a specific [common area phone](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360028516231-Managing-Common-Area-Phones) in an account.<br><br>**Prerequisites:**<br>
* Pro or a higher account with Zoom Phone license.
* Account owner or admin permissions.
* [Supported device](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360001299063-Zoom-Voice-Supported-Devices)<br>
**Scopes:** `phone:write:admin`<br> 


 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "display_name": "string",
  "extension_number": 0,
  "mac_address": "string",
  "site_id": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="update-common-area-phone-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|commonAreaPhoneId|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» display_name|body|string|false|Display name of the common area phone.|
|» extension_number|body|integer|false|Extension number of the phone. If site code is enabled, provide short extension number instead.|
|» mac_address|body|string|false| Mac address or serial number of the device. Examples of supported format: "64-16-7f-37-90-92" or "64167f379092".|
|» site_id|body|string|false|Unique identifier of the [site](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360020809672-Managing-Multiple-Sites) to which the common area desk phone is assigned.|

> Example responses

> 204 Response

```json
null
```

<h3 id="update-common-area-phone-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|**HTTP Status Code:** `204` **No Content**<br><br>Common Area Phone information updated successfully.|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400` **Bad Request**<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `300`<br><br>Validation Failed. Device does not exist in the system.|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

## Get sign In / sign out activity report

<a id="opIdreportSignInSignOutActivities"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/report/activities \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /report/activities`

Retrieve a list of sign in / sign out activity logs [report](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/201363213-Getting-Started-with-Reports) of users under a Zoom account.<br>
**Prerequisites**<br>
* Pro or higher plan.<br>
**Scopes:** `report:read:admin`<br>
 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Heavy`

<h3 id="get-sign-in-sign-out-activity-report-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|from|query|string(date)|false|Start date for which you would like to view the activity logs report. Using the `from` and `to` parameters, specify a monthly date range for the report as the API only provides one month worth of data in one request. The specified date range should fall within the last six months.|
|to|query|string(date)|false|End date up to which you would like to view the activity logs report.|
|page_size|query|integer|false|The number of records to be returned within a single API call|
|next_page_token|query|string|false|Next page token is used to paginate through large result sets|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
"{\n            \"email\": \"sfkjsldfhjdsf@dskjflhdsf.com\",\n            \"time\": \"2019-09-15T20:56:09Z\",\n            \"type\": \"Sign in\",\n            \"ip_address\": \"38.99.100.6\",\n            \"client_type\": \"Browser\",\n            \"version\": \"-\"\n        },\n        {\n            \"email\": \"dfdsfdfdf@gidfdfdl.com\",\n            \"time\": \"2019-09-15T19:13:41Z\",\n            \"type\": \"Sign in\",\n            \"ip_address\": \"38.99.100.6\",\n            \"client_type\": \"Browser\",\n            \"version\": \"-\"\n        },\n        {\n            \"email\": \"fdfdfdf@gfdgfdgdsfg.com\",\n            \"time\": \"2019-09-15T18:50:15Z\",\n            \"type\": \"Sign out\",\n            \"ip_address\": \"38.99.100.6\",\n            \"client_type\": \"Browser\",\n            \"version\": \"-\"\n        }"
```

<h3 id="get-sign-in-sign-out-activity-report-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** `200`<br><br>Success|Inline|

<h3 id="get-sign-in-sign-out-activity-report-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|activity_logs|[object]|false|none|Array of activity logs.|
|» client_type|string|false|none|The client interface type using which the activity was performed.|
|» email|string|false|none|Email address of the user used for the activity. |
|» ip_address|string|false|none|The IP address of the user's device.|
|» time|string(date-time)|false|none|Time during which the activity occurred. |
|» type|string|false|none|The type of activity: <br>`Sign in`: Sign in activity by user.<br>`Sign out`: Sign out activity by user.|
|» version|string|false|none|Zoom client version of the user.|
|from|string|false|none|Start date from which you want the activity logs report to be generated.|
|next_page_token|string|false|none|Next page token is used to paginate through large result sets.|
|page_size|string|false|none|The number of records returned within a single API call.|
|to|string|false|none|End date until which you want the activity logs report to be generated|

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth

## Get cloud recording usage report

<a id="opIdreportCloudRecording"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/report/cloud_recording?from=1970-01-01&to=1970-01-01' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /report/cloud_recording`

Retrieve cloud recording usage report for a specified period. You can only get cloud recording reports that is one day ealier than the current date and for the most recent period of 6 months. The date gap between from and to dates should be smaller or equal to 30 days. <br>
**Prerequisites**<br>
* Pro or higher plan.<br>
**Scopes:** `report:read:admin`<br>
 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Heavy`

<h3 id="get-cloud-recording-usage-report-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|from|query|string(date)|true|Start date in 'yyyy-mm-dd' format. The date range defined by the "from" and "to" parameters should only be one month as the report includes only one month worth of data at once.|
|to|query|string(date)|true|End date.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "cloud_recording_storage": [
    {
      "date": "2019-09-14",
      "free_usage": "1 GB",
      "plan_usage": "0",
      "usage": "29 MB"
    }
  ],
  "from": "2019-09-14",
  "to": "2019-09-14"
}
```

<h3 id="get-cloud-recording-usage-report-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** `200`<br><br>Cloud Recording Report Returned|Inline|
|300|Multiple Choices|**HTTP Status Code:** `300`<br><br>Only provide report in recent 6 months|None|

<h3 id="get-cloud-recording-usage-report-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|from|string(date)|false|none|Start date for this report|
|to|string(date)|false|none|End date for this report|
|cloud_recording_storage|[object]|false|none|Array of cloud usage objects|
|» date|string(date-time)|false|none|Date of the usage|
|» free_usage|string|false|none|Free storage|
|» plan_usage|string|false|none|Paid storage|
|» usage|string|false|none|Storage used on the date|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404`<br><br>Meeting ID not found.<br><br>**Error Code:** `3001`<br><br>Meeting {meetingId} not found or has expired.<br>|None|

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

|» key|string|false|none|Custom key associated with the user.|
|» value|string|false|none|Value of the custom key associated with the user.|
|dept|string|false|none|Department of the host.|
|duration|integer|false|none|Meeting duration.|
|end_time|string(date-time)|false|none|Meeting end time.|
|id|integer(int64)|false|none|[Meeting ID](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/201362373-What-is-a-Meeting-ID-): Unique identifier of the meeting in "**long**" format(represented as int64 data type in JSON), also known as the meeting number.|
|participants_count|integer|false|none|Number of meeting participants.|
|start_time|string(date-time)|false|none|Meeting start time.|
|topic|string|false|none|Meeting topic.|
|total_minutes|integer|false|none|Number of meeting minutes. This represents the total amount of meeting minutes attended by each participant including the host, for meetings hosted by the user. For instance if there were one host(named A) and one participant(named B) in a meeting, the value of total_minutes would be calculated as below:<br><br>**total_minutes** = Total Meeting Attendance Minutes of A + Total Meeting Attendance Minutes of B|
|tracking_fields|[object]|false|none|Tracking fields.|
|» field|string|false|none|Tracking fields type.|
|» value|string|false|none|Tracking fields value.|
|type|integer|false|none|Meeting type.|
|user_email|string|false|none|User email.|
|user_name|string|false|none|User display name.|
|uuid|string(uuid)|false|none|Meeting UUID. Each meeting instance will generate its own UUID(i.e., after a meeting ends, a new UUID will be generated for the next instance of the meeting). Please double encode your UUID when using it for API calls if the UUID begins with a '/' or contains '//' in it.|

OAuth
</aside>

## Get telephone reports

<a id="opIdreportTelephone"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/report/telephone?from=1970-01-01&to=1970-01-01' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /report/telephone`

The [telephone report](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/206514816-Telephone-reports) allows you to view who dialed into meetings via phone (Audio Conferencing or SIP Connected Audio) and which number they dialed into and other details. Use this API to get telephone report for a specified period of time.

**Scopes:** `report:read:admin`<br>
 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Heavy`<br>**Prerequisites:**<br>
* Pro or higher plan.

<h3 id="get-telephone-reports-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|type|query|string|false|Audio types:<br>`1` - Toll-free Call-in & Call-out.<br>`2` - Toll <br><br>`3` - SIP Connected Audio|
|from|query|string(date)|true|Start date in 'yyyy-mm-dd' format. The date range defined by the "from" and "to" parameters should only be one month as the report includes only one month worth of data at once.|
|to|query|string(date)|true|End date.|
|page_size|query|integer|false|The number of records returned within a single API call.|
|page_number|query|integer|false|<br>**Deprecated** - This field has been deprecated and we will stop supporting it completely in a future release. Please use "next_page_token" for pagination instead of this field.<br><br>The page number of the current page in the returned records.|
|next_page_token|query|string|false|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|type|1|
|type|3|

## Get active/inactive host reports

<a id="opIdreportUsers"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/report/users?from=1970-01-01&to=1970-01-01' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /report/users`

A user is considered to be an active host during the month specified in the "from" and "to" range, if the user has hosted at least one meeting during this period. If the user didn't host any meetings during this period, the user is considered to be inactive.<br>The Active Hosts report displays a list of meetings, participants, and meeting minutes for a specific time range, up to one month. The month should fall within the last six months.<br>The Inactive Hosts report pulls a list of users who were not active during a specific period of time. 
Use this API to retrieve an active or inactive host report for a specified period of time. The time range for the report is limited to a month and the month should fall under the past six months. <br>You can specify the type of report and date range using the query parameters.<br>
**Scopes:** `report:read:admin`<br>
 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Heavy`<br>
**Prerequisites:**<br>
* Pro or higher plan.

<h3 id="get-activeinactive-host-reports-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|type|query|string|false|Active or inactive hosts.<br>`active` - Active hosts. <br>`inactive` - Inactive hosts.|
|from|query|string(date)|true|Start date in 'yyyy-mm-dd' format. The date range defined by the "from" and "to" parameters should only be one month as the report includes only one month worth of data at once.|
|to|query|string(date)|true|End date.|
|page_size|query|integer|false|The number of records returned within a single API call.|
|page_number|query|integer|false|The page number of the current page in the returned records.|
|next_page_token|query|string|false|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|type|active|
|type|inactive|

## Get meeting reports

<a id="opIdreportMeetings"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/report/users/string/meetings?from=1970-01-01&to=1970-01-01' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /report/users/{userId}/meetings`

Retrieve [report](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/216378603-Meeting-Reporting) on a past meeting for a specified period of time. The time range for the report is limited to a month and the month should fall under the past six months.

Meetings will only be returned in the response if the meeting has two or more unique participants.  <br><br>
**Scopes:** `report:read:admin`<br>
 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Heavy`<br>
**Prerequisites:**<br>
* Pro or higher plan.

<h3 id="get-meeting-reports-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|userId|path|string|true|The user ID or email address of the user. For user-level apps, pass `me` as the value for userId.|
|from|query|string(date)|true|Start date in 'yyyy-mm-dd' format. The date range defined by the "from" and "to" parameters should only be one month as the report includes only one month worth of data at once.|
|to|query|string(date)|true|End date.|
|page_size|query|integer|false|The number of records returned within a single API call.|
|next_page_token|query|string|false|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|
|type|query|string|false|The meeting types: <br>`past` - Past meetings.<br>`pastOne` - Past one user meetings. |

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|type|past|
|type|pastOne|

## Get webinar participant reports

<a id="opIdreportWebinarParticipants"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/report/webinars/string/participants \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /report/webinars/{webinarId}/participants`

Get detailed report on each attendee of a webinar.<br><br>
**Scopes:** `report:read:admin`<br>
 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Heavy`<br>
**Prerequisites:**<br>

<h3 id="get-webinar-participant-reports-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|webinarId|path|string|true|The webinar ID or the webinar UUID.  If a webinar ID is provided in the request instead of a UUID, the response will be for the latest webinar instance.<br><br>If a UUID starts with "/" or contains "//" (example: "/ajXp112QmuoKj4854875==\"), you must **double encode** the UUID before making an API request.|
|page_size|query|integer|false|The number of records returned within a single API call.|
|next_page_token|query|string|false|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|
|include_fields|query|string|false|Enter 'registrant_id' as the value for this field if you would like to see the registrant ID attribute included in the response of this API call. A registrant ID is a unique identifier of a [webinar registrant](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/webinars/webinarregistrants).<br><br><br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|include_fields|registrant_id|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "next_page_token": "",
  "page_count": "1",
  "page_size": "30",
  "participants": [
    {
      "duration": "20",
      "id": "dskfjladjskfl",
      "join_time": "2019-02-01T12:34:12.660Z",
      "leave_time": "2019-03-01T12:34:12.660Z",
      "name": "Riya",
      "user_email": "riya@jdfghsdfgsd.fdjfhdf",
      "user_id": "sdfjkldsfdfgdfg"
    }
  ],
  "total_records": "1"
}
```

<h3 id="get-webinar-participant-reports-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** `200`<br><br>Meeting participants report returned.<br><br>This is only available for paid account: {accountId}.|Inline|
|300|Multiple Choices|**HTTP Status Code:** `300`<br><br>The next page token is invalid or has expired.<br><br>Can not access the webinar information, {webinarId}.|None|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400`<br><br>Bad request<br><br>**Error Code:** `1010`<br><br>User does not belong to this account:{accountId}.<br>|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404`<br><br>Webinar ID not found.<br><br>**Error Code:** `3001`<br><br>Webinar  {webinarId} not found or has expired.<br>|None|

<h3 id="get-webinar-participant-reports-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|next_page_token|string|false|none|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|
|page_count|integer|false|none|The number of pages returned for the request made.|
|page_size|integer|false|none|The number of records returned within a single API call.|
|total_records|integer|false|none|The number of all records available across pages.|
|participants|[object]|false|none|Array of webinar participant objects.|
|» customer_key|string|false|none|Another identifier for the participant. Can be a number or characters, maximum length of 15 characters. |
|» duration|integer|false|none|Participant duration.|
|» failover|boolean|false|none|Indicates if failover happened during the webinar.|
|» id|string(uuid)|false|none|Universally unique identifier of the Participant. It is the same as the User ID of the participant if the participant joins the meeting by logging into Zoom. If the participant joins the meeting without logging in, the value of this field will be blank.|
|» join_time|string(date-time)|false|none|Participant join time.|
|» leave_time|string(date-time)|false|none|Participant leave time.|
|» name|string|false|none|Participant display name.|
|» user_email|string|false|none|Participant email.|
|» user_id|string|false|none|Participant ID. This is a unique ID assigned to the participant joining the webinar and is valid for that webinar only.|

OAuth

## Create a role

<a id="opIdcreateRole"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/roles \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "description": "string",
    "name": "string",
    "privileges": [
      "string"
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /roles`

Each Zoom user automatically has a role which can either be owner, administrator, or a member. 

**Pre-requisite:**<br>
* Pro or higher plan.
* For setting the initial role, you must be the Account Owner.<br>
* For subsequent role management, you must be the Account Owner or user with role management permissions.<br>
**Scopes:** `role:write:admin`<br>
 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "description": "string",
  "name": "string",
  "privileges": [
    "string"
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-role-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» description|body|string|false|Description of the role.|
|» name|body|string|false|Name of the role.|
|» privileges|body|[string]|false|Privileges assigned to the role. Can be one or a combination of [these permissions](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/other-references/privileges).|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
null
```

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "description": "string",
  "id": "string",
  "name": "string",
  "privileges": [
    "string"
  ],
  "total_members": 0
}
```

<h3 id="create-a-role-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**Status Code:** `200`<br><br>You do not have the permission to create a role.|Inline|
|201|Created|**Status Code:** `201`<br><br>Role created.|Inline|
|300|Multiple Choices|**Error Code:** `300`<br><br>The name field cannot be empty.|None|

<h3 id="create-a-role-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **201**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|description|string|false|none|Description of the role.|
|id|string|false|none|Role Id|
|name|string|false|none|Name of the role.|
|privileges|[string]|false|none|[Privileges](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/other-references/privileges) provided to the role.|
|total_members|integer|false|none|Total members assigned to the role.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

## Get role information

<a id="opIdgetRoleInformation"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/roles/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /roles/{roleId}`

Each Zoom user automatically has a role which can either be owner, administrator, or a member. Account Owners and users with edit privileges for Role management can add customized roles with a list of privileges.

Use this API to get information including specific privileges assigned to a [role](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/115001078646-Role-Based-Access-Control).<br>
**Pre-requisite:**<br>
* A Pro or higher plan.<br>
* For role management and updates, you must be the Account Owner or user with role management permissions.

**Scopes:** `role:read:admin`<br>
 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`

<h3 id="get-role-information-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|roleId|path|string|true|Role Id. |

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "description": "string",
  "id": "string",
  "name": "string",
  "privileges": [
    "string"
  ],
  "sub_account_privileges": {
    "second_level": 0
  },
  "total_members": 0
}
```

<h3 id="get-role-information-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**Status Code:** `200`<br><br>Information about a specific role returned.<br><br>**Error Code:** `200`<br><br>You do not have the permission to retrieve role information.<br>|Inline|
|300|Multiple Choices|**Error Code:** `300`<br><br>Role not found.|None|

<h3 id="get-role-information-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|description|string|false|none|Description of the role.|
|id|string|false|none|Role Id.|
|name|string|false|none|Name of the role.|
|privileges|[string]|false|none|Privileges assigned to the role. Can be one or a combination of [these permissions](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/other-references/privileges).<br>|
|sub_account_privileges|object|false|none|This field will only be displayed to accounts that are enrolled in a partner plan and follow the master accounts and sub accounts structure.|
|» second_level|integer|false|none|Indicates how the account can manage sub accounts. The value can be one of the following:<br><br>`1`: Manage the sub account as an owner of the account.<br><br>`2`: Manage the sub account with the same privileges as the current account.<br><br>`3`: Manage the sub account with specified privileges.|
|total_members|integer|false|none|Total members assigned to that role.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

The value can be one of the following:<br><br>`1`: Manage the sub account as an owner of the account.<br><br>`2`: Manage the sub account with the same privileges as the current account.<br><br>`3`: Manage the sub account with specified privileges.|

<a id="opIdlistZoomRooms"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /rooms`

Zoom Rooms is a software-based room system that provides an integrated experience for audio conferencing, wireless screen sharing and video conferencing. Use this API to list all the existing [Zoom Rooms](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/207483343-Getting-Started-with-Zoom-Rooms) in a Zoom account.<br><br>
**Prerequisites:**<br>
* Pro or a higher plan with [Zoom Room](https://zoom.us/zoomrooms) license.<br>
**Scopes**: `room:read:admin`<br> 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|

|status|query|string|false|The status of the Zoom Room.|
|type|query|string|false|Type of the Zoom Rooms.|
|unassigned_rooms|query|boolean|false|Use this query parameter with a value of `true` if you would like to see Zoom Rooms in your account that have not been assigned to anyone yet.|
|page_size|query|integer|false|The number of records returned within a single API call.|
|next_page_token|query|string|false|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|
|location_id|query|string|false|Parent location ID of the Zoom Room.|

|status|UnderConstruction|

## Update E911 digital signage

<a id="opIdmanageE911signage"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/rooms/events \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "method": "zoomroom.emergency_alert_displayed",
    "params": {
      "content": "string",
      "target_ids": [
        "string"
      ],
      "target_type": "account"
    }
  }'
```

`PATCH /rooms/events`

Display or hide E911 emergency alert text content from [Zoom Rooms digital signage](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360000030683-Zoom-Rooms-digital-signage).

**Scope:** `room:write:admin`

**Prerequisites:**<br>
* [Zoom Rooms](https://zoom.us/zoomrooms/software) 5.3.0 or higher
* Zoom Rooms digital signage must be [enabled](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360000030683-Zoom-Rooms-Digital-Signage#h_767fbb33-82a8-45a8-8392-a1bfa9687edd)


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "method": "zoomroom.emergency_alert_displayed",
  "params": {
    "content": "string",
    "target_ids": [
      "string"
    ],
    "target_type": "account"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="update-e911-digital-signage-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» *oneOf*|body|object|false|Provide this request body to set and display the emergency alert content. |
|» method|body|string|false|To display the emergency content on the Zoom Rooms digital signage display, set the value of this field to be `zoomroom.emergency_alert_displayed`.|
|» params|body|object|false|none|
|» » content|body|string|false|Provide the content to be displayed. |
|» » target_ids|body|[string]|false|Provide one of the following IDs associated with the Zoom Room.<br><br><br>* `accountId`: Account ID of the Zoom account.<br> Provide account ID as the value of this field to display the alert content on all Zoom Rooms' displays in the account.<br><br><br>* `locationId`: Location ID. Get the value of this field by calling [List Zoom Rooms Locations API](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/rooms-location/listzrlocations).<br>Provide location ID as the value of this field to display the alert content on all Zoom Rooms' displays listed in the specified location.<br><br><br>* `roomId`: Unique identifier of the Zoom Room. Get the value of this field by calling [List Zoom Rooms API](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/rooms/listzoomrooms). Provide room ID as the value of this field to display the alert content on a specific Zoom Rooms' display.|
|» » target_type|body|string|false|Provide one of the following values for this field that is associated to the value you entered in the `target_ids` field. <br><br>* `account`<br>* `location`<br>* `room`|
|» *oneOf*|body|object|false|Provide this request body to remove the emergency alert content. Note that there won't be a response body for this request.|
|» method|body|string|false|To remove the emergency content from the Zoom Rooms digital signage display, set the value of this field to be `zoomroom.emergency_alert_removed`.|
|» params|body|object|false|none|
|» » event_id|body|string|false|Unique identifier of the event. |
|» » target_ids|body|[string]|false|Provide one of the following IDs associated with the Zoom Room.<br><br><br>* `accountId`: Account ID of the Zoom account.<br> Provide account ID as the value of this field to remove the alert content from all Zoom Rooms' displays in the account.<br><br><br>* `locationId`: Location ID. Get the value of this field by calling [List Zoom Rooms Locations API](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/rooms-location/listzrlocations).<br>Provide location ID as the value of this field to remove the alert content from all Zoom Rooms' displays listed in the specified location.<br><br><br>* `roomId`: Unique identifier of the Zoom Room. Get the value of this field by calling [List Zoom Rooms API](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/rooms/listzoomrooms). Provide room ID as the value of this field to remove the alert content from a specific Zoom Rooms' display.|
|» » target_type|body|string|false|Provide one of the following values for this field that is associated to the value you entered in the `target_ids` field. <br><br>* `account`<br>* `location`<br>* `room`|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» method|zoomroom.emergency_alert_displayed|
|» » target_type|account|
|» » target_type|location|
|» » target_type|room|
|» method|zoomroom.emergency_alert_removed|
|» » target_type|account|

This field is only returned if you provided `zoomroom.emergency_alert_displayed` as the value of the `method` parameter.<br><br>Save this response value and provide it as the value of the `event_id` request parameter when you need to remove the alert content using `zoomroom.emergency_alert_removed` method.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

## Check-in or check-out of a Zoom Room

<a id="opIdcheckInRooms"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/rooms/string/events \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "method": "string",
    "params": {
      "calendar_id": "string",
      "change_key": "string",
      "event_id": "string",
      "resource_email": "user@example.com"
    }
  }'
```

`PATCH /rooms/{id}/events`

The Zoom Rooms check-in feature helps maximize your room utilization. Use this API to either **check in** and confirm that you are utilizing the room reservation or to **check out** of the room so that the room gets released from the scheduled meeting and will be made available for others to use. Learn more from the [Using the Zoom Rooms check-in feature](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360001147163-Using-the-Zoom-Rooms-check-in-feature) guide. 

**Prerequisites:**
* [Zoom Rooms](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/207483343-Getting-started-with-Zoom-Rooms#:~:text=Zoom%20Rooms%20is%20a%20software,or%20from%20their%20mobile%20device) must have been set up for use for the account and must be online. 
* You must have access to the Calendar Integration APIs (either Microsoft Exchange or Google Calendar APIs) to get calendar information associated with the Room.

**Scope:** `room:write:admin`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "method": "string",
  "params": {
    "calendar_id": "string",
    "change_key": "string",
    "event_id": "string",
    "resource_email": "user@example.com"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="check-in-or-check-out-of-a-zoom-room-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|string|true|Room ID|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» method|body|string|false|The value of this field can be one of the following:<br><br>* zoomroom.check_in<br>* zoomroom.check_out|
|» params|body|object|false|none|
|» » calendar_id|body|string|false|This field is only required if Google Calendar is being used for the event associated with the Zoom Room. The value for this field can be retrieved by calling Google's [CalendarList:list API](https://developers.google.com/calendar/v3/reference/events/list) and referring to the "id" field included in the [calendarList resource](https://developers.google.com/calendar/v3/reference/calendarList#resource).<br><br> |
|» » change_key|body|string|false|This field is required only for Microsoft Exchange or Office 365  calendar. The change key represents the specific version of the calendar item and can be retrieved by using Microsoft's [FindItem Operation](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/exchange/client-developer/web-service-reference/finditem-operation) and referring to the ChangeKey field of the ItemId Element included in the operation response.<br>|
|» » event_id|body|string|true|Unique Identifier of the calendar event associated with the Zoom Room.<br><br>If the calendar integration being used is Microsoft Exchange, the value for this field can be retrieved by using Microsoft's [FindItem Operation](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/exchange/client-developer/web-service-reference/finditem-operation) and referring to the Id field of the ItemId Element included in the operation response.<br><br>If the Google calendar integration was used for this event, the event_id can be retrieved by calling Google's [Events:list API](https://developers.google.com/calendar/v3/reference/events/list) and referring to the "id" field included in the [events resource](https://developers.google.com/calendar/v3/reference/events#resource).<br><br>|
|» » resource_email|body|string(email)|false|This field is only required for Microsoft Exchange / Office 365 Calendar. It is the [resource mailbox](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/help/10063/creating-and-managing-resource-mailboxes-in-office-365) associated with the calendar.|

> Example responses

> 202 Response

```json
null
```

<h3 id="check-in-or-check-out-of-a-zoom-room-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|202|Accepted|**HTTP Status Code:** `202` **Accepted**<br><br>Request processed successfully.|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400` **Bad Request**<br><br>**Error Code:** `300`<br><br>* Zoom Room is offline. Please ensure that the Zoom Room is online before checking in or checking out.<br>* Invalid parameters.<br><br><br>|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404` **Not Found**<br><br>**Error Code:** `1012` <br><br>Room does not exist: {roomId}.<br><br><br>|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

## Change a Zoom Room's location

<a id="opIdchangeZRLocation"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/rooms/string/location \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "location_id": "string"
  }'
```

`PUT /rooms/{roomId}/location`

An account owner of a Zoom account can establish a [Zoom Rooms Location Hierarchy](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/115000342983-Zoom-Rooms-Location-Hierarchy) to better organize Zoom Rooms spread accress various location. The location can be structured in a hierarchy with Country being the top-level location, followed by city, campus, building, and floor. Use this API to assign a new location for a Zoom Room. Note that the Zoom Room can be assigned only to the lowest level location available in the hierarchy.
**Prerequisite:**<br>
* Account owner or admin permission
* Zoom Rooms version 4.0 or higher<br>
**Scopes:** `room:write:admin`<br> 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "location_id": "string"
}
```

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|roomId|path|string|true|Unique Identifier of the Zoom Room.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» location_id|body|string|false|Location ID of the location where Zoom Room is to be assigned. This can be retrieved from the `id` property in the response of [List Zoom Rooms Locations](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/rooms-location/listzrlocations) API.|

```json
null
```

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

|» encryption_type|string|false|none|Choose between enhanced encryption and [end-to-end encryption](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360048660871) when starting or a meeting. When using end-to-end encryption, several features (e.g. cloud recording, phone/SIP/H.323 dial-in) will be **automatically disabled**. <br><br>The value of this field can be one of the following:<br><br>`enhanced_encryption`: Enhanced encryption. Encryption is stored in the cloud if you enable this option. <br><br><br>`e2ee`: [End-to-end encryption](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360048660871). The encryption key is stored in your local device and can not be obtained by anyone else. Enabling this setting also **disables** the following features: join before host, cloud recording, streaming, live transcription, breakout rooms, polling, 1:1 private chat, and meeting reactions.|
|» end_to_end_encrypted_meetings|boolean|false|none|Allow use of end-to-end encryption for meetings. If set to `true`, you can specify the encryption type in `encryption_type` field.|

|» display_top_banner|boolean|false|none|Allow to display room name, time and sharing key on the top portion of TV.|
|» encrypt_shared_screen_content|boolean|false|none|Encrypt screen and content shared in meetings.|
|» hide_id_for_private_meeting|boolean|false|none|If enabled, the meeting host and meeting ID (in addition to the meeting topic) are hidden from the Zoom Rooms display for private meetings. This affects meetings that were originally scheduled as private, as well as public meetings that were transformed to private.|
|» hide_share_instruction|boolean|false|none|Hide share instructions from TV.|
|» send_whiteboard_to_internal_contact_only|boolean|false|none|Restrict[ sending Whiteboard sessions](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/115004797286-Using-the-Whiteboard-in-Zoom-Rooms-for-Touch#h_781274b3-5237-4320-8826-be2120b00e21) to contacts or internal users only.|

## Update Zoom Room settings

<a id="opIdupdateZRSettings"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/rooms/string/settings \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "meeting_security": {
      "encryption_type": "enhanced_encryption",
      "end_to_end_encrypted_meetings": true
    },
    "zoom_rooms": {
      "allow_multiple_content_sharing": true,
      "audio_device_daily_auto_test": true,
      "auto_direct_sharing": true,
      "auto_start_scheduled_meeting": true,
      "auto_stop_scheduled_meeting": true,
      "count_attendees_number_in_room": true,
      "display_feedback_survey": true,
      "display_meeting_list": true,
      "display_top_banner": true,
      "encrypt_shared_screen_content": true,
      "hide_id_for_private_meeting": true,
      "hide_share_instruction": true,
      "send_whiteboard_to_internal_contact_only": true,
      "show_alert_before_meeting": true,
      "show_call_history_in_room": true,
      "show_contact_list_on_controller": true,
      "show_non_video_participants": true,
      "start_airplay_manually": true,
      "start_airplay_mirroring": true,
      "support_join_3rd_party_meeting": true,
      "transform_meeting_to_private": true,
      "upcoming_meeting_alert": true,
      "weekly_system_restart": true
    }
  }'
```

`PATCH /rooms/{roomId}/settings`

Update either meeting or alert settings applied to a specific Zoom Room. To update **Alert Settings**, specify `alert` as the value of the `setting_type` query parameter. To update **Meeting Settings**, specify `meeting` as the value of the `setting_type` query parameter.<br>
**Prerequisites:**<br>
* Zoom Room licenses
* Owner or Admin privileges on the Zoom Account.<br>
**Scopes:** `room:write:admin`<br> 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "meeting_security": {
    "encryption_type": "enhanced_encryption",
    "end_to_end_encrypted_meetings": true
  },
  "zoom_rooms": {
    "allow_multiple_content_sharing": true,
    "audio_device_daily_auto_test": true,
    "auto_direct_sharing": true,
    "auto_start_scheduled_meeting": true,
    "auto_stop_scheduled_meeting": true,
    "count_attendees_number_in_room": true,
    "display_feedback_survey": true,
    "display_meeting_list": true,
    "display_top_banner": true,
    "encrypt_shared_screen_content": true,
    "hide_id_for_private_meeting": true,
    "hide_share_instruction": true,
    "send_whiteboard_to_internal_contact_only": true,
    "show_alert_before_meeting": true,
    "show_call_history_in_room": true,
    "show_contact_list_on_controller": true,
    "show_non_video_participants": true,
    "start_airplay_manually": true,
    "start_airplay_mirroring": true,
    "support_join_3rd_party_meeting": true,
    "transform_meeting_to_private": true,
    "upcoming_meeting_alert": true,
    "weekly_system_restart": true
  }
}
```

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|

|body|body|object|false|none|

|» » encryption_type|body|string|false|Choose between enhanced encryption and [end-to-end encryption](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360048660871) when starting or a meeting. When using end-to-end encryption, several features (e.g. cloud recording, phone/SIP/H.323 dial-in) will be **automatically disabled**. <br><br>The value of this field can be one of the following:<br><br>`enhanced_encryption`: Enhanced encryption. Encryption is stored in the cloud if you enable this option. <br><br><br>`e2ee`: [End-to-end encryption](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360048660871). The encryption key is stored in your local device and can not be obtained by anyone else. <h1 id="zoom-api-rooms-account">Rooms Account</h1>

## Get Zoom Room account profile

<a id="opIdgetZRAccountProfile"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/rooms/account_profile \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /rooms/account_profile`

Get details on the account profile of a Zoom Room. This information can only by accessed either by the Zoom Room Account Owner or a user with Zoom Rooms admin permission. To get information on an individual Room Profile, use [Get Zoom Room Profile API](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/rooms/getzrprofile) instead.

**Prerequisites:**<br>
* Zoom account owner or Zoom Rooms admin permissions<br>

**Scopes:** `room:read:admin`<br> 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "basic": {
    "required_code_to_ext": true,
    "room_passcode": "12234",
    "support_email": "abc123@someemailaddress.sbfj",
    "support_phone": "00222"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="get-zoom-room-account-profile-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** `200`<br><br>Zoom Room Account Profile returned successfully.|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400` **Bad Request**<br><br>**Error Code:** `200`<br><br>Zoom Room subscription not found. Try again after purchasing a Zoom Room subscription.<br><br>Access restricted.|None|

<h3 id="get-zoom-room-account-profile-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|basic|object|false|none|none|
|» required_code_to_ext|boolean|false|none|Require code to exit out of the Zoom Rooms application to switch between other apps.<br>|
|» room_passcode|string|false|none|1-16 digit number or characters used to secure your Zoom Rooms application. This code must be entered on your Zoom Room Controller to change settings or to sign out.|
|» support_email|string(email)|false|none|The email address used for reporting Zoom Room issues.|

`PATCH /rooms/account_profile`

Update information on the account profile of a Zoom Room. This information can only by accessed either by the Zoom Room Account Owner or a user with Zoom Rooms admin permission. To update information on an individual Room Profile, use [Update Zoom Room Profile API](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/rooms/updatezrprofile) instead.

**Prerequisites:**<br>
* Zoom account owner or Zoom Rooms admin permissions<br>

**Scopes:** `room:write:admin`<br> 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "basic": {
    "required_code_to_ext": true,
    "room_passcode": "string",
    "support_email": "user@example.com",
    "support_phone": "string"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="update-zoom-room-account-profile-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» basic|body|object|false|none|
|» » required_code_to_ext|body|boolean|false|Require code to exit out of the Zoom Rooms application to switch between other apps.<br>|
|» » room_passcode|body|string|false|1-16 digit number or characters used to secure your Zoom Rooms application. This code must be entered on your Zoom Room Controller to change settings or to sign out.|
|» » support_email|body|string(email)|false|The email address used for reporting Zoom Room issues.|
|» » support_phone|body|string|false|The phone number used for reporting Zoom room issues.|

```json
{}
```

## Get Zoom Room account settings

<a id="opIdgetZRAccountSettings"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/rooms/account_settings?setting_type=meeting' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /rooms/account_settings`

Get details on Account Settings of a Zoom Room. With this API, you can view either the **Account Meeting Settings** or the **Alert Settings** (Client Alert Settings and Notfication Settings) of the Zoom Rooms account. By default, only **Account Meeting Settings** are returned. To view only **Alert Settings**, specify `alert` as the value of the `setting_type` query parameter.<br><br>
**Prerequisites:**<br>
* Zoom Room licenses
* Owner or Admin privileges on the Zoom Account.<br>
**Scopes:** `room:read:admin`<br><br> 
 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`

<h3 id="get-zoom-room-account-settings-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|setting_type|query|string|true|The type of setting that you would like to retrieve.<br> `alert`: Alert Settings applied on the Zoom Rooms Account.<br><br>`meeting`: Meeting settings of the Zoom Rooms Account. <br><br>`signage`: View digital signage settings of the Zoom Rooms Account.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|setting_type|meeting|
|setting_type|alert|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "client_alert": {
    "detect_bluetooth_microphone_error_alert": true,
    "detect_bluetooth_speaker_error_alert": true,
    "detect_camera_error_alert": true,
    "detect_microphone_error_alert": true,
    "detect_speaker_error_alert": true
  },
  "notification": {
    "audio_not_meet_usability_threshold": false,
    "battery_low_and_not_charging": false,
    "controller_scheduling_disconnected": false,
    "cpu_usage_high_detected": false,
    "mic_speaker_camera_disconnected": false,
    "network_unstable_detected": false,
    "sip_registration_failed": false,
    "zoom_room_display_disconnected": false,
    "zoom_room_offline": false
  }
}
```

<h3 id="get-zoom-room-account-settings-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** `200` **OK**<br><br>ZR Account Settings returned successfully.<br>|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400` **Bad Request**<br><br>**Error Code:** `200`<br><br>Zoom Room subscription not found. Try again after purchasing a Zoom Room subscription.<br><br>Access restricted.|None|

`PATCH /rooms/account_settings`

Update account settings applied for Zoom Rooms in a Zoom account. With this API, you can update either the **Account Meeting Settings** or the **Alert Settings** (Client Alert Settings and Notfication Settings) of the Zoom Rooms account by specifying the required setting type in the `setting_type` parameter. To update only **Alert Settings**, specify `alert` as the value of the `setting_type` query parameter and to update only **Account Meeting Settings**, specify `meeting` as the value of the `setting_type` query parameter.<br><br>

<h1 id="zoom-api-rooms-location">Rooms Location</h1>

## List Zoom Room locations

<a id="opIdlistZRLocations"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/rooms/locations \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /rooms/locations`

A Zoom account owner or a Zoom Room administrator can establish a [location hierarchy](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/115000342983-Zoom-Rooms-Location-Hierarchy) to help manage Zoom Rooms that are spread among a variety of locations. Use this API to list the different location types used for Zoom Rooms in an account.<br><br>
**Prerequisites:**
* Account owner or admin permissions.
* Zoom Rooms Version 4.0 or higher<br><br>
**Scopes:** `room:read:admin`<br> 
 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`

<h3 id="list-zoom-room-locations-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|parent_location_id|query|string|false|A unique identifier of the parent location. For instance, if a Zoom Room is located in Floor 1 of Building A, the location of Building A will be the parent location of Floor 1. Use this parameter to filter the response by a specific location hierarchy level.|
|type|query|string|false|Use this field to filter the response by the type of location. The value can be one of the following:<br>`country`, `states`, `city`, `campus`, `building`, `floor`. |
|page_size|query|integer|false|The number of records returned within a single API call.|
|next_page_token|query|string|false|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
"{\n  \"page_size\": 30,\n  \"next_page_token\": \"\",\n  \"locations\": [\n    {\n      \"id\": \"AAAAAAAAAA\",\n      \"name\": \"Country/Region1\",\n      \"parent_location_id\": \"I-qsfdUbbbbg\",\n      \"type\": \"country\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"BBBBBBBB\",\n      \"name\": \"State1\",\n      \"parent_location_id\": \"AAAAAAAAAA\",\n      \"type\": \"state\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"ccccddddd,\n      \"name\": \"City1\",\n      \"parent_location_id\": \"BBBBBBBB\",\n      \"type\": \"city\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"fgaajfjfhgjgjgjg\",\n      \"name\": \"Campus1\",\n      \"parent_location_id\": \"ccccddddd,\n      \"type\": \"campus\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"YQGK12344\",\n      \"name\": \"Building1\",\n      \"parent_location_id\": \"fgaajfjfhgjgjgjg\",\n      \"type\": \"building\"\n    },\n    {\n      \"id\": \"uUbbbbbbbb\",\n      \"name\": \"Floor1\",\n      \"parent_location_id\": \"YQGK12344\",\n      \"type\": \"floor\"\n    }\n  ]\n}"
```

<h3 id="list-zoom-room-locations-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** `200` **OK**<br><br>Zoom Room locations listed successfully.<br>|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400` **Bad Request**<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `200`<br><br>Zoom Room subscription not found. Try again after purchasing a Zoom Room subscription.<br><br>**Error Code:** `300`<br><br>Location type not exist.<br><br>|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404` **Not Found**<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `4801`<br><br> Location not found:{parent_location_id}.|None|

<h3 id="list-zoom-room-locations-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|locations|[object]|false|none|none|
|» id|string|false|none|Unique Identifier of the location.|
|» name|string|false|none|Name of the location.|
|» parent_location_id|string|false|none|ID (Unique Identifier) of the parent location. For instance, if a Zoom Room is located in Floor 1 of Building A, the location of Building A will be the parent location of Floor 1 and the parent_location_id of Floor 1 will be the ID of Building A.<br><br>The value of parent_location_id of the top-level location (country) is the Account ID of the Zoom account.|
|» type|string|false|none|The type of location. The value can be one of the following:<br>`country`, `states`, `city`, `campus`, `building`, `floor`. |
|next_page_token|string|false|none|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|
|page_size|integer|false|none|The number of records returned within a single API call.|

|Property|Value|

|» type|country|
|» type|states|
|» type|city|
|» type|campus|
|» type|building|
|» type|floor|

## Add a location

<a id="opIdaddAZRLocation"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/rooms/locations \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "name": "string",
    "parent_location_id": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /rooms/locations`

Add a location to the [location hierarchial structure(s)](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/115000342983-Zoom-Rooms-Location-Hierarchy) of Zoom Rooms in an account.

**Prerequisites:**
* Account owner or admin permissions.
* Zoom Rooms Version 4.0 or higher<br><br>
**Scopes:** `room:write:admin`<br> 

 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "name": "string",
  "parent_location_id": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="add-a-location-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» name|body|string|false|Name of the location. The name must be unique and shouldn't have already been used in the same account.|
|» parent_location_id|body|string|false|The location ID of the location that is a level higher from the location that is being added.<br><br> For example, to add a City named "City 1" as the child location under a State named "State 1", you must provide the location ID of "State 1". This can be retrieved using the [List Zoom Room Locations](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/rooms-location/listzrlocations) API.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "id": "sedo534pis",
  "name": "San Jose City",
  "parent_location_id": "gdrgre54t5th",
  "type": "City"
}
```

<h3 id="add-a-location-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** `200` **OK**<br><br>Location added successfully.|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400` **Bad Request**<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `200`<br><br>Zoom Room subscription not found. Try again after purchasing a Zoom Room subscription.<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `300`<br><br>Location name already exists. Try a different location name.<br><br>Invalid parent location id {parent_location_id}<br>|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404` **Not Found**<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `4801`<br><br>Location not exist {parent_location_id}|None|

<h3 id="add-a-location-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|false|none|Location ID: Unique Identifier of the location that was added.|
|name|string|false|none|Name of the location.|
|parent_location_id|string|false|none|Unique Identifier of the parent location.|
|type|string|false|none|Type of location. The value should be one of the following:<br><br>`country`, `states`, `city`, `campus`, `building`, `floor`.|
