## Get Zoom Room location profile

<a id="opIdgetZRLocationProfile"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/rooms/locations/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /rooms/locations/{locationId}`

Each location type of the [Zoom Rooms location hierarchy](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/115000342983-Zoom-Rooms-Location-Hierarchy) has a profile page that includes information such as name of the location, address, support email, etc. Use this API to retrieve information about a specific Zoom Rooms location type such as information about the city where the Zoom Rooms is located.

**Prerequisite:**<br>
* Account owner or admin permission
* Zoom Rooms version 4.0 or higher<br>
**Scopes:** `room:read:admin`<br> 
 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`

<h3 id="get-zoom-room-location-profile-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|locationId|path|string|true|Unique identifier of the location type. This can be retrieved using the [List Zoom Room Location API](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/rooms-location/listzrlocations) (Id property in the response).|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "basic": {
    "description": "This Zoom Rooms is located in Kathmandu.",
    "name": "Kathmandu",
    "required_code_to_ext": true,
    "room_passcode": "12234",
    "support_email": "abb123@123",
    "support_phone": "00222",
    "timezone": "Asia/Kathmandu"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="get-zoom-room-location-profile-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** `200` **OK**<br><br>Zoom Rooms Location Profile returned successfully.|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400` **Bad Request**<br><br>**Error Code:** `200`<br><br>Zoom Room subscription not found. Try again after purchasing a Zoom Room subscription.<br><br>Access restricted.<br><br><br><br><br><br><br>|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404` **Not Found**<br><br>**Error Code:** `4801`<br><br>Location not found: {locationId}.|None|

<h3 id="get-zoom-room-location-profile-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|basic|object|false|none|none|
|» address|string|false|none|Address|
|» description |string|false|none|Description about the location.|
|» name|string|false|none|Name of the location type.|
|» required_code_to_ext|boolean|false|none|Require code to exit out of your Zoom Rooms application to switch between other apps.<br>|
|» room_passcode|string|false|none|1-16 digit number or characters that is used to secure your Zoom Rooms application.|
|» support_email|string(email)|false|none|The email address to be used for reporting Zoom Room issues.<br>|
|» support_phone|string|false|none|The phone number to be used for reporting Zoom Room issues.<br>|
|» timezone|string|false|none|Timezone (only returned for location type - city).|

OAuth

## Change the assigned parent location

<a id="opIdchangeParentLocation"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/rooms/locations/string/location \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "parent_location_id": "string"
  }'
```

`PUT /rooms/locations/{locationId}/location`

An account owner of a Zoom account can establish a [Zoom Rooms Location Hierarchy](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/115000342983-Zoom-Rooms-Location-Hierarchy) to better organize Zoom Rooms spread accross various location. The location can be structured in a hierarchy with Country being the top-level location, followed by city, campus, building, and floor. The location in the lower level in the hierarchy is considered as a child of the location that is a level above in the hierarchy. Use this API to change the parent location of a child location. <br><br> For instance, if the location hierarchy is structured in a way where there are two campuses (Campus 1, and Campus 2) in a City and Campus 1 consists of a building named Building 1 with a floor where Zoom Rooms are located, and you would like to rearrange the structure so that Building 1 along with its child locations (floor and Zoom Rooms) are relocated directly under Campus 2 instead of Campus 1, you must provide the location ID of Building 1 in the path parameter of this request and the location ID of Campus 2 as the value of `parent_location_id` in the  request body.<br><br>
**Prerequisite:**<br>
* Account owner or admin permission
* Zoom Rooms version 4.0 or higher<br>
**Scopes:** `room:write:admin`<br><br> 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "parent_location_id": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="change-the-assigned-parent-location-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|locationId|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» parent_location_id|body|string|false|Location ID of the new Parent Location under which you the child location will be positioned. This can be retrieved from the [List Zoom Room Locations](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/rooms-location/listzrlocations) API.|

> Example responses

> 204 Response

```json
null
```

<h3 id="change-the-assigned-parent-location-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|**HTTP Status Code:** `204` **No Content**<br><br>Location assigned successfully.|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400` **Bad Request**<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `200`<br> Zoom Room subscription not found. Try again after purchasing a Zoom Room subscription.<br><br>**Error Code:** `300`<br> Invalid parent location id {parent_location_id}|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404` **Not Found**<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `4801`<br> Location not found:{parent_location_id}.<br>|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

## Get location settings

<a id="opIdgetZRLocationSettings"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/rooms/locations/string/settings?setting_type=meeting' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /rooms/locations/{locationId}/settings`

Get information on meeting or alert settings applied to Zoom Rooms located in a specific location. By default, only **Meeting Settings** are returned. To view only **Alert Settings**, specify `alert` as the value of the `setting_type` query parameter.<br><br>
**Prerequisites:**<br>
* Zoom Room licenses
* Owner or Admin privileges on the Zoom Account.<br>
**Scopes:** `room:read:admin`<br> 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`

<h3 id="get-location-settings-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|setting_type|query|string|true|The type of setting that you would like to retrieve.<br> `alert`: Alert Settings applied on the Zoom Rooms Account.<br><br>`meeting`: Meeting settings of the Zoom Rooms Account.<br><br>`signage`: Digital signage settings of the Zoom Rooms Account.|
|locationId|path|string|true|Unique identifier of the location type. This can be retrieved using the [List Zoom Room Location API](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/rooms-location/listzrlocations) (Id property in the response).|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "client_alert": {
    "detect_bluetooth_microphone_error_alert": true,
    "detect_bluetooth_speaker_error_alert": true,
    "detect_camera_error_alert": true,
    "detect_microphone_error_alert": true,
    "detect_speaker_error_alert": true
  },
  "notification": {
    "audio_not_meet_usability_threshold": false,
    "battery_low_and_not_charging": false,
    "controller_scheduling_disconnected": false,
    "cpu_usage_high_detected": false,
    "mic_speaker_camera_disconnected": false,
    "network_unstable_detected": false,
    "sip_registration_failed": false,
    "zoom_room_display_disconnected": false,
    "zoom_room_offline": false
  }
}
```

<h3 id="get-location-settings-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** `200` **OK**<br><br>Zoom Room location settings returned successfully.|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400` **Bad Request**<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `200`<br><br>Zoom Room subscription not found. Try again after purchasing a Zoom Room subscription.<br><br>Access Restricted.|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404` **Not Found**<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `4801`<br><br>Location not found: {locationId}<br><br>|None|

## Update location settings

<a id="opIdupdateZRLocationSettings"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://example.com/rooms/locations/string/settings?setting_type=meeting' \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "meeting_security": {
      "encryption_type": "enhanced_encryption",
      "end_to_end_encrypted_meetings": true
    },
    "zoom_rooms": {
      "allow_multiple_content_sharing": true,
      "audio_device_daily_auto_test": true,
      "auto_accept_incoming_call_and_fecc": true,
      "auto_direct_sharing": true,
      "auto_start_scheduled_meeting": true,
      "auto_stop_scheduled_meeting": true,
      "count_attendees_number_in_room": true,
      "display_feedback_survey": true,
      "display_meeting_list": true,
      "display_top_banner": true,
      "encrypt_shared_screen_content": true,
      "hide_id_for_private_meeting": true,
      "hide_self_view": true,
      "lock_speaker_volume_control": true,
      "send_whiteboard_to_internal_contact_only": true,
      "show_alert_before_meeting": true,
      "show_call_history_in_room": true,
      "show_contact_list_on_controller": true,
      "show_non_video_participants": true,
      "start_airplay_manually": true,
      "start_airplay_mirroring": true,
      "start_hdmi_content_share_manualy": true,
      "support_join_3rd_party_meeting": true,
      "transform_meeting_to_private": true,
      "upcoming_meeting_alert": true,
      "voice_commands": true,
      "weekly_system_restart": true
    }
  }'
```

`PATCH /rooms/locations/{locationId}/settings`

Update information on either meeting or alert settings applied to Zoom Rooms located in a specific location. To update **Alert Settings**, specify `alert` as the value of the `setting_type` query parameter. Similarly, to update **Meeting Settings**, specify `meeting` as the value of the `setting_type` query parameter.<br><br>
**Prerequisites:**<br>
* Zoom Room licenses
* Owner or Admin privileges on the Zoom Account.<br>
**Scopes:** `room:write:admin`<br> 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`

```json
    "send_whiteboard_to_internal_contact_only": true,
    "show_alert_before_meeting": true,

    "transform_meeting_to_private": true,
    "upcoming_meeting_alert": true,
    "voice_commands": true,
    "weekly_system_restart": true
  }
}
```

<h1 id="zoom-api-sip-phone">SIP Phone</h1>

## List SIP phones

<a id="opIdlistSipPhones"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/sip_phones \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /sip_phones`

Zoom’s Phone System Integration (PSI), also referred as SIP phones, enables an organization to leverage the Zoom client to complete a softphone registration to supported premise based PBX system. End users will have the ability to have softphone functionality within a single client while maintaining a comparable interface to Zoom Phone. Use this API to list SIP phones on an account.<br><br>
**Prerequisites**:
* Currently only supported on Cisco and Avaya PBX systems. 
* User must enable SIP Phone Integration by contacting the [Sales](https://zoom.us/contactsales) team.<br> **Scope:** `sip_phone:read:admin`<br> 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`<br>


<h3 id="list-sip-phones-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|page_number|query|integer|false|<br>**Deprecated** - This field has been deprecated and we will stop supporting it completely in a future release. Please use "next_page_token" for pagination instead of this field.<br><br>The page number of the current page in the returned records.|
|search_key|query|string|false|User name or email address of a user. If this parameter is provided, only the SIP phone system integration enabled for that specific user will be returned. Otherwise, all SIP phones on an account will be returned.|
|page_size|query|integer|false|The number of records returned within a single API call.|
|next_page_token|query|string|false|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|

```json
}
```

## Enable SIP phone

<a id="opIdcreateSIPPhone"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/sip_phones \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "authorization_name": "string",
    "domain": "string",
    "password": "string",
    "proxy_server": "string",
    "proxy_server2": "string",
    "proxy_server3": "string",
    "register_server": "string",
    "register_server2": "string",
    "register_server3": "string",
    "registration_expire_time": 60,
    "transport_protocol": "UDP",
    "transport_protocol2": "UDP",
    "transport_protocol3": "UDP",
    "user_email": "user@example.com",
    "user_name": "string",
    "voice_mail": "string"
  }'
```

`POST /sip_phones`

Zoom’s Phone System Integration (PSI), also referred as SIP phones, enables an organization to leverage the Zoom client to complete a softphone registration to supported premise based PBX system. End users will have the ability to have softphone functionality within a single client while maintaining a comparable interface to Zoom Phone. Use this API to enable a user to use SIP phone.<br><br>
**Prerequisites**:
* Currently only supported on Cisco and Avaya PBX systems. 
* The account owner or account admin must first enable SIP Phone Integration by contacting the [Sales](https://zoom.us/contactsales) team.<br> **Scope:** `sip_phone:write:admin`
<br> 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`

`DELETE /sip_phones/{phoneId}`

Zoom’s Phone System Integration (PSI), also referred as SIP phones, enables an organization to leverage the Zoom client to complete a softphone registration to supported premise based PBX system.     "register_server2": "string",
```bash
    "register_server3": "string",
    "registration_expire_time": 60,
    "transport_protocol": "UDP",
    "transport_protocol2": "UDP",
    "transport_protocol3": "UDP",
    "user_name": "string",
    "voice_mail": "string"
  }'
```

`PATCH /sip_phones/{phoneId}`

Zoom’s Phone System Integration (PSI), also referred as SIP phones, enables an organization to leverage the Zoom client to complete a softphone registration to supported premise based PBX system. End users will have the ability to have softphone functionality within a single client while maintaining a comparable interface to Zoom Phone. Use this API to update information of a specific SIP Phone on a Zoom account.<br><br>
**Prerequisites**:
* Currently only supported on Cisco and Avaya PBX systems. 
* The account owner or account admin must first enable SIP Phone Integration by contacting the [Sales](https://zoom.us/contactsales) team.<br> **Scope:** `sip_phone:write:admin`
<br> 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "authorization_name": "string",
  "domain": "string",
  "password": "string",
  "proxy_server": "string",
  "proxy_server2": "string",
  "proxy_server3": "string",
  "register_server": "string",
  "register_server2": "string",
  "register_server3": "string",
  "registration_expire_time": 60,
  "transport_protocol": "UDP",
  "transport_protocol2": "UDP",
  "transport_protocol3": "UDP",
  "user_name": "string",
  "voice_mail": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="update-sip-phone-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|phoneId|path|string|true|Unique Identifier of the SIP Phone. This can be retrieved from the List SIP Phones API.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» authorization_name|body|string|true|Authorization name of the user  registered for SIP Phone.|
|» domain|body|string|true|The name or IP address of your provider’s SIP domain. (example: CDC.WEB).|
|» password|body|string|true|The password generated for the user in the SIP account.|
|» proxy_server|body|string|true|IP address of the proxy server for SIP requests. Note that if you are using the UDP transport protocol, the default port is 5060. If you are using UDP with a different port number, that port number must be included with the IP address. If you are not using a proxy server, this value can be the same as the Register Server.|
|» proxy_server2|body|string|true|IP address of the proxy server for SIP requests. Note that if you are using the UDP transport protocol, the default port is 5060. If you are using UDP with a different port number, that port number must be included with the IP address. If you are not using a proxy server, this value can be the same as the Register Server.|
|» proxy_server3|body|string|true|IP address of the proxy server for SIP requests. Note that if you are using the UDP transport protocol, the default port is 5060. If you are using UDP with a different port number, that port number must be included with the IP address. If you are not using a proxy server, this value can be the same as the Register Server.|
|» register_server|body|string|true|IP address of the server that accepts REGISTER requests. Note that if you are using the UDP transport protocol, the default port is 5060. If you are using UDP with a different port number, that port number must be included with the IP address.|
|» register_server2|body|string|true|IP address of the server that accepts REGISTER requests. Note that if you are using the UDP transport protocol, the default port is 5060. If you are using UDP with a different port number, that port number must be included with the IP address.|
|» register_server3|body|string|true|IP address of the server that accepts REGISTER requests. Note that if you are using the UDP transport protocol, the default port is 5060. If you are using UDP with a different port number, that port number must be included with the IP address.|
|» registration_expire_time|body|integer|false|The number of minutes after which the SIP registration of the Zoom client user will expire, and the client will auto register to the SIP server.|
|» transport_protocol|body|string|false|Protocols supported by the SIP provider.<br> The value must be either `UDP`, `TCP`, `TLS`, `AUTO`.|
|» transport_protocol2|body|string|false|Protocols supported by the SIP provider.<br> The value must be either `UDP`, `TCP`, `TLS`, `AUTO`.|
|» transport_protocol3|body|string|false|Protocols supported by the SIP provider.<br> The value must be either `UDP`, `TCP`, `TLS`, `AUTO`.|
|» user_name|body|string|true|The phone number associated with the user in the SIP account.|
|» voice_mail|body|string|true|The number to dial for checking voicemail.|

|» transport_protocol2|TCP|
|» transport_protocol2|TLS|
|» transport_protocol2|AUTO|
|» transport_protocol3|UDP|
|» transport_protocol3|TCP|
|» transport_protocol3|TLS|
|» transport_protocol3|AUTO|

Contact Zoom Developer Support for details.<br><br>**Error Code**: `2024`<br><br> Account not enable TSP|None|

## Switch a user's account

<a id="opIdswitchUserAccount"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/accounts/string/users/string/account \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "account_id": "string"
  }'
```

`PUT /accounts/{accountId}/users/{userId}/account`

Disassociate a user from one Account and move the user to another Account under the same master account. 

With this API, a user under a master account or a sub account can be moved to another sub account within the same master account. To move a user from a master account to a sub account, use `me` as the value for `accountId`. In this scenario, "me" refers to the Account ID of the master account. 

To move a user from one sub account to another sub account, provide the sub account's Account ID as the value for `accountId`. 

**Prerequisites**:
* The account should have Pro or a higher plan with master account option enabled.
* The user whose account needs to be switched should not be an admin or an owner of that account.
* The user should not have the same [managed domain](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/203395207-What-is-Managed-Domain-) as the account owner.

**Scope:** `user:master`<br> 

 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "account_id": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="switch-a-users-account-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|accountId|path|string|true|none|
|userId|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» account_id|body|string|true|The Account ID of the account to which you would like move the user to.|

> Example responses

> 204 Response

```json
null
```

<h3 id="switch-a-users-account-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|**HTTP Status Code**: `204`<br><br>User's account switched successfully.|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code**: `400` **Bad Request**<br><br>**Error Code:** `1117`<br> Can not disassociate Admin user|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code**: `404` **Not Found**<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `1001`<br><br>User {userId} does not exist or does not belong to this account.<br><br><br><br>**Error Code:** `1010`<br><br>User not found on this account.<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `1120`<br> Invite not exist<br>	<br><br>|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

|» verified|integer|false|none|Display whether the user's email address for the Zoom account is verified or not. <br><br>`1` - Verified user email.<br><br>`0` - User's email not verified.|

## Create users

<a id="opIduserCreate"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/users \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "action": "create",
    "user_info": {
      "email": "string",
      "first_name": "string",
      "last_name": "string",
      "password": "password",
      "type": 1
    }
  }'
```

`POST /users`

A Zoom account can have one or more users. Use this API to add a new user to your account.<br><br>
**Prerequisites:**<br>
* Pro or higher plan<br><br>
**Scopes:** `user:write:admin` `user:write`<br>
 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "action": "create",
  "user_info": {
    "email": "string",
    "first_name": "string",
    "last_name": "string",
    "password": "password",
    "type": 1
  }
}
```

<h3 id="create-users-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|object|true|User|
|» action|body|string|true|Specify how to create the new user: <br>`create` - User will get an email sent from Zoom. There is a confirmation link in this email. The user will then need to use the link to activate their Zoom account. The user can then set or change their password.<br>`autoCreate` - This action is provided for the enterprise customer who has a managed domain. This feature is disabled by default because of the security risk involved in creating a user who does not belong to your domain.<br>`custCreate` - Users created via this option do not have passwords and will not have the ability to log into the Zoom Web Portal or the Zoom Client. These users can still host and join meetings using the `start_url` and `join_url` respectively. To use this option, you must contact the ISV Platform Sales team at isv@zoom.us.<br>`ssoCreate` - This action is provided for the enabled “Pre-provisioning SSO User” option. A user created in this way has no password. If not a basic user, a personal vanity URL using the user name (no domain) of the provisioning email will be generated. If the user name or PMI is invalid or occupied, it will use a random number or random personal vanity URL.|
|» user_info|body|object|false|none|
|» » email|body|string|true|User email address.|
|» » first_name|body|string|false|User's first name: cannot contain more than 5 Chinese words.|
|» » last_name|body|string|false|User's last name: cannot contain more than 5 Chinese words.|
|» » password|body|string(password)|false|User password. Only used for the "autoCreate" function. The password has to have a minimum of 8 characters and maximum of 32 characters. By default (basic requirement), password must have at least one letter (a, b, c..), at least one number (1, 2, 3...) and include both uppercase and lowercase letters. It should not contain only one identical character repeatedly ('11111111' or 'aaaaaaaa') and it cannot contain consecutive characters ('12345678' or 'abcdefgh').<br><br>**Note:** If the account owner or admin has enabled [enhanced password requirements](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360034675592-Advanced-security-settings#h_fa9186e4-6818-4f7a-915c-2e25c19f0acd), the value provided in this field must meet those requirements. These requirements can be retrieved by calling the [Get Account Settings API](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/accounts/accountsettings) and referring to the `password_requirement` field present in the `security` object.|
|» » type|body|integer|true|User type:<br>`1` - Basic.<br>`2` - Licensed.<br>`3` - On-prem.<br>`99` - None (this can only be set with `ssoCreate`).|

|» action|autoCreate|
|» action|custCreate|
|» action|ssoCreate|
|» » type|1|
|» » type|2|
|» » type|3|
|» » type|99|

```json
}
```

## Check a user email

`GET /users/email`

Verify if a user's email is registered with Zoom.<br><br>

<b>Note: </b>You can successfully check if a user is a registered Zoom user only if the user **signed up for Zoom via email and is within your account.** If you provide an email address of a user who is not in your account, the value of "existed_email" parameter will be "false" irrespective of whether or not the user is registered with Zoom. The response of this API call will not include users who joined Zoom using options such as "Sign in with SSO", "Sign in with Google" or "Sign in with Facebook" even if they are in the same account as yours.

**Scopes:** `user:read:admin` `user:read`
 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`


<h3 id="check-a-user-email-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|email|query|string|true|The email address to be verified.|

```json
{
  "existed_email": false
}
```

|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404` **Not Found**<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `1001`<br><br>User does not exist: $userId.|None|

## Delete a user

<a id="opIduserDelete"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/users/string \
  -X DELETE \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /users/{userId}`

Deleting a user permanently removes the user and their data from Zoom. Users can create a new Zoom account using the same email address. An account owner or an account admin can transfer meetings, webinars and cloud recordings to another Zoom user account before deleting.<br><br>

This API disassociates (unlinks) a user from the associated Zoom account and provides the user their own basic free Zoom account, and the user can purchase their own licenses. You can transfer the user's data (meetings, webinars and cloud recordings) to another user before disassociation.<br> To permanently delete a user, specify "delete" as the value of the `action` query parameter.
**Scopes:** `user:write:admin` `user:write`<br>
 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`

<h3 id="delete-a-user-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|userId|path|string|true|The user ID or email address of the user. For user-level apps, pass `me` as the value for userId.|
|action|query|string|false|Delete action options:<br>`disassociate` - Disassociate a user.<br>`delete`-  Permanently delete a user.<br>Note: To delete pending user in the account, use `disassociate`|
|transfer_email|query|string|false|Transfer email.|
|transfer_meeting|query|boolean|false|Transfer meeting.|
|transfer_webinar|query|boolean|false|Transfer webinar.|
|transfer_recording|query|boolean|false|Transfer recording.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|action|disassociate|
|action|delete|

<h3 id="delete-a-user-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|**HTTP Status Code:** `204`<br><br>User deleted.|None|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400` **Bad Request** <br><br> **Error Code:** `300`<br>The transfer-to email address cannot be the same as the unlinked or deleted user’s email address.<br> Unable to unlink API user(s).<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `200`<br>Cannot delete a user out of your account. <br>Cannot delete a Zoom Rooms user. <br>Unable to delete this deactivated user. Please contact Zoom support team for more information. <br><br><br>**Error Code:** `1000`<br><br>The user cannot be changed because they are a Call-queue manager or Auto-receptionist operator.<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `1107`<br>You can not disassociate a user with managed domain.<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `1117`<br>You can not disassociate an Admin user.<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `1120`<br>A valid invitation to join the Zoom account was not found for this user. <br>This error is thrown if you added a user in your account but the user did not accept the invitation on time and the invitation expired - thus making the userId invalid.|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404` **Not Found**<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `1001`<br><br>User does not exist: $userId.<br>|None|

## List user assistants

<a id="opIduserAssistants"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/users/string/assistants \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /users/{userId}/assistants`

List a user's assistants.

Assistants are the users to whom the current user has assigned [scheduling privilege](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/201362803-Scheduling-Privilege). These assistants can schedule meeting on behalf of the current user as well as manage and act as an alternative host for all meetings if the admin has enabled [Co-host option](https://zoom.us/account/setting) on the account.<br><br>
**Prerequisites**: <br>
* Current user as well as the assistant must have Licensed or an On-prem license.
* Assistants must be under the current user's account.<br>
**Scopes**: `user:read:admin` `user:read`<br>
 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`

<h3 id="list-user-assistants-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|userId|path|string|true|The user ID or email address of the user. For user-level apps, pass `me` as the value for userId.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "assistants": [
    {
      "email": "sfhdfkjdf@hjdsf.fdjf",
      "id": "ddgdfgfdgfgg"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="list-user-assistants-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** `200`<br><br>Success.|Inline|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404` **Not Found**<br><br>**Error Code:** `1001`<br><br>User does not exist: $userId.<br>|None|

<h3 id="list-user-assistants-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|assistants|[object]|false|none|List of User's assistants.|
|» email|string|false|none|Assistant's email address.|
|» id|string|false|none|Assistant's user ID.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

## Add assistants

<a id="opIduserAssistantCreate"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/users/string/assistants \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "assistants": [
      {
        "email": "string",
        "id": "string"
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /users/{userId}/assistants`

Assistants are the users to whom the current user has assigned [scheduling privilege](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/201362803-Scheduling-Privilege). These assistants can schedule meeting on behalf of the current user as well as manage and act as an alternative host for all meetings if the admin has enabled [Co-host option](https://zoom.us/account/setting) on the account.<br>Use this API to assign assistants to a user. <br> In the request body, provide either the User ID or the email address of the user.<br><br>
**Prerequisite**: 
* The user as well as the assistant must have Licensed or an On-prem license.
* Assistants must be under the current user's account.<br>
**Scopes**: `user:write:admin` `user:write`
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`
 

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "assistants": [
    {
      "email": "string",
      "id": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="add-assistants-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|userId|path|string|true|The user ID or email address of the user. For user-level apps, pass `me` as the value for userId.|
|body|body|object|true|User assistant.|
|» assistants|body|[object]|false|List of User's assistants.|
|» » email|body|string|false|Assistant's email address.|
|» » id|body|string|false|Assistant's user ID.|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "add_at": "string [date-time]",
  "ids": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="add-assistants-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|**HTTP Status Code:** `201`<br><br>Assistant added.|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400` **Bad Request**<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `200`<br><br>Current account must be paid account: $userId <br><br>The user must either be a Licensed user or an On-prem user : $userId. <br><br>Can't assign scheduling privilege to yourself.<br><br>Can't find user $email.<br><br>User $email has already granted scheduling privilege.<br><br>The user must either be a Licensed user or an On-prem user : $email.|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404` **Not Found**<br><br>**Error Code:** `1001`<br><br>User does not exist: $userId.<br>|None|

<h3 id="add-assistants-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **201**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|add_at|string(date-time)|false|none|none|
|ids|string|false|none|User ID.|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|201|Content-Location|string||Location of created assistant|

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

## Update a user's email

<a id="opIduserEmailUpdate"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/users/string/email \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "email": "user@example.com"
  }'
```

`PUT /users/{userId}/email`

Change a user's [email address](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/201362563-How-Do-I-Change-the-Email-on-My-Account-) on a Zoom account that has managed domain set up.<br>If the Zoom Account in which the user belongs, has multiple [managed domains](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/203395207-What-is-Managed-Domain-), the email to be updated must match one of the managed domains.<br>
**Scopes:** `user:write:admin` `user:write`<br>
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`<br>
>  Note: A user's email address can only be changed for a maximum of 3 times in a day(24 hours).
**Prerequisite:**<br>
* Managed domain must be enabled in the account.
* The new email address should not already exist in Zoom.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "email": "user@example.com"
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-users-email-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|userId|path|string|true|The user ID or email address of the user. For user-level apps, pass `me` as the value for userId.|
|body|body|object|true|User email.|
|» email|body|string(email)|true|User’s email. The length should be less than 128 characters.|

<h3 id="update-a-users-email-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|**HTTP Status Code:** `204` **No Content**<br><br>Email updated.|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404` **Not Found**<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `1001`<br><br>User does not exist: $email.<br>|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

## Update a user's password

<a id="opIduserPassword"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/users/string/password \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "password": "string"
  }'
```

`PUT /users/{userId}/password`

Update the [password](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/206344385-Change-a-User-s-Password) of a user using which the user can login to Zoom.<br> After this request is processed successfully, an email notification will be sent to the user stating that the password was changed.<br>
**Scopes:** `user:write:admin` `user:write`<br>
 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`
**Prerequisites:**<br>
* Owner or admin of the Zoom account.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "password": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-users-password-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|userId|path|string|true|The user ID or email address of the user. For user-level apps, pass `me` as the value for userId.|
|body|body|object|true|User password.|
|» password|body|string|true|User password. Should be less than 32 characters.<br><br>**Note:** If the account owner or admin has enabled [enhanced password requirements](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360034675592-Advanced-security-settings#h_fa9186e4-6818-4f7a-915c-2e25c19f0acd), the value provided in this field must meet those requirements. These requirements can be retrieved by calling the [Get Account Settings API](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/accounts/accountsettings) and referring to the `password_requirement` field present in the `security` object.|

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|**HTTP Status Code:** `204` **OK**<br><br>Password updated.|None|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400` **Bad Request** <br><br> **Error Code:** `300` <br>Your new password can not match the old password.<br>This password cannot be changed because it has already been changed the maximum number of times over the past 24 hours.<br><br> **Error Code:** `1117` <br>Can not update Admin’s password<br><br> **Error Code:** `1123`<br>Can only update password of Zoom work email account<br><br> **Error Code:** `1124` <br>Minimum of 6 characters.<br> Have at least {lengthRule} characters<br><br> **Error Code:** `1125` <br>Have at least 1 letter (a, b, c…)<br><br> **Error Code:** `1126` <br>Have at least 1 number (1, 2, 3…)<br><br> **Error Code:** `1127` <br>Have at least 1 special character (!, @, #…)<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `1128` <br>Include both Upper case and Lower case characters<br><br>**Error Code:** `1129` Users cannot reuse any of the last $formerPwdCount passwords created.<br><br> **Error Code:** `1130`<br>Password can’t use the same character.<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `1131`<br>Password can’t use continuation character.Such as 'abcdef’,’123456’.<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `1136`<br><br>Your password is too easy to guess. Try another one.<br><br><br>|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404` **Not Found**<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `1001`<br><br>User does not exist: $userId.<br>|None|

```bash
  -X POST \
```

`POST /users/{userId}/picture`

Upload a user's profile picture.<br><br>

Provide `multipart/form-data` as the value of the `content-type` header for this request. This API supports JPEG and PNG file formats.

**Scopes:** `user:write:admin` `user:write`<br>
 
**[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`

```yaml
pic_file: string
```

|userId|path|string|true|The user ID or email address of the user. For user-level apps, pass `me` as the value for userId.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» pic_file|body|string(binary)|true|The file's path. |

<h3 id="upload-a-users-profile-picture-responses">Responses</h3>

|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404` **Not Found**<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `1001`<br><br>User does not exist: $userId.<br>|None|

## Update a user's presence status

<a id="opIdupdatePresenceStatus"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/users/string/presence_status \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "duration": 20,
    "status": "Do_No_Disturb"
  }'
```

`PUT /users/{userId}/presence_status`

Users in the Zoom desktop client and mobile apps are assigned with a [presence status](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360032554051-Status-Icons). The presence status informs users of their contact's availability. Users can also change their own presence status to be either "Away", "Do not disturb", or "Available".

Use this API to update a user's presence status. A user's status can not be updated more than once per minute, i.e., you can only submit a maximum of 1 update request/minute for a single user.<br>Note that a user's presence status can not be updated using this API if the user is not logged in to the Zoom client.

**Scopes:** `user:write`, `user:write:admin`<br>
**[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`<br>




> Body parameter

```json
{
  "duration": 20,
  "status": "Do_No_Disturb"
}
```

<h3 id="update-a-users-presence-status-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|userId|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» duration|body|integer|false|If you're updating the status to `Do_Not_Disturb`, specify a duration in minutes for which the status should remain as `Do_Not_Disturb`. <br><br>The default value is 20 minutes and the maximum allowed value is 1440 minutes.|
|» status|body|string|false|Presence status of the user. The value can be set to one of the following:<br><br>* `Away`<br>* `Do_Not_Disturb`<br>* `Available`<br><br>Users who are on Zoom Client with a version **lower than 5.3.0** can update the status from:<br>* `Away` to `Do_Not_Disturb` <br>* `Available` to `Do-Not_Disturb`<br><br>Users who are on **Zoom Client 5.3.0** or higher can update the status from:<br>* `Do_Not_Disturb` to `Away`<br>* `Do_Not_Disturb` to `Available`<br>* `Available` to `Away`<br>* `Away` to `Available`|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» status|Do_No_Disturb|
|» status|Away|
|» status|Available|

> Example responses

> 204 Response

```json
null
```

<h3 id="update-a-users-presence-status-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|**HTTP Status Code:** `204`<br><br><br>Status updated succesfully.<br>|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400` **Bad Request**<br><br>**Error Code:** `5301`<br><br>Request to update the presence status of this user failed.<br><br>**Error Code:** `5411`<br><br>Unauthorized request. You do not have permission to update the presence status of this user.|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404` **Not Found**<br><br>**Error Code:** `1001`<br><br>User does not exist: {userId}.<br><br><br><br>|None|
|429|Too Many Requests|**HTTP Status Code:** `429` **Too Many Requests**<br><br>Too many requests submitted to update the presence status of this user. Please wait for the request to be processed and try again later.|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

## List user schedulers

<a id="opIduserSchedulers"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/users/string/schedulers \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /users/{userId}/schedulers`

List all the schedulers of a user. Schedulers in this context are the users for whom the current user can schedule meetings for.

For instance, if the current user (i.e., the user whose userId was passed in the path parameter of this API call) is user A, the response of this API will contain a list of user(s), for whom user A can schedule and manage meetings. User A is the assistant of these users and thus has scheduling privilege for these user(s). 

**Prerequisites**:
* Current user must be under the same account as the scheduler.<br>
**Scopes**: `user:read:admin` `user:read`
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`

<h3 id="list-user-schedulers-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|userId|path|string|true|The user ID or email address of the user. For user-level apps, pass `me` as the value for userId.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "schedulers": [
    {
      "email": "sjfgduyfghdfg@myemail.dshdgshfd",
      "id": "abXXXsfsidfhjdsfhd768944"
    },
    {
      "email": "sdhfefghdfg@myemail.dshdgshfd",
      "id": "abXXbbbbioepur8944"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="list-user-schedulers-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** `200`<br>Successfully listed all schedulers of the user.|Inline|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404` **Not Found**<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `1001`<br><br>User does not exist: $userId.<br>|None|

<h3 id="list-user-schedulers-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|schedulers|[object]|false|none|List of users for whom the current user can schedule meetings.|
|» email|string|false|none|Email address of the scheduler.|
|» id|string|false|none|Unique Identifier (User ID) of the Scheduler.|
|» pmi|integer(int64)|false|none|PMI of the meeting host in long (int64) format.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

## Update user status

<a id="opIduserStatus"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/users/string/status \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "action": "activate"
  }'
```

`PUT /users/{userId}/status`

An account owner or admins can deactivate as well as activate a user in a Zoom account. Deactivating a user will remove all licenses associated with a user. It will prevent the deactivated user from logging into their Zoom account. A deactivated user can be reactivated. Reactivating a user grants the user access to login to their Zoom account.<br> Use this API to either [deactivate](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/115005269946-Remove-User-from-your-Account#h_6a9bc1c3-d739-4945-b1f2-00b3b88fb5cc) an active user or to [reactivate](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/115005269946-Remove-User-from-your-Account#h_16319724-d120-4be6-af5d-31582d134ea0) a deactivated user .<br><br>**Scopes:** `user:write:admin` `user:write`<br> 

 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`



> Body parameter

```json
{
  "action": "activate"
}
```

<h3 id="update-user-status-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|userId|path|string|true|The user ID or email address of the user. For user-level apps, pass `me` as the value for userId.|
|body|body|object|true|User status.|
|» action|body|string|true|The action types:<br>`activate` - Activate a deactivated user.<br>`deactivate` - Deactivate a user.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» action|activate|
|» action|deactivate|

> Example responses

> 204 Response

```json
""
```

<h3 id="update-user-status-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK||None|
|204|No Content|**HTTP Status Code:** `204`<br><br>Status updated.|None|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400` **Bad Request**<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `200`<br><br>Zoom Room and Admin users' status can not be activated or deactivated.<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `3412`<br>Your request to activate the user was not approved at this time because your account has reached the permitted maximum number of $maxAllowedNumber basic users. Please remove existing basic user(s) from your Users list or the Pending Users list before attempting to activate this user.<br><br>**Error Code:** `2033`<br>Your request to activate the basic user was not approved because you have already reached the maximum basic user limit allowed in your account. For additional help regarding this issue, contact the Zoom Customer Support team.<br>|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404` **Not Found**<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `1001`<br><br>User does not exist: $userId.<br>|None|

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

## Get a user token

<a id="opIduserToken"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/users/string/token \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /users/{userId}/token`

Retrieve a user's token.<br><br> This token is used for starting meetings with the Client SDK.<br>
**Scopes:** `user:read:admin` `user:read`<br>
 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`
If a user signed into Zoom using Google or Facebook, a null value will be returned for the token. To get the token with this API, ask the user to sign into Zoom using their email and password instead.

<h3 id="get-a-user-token-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|userId|path|string|true|The user ID or email address of the user. For user-level apps, pass `me` as the value for userId.|
|type|query|string|false|User token types:<br>`token` - Used for starting meetings with the client SDK. This token expires in 14 days and a new token will be returned after the expiry.<br>`zak` - Used for generating the start meeting URL. The token expiration time is two hours. For API users, the expiration time is 90 days.|
|ttl|query|integer|false|Use this field in conjunction with the `type` field where the value of `type` field is `zak`. The value of this field denotes the expiry time of the `zak` token in seconds. For example, if you would like the zak token to be expired after one hour of the token generation, the value of this field should be `3600`.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|type|token|
|type|zak|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "token": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="get-a-user-token-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** `200`<br><br>Token returned.|Inline|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404` **Not Found**<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `1001`<br><br>User does not exist: $userId.<br>|None|

<h3 id="get-a-user-token-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|token|string|false|none|User token.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

|total_records|integer|false|none|The total number of records available across all pages.|

OAuth

`GET /past_webinars/{webinarId}/polls`

The polling feature for webinar allows you to create single choice or multiple choice polling questions for your webinars. Use this API to retrieve the results for Webinar Polls of a specific Webinar.

**Prerequisites:**<br>
* [Webinar license](https://zoom.us/webinar)<br>
**Scopes**: `webinar:read:admin`, `webinar:read`<br>

|---|---|---|---|---|
|webinarId|path|string|true|The webinar ID or the webinar UUID.  If a webinar ID is provided in the request instead of a UUID, the response will be for the latest webinar instance.<br><br>If a UUID starts with "/" or contains "//" (example: "/ajXp112QmuoKj4854875==\"), you must **double encode** the UUID before making an API request.|

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "id": 123456,
  "questions": [
    {

          "question": "How are you?"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "start_time": "2019-02-01T12:34:12.660Z",
  "title": "Learn something new",
  "uuid": "gsdjfhsdfkhjdsf"
}
```

|401|Unauthorized|**HTTP Status Code:** `401` **Unauthorized**<br><br>**Error Code:** `1010`<br>  User does not belong to this account:{accountId}.<br>|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404` **Not found**<br><br>Webinar not found.<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `3001`<br><br>Webinar ID is invalid or not end.<br><br>This webinar id does not belong to you:{webinarId}.<br>|None|

<h3 id="list-past-webinar-poll-results-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|integer(int64)|false|none|Webinar ID in "**long**" format(represented as int64 data type in JSON), also known as the webinar number.|
|questions|[object]|false|none|none|

|» » polling_id|string|false|none|Unique identifier of the poll.|
|» » question|string|false|none|Question asked during the poll.|
|start_time|string(date-time)|false|none|The start time of the Webinar.|
|uuid|string|false|none|Webinar UUID.|

OAuth

## List webinars

<a id="opIdwebinars"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/users/string/webinars \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /users/{userId}/webinars`

Zoom users with a [Webinar Plan](https://zoom.us/webinar) have access to creating and managing Webinars. Webinar allows a host to broadcast a Zoom meeting to up to 10,000 attendees.<br> Use this API to list all the webinars that are scheduled by or on-behalf a user (Webinar host).<br><br>
**Scopes:** `webinar:read:admin` `webinar:read`<br> <br>
 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`
**Prerequisites:**
* Pro or higher plan with a Webinar Add-on.

<h3 id="list-webinars-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|userId|path|string|true|The user ID or email address of the user. For user-level apps, pass `me` as the value for userId.|
|page_size|query|integer|false|The number of records returned within a single API call.|
|page_number|query|integer|false|<br>**Deprecated** - This field has been deprecated and we will stop supporting it completely in a future release. Please use "next_page_token" for pagination instead of this field.<br><br>The page number of the current page in the returned records.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
"{\n  \"page_count\": \"1\",\n  \"page_number\": \"1\",\n  \"page_size\": \"30\",\n  \"total_records\": \"1\",\n  \"webinars\": [\n    {\n      \"uuid\": \"dsghfkhaewfds\",\n      \"id\": 0001000,\n      \"host_id\": \"24654130000000\",\n      \"topic\": \"My Webinar\",\n      \"agenda\": \"Learn more about Zoom APIs\",\n      \"type\": \"5\",\n      \"duration\": \"60\",\n      \"start_time\": \"2019-09-24T22:00:00Z\",\n      \"timezone\": \"America/Los_Angeles\",\n      \"created_at\": \"2019-08-30T22:00:00Z\",\n      \"join_url\": \"https://zoom.us/0001000/awesomewebinar\"\n    }\n  ]\n}"
```

<h3 id="list-webinars-1-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** `200`<br><br>List of webinar objects returned.|Inline|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404` **Not Found**<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `1001`<br><br>User {userId} not exist or not belong to this account.|None|

<h3 id="list-webinars-1-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|next_page_token|string|false|none|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|
|page_count|integer|false|none|The number of pages returned for the request made.|
|page_number|integer|false|none|**Deprecated**: This field has been deprecated. Please use the "next_page_token" field for pagination instead of this field.<br><br>The page number of the current results.|
|page_size|integer|false|none|The number of records returned with a single API call.|
|total_records|integer|false|none|The total number of all the records available across pages.|
|webinars|[object]|false|none|List of webinar objects.|
|» agenda|string|false|none|Webinar Description. The length of agenda gets truncated to 250 characters when you list all webinars for a user. To view the complete agenda, retrieve details for a single webinar [here](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/webinars/webinar).|
|» created_at|string(date-time)|false|none|Time of webinar creation.|
|» duration|integer|false|none|Meeting duration.|
|» host_id|string|false|none|ID of the host of the webinar.|
|» id|integer(int64)|false|none|Webinar ID in "**long**" format(represented as int64 data type in JSON), also known as the webinar number.|
|» join_url|string|false|none|Join URL of the webinar (using which others can join the webinar).|
|» start_time|string(date-time)|false|none|Scheduled start time of the Webinar.|
|» timezone|string|false|none|[Timezone ID](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/other-references/abbreviation-lists#timezones) for the Webinar.|
|» topic|string|false|none|Meeting topic.|
|» type|string|false|none|Webinar Types:<br>`5` - Webinar.<br>`6` - Recurring webinar with no fixed time.<br>`9` - Recurring webinar with a fixed time.|
|» uuid|string|false|none|Unique identifier of a Webinar. Each webinar instance will generate its own UUID. Once a Webinar ends, the value of uuid for the same webinar will be different from when it was scheduled.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

`POST /users/{userId}/webinars`

Zoom users with a [Webinar Plan](https://zoom.us/webinar) have access to creating and managing Webinars. Webinar allows a host to broadcast a Zoom meeting to up to 10,000 attendees.<br>Use this API to schedule a Webinar for a user (host).<br><br> 
**Scopes:** `webinar:write:admin` `webinar:write`<br>
 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`<br>
**Prerequisites:**
* Pro or higher plan with a Webinar Add-on.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "agenda": "string",
  "duration": 0,
  "password": "string",
  "recurrence": {
    "end_date_time": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",

    "monthly_day": 0,
    "monthly_week": -1,
    "monthly_week_day": 1,
    "repeat_interval": 0,

    "weekly_days": "string"
  },
  "settings": {
    "allow_multiple_devices": true,
    "alternative_hosts": "string",
    "approval_type": 2,
    "attendees_and_panelists_reminder_email_notification": {
      "enable": true,
      "type": 0
    },
    "audio": "both",
    "authentication_domains": "string",
    "authentication_option": "string",
    "auto_recording": "none",
    "close_registration": true,
    "contact_email": "string",
    "contact_name": "string",
    "email_language": "string",

    "enforce_login_domains": "string",
    "follow_up_absentees_email_notification": {
      "enable": true,
      "type": 0
    },
    "follow_up_attendees_email_notification": {
      "enable": true,
      "type": 0
    },

      "string"
    ],

      "attendees_can_upvote": true,

    },

    }
  ],
```

<h3 id="create-a-webinar-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|userId|path|string|true|The user ID or email address of the user. For user-level apps, pass `me` as the value for userId.|
|body|body|object|true|none|
|» agenda|body|string|false|Webinar description.|
|» duration|body|integer|false|Webinar duration (minutes). Used for scheduled webinars only.|
|» password|body|string|false|Webinar passcode. Passcode may only contain the following characters: [a-z A-Z 0-9 @ - _ * !]. Max of 10 characters.<br><br>If "Require a passcode when scheduling new meetings" setting has been **enabled** **and** [locked](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/115005269866-Using-Tiered-Settings#locked) for the user, the passcode field will be autogenerated for the Webinar in the response even if it is not provided in the API request. <br><br><br><br>**Note:** If the account owner or the admin has configured [minimum passcode requirement settings](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360033559832-Meeting-and-webinar-passwords#h_a427384b-e383-4f80-864d-794bf0a37604), the passcode value provided here must meet those requirements. <br><br>If the requirements are enabled, you can view those requirements by calling [Get Account Settings](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/accounts/accountsettings) API. <br><br><br><br>|
|» recurrence|body|object|false|Recurrence object. Use this object only for a webinar of type `9` i.e., a recurring webinar with fixed time. |
|» » end_date_time|body|string(date-time)|false|Select a date when the webinar will recur before it is canceled. Should be in UTC time, such as 2017-11-25T12:00:00Z. (Cannot be used with "end_times".)|
|» » end_times|body|integer|false|Select how many times the webinar will recur before it is canceled. (Cannot be used with "end_date_time".)|
|» » monthly_day|body|integer|false|Use this field **only if you're scheduling a recurring webinar of type** `3` to state which day in a month, the webinar should recur. The value range is from 1 to 31.<br><br>For instance, if you would like the webinar to recur on 23rd of each month, provide `23` as the value of this field and `1` as the value of the `repeat_interval` field. Instead, if you would like the webinar to recur once every three months, on 23rd of the month, change the value of the `repeat_interval` field to `3`.|
|» » monthly_week|body|integer|false|Use this field **only if you're scheduling a recurring webinar of type** `3` to state the week of the month when the webinar should recur. If you use this field, **you must also use the `monthly_week_day` field to state the day of the week when the webinar should recur.** <br>`-1` - Last week of the month.<br>`1` - First week of the month.<br>`2` - Second week of the month.<br>`3` - Third week of the month.<br>`4` - Fourth week of the month.|
|» » monthly_week_day|body|integer|false|Use this field **only if you're scheduling a recurring webinar of type** `3` to state a specific day in a week when the monthly webinar should recur. To use this field, you must also use the `monthly_week` field. <br>`1` - Sunday.<br>`2` - Monday.<br>`3` - Tuesday.<br>`4` -  Wednesday.<br>`5` - Thursday.<br>`6` - Friday.<br>`7` - Saturday.|
|» » repeat_interval|body|integer|false|Define the interval at which the webinar should recur. For instance, if you would like to schedule a Webinar that recurs every two months, you must set the value of this field as `2` and the value of the `type` parameter as `3`. <br><br>For a daily webinar, the maximum interval you can set is `90` days. For a weekly webinar, the maximum interval that you can set is `12` weeks. For a monthly webinar, the maximum interval that you can set is `3` months.|
|» » type|body|integer|true|Recurrence webinar types:<br>`1` - Daily.<br>`2` - Weekly.<br>`3` - Monthly.|
|» » weekly_days|body|string|false|Use this field **only if you're scheduling a recurring webinar of type** `2` to state which day(s) of the week the webinar should repeat. <br> The value for this field could be a number between `1` to `7` in string format. For instance, if the Webinar should recur on Sunday, provide `"1"` as the value of this field.  <br><br> **Note:** If you would like the webinar to occur on multiple days of a week, you should provide comma separated values for this field. For instance, if the Webinar should recur on Sundays and Tuesdays provide `"1,3"` as the value of this field.<br><br><br>`1`  - Sunday. <br>`2` - Monday.<br>`3` - Tuesday.<br>`4` -  Wednesday.<br>`5` -  Thursday.<br>`6` - Friday.<br>`7` - Saturday.<br><br>|
|» settings|body|object|false|Create Webinar settings.|
|» » allow_multiple_devices|body|boolean|false|Allow attendees to join from multiple devices.|
|» » alternative_hosts|body|string|false|Alternative host emails or IDs. Multiple values separated by comma.|

<h3 id="create-a-webinar-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|**HTTP Status Code:** `201`<br><br>Webinar created.|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400` **Bad Request**<br><br>**Error Code:** `200`<br>Subscription plan for webinar is missing. Enable webinar for this user once the subscription plan is added:{userId}.|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404` **Not Found**<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `1001`<br><br>User {userId} not exist or not belong to this account.<br>|None|

<h3 id="create-a-webinar-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **201**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|host_email|string(email)|false|none|Email address of the meeting host.|
|host_id|string|false|none|ID of the user set as host of the webinar.|
|id|integer(int64)|false|none|Webinar ID in "**long**" format(represented as int64 data type in JSON), also known as the webinar number.|
|registrants_confirmation_email|boolean|false|none|Specify whether or not registrants of this Webinar should receieve confirmation emails.|
|template_id|string|false|none|Unique identifier of the Webinar template. Use this field only if you would like to [schedule the webinar using an existing template](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/115001079746-Webinar-Templates#schedule). The value of this field can be retrieved from [List Webinar Templates](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/webinars/listwebinartemplates) API.<br>You must provide the user ID of the host instead of the email address in the `userId` path parameter in order to use a template for scheduling a Webinar.|
|uuid|string|false|none|Unique identifier of a Webinar. Each Webinar instance will generate its own UUID(i.e., after a Webinar ends, a new UUID will be generated for the next instance of the Webinar). Once a Webinar ends, the value of uuid for the same webinar will be different from when it was scheduled.|
|agenda|string|false|none|Webinar agenda.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|false|none|Create time.|
|duration|integer|false|none|Webinar duration.|
|join_url|string|false|none|URL to join the Webinar. This URL should only be shared with the users who should be invited to the Webinar.|
|occurrences|[object]|false|none|Array of occurrence objects.|
|» duration|integer|false|none|Duration.|
|» occurrence_id|string|false|none|Occurrence ID: Unique Identifier that identifies an occurrence of a recurring webinar. [Recurring webinars](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/216354763-How-to-Schedule-A-Recurring-Webinar) can have a maximum of 50 occurrences.|
|» start_time|string(date-time)|false|none|Start time.|
|» status|string|false|none|Occurrence status.|
|password|string|false|none|Webinar passcode. <br><br>If "Require a passcode when scheduling new meetings" setting has been **enabled** **and** [locked](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/115005269866-Using-Tiered-Settings#locked) for the user, the passcode field will be autogenerated for the Webinar in the response even if it is not provided in the API request. <br><br><br>**Note:** If the account owner or the admin has configured [minimum passcode requirement settings](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360033559832-Meeting-and-webinar-passwords#h_a427384b-e383-4f80-864d-794bf0a37604), the passcode value provided here must meet those requirements. <br><br>If the requirements are enabled, you can view those requirements by calling either the [Get User Settings API](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/users/usersettings) or the  [Get Account Settings](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/accounts/accountsettings) API. <br><br><br><br><br><br>|
|recurrence|object|false|none|Recurrence object. Use this object only for a webinar of type `9` i.e., a recurring webinar with fixed time. |
|» end_date_time|string(date-time)|false|none|Select a date when the webinar will recur before it is canceled. Should be in UTC time, such as 2017-11-25T12:00:00Z. (Cannot be used with "end_times".)|
|» end_times|integer|false|none|Select how many times the webinar will recur before it is canceled. (Cannot be used with "end_date_time".)|
|» monthly_day|integer|false|none|Use this field **only if you're scheduling a recurring webinar of type** `3` to state which day in a month, the webinar should recur. The value range is from 1 to 31.<br><br>For instance, if you would like the webinar to recur on 23rd of each month, provide `23` as the value of this field and `1` as the value of the `repeat_interval` field. Instead, if you would like the webinar to recur once every three months, on 23rd of the month, change the value of the `repeat_interval` field to `3`.|
|» monthly_week|integer|false|none|Use this field **only if you're scheduling a recurring webinar of type** `3` to state the week of the month when the webinar should recur. If you use this field, **you must also use the `monthly_week_day` field to state the day of the week when the webinar should recur.** <br>`-1` - Last week of the month.<br>`1` - First week of the month.<br>`2` - Second week of the month.<br>`3` - Third week of the month.<br>`4` - Fourth week of the month.|
|» monthly_week_day|integer|false|none|Use this field **only if you're scheduling a recurring webinar of type** `3` to state a specific day in a week when the monthly webinar should recur. To use this field, you must also use the `monthly_week` field. <br>`1` - Sunday.<br>`2` - Monday.<br>`3` - Tuesday.<br>`4` -  Wednesday.<br>`5` - Thursday.<br>`6` - Friday.<br>`7` - Saturday.|
|» repeat_interval|integer|false|none|Define the interval at which the webinar should recur. For instance, if you would like to schedule a Webinar that recurs every two months, you must set the value of this field as `2` and the value of the `type` parameter as `3`. <br><br>For a daily webinar, the maximum interval you can set is `90` days. For a weekly webinar, the maximum interval that you can set is `12` weeks. For a monthly webinar, the maximum interval that you can set is `3` months.|
|» type|integer|true|none|Recurrence webinar types:<br>`1` - Daily.<br>`2` - Weekly.<br>`3` - Monthly.|
|» weekly_days|string|false|none|Use this field **only if you're scheduling a recurring webinar of type** `2` to state which day(s) of the week the webinar should repeat. <br> The value for this field could be a number between `1` to `7` in string format. |» registration_type|integer|false|none|Registration types. Only used for recurring webinars with a fixed time.<br>`1` - Attendees register once and can attend any of the webinar sessions.<br>`2` - Attendees need to register for each session in order to attend.<br>`3` - Attendees register once and can choose one or more sessions to attend.|
|» show_share_button|boolean|false|none|Show social share buttons on the registration page.|
|» survey_url|string|false|none|Survey url for post webinar survey|
|start_time|string(date-time)|false|none|Webinar start time in GMT/UTC.|

This URL should only be used by the host of the meeting and should not be shared with anyone other than the host of the Webinar. <br><br>The expiration time for the <code>start_url</code> field listed in the response of [Create a Webinar API](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/webinars/webinarcreate) is two hours for all regular users. <br>	<br>For users created using the <code>custCreate</code> option via the [Create Users](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/users/usercreate) API, the expiration time of the <code>start_url</code> field is 90 days.<br>	<br>For security reasons, to retrieve the latest value for the <code>start_url</code> field programmatically (after expiry), you must call the [Retrieve a Webinar API](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/webinars/webinar) and refer to the value of the <code>start_url</code> field in the response.</aside><br><br><br>|

## Get a webinar

<a id="opIdwebinar"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/webinars/0 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /webinars/{webinarId}`

Zoom users with a [Webinar Plan](https://zoom.us/webinar) have access to creating and managing Webinars. Webinar allows a host to broadcast a Zoom meeting to up to 10,000 attendees.<br>Use this API to get details of a scheduled webinar.<br><br>
**Scopes:** `webinar:read:admin` `webinar:read`<br> 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`<br>**Prerequisites:**
* Pro or higher plan with a Webinar Add-on.

<h3 id="get-a-webinar-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|webinarId|path|integer(int64)|true|The webinar ID in "**long**" format(represented as int64 data type in JSON). |
|occurrence_id|query|string|false|Unique Identifier that identifies an occurrence of a recurring webinar. [Recurring webinars](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/216354763-How-to-Schedule-A-Recurring-Webinar) can have a maximum of 50 occurrences. When you create a recurring Webinar using [Create a Webinar API](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/webinars/webinarcreate), you can retrieve the Occurrence ID from the response of the API call.|
|show_previous_occurrences|query|boolean|false|Set the value of this field to `true` if you would like to view Webinar details of all previous occurrences of a recurring Webinar.|

<h3 id="get-a-webinar-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|host_email|string(email)|false|none|Email address of the meeting host.|
|host_id|string|false|none|ID of the user set as host of webinar.|
