|uuid|string|false|none|Unique Webinar ID. Each Webinar instance will generate its own Webinar UUID (i.e., after a Webinar ends, a new UUID will be generated for the next instance of the Webinar). You can retrieve a list of UUIDs from past Webinar instances using [this API](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/webinars/pastwebinars). Please double encode your UUID when using it for API calls if the UUID begins with a '/'or contains '//' in it.<br><br>|
|agenda|string|false|none|Webinar agenda.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|false|none|Create time.|
|duration|integer|false|none|Webinar duration.|
|join_url|string|false|none|URL to join the Webinar. This URL should only be shared with the users who should be invited to the Webinar.|
|occurrences|[object]|false|none|Array of occurrence objects.|
|» duration|integer|false|none|Duration.|
|» occurrence_id|string|false|none|Occurrence ID: Unique Identifier that identifies an occurrence of a recurring webinar. [Recurring webinars](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/216354763-How-to-Schedule-A-Recurring-Webinar) can have a maximum of 50 occurrences.|
|» start_time|string(date-time)|false|none|Start time.|
|» status|string|false|none|Occurrence status.|
|password|string|false|none|Webinar passcode. <br><br>If "Require a passcode when scheduling new meetings" setting has been **enabled** **and** [locked](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/115005269866-Using-Tiered-Settings#locked) for the user, the passcode field will be autogenerated for the Webinar in the response even if it is not provided in the API request. <br><br><br>**Note:** If the account owner or the admin has configured [minimum passcode requirement settings](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360033559832-Meeting-and-webinar-passwords#h_a427384b-e383-4f80-864d-794bf0a37604), the passcode value provided here must meet those requirements. <br><br>If the requirements are enabled, you can view those requirements by calling either the [Get User Settings API](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/users/usersettings) or the  [Get Account Settings](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/accounts/accountsettings) API. <br><br><br><br><br><br>|
|recurrence|object|false|none|Recurrence object. Use this object only for a webinar of type `9` i.e., a recurring webinar with fixed time. |
|» end_date_time|string(date-time)|false|none|Select a date when the webinar will recur before it is canceled. Should be in UTC time, such as 2017-11-25T12:00:00Z. (Cannot be used with "end_times".)|
|» end_times|integer|false|none|Select how many times the webinar will recur before it is canceled. (Cannot be used with "end_date_time".)|
|» monthly_day|integer|false|none|Use this field **only if you're scheduling a recurring webinar of type** `3` to state which day in a month, the webinar should recur. The value range is from 1 to 31.<br><br>For instance, if you would like the webinar to recur on 23rd of each month, provide `23` as the value of this field and `1` as the value of the `repeat_interval` field. Instead, if you would like the webinar to recur once every three months, on 23rd of the month, change the value of the `repeat_interval` field to `3`.|
|» monthly_week|integer|false|none|Use this field **only if you're scheduling a recurring webinar of type** `3` to state the week of the month when the webinar should recur. If you use this field, **you must also use the `monthly_week_day` field to state the day of the week when the webinar should recur.** <br>`-1` - Last week of the month.<br>`1` - First week of the month.<br>`2` - Second week of the month.<br>`3` - Third week of the month.<br>`4` - Fourth week of the month.|
|» monthly_week_day|integer|false|none|Use this field **only if you're scheduling a recurring webinar of type** `3` to state a specific day in a week when the monthly webinar should recur. To use this field, you must also use the `monthly_week` field. <br>`1` - Sunday.<br>`2` - Monday.<br>`3` - Tuesday.<br>`4` -  Wednesday.<br>`5` - Thursday.<br>`6` - Friday.<br>`7` - Saturday.|
|» repeat_interval|integer|false|none|Define the interval at which the webinar should recur. For instance, if you would like to schedule a Webinar that recurs every two months, you must set the value of this field as `2` and the value of the `type` parameter as `3`. <br><br>For a daily webinar, the maximum interval you can set is `90` days. For a weekly webinar, the maximum interval that you can set is `12` weeks. For a monthly webinar, the maximum interval that you can set is `3` months.|
|» type|integer|true|none|Recurrence webinar types:<br>`1` - Daily.<br>`2` - Weekly.<br>`3` - Monthly.|
|» weekly_days|string|false|none|Use this field **only if you're scheduling a recurring webinar of type** `2` to state which day(s) of the week the webinar should repeat. <br> The value for this field could be a number between `1` to `7` in string format. For instance, if the Webinar should recur on Sunday, provide `"1"` as the value of this field.  <br><br> **Note:** If you would like the webinar to occur on multiple days of a week, you should provide comma separated values for this field. For instance, if the Webinar should recur on Sundays and Tuesdays provide `"1,3"` as the value of this field.<br><br><br>`1`  - Sunday. <br>`2` - Monday.<br>`3` - Tuesday.<br>`4` -  Wednesday.<br>`5` -  Thursday.<br>`6` - Friday.<br>`7` - Saturday.<br><br>|

## Delete a webinar

<a id="opIdwebinarDelete"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/webinars/0 \
  -X DELETE \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /webinars/{webinarId}`

Delete a Webinar.<br><br>
**Scopes:** `webinar:write:admin` `webinar:write`<br>
 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`<br>
**Prerequisites:**<br>
* Pro or higher plan with a Webinar Add-on.

<h3 id="delete-a-webinar-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|webinarId|path|integer(int64)|true|The webinar ID in "**long**" format(represented as int64 data type in JSON). |
|occurrence_id|query|string|false|The meeting occurrence ID.|
|cancel_webinar_reminder|query|string|false|`true`: Notify panelists and registrants about the webinar cancellation via email. <br><br>`false`: Do not send any email notification to webinar registrants and panelists. <br><br>The default value of this field is `false`.|

<h3 id="delete-a-webinar-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** `200`<br><br>Success|None|
|204|No Content|**HTTP Status Code:** `204`<br><br>Webinar deleted.|None|
|300|Multiple Choices|**HTTP Status Code:** `300`<br>Invalid webinar ID.|None|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400`<br><br>Bad request<br><br>**Error Code:** `1010`<br><br>User does not belong to this account:{accountId}.<br><br>**Error Code:** `3002`<br><br>Sorry, you cannot delete this webinar since it is in progress.<br><br>**Error Code:** `3003`<br><br>You are not the webinar host.<br><br>**Error Code:** `3007`<br><br>Sorry, you cannot delete this webinar since it has ended.<br><br>**Error Code:** `3018`<br><br>Not allowed to delete PMI.<br><br>**Error Code:** `3037`<br><br>Not allowed to delete PAC.<br>|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404`<br><br>Webinar not found.<br><br>**Error Code:** `1001`<br><br>User {userId} does not exist or does not belong to this account.<br><br>**Error Code:** `3001`<br><br>Webinar {webinarId} not found or has expired.<br>|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

`PATCH /webinars/{webinarId}`

Zoom users with a [Webinar Plan](https://zoom.us/webinar) have access to creating and managing Webinars. Webinar allows a host to broadcast a Zoom meeting to up to 10,000 attendees.<br>
Use this API to make updates to a scheduled Webinar.<br><br>
**Scopes:** `webinar:write:admin` `webinar:write`<br>
 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`<br>
**Prerequisites:**<br>

<h3 id="update-a-webinar-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|webinarId|path|integer(int64)|true|The webinar ID in "**long**" format(represented as int64 data type in JSON). |
|occurrence_id|query|string|false|Webinar occurrence id. Support change of agenda, start_time, duration, settings: {host_video, panelist_video, hd_video, watermark, auto_recording}|
|body|body|object|true|Webinar.|
|» agenda|body|string|false|Webinar description.|
|» duration|body|integer|false|Webinar duration (minutes). Used for scheduled webinar only.|
|» password|body|string|false|[Webinar passcode](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360033559832-Meeting-and-webinar-passwords). By default, passcode may only contain the following characters: [a-z A-Z 0-9 @ - _ * !] and can have a maximum of 10 characters.<br><br>**Note:** If the account owner or the admin has configured [minimum passcode requirement settings](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360033559832-Meeting-and-webinar-passwords#h_a427384b-e383-4f80-864d-794bf0a37604), the passcode value provided here must meet those requirements. <br><br>If the requirements are enabled, you can view those requirements by calling either the [Get User Settings API](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/users/usersettings) or the  [Get Account Settings](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/accounts/accountsettings) API. <br><br>If "**Require a passcode when scheduling new meetings**" setting has been **enabled** **and** [locked](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/115005269866-Using-Tiered-Settings#locked) for the user, the passcode field will be autogenerated for the Webinar in the response even if it is not provided in the API request. <br><br><br><br><br><br><br><br><br><br>|
|» recurrence|body|object|false|Recurrence object. Use this object only for a meeting with type `8` i.e., a recurring meeting with fixed time. |
|» » end_date_time|body|string(date-time)|false|Select the final date on which the meeting will recur before it is canceled. Should be in UTC time, such as 2017-11-25T12:00:00Z. (Cannot be used with "end_times".)|
|» » end_times|body|integer|false|Select how many times the meeting should recur before it is canceled. (Cannot be used with "end_date_time".)|
|» » monthly_day|body|integer|false|Use this field **only if you're scheduling a recurring meeting of type** `3` to state which day in a month, the meeting should recur. The value range is from 1 to 31.<br><br>For instance, if you would like the meeting to recur on 23rd of each month, provide `23` as the value of this field and `1` as the value of the `repeat_interval` field. Instead, if you would like the meeting to recur every three months, on 23rd of the month, change the value of the `repeat_interval` field to `3`.|
|» » monthly_week|body|integer|false|Use this field **only if you're scheduling a recurring meeting of type** `3` to state the week of the month when the meeting should recur. If you use this field, **you must also use the `monthly_week_day` field to state the day of the week when the meeting should recur.** <br>`-1` - Last week of the month.<br>`1` - First week of the month.<br>`2` - Second week of the month.<br>`3` - Third week of the month.<br>`4` - Fourth week of the month.|
|» » monthly_week_day|body|integer|false|Use this field **only if you're scheduling a recurring meeting of type** `3` to state a specific day in a week when the monthly meeting should recur. To use this field, you must also use the `monthly_week` field. <br><br><br>`1` - Sunday.<br>`2` - Monday.<br>`3` - Tuesday.<br>`4` -  Wednesday.<br>`5` - Thursday.<br>`6` - Friday.<br>`7` - Saturday.|
|» » repeat_interval|body|integer|false|Define the interval at which the meeting should recur. For instance, if you would like to schedule a meeting that recurs every two months, you must set the value of this field as `2` and the value of the `type` parameter as `3`. <br><br>For a daily meeting, the maximum interval you can set is `90` days. For a weekly meeting the maximum interval that you can set is  of `12` weeks. For a monthly meeting, there is a maximum of `3` months.<br><br>|
|» » type|body|integer|true|Recurrence meeting types:<br>`1` - Daily.<br>`2` - Weekly.<br>`3` - Monthly.|
|» » weekly_days|body|string|false|This field is required **if you're scheduling a recurring meeting of type** `2` to state which day(s) of the week the meeting should repeat. <br> <br> The value for this field could be a number between `1` to `7` in string format. For instance, if the meeting should recur on Sunday, provide `"1"` as the value of this field.<br><br> **Note:** If you would like the meeting to occur on multiple days of a week, you should provide comma separated values for this field. For instance, if the meeting should recur on Sundays and Tuesdays provide `"1,3"` as the value of this field.<br><br> <br>`1`  - Sunday. <br>`2` - Monday.<br>`3` - Tuesday.<br>`4` -  Wednesday.<br>`5` -  Thursday.<br>`6` - Friday.<br>`7` - Saturday.|
|» settings|body|object|false|none|
|» » allow_multiple_devices|body|boolean|false|Allow attendees to join from multiple devices.|
|» » alternative_hosts|body|string|false|Alternative host emails or IDs. Multiple values separated by comma.|
|» » approval_type|body|integer|false|`0` - Automatically approve.<br>`1` - Manually approve.<br>`2` - No registration required.|
|» » attendees_and_panelists_reminder_email_notification|body|object|false|Send reminder email to attendees and panelists.|
|» » » enable|body|boolean|false|* `true`: Send reminder email to attendees and panelists.<br><br>* `false`: Do not send reminder email to attendees and panelists.|
|» » » type|body|integer|false|`0` - No plan.<br>`1` - Send 1 hour before webinar.<br>`2` - Send 1 day before webinar.<br>`3` - Send 1 hour and 1 day before webinar.<br>`4` - Send 1 week before webinar.<br>`5` - Send 1 hour and 1 week before webinar.<br>`6` - Send 1 day and 1 week before webinar.<br>`7` - Send 1 hour, 1 day and 1 week before webinar.|
|» » audio|body|string|false|Determine how participants can join the audio portion of the webinar.|
|» » authentication_domains|body|string|false|If user has configured ["Sign Into Zoom with Specified Domains"](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360037117472-Authentication-Profiles-for-Meetings-and-Webinars#h_5c0df2e1-cfd2-469f-bb4a-c77d7c0cca6f) option, this will list the domains that are authenticated.|
|» » authentication_name|body|string|false|Authentication name set in the [authentication profile](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360037117472-Authentication-Profiles-for-Meetings-and-Webinars#h_5c0df2e1-cfd2-469f-bb4a-c77d7c0cca6f).|
|» » authentication_option|body|string|false|Webinar authentication option id.|
|» » auto_recording|body|string|false|Automatic recording:<br>`local` - Record on local.<br>`cloud` -  Record on cloud.<br>`none` - Disabled.|
|» » close_registration|body|boolean|false|Close registration after event date.|
|» » contact_email|body|string|false|Contact email for registration|
|» » contact_name|body|string|false|Contact name for registration|
|» » email_language|body|string|false|Set the email language to one of the following:<br>`en-US`,`de-DE`,`es-ES`,`fr-FR`,`jp-JP`,`pt-PT`,`ru-RU`,`zh-CN`, `zh-TW`, `ko-KO`, `it-IT`, `vi-VN`.|
|» » enforce_login|body|boolean|false|Only signed in users can join this meeting.<br><br>**This field is deprecated and will not be supported in the future.**  <br><br>As an alternative, use the "meeting_authentication", "authentication_option" and "authentication_domains" fields to understand the [authentication configurations](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360037117472-Authentication-Profiles-for-Meetings-and-Webinars) set for the Webinar.|
|» » enforce_login_domains|body|string|false|Only signed in users with specified domains can join meetings.<br><br>**This field is deprecated and will not be supported in the future.**  <br><br>As an alternative, use the "meeting_authentication", "authentication_option" and "authentication_domains" fields to understand the [authentication configurations](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360037117472-Authentication-Profiles-for-Meetings-and-Webinars) set for the Webinar.|
|» » follow_up_absentees_email_notification|body|object|false|Send follow-up email to absentees.|
|» » » enable|body|boolean|false|* `true`: Send follow-up email to absentees.<br><br>* `false`: Do not send follow-up email to absentees.|
|» » » type|body|integer|false|`0` - No plan.<br>`1` - Send 1 days after the scheduled end date.<br>`2` - Send 2 days after the scheduled end date.<br>`3` - Send 3 days after the scheduled end date.<br>`4` - Send 4 days after the scheduled end date.<br>`5` - Send 5 days after the scheduled end date.<br>`6` - Send 6 days after the scheduled end date.<br>`7` - Send 7 days after the scheduled end date.|
|» » follow_up_attendees_email_notification|body|object|false|Send follow-up email to attendees.|

## Perform batch registration

<a id="opIdaddBatchWebinarRegistrants"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/webinars/string/batch_registrants \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "auto_approve": true,
    "registrants": [
      {
        "email": "user@example.com",
        "first_name": "string",
        "last_name": "string"
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /webinars/{webinarId}/batch_registrants`

Use this API to register up to 30 registrants at once for a scheduled webinar that requires [registration](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/204619915-Scheduling-a-webinar-with-registration). <br>

**Prerequisites:**<br>
* The webinar host must be a Licensed user.
* The webinar should be of type `5`, i.e., it should be a scheduled webinar. Other types of webinars are not supported by this API.<br><br>
**Scope:** `webinar:write`, `webinar:write:admin`<br>
**[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Heavy`<br>









> Body parameter

```json
{
  "auto_approve": true,
  "registrants": [
    {
      "email": "user@example.com",
      "first_name": "string",
      "last_name": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="perform-batch-registration-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|webinarId|path|string|true|Unique identifier of the webinar.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» auto_approve|body|boolean|false|If a meeting was scheduled with approval_type `1` (manual approval), but you would like to automatically approve the registrants that are added via this API, you can set the value of this field to `true`. <br><br>You **cannot** use this field to change approval setting for a meeting  that was originally scheduled with approval_type `0` (automatic approval).|
|» registrants|body|[object]|false|none|
|» » email|body|string(email)|true|Email address of the registrant.|
|» » first_name|body|string|true|First name of the registrant.|
|» » last_name|body|string|false|Last name of the registrant.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "registrants": [
    {
      "email": "AqJiu@BkIJbPQOXXngjYCpbrlI.zyax",
      "join_url": " https://zoom.us/w/9999999?tk=oZuwHfdgAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA&uuid=WN_XW4_SdxBBBBxLDQt",
      "registrant_id": "conseret14re"
    },
    {
      "email": "DEih6AZ@mvRTbzqfUSOItBkyPDbNbAW.ouz",
      "join_url": " https://zoom.us/w/9999999?tk=oZu52542356AAAAAA&uuid=WN_XW4_SdxBBBBxLDQt",
      "registrant_id": "fdgsfh2ey82fuh"
    },
    {
      "email": "i8OzhqFt2h@YKJmTmm.tge",
      "join_url": " https://zoom.us/w/9999999?tk=ozghdfdsghf36AAA&uuid=WN_XW4_SdxBBBBxLDQt",
      "registrant_id": "hdsfhjf3iwh"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="perform-batch-registration-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** `200` **OK** <br><br>Registrants added.|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400` **Bad Request** <br><br>**Error Code:** `200`<br> Webinar plan is missing. You must subscribe to the webinar plan and enable webinar for this user: {0} in order to perform this action.<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `300`<br> <br>This API can only be used for scheduled webinar(webinar type: 5). Batch registration is not supported for other webinar types.<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `3038`<br><br>This webinar is over, you can no longer register for this webinar. If you have any questions, please contact the webinar host.<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `3000`<br> Registration has not been enabled for this webinar: {0}.<br><br>|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404` **Not Found** <br><br>**Error Code:** `3001`<br><br>Webinar does not exist: {0}.<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `3043`<br><br>Webinar has reached maximum attendee capacity.<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `404`<br><br>Registration has not been enabled for this meeting: {meetingId}.<br><br><br><br>|None|

<h3 id="perform-batch-registration-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|registrants|[object]|false|none|none|
|» email|string|false|none|Email address of the registrant.|
|» join_url|string|false|none|Unique URL using which registrant can join the webinar.|
|» registrant_id|string|false|none|Unique identifier of the registrant.|

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth, Bearer
</aside>

## List panelists

`GET /webinars/{webinarId}/panelists`

Panelists in a Webinar can view and send video, screen share, annotate, etc and do much more compared to attendees in a Webinar. 

Use this API to list all the panelists of a Webinar.<br><br>
**Scopes:** `webinar:read:admin` `webinar:read`<br>
 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`<br>
**Prerequisites:**<br>
* Pro or a higher plan with [Webinar Add-on](https://zoom.us/webinar).<br> 

<h3 id="list-panelists-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|webinarId|path|integer(int64)|true|The webinar ID in "**long**" format(represented as int64 data type in JSON). |

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "panelists": [
    {
      "email": "maryjkdfdsgfshdgf@jdfdkjdglfk.jkfgdj",
      "name": "Mary"
    },
    {
      "email": "dfdsgfsdhf@jkgfdgfkdhgfdjg.fkjgdf",
      "name": "Mike"
    }
  ],
  "total_records": "2"
}
```

<h3 id="list-panelists-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** `200`<br><br>Webinar plan subscription missing. Enable webinar for this user once the subscription is added.|Inline|
|300|Multiple Choices|**HTTP Status Code:** `300`<br>|None|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400`<br><br>Bad request<br><br>**Error Code:** `1010`<br><br>User does not belong to this account:{accountId}.<br>|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404`<br><br>Webinar not found.<br><br>**Error Code:** `1001`<br><br>User {userId} does not exist or does not belong to this account.<br><br>**Error Code:** `3001`<br><br>Webinar {webinarId} not found or has expired.<br>|None|

<h3 id="list-panelists-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|panelists|[object]|false|none|List of panelist objects.|
|» id|string|false|none|Panelist's ID.|
|» email|string(email)|false|none|Panelist's email.|
|» name|string|false|none|Panelist's full name.|
|» join_url|string|false|none|Join URL.|
|total_records|integer|false|none|Total records.|

## List webinar registrants

<a id="opIdwebinarRegistrants"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/webinars/0/registrants \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /webinars/{webinarId}/registrants`

Zoom users with a [Webinar Plan](https://zoom.us/webinar) have access to creating and managing Webinars. Webinar allows a host to broadcast a Zoom meeting to up to 10,000 attendees. Scheduling a [Webinar with registration](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/204619915-Scheduling-a-Webinar-with-Registration) requires your registrants to complete a brief form before receiving the link to join the Webinar.<br>
Use this API to list all the users that have registered for a webinar.<br><br>
**Prerequisites:**
* Pro or higher plan with a Webinar Add-on.<br>
**Scopes:** `webinar:read:admin` `webinar:read`<br> 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium`<br>



<h3 id="list-webinar-registrants-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|webinarId|path|integer(int64)|true|The webinar ID in "**long**" format(represented as int64 data type in JSON). |
|occurrence_id|query|string|false|The meeting occurrence ID.|
|status|query|string|false|The registrant status:<br>`pending` - Registrant's status is pending.<br>`approved` - Registrant's status is approved.<br>`denied` - Registrant's status is denied.|
|tracking_source_id|query|string|false|The tracking source ID for the registrants. Useful if you share the webinar registration page in multiple locations. See [Creating source tracking links for webinar registration](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360000315683-Creating-source-tracking-links-for-webinar-registration) for details.|
|page_size|query|integer|false|The number of records returned within a single API call.|
|page_number|query|integer|false|<br>**Deprecated** - This field has been deprecated and we will stop supporting it completely in a future release. Please use "next_page_token" for pagination instead of this field.<br><br>The page number of the current page in the returned records.|
|next_page_token|query|string|false|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|status|pending|
|status|approved|
|status|denied|

## Get a webinar registrant

<a id="opIdwebinarRegistrantGet"></a>

`GET /webinars/{webinarId}/registrants/{registrantId}`

Zoom users with a [Webinar Plan](https://zoom.us/webinar) have access to creating and managing Webinars. Webinar allows a host to broadcast a Zoom meeting to up to 10,000 attendees. Scheduling a [Webinar with registration](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/204619915-Scheduling-a-Webinar-with-Registration) requires your registrants to complete a brief form before receiving the link to join the Webinar.<br>Use this API to get details on a specific user who has registered for the Webinar.<br><br>
**Scopes:** `webinar:read:admin` `webinar:read`<br>
 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`<br>
**Prerequisites:**<br>

|occurrence_id|query|string|false|The meeting occurrence ID.|

```bash
curl https://example.com/rooms/string/devices/string/app_version \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
```

`PUT /rooms/{roomId}/devices/{deviceId}/app_version`

[Upgrade](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/204675449-Upgrade-or-Downgrade-Zoom-Rooms-Software#h_1751c48a-644e-4a60-b96a-31ec77c616e6) or [downgrade](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/204675449-Upgrade-or-Downgrade-Zoom-Rooms-Software#h_d97349d6-9253-484c-af80-350475026524) the version of Zoom Rooms App installed in your Mac or Windows device.

**Prerequisites:**<br>

```json
  "action": "upgrade"
}
```

|body|body|object|false|none|
|» action|body|string|false|Specify one of the following values for this field:<br><br>`upgrade`: Upgrade to the latest Zoom Rooms App Version.<br><br>`downgrade`: Downgrade the Zoom Rooms App Version.<br><br>`cancel`: Cancel an ongoing upgrade or downgrade process.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» action|upgrade|
|» action|downgrade|
|» action|cancel|

> Example responses

```json
null
```

|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400` **Bad Request**<br><br>**Error Code:** `8001` <br> Cannot process this upgrade request. The Zoom Rooms Software in this device is either already up to date or is currently being updated.  <br>  <br> <br>**Error Code:** `8002` <br> Cannot process the downgrade request. The target version for downgrading is not available or the downgrade process has already been initiated. <br>  <br> <br>**Error Code:** `8003` <br>  The cancel request could not be processed because the Zoom Rooms Software in this device is not being downgraded or upgraded at the moment. The cancel action should only be used to cancel an ongoing upgrade or downgrade process. <br>  <br> <br>**Error Code:** `8004` <br> A device with the provided Device ID: {deviceId} does not belong to the current room: {roomId}.|None|

`GET /accounts/{accountId}/sip_trunk/callout_countries`

Retrieve the list of internal [call-out](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/200942859-How-To-Use-Telephone-Call-Out-) countries of a master account or a sub account. To list call-out enabled countries of a sub account, provide the account ID of the sub account in the `accountId` path parameter. To list call-out enabled countries of a master account, provide `me` as the value of the `accountId` path parameter.
<br><b>Prerequisites:</b><br>
* The account making this API request must be a [master account](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/master-account-apis) with SIP Connected Audio Plan.<br><br>
**Scope:** `sip_trunk:master`

<h3 id="list-internal-call-out-countries-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|accountId|path|string|true|Unique identifier of the account. To list Call-out enabled countries to a sub account, provide the account ID of the sub account in the `accountId` path parameter. To list Call-out enabled countries of a sub account, provide the account ID of the sub account in the `accountId` path parameter. To list Call-out enabled countries of a master account, provide `me` as the value of the `accountId` path parameter.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "callout_countries": [
    {
      "code": "1",
      "id": "US",
      "name": "United States"

    {
      "code": "1",
      "id": "CA",
      "name": "Canada"
    }
  ],
  "total_records": 2
}
```

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** `200` **OK** <br><br>List of Internal Callout Countries returned.|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400` **Bad Request**<br><br>**Error Code:** `300`<br> <br>* Your account does not have the permission to make updates on this account. Only a master account can perform this action on a sub account.<br>*  Request failed because this account is not enrolled in SIP Connected Audio plan.<br>* This account is not a master account. To get access to this API, your account must be enrolled in the API Partner Plan and must be a master account.<br><br>|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404` **Not Found**<br><br>**Error Code:** `2001`<br> Account does not exist: {0}.|None|

<h3 id="list-internal-call-out-countries-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

|» name|string|false|none|Name of the country.|

## List internal numbers

<a id="opIdlistInternalNumbers"></a>

> Code samples

```bash

  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /accounts/{accountId}/sip_trunk/internal_numbers`

This API allows a master account with SIP Connected Audio plan to list internal phone numbers (i.e., numbers that are not provided by Zoom but are owned by the organization consuming the API) assigned to a master account or a sub account.<br><br>To list internal numbers of a sub account, provide the account ID of the sub account in the `accountId` path parameter. To list internal numbers of a  master account, provide `me` as the value of the `accountId` path parameter.
<br><b>Prerequisites:</b><br>
* The account making this API request must be a [master account](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/master-account-apis) with SIP Connected Audio Plan.<br><br>
**Scope:** `sip_trunk:master`




<h3 id="list-internal-numbers-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|accountId|path|string|true|Unique identifier of the account. To list internal numbers of a sub account, provide the account ID of the sub account in the `accountId` path parameter. To list internal numbers of a  master account, provide `me` as the value of the `accountId` path parameter.|
|page_size|query|integer|false|The number of records returned within a single API call.|
|next_page_token|query|string|false|The next page token is used to paginate through large result sets. A next page token will be returned whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "internal_numbers": [
    {
      "allow_for_external_meetings": true,
      "allow_join": true,
      "country": "string",
      "display_number": "string",
      "labels": "string",
      "languages": "en-GB",
      "number": "string",
      "type": 0,
      "visible": true
    }
  ],
  "next_page_token": "string",
  "page_size": 30,
  "total_records": 0
}
```

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** `200` **OK**<br><br>List of internal numbers returned.<br>|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400` **Bad Request**<br><br>**Error Code:** `300`<br> <br>* Your account does not have the permission to make updates on this account. Only a master account can perform this action on a sub account.<br>* Request failed because this account is not enrolled in SIP Connected Audio plan.<br>* This account is not a master account. To get access to this API, your account must be enrolled in the API Partner Plan and must be a master account.<br><br><br><br>|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404` **Not Found**<br><br>**Error Code:** `2001`<br> Account does not exist: {0}.|None|

<h3 id="list-internal-numbers-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|internal_numbers|[object]|false|none|none|
|» allow_for_external_meetings|boolean|false|none|Control whether the number can be used to attend 3rd party meetings.|
|» allow_join|boolean|false|none|Specify whether this number can be used by users to join a meeting or not. <br><br>* `true` : This number can be used to join a meeting. <br><br>*  `false`: This number can not be used to join a meeting. <br><br>Note that if the value of `visible` field is set to `true`, the value of this field will always be `true`.|
|» country|string|true|none|Two letter country code of the country.|
|» display_number|string|true|none|Phone number with display format. For instance, if the value in the number field is `+1888888000`, the value of this field could be `+1 888 888 000`. |
|» labels|string|true|none|A short description for the phone number.|
|» languages|string|true|none|Specify the language in which this phone number should be displayed. Currently, the only supported languages are `en-GB`, `en-US`, `de-DE`.|
|» number|string|true|none|Phone number in E164 format.|

|total_records|integer|false|none|The total number of records returned.|

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|» languages|en-GB|
|» languages|en-US|
|» languages|de-DE|
|» type|0|
|» type|1|

## Assign numbers

<a id="opIdassignSipTrunkNumbers"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/accounts/string/sip_trunk/numbers \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "phone_numbers": [
      "string"
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /accounts/{accountId}/sip_trunk/numbers`

With SIP-connected audio, Zoom establishes a SIP trunk (a network connection specifically designed to make and deliver phone calls) over a direct and private connection between the customer’s network and the Zoom cloud. Meeting participants that dial into a meeting or have the meeting call them, and are On-Net from the perspective of the customers' IP telephony network, will be connected over this trunk rather than over the PSTN. <br><br>Use this API to assign internal numbers to a sub account.

**Prerequisites:**<br>
* Pro or a higher account with SIP Connected Audio plan enabled.
* The account must be a master account<br>
**Scopes:** `sip_trunk:master`<br> 
 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "phone_numbers": [
    "string"
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="assign-numbers-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|accountId|path|string|true|Unique Identifier of the sub account.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» phone_numbers|body|[string]|false|Phone number(s) to be assigned to the sub account.|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
null
```

<h3 id="assign-numbers-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|**HTTP Status Code:** `201` **Created**<br><br>Numbers assigned successfully.<br>|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400` **Bad Request**<br><br>**Error Code:** `2100`<br><br>This sub account has no sip trunk plan.<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `400`<br><br>This number does not belong to master account.<br>|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404` **Not Found**<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `2001`<br><br>This account does not exist or does not belong to this master account.<br><br>This account does not exist or does not belong to you.<br>|None|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

## Assign SIP trunk configuration

<a id="opIdassignSIPConfig"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/accounts/string/sip_trunk/settings \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "enable": true,
    "show_callout_internal_number": true,
    "show_zoom_provided_callout_countries": 0,
    "show_zoom_provided_numbers": 0
  }'
```

`PATCH /accounts/{accountId}/sip_trunk/settings`

With SIP-connected audio, Zoom establishes a SIP trunk (a network connection specifically designed to make and deliver phone calls) over a direct and private connection between the customer’s network and the Zoom cloud. Meeting participants that dial into a meeting or have the meeting call them, and are On-Net from the perspective of the customers' IP telephony network, will be connected over this trunk rather than over the PSTN. <br><br> Using this API, a master account owner can copy the SIP Connected Audio configurations applied on the master account and enable those configurations on a sub account. The owner can also disable the configuration in the sub account where it was previously enabled. 
**Prerequisites:**<br>
* Pro or a higher account with SIP Connected Audio plan enabled.
* master account Owner<br>
**Scopes:** `sip_trunk:master`<br> 

 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Light`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "enable": true,
  "show_callout_internal_number": true,
  "show_zoom_provided_callout_countries": 0,
  "show_zoom_provided_numbers": 0
}
```

<h3 id="assign-sip-trunk-configuration-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|accountId|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» enable|body|boolean|false|Enable or delete the configuration.<br> The values can be one of the following:<br> `true`: Enable configuration.<br> `false`: Delete configuration|
|» show_callout_internal_number|body|boolean|false|If the value of this option is set to `true`, the call-out numbers provided by the Zoom carrier partners will be displayed in the account's list of available call-out numbers in the Zoom Web Portal and Zoom Client.|
|» show_zoom_provided_callout_countries|body|integer|false|If the value of this option is set to `0`, the call-out countries list provided by Zoom will be [displayed](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/200942859-Using-telephone-call-out) in the account's list of available call-out countries. <br><br>If the value of this option is set to `1`, the Zoom provided call-out countries will be hidden from the user's account.<br> <br><br>If the value of this option is set to `2`, all Zoom provided countries will be deleted and only internal countries (provided by carrier partners) will be used.|
|» show_zoom_provided_numbers|body|integer|false|If the value of this option is set to `0`, the numbers provided by Zoom will be displayed in the account's list of available call-out and call-in numbers in the Zoom Web Portal and Zoom Client. <br><br>If the value of this option is set to `1`, the Zoom provided numbers will be shown in the Zoom Web Portal but will not be used unless specified by the user.<br> <br><br>If the value of this option is set to `2`, all Zoom provided numbers will be deleted and only internal numbers (provided by carrier partners) will be used.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» show_zoom_provided_numbers|0|
|» show_zoom_provided_numbers|1|
|» show_zoom_provided_numbers|2|

> Example responses

> 204 Response

```json
null
```

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|204|No Content|**HTTP Status Code:** `204` **No Content**<br><br>Configuration assigned successfully.<br>|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400` **Bad Request**<br><br>**Error Code:** `2100`<br><br>This sub account has no sip trunk plan.|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404` **Not Found**<br><br><br>**Error Code:** `2001`<br><br>This account does not exist or does not belong to this master account.<br><br>This account does not exist or does not belong to you.|None|

## List SIP trunks

<a id="opIdlistSIPTrunks"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/accounts/string/sip_trunk/trunks \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /accounts/{accountId}/sip_trunk/trunks`

With SIP-connected audio, Zoom establishes a SIP trunk (a network connection specifically designed to make and deliver phone calls) over a direct and private connection between the customer’s network and the Zoom cloud. Meeting participants that dial into a meeting or have the meeting call them, and are On-Net from the perspective of the customers’ IP telephony network, will be connected over this trunk rather than over the PSTN.<br><br>
Use this API to list all the SIP trunks assigned to a master account or a sub account of the master account. To retrieve SIP trunks assigned to a sub account, provide the account ID of the sub account in the `accountId` path parameter. To retrieve SIP trunks of a master account, provide `me` as the value of the `accountId` path parameter. <br><br> **Scope:** `sip_trunk:read:admin`
<br><b>Prerequisites:</b><br>
* The account must either be a master account or a sub account with [API Partner Plan](https://zoom.us/plan/api) and SIP Connected Audio Plan.

<h3 id="list-sip-trunks-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|accountId|path|string|true|Unique Identifier of the Account. To retrieve SIP trunks assigned to a sub account, provide the account ID of the sub account in the as the value of this field. To retrieve SIP trunks of a master account, provide `me` as the value of this field.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "sip_trunks": [
    {
      "dnis": "90001258",
      "id": "268",
      "name": "test1",
      "number_prefix": "0",
      "sip_server_address": "111.111.1.1"
    },
    {
      "dnis": "80001748",
      "id": "281",
      "name": "test2",
      "number_prefix": "0",
      "sip_server_address": "111.111.1.34"
    }
  ],
  "total_records": 1
}
```

<h3 id="list-sip-trunks-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** `200` **OK**<br><br>List of SIP Trunks returned.|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400` **Bad Request**<br><br>**Error Code:** `300`<br> Request failed because this account is not enrolled in SIP Connected Audio plan.<br><br>|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404` **Not Found**<br><br>**Error Code:** `2001`<br> Account does not exist: {0}.<br><br>|None|

<h3 id="list-sip-trunks-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|sip_trunks|[object]|false|none|none|
|» dnis|string|false|none|DNIS of the SIP trunk.|
|» id|string|false|none|Unique identifier of the sip trunk.|
|» name|string|false|none|Name assigned to the SIP trunk.|
|» number_prefix|string|false|none|Prefix of the SIP Connected Audio phone number.|
|» outbound_caller_id|string|false|none|Outbound caller Id assigned to the trunk.|
|» sip_server_address|string|false|none|IP address or domain of the SIP trunk.|
|total_records|integer|false|none|Total number of records returned. |

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

## Assign SIP trunks

<a id="opIdassignSIPTrunks"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/accounts/string/sip_trunk/trunks \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "sip_trunks": [
      {
        "dnis": "string",
        "id": "string",
        "outbound_caller_id": "string"
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /accounts/{accountId}/sip_trunk/trunks`

With SIP-connected audio, Zoom establishes a SIP trunk (a network connection specifically designed to make and deliver phone calls) over a direct and private connection between the customer’s network and the Zoom cloud. Meeting participants that dial into a meeting or have the meeting call them, and are On-Net from the perspective of the customers’ IP telephony network, will be connected over this trunk rather than over the PSTN.<br><br>Use this API to assign SIP trunk(s) that are available on a master account to a sub account. <br><b>Prerequisites:</b><br>
* The account making this API request must be a master account with [API Partner Plan](https://zoom.us/plan/api) and SIP Connected Audio Plan.<br><br>
**Scope:** `sip_trunk:master`

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "sip_trunks": [
    {
      "dnis": "string",
      "id": "string",
      "outbound_caller_id": "string"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="assign-sip-trunks-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|accountId|path|string|true|Unique Identifier of the sub account.|
|body|body|object|false|none|
|» sip_trunks|body|[object]|false|Array of one or more SIP Trunk objects. |
|» » dnis|body|string|false|DNIS of the sub account. The prefix of the DNIS (i.e. the first five digits of the DNIS value) must match the DNIS prefix of the master account. To retrieve the DNIS prefix of a master account's SIP Trunk, use the List SIP Trunks API and refer to the first five digits in the `dnis` value. <br><br>For example, if the DNIS of the master account is 1888812345, the DNIS of the sub account must comprise of "18888" + "random_number". The maximum allowed length of the DNIS is 8.|
|» » id|body|string|false|Unique identifier of the SIP trunk that will be assigned to the sub account. The value of this field can be retrieved by listing the SIP Trunks of a master account using List SIP Trunks API.|
|» » outbound_caller_id|body|string|false|Assign an outbound caller Id to the trunk.|

> Example responses

> 201 Response

```json
{
  "sip_trunks": [
    {
      "dnis": "dolore43tr4u",
      "id": "represdf324fe",
      "name": "HQ-trunk",
      "number_prefix": "0",
      "sip_server_address": "1.11.123.123"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="assign-sip-trunks-1-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|201|Created|**HTTP Status Code:** `204` **No Content**<br><br>SIP Trunk assigned successfully.|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400` **Bad Request**<br><br>**Error Code:** `300`<br> <br>* Request failed because this account is not enrolled in SIP Connected Audio plan.<br><br>* The master account has no sip trunk configs.<br><br>* Invalid parameter: sip_trunks.<br><br><br>|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404` **Not Found**<br><br>**Error Code:** `2001`<br> Account does not exist: {0}.<br><br><br>|None|

<h3 id="assign-sip-trunks-1-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **201**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|sip_trunks|[object]|false|none|none|
|» dnis|string|false|none|DNIS - identifier for the SIP trunk enabled account.|
|» id|string|false|none|Unique identifier of the SIP trunk.|
|» name|string|false|none|Name of the SIP trunk.|
|» number_prefix|string|false|none|If the value of this field is `"0"`, it means that all the calls will be routed through this special line. All other values indicate the prefix of the phone number.|
|» sip_server_address|string|false|none|IP Address or domain of the SIP trunk.|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

## List past meeting's files

<a id="opIdlistPastMeetingFiles"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/past_meetings/0/files \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /past_meetings/{meetingId}/files`

**Note: This API has been deprecated and is no longer supported due to GCM encryption updates for security purposes.** To learn about saving the in-meeting chat files via Zoom Client, refer to the [Saving in-meeting chat](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/115004792763-Saving-in-meeting-chat) guide.

List files sent via in-meeting chat during a meeting. The in-meeting files are deleted after 24 hours of the meeting completion time. 
<br><br>
**Scope:** `meeting:read`, `meeting:read:admin`<br>

 **[Rate Limit Label](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/rate-limits#rate-limits):** `Medium` 

<h3 id="list-past-meetings-files-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|meetingId|path|integer(int64)|true|The meeting ID in **long** format. The data type of this field is "long"(represented as int64 in JSON).<br><br>While storing it in your database, store it as a **long** data type and **not as an integer**, as the Meeting IDs can be longer than 10 digits.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "in_meeting_files": [
    {
      "download_url": "somefile.txt/randomurl",
      "file_name": "somefile.txt",
      "file_size": 300
    }
  ],
  "total_records": 1
}
```

<h3 id="list-past-meetings-files-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|**HTTP Status Code:** `200` **OK**<br><br>Files retrieved successfully.|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|**HTTP Status Code:** `400`<br><br>**Error Code:** `1010`<br><br>User does not belong to this account: {accountId}.|None|
|404|Not Found|**HTTP Status Code:** `404` **Not Found**<br><br>**Error Code:** `3001`<br><br>Meeting ID is invalid or not end.|None|

<h3 id="list-past-meetings-files-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|in_meeting_files|[object]|false|none|none|
|» download_url|string|false|none|URL to download the file.|
|» file_name|string|false|none|Name of the file.|
|» file_size|integer|false|none|Size of the file in bytes.|
|total_records|integer|false|none|The total number of files found.|

To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth
</aside>

### Properties

|---|---|---|---|---|
|billing_auto_renew|boolean|false|none|Toggle whether automatic billing renewal is on or off.|
|meeting_connector_list|[string]|false|none|Specify the IP addresses of the Meeting Connectors that you would like to share with the sub account. Multiple values can be separated by comma. If no value is provided in this field, all the Meeting Connectors of a master account will be shared with the sub account.<br><br><br>**Note:** This option can only be used if the value of `share_mc` is set to `true`.|

If no value is provided in this field, all the Room Connectors of a master account will be shared with the sub account.<br><br><br>**Note:** This option can only be used if the value of `share_rc` is set to `true`.|
|share_mc|boolean|false|none|Enable/disable the option for a sub account to use shared [Meeting Connector(s)](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/201363093-Getting-Started-with-the-Meeting-Connector) that are set up by the master account. Meeting Connectors can only be used by On-prem users.|
|share_rc|boolean|false|none|Enable/disable the option for a sub account to use shared [Virtual Room Connector(s)](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/202134758-Getting-Started-With-Virtual-Room-Connector) that are set up by the master account. Virtual Room Connectors can only be used by On-prem users.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|pay_mode|master|
|pay_mode|sub|

Account Settings: In Meeting.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|alert_guest_join|boolean|false|none|Identify guest participants in a meeting or webinar.|
|allow_live_streaming|boolean|false|none|Allow live streaming.|
|allow_participants_to_rename|boolean|false|none|If the value of this field is set to `true`, meeting participants and webinar panelists can be allowed to rename themselves during a meeting or a webinar.<br>|
|allow_show_zoom_windows|boolean|false|none|Show the Zoom desktop application when sharing screens. |
|annotation|boolean|false|none|Allow participants to use annotation tools to add information to shared screens.|
|anonymous_question_answer|boolean|false|none|Allow an anonymous Q&A in a webinar.|
|attendee_on_hold|boolean|false|none|Allow host to put attendee on hold.<br><br>**This field has been deprecated and is no longer supported.**|
|auto_answer|boolean|false|none|Enable users to see and add contacts to the "auto-answer group" in the chat contact list. Any call from members of this group will automatically be answered.|
|auto_saving_chat|boolean|false|none|Automatically save all in-meeting chats so that the host does not need to manually save the chat transcript after the meeting starts.|
|breakout_room|boolean|false|none|Allow host to split meeting participants into separate, smaller rooms.|
|chat|boolean|false|none|Allow meeting participants to send a message that is visible to all participants.|
|closed_caption|boolean|false|none|Allow a host to type closed captions. Enable a host to assign a participant or third party device to add closed captions. |
|co_host|boolean|false|none|Allow the host to add co-hosts.|
|custom_data_center_regions|boolean|false|none|If set to `true`, account owners and admins on paid accounts can [select data center regions](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360042411451-Selecting-data-center-regions-for-hosted-meetings-and-webinars) to use for hosting their real-time meeting and webinar traffic. These regions can be provided in the `data_center_regions` field. If set to `false`, the regions cannot be customized and the default regions will be used.|
|custom_live_streaming_service|boolean|false|none|Custom live streaming.|
|custom_service_instructions|string|false|none|Custom service instructions.|
|data_center_regions|[string]|false|none|If you have set the value of `custom_data_center_regions` to `true`, specify the data center regions that you would like to opt in to (country codes from among: ["EU", "HK", "AU", "IN", "LA", "TY", "CN", "US", "CA"]).<br>|
|dscp_audio|integer|false|none|DSCP audio.|
|dscp_marking|boolean|false|none|DSCP marking.|
|dscp_video|integer|false|none|DSCP video.|
|e2e_encryption|boolean|false|none|Zoom requires encryption for all data between the Zoom cloud, Zoom client, and Zoom Room. Require encryption for 3rd party endpoints (H323/SIP).|
|entry_exit_chime|string|false|none|Play sound when participants join or leave.<br>`host` - Heard by host only.<br>`all` - Heard by host and all attendees.<br>`none` - Disable.|
|far_end_camera_control|boolean|false|none|Allow another user to take control of your camera during a meeting.|
|feedback|boolean|false|none|Add a "Feedback" tab to the Windows Settings or Mac Preferences dialog. Enable users to provide feedback to Zoom at the end of the meeting.|
|file_transfer|boolean|false|none|Indicates whether [in-meeting file transfer](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/209605493-In-meeting-file-transfer) setting has been enabled on the account or not.|
|group_hd|boolean|false|none|Activate higher quality video for host and participants.<br>Please note: This will use more bandwidth.|
|meeting_reactions|boolean|false|none|Enable or disable meeting reactions. <br><br>`true`: Allow meeting participants to communicate without interrupting by reacting with an emoji that shows on their video.<br><br>`false`: Do not enable meeting reactions.|
|original_audio|boolean|false|none|Allow users to select original sound in their client settings.|
|p2p_connetion|boolean|false|none|Peer to peer connection while only two people are in a meeting.|
|p2p_ports|boolean|false|none|Peer to peer listening ports range.|
|polling|boolean|false|none|Add "Polls" to the meeting controls.|
|ports_range|string|false|none|The listening ports range, separated by a comma (ex 55,56). The ports range must be between 1 to 65535.|
|post_meeting_feedback|boolean|false|none|Display a thumbs up or down survey at the end of each meeting.|
|private_chat|boolean|false|none|Allow a meeting participant to send a private message to another participant.|
|record_play_own_voice|boolean|false|none|Record and play their own voice.|
|remote_control|boolean|false|none|Allow users to request remote control.|

|show_meeting_control_toolbar|boolean|false|none|Always show the meeting control toolbar.|

|virtual_background|boolean|false|none|Allow users to replace their background with any selected image. Choose or upload an image in the Zoom desktop application settings.|

The value can be one of the following: <br><br>`host`: Only host can share the screen.<br><br>`all`: Both hosts and attendees can share their screen during meetings. For Webinar, the hosts and panelists can start screen sharing, but not the attendees.<br>|

The value can be one of the following:<br><br>`host`: Only a host can share the screen when someone else is sharing.<br><br>`all`: Anyone in the meeting is allowed to start sharing their screen when someone else is sharing. For Webinar, the hosts and panelists can start screen sharing, but not the attendees.<br>|

Account Settings: Recording.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_user_access_recording|boolean|false|none|Cloud recordings are only accessible to account members. People outside of your organization cannot open links that provide access to cloud recordings.|
|allow_recovery_deleted_cloud_recordings|boolean|false|none|Allow recovery of deleted cloud recordings from trash. <br>If the value of this field is set to `true`, deleted cloud recordings will be kept in trash for 30 days after deletion and can be recovered within that period. |
|archive|object|false|none|[Archiving solution](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360050431572-Archiving-Meeting-and-Webinar-data) settings. This setting can only be used if you have been granted with archiving solution access by the Zoom support team.|
|auto_delete_cmr|boolean|false|none|Allow Zoom to permanantly delete recordings automatically after a specified number of days.|
|auto_delete_cmr_days|integer|false|none|When `auto_delete_cmr` function is 'true' this value will set the number of days before the auto deletion of cloud recordings.|
|auto_recording|string|false|none|Automatic recording:<br>`local` - Record on local.<br>`cloud` -  Record on cloud.<br>`none` - Disabled.|
|cloud_recording|boolean|false|none|Allow hosts to record and save the meeting in the cloud.|
|cloud_recording_download|boolean|false|none|Cloud recording downloads.|
|cloud_recording_download_host|boolean|false|none|Only the host can download cloud recordings.|
|host_delete_cloud_recording|boolean|false|none|If the value of this field is set to `true`, hosts will be able to delete the recordings. If this option is set to `false`, the recordings cannot be deleted by the host and only admin can delete them.<br>|
|ip_address_access_control|object|false|none|Setting to allow cloud recording access only from specific IP address ranges.<br>|
|local_recording|boolean|false|none|Allow hosts and participants to record the meeting using a local file.|
|prevent_host_access_recording|boolean|false|none|If set to `true`, meeting hosts cannot view their meeting cloud recordings. Only the admins who have recording management privilege can access them.<br>|
|record_audio_file|boolean|false|none|Record an audio only file.|
|record_gallery_view|boolean|false|none|Record the gallery view with a shared screen.|
|record_speaker_view|boolean|false|none|Record the active speaker with a shared screen.|
|recording_audio_transcript|boolean|false|none|Automatically transcribe the audio of the meeting or webinar to the cloud.|
|recording_disclaimer|boolean|false|none|Show a disclaimer to participants before a recording starts<br>|
|recording_password_requirement|object|false|none|This object represents the minimum password requirements set for recordings via Account Recording Settings.|
|required_password_for_existing_cloud_recordings|boolean|false|none|Require a passcode to access existing cloud recordings.|
|save_chat_text|boolean|false|none|Save the chat text from the meeting.|
|show_timestamp|boolean|false|none|Add a timestamp to the recording.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|auto_recording|local|
|auto_recording|cloud|
|auto_recording|none|

Account Settings: Schedule Meeting.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|audio_type|string|false|none|Determine how participants can join the audio portion of the meeting.<br>`both` - Telephony and VoIP.<br>`telephony` - Audio PSTN telephony only.<br>`voip` - VoIP only.<br>`thirdParty` - 3rd party audio conference.|
|enforce_login|boolean|false|none|Only Zoom users who are signed in can join meetings.|
|enforce_login_domains|string|false|none|Only signed in users with a specified domain can join the meeting. |
|enforce_login_with_domains|boolean|false|none|Only signed in users with a specific domain can join meetings.|
|force_pmi_jbh_password|boolean|false|none|Require a password for Personal Meetings if attendees can join before host.|
|host_video|boolean|false|none|Start meetings with the host video on.|
|join_before_host|boolean|false|none|Allow participants to join the meeting before the host arrives.|
|meeting_password_requirement|object|false|none|Account wide meeting/webinar [password requirements](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360033559832-Meeting-and-webinar-passwords#h_a427384b-e383-4f80-864d-794bf0a37604).|
|not_store_meeting_topic|boolean|false|none|Always display "Zoom Meeting" as the meeting topic.|
|participant_video|boolean|false|none|Start meetings with the participant video on. Participants can change this setting during the meeting.|
|personal_meeting|boolean|false|none|Personal Meeting Setting.<br><br><br>`true`: Indicates that the **"Enable Personal Meeting ID"** setting is turned on. Users can choose to use personal meeting ID for their meetings. <br><br><br>`false`: Indicates that the **"Enable Personal Meeting ID"** setting is [turned off](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/201362843-Personal-meeting-ID-PMI-and-personal-link#h_aa0335c8-3b06-41bc-bc1f-a8b84ef17f2a). If this setting is disabled, meetings that were scheduled with PMI will be invalid. Scheduled meetings will need to be manually updated.<br>For Zoom Phone only:If a user has been assigned a desk phone, **"Elevate to Zoom Meeting"** on desk phone will be disabled.<br><br><br>|
|require_password_for_instant_meetings|boolean|false|none|Require a password for instant meetings. If you use PMI for your instant meetings, this option will be disabled. This setting is always enabled for free accounts and Pro accounts with a single host and cannot be modified for these accounts.<br>|
|require_password_for_pmi_meetings|string|false|none|Require a password for a meeting held using Personal Meeting ID (PMI) This setting is always enabled for free accounts and Pro accounts with a single host and cannot be modified for these accounts.<br>|
|require_password_for_scheduled_meetings|boolean|false|none|Require a password for meetings which have already been scheduled<br>|
|require_password_for_scheduling_new_meetings|boolean|false|none|Require a password when scheduling new meetings. This setting applies for regular meetings that do not use PMI. If enabled, a password will be generated while a host schedules a new meeting and participants will be required to enter the password before they can join the meeting. This setting is always enabled for free accounts and Pro accounts with a single host and cannot be modified for these accounts.|
|use_pmi_for_instant_meetings|boolean|false|none|Use Personal Meeting ID (PMI) when starting an instant meeting<br>|
|use_pmi_for_scheduled_meetings|boolean|false|none|Use Personal Meeting ID (PMI) when scheduling a meeting<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|audio_type|both|
|audio_type|telephony|
|audio_type|voip|
|audio_type|thirdParty|
|require_password_for_pmi_meetings|jbh_only|
|require_password_for_pmi_meetings|all|
|require_password_for_pmi_meetings|none|

```json
    "minimum_password_length": 8,
    "weak_enhance_detection": true
  },
  "sign_again_period_for_inactivity_on_client": 0,
  "sign_again_period_for_inactivity_on_web": 0,
  "sign_in_with_two_factor_auth": "all",
  "sign_in_with_two_factor_auth_groups": [
    "string"
  ],
  "sign_in_with_two_factor_auth_roles": [
    "string"
  ]
}
```

[Security settings](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360034675592-Advanced-security-settings#h_bf8a25f6-9a66-447a-befd-f02ed3404f89) of an Account.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|admin_change_name_pic|boolean|false|none|Only account administrators can change a user's username and picture.|
|hide_billing_info|boolean|false|none|Hide billing information.|
|import_photos_from_devices|boolean|false|none|Allow users to import photos from a photo library on a  device.|
|password_requirement|object|false|none|This object refers to the [enhanced password rules](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360034675592-Advanced-security-settings#h_bf8a25f6-9a66-447a-befd-f02ed3404f89) that allows Zoom account admins and owners to apply extra requiremets to the users' Zoom login password. |
|sign_again_period_for_inactivity_on_client|integer|false|none|Settings for User Sign In interval requirements after a period of inactivity. If enabled, this setting forces automatic logout of users in Zoom Client app after a set amount of time. <br><br><br>If this setting is disabled, the value of this field will be `0`. If the setting is enabled, the value of this field will indicate the **period of inactivity** in minutes after which, an inactive user will be automatically logged out of the Zoom Client. The value for the period of inactivity can be one of the following:<br><br><br>`5`: 5 minutes<br><br>`10`: 10 minutes<br><br>`15`: 15 minutes<br><br>`30`: 30 minutes<br><br>`45`: 45 minutes<br><br>`60`: 60 minutes<br><br>`90`: 90 minutes<br><br>`120`: 120 minutes<br>|
|sign_again_period_for_inactivity_on_web|integer|false|none|Settings for User Sign In interval requirements after a period of inactivity. If enabled, this setting forces automatic logout of users in Zoom Web Portal after a set amount of time. <br><br><br>If this setting is disabled, the value of this field will be `0`. If the setting is enabled, the value of this field will indicate the **period of inactivity** in minutes after which, an inactive user will be automatically logged out of the Zoom Web Portal. The value for the period of inactivity can be one of the following:<br><br><br>`5`: 5 minutes<br><br>`10`: 10 minutes<br><br>`15`: 15 minutes<br><br>`30`: 30 minutes<br><br>`60`: 60 minutes<br><br>`120`: 120 minutes<br><br>    <br><br>|
|sign_in_with_two_factor_auth|string|false|none|Settings for 2FA( [two factor authentication](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360038247071) ). The value can be one of the following:<br>`all`: Two factor authentication will be enabled for all users in the account.<br><br>`none`: Two factor authentication is disabled.<br><br>`group`: Two factor authentication will be enabled for users belonging to specific groups. If 2FA is enabled for certain groups, the group IDs of the group(s) will be provided in the `sign_in_with_two_factor_auth_groups` field.<br><br>`role`: Two factor authentication will be enabled only for users assigned with specific roles in the account. If 2FA is enabled for specific roles, the role IDs will be provided in the<br>`sign_in_with_two_factor_auth_roles` field.<br>|
|sign_in_with_two_factor_auth_groups|[string]|false|none|This field contains group IDs of groups that have 2FA enabled. This field is only returned if the value of `sign_in_with_two_factor_auth` is `group`|
|sign_in_with_two_factor_auth_roles|[string]|false|none|This field contains role IDs of roles that have 2FA enabled. This field is only returned if the value of `sign_in_with_two_factor_auth` is `role`.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|sign_in_with_two_factor_auth|all|
|sign_in_with_two_factor_auth|group|
|sign_in_with_two_factor_auth|role|
|sign_in_with_two_factor_auth|none|

Create Webinar settings.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|allow_multiple_devices|boolean|false|none|Allow attendees to join from multiple devices.|
|alternative_hosts|string|false|none|Alternative host emails or IDs. Multiple values separated by comma.|
|approval_type|integer|false|none|The default value is `2`. To enable registration required, set the approval type to `0` or `1`.  Values include:<br><br><br>`0` - Automatically approve.<br>`1` - Manually approve.<br>`2` - No registration required.|
|attendees_and_panelists_reminder_email_notification|object|false|none|Send reminder email to attendees and panelists.|
|audio|string|false|none|Determine how participants can join the audio portion of the meeting.|
|authentication_domains|string|false|none|Meeting authentication domains. This option, allows you to specify the rule so that Zoom users, whose email address contains a certain domain, can join the Webinar. You can either provide multiple domains, using a comma in between and/or use a wildcard for listing domains.|
|authentication_option|string|false|none|Specify the authentication type for users to join a Webinar with`meeting_authentication` setting set to `true`. The value of this field can be retrieved from the `id` field within `authentication_options` array in the response of [Get User Settings API](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/users/usersettings).|
|auto_recording|string|false|none|Automatic recording:<br>`local` - Record on local.<br>`cloud` -  Record on cloud.<br>`none` - Disabled.|
|close_registration|boolean|false|none|Close registration after event date.|
|contact_email|string|false|none|Contact email for registration|
|contact_name|string|false|none|Contact name for registration|
|email_language|string|false|none|Set the email language to one of the following:<br>`en-US`,`de-DE`,`es-ES`,`fr-FR`,`jp-JP`,`pt-PT`,`ru-RU`,`zh-CN`, `zh-TW`, `ko-KO`, `it-IT`, `vi-VN`.|
|enforce_login|boolean|false|none|Only signed-in users can join this meeting. <br><br>**This field is deprecated and will not be supported in future.** <br><br> Instead of this field, use the "meeting_authentication", "authentication_option" and/or "authentication_domains" fields to establish the authentication mechanism for this Webinar. |
|enforce_login_domains|string|false|none|Only signed-in users with specified domains can join meetings.<br><br>**This field is deprecated and will not be supported in future.** <br><br> Instead of this field, use the "authentication_domains" field for this Webinar. |
|follow_up_absentees_email_notification|object|false|none|Send follow-up email to absentees.|
|follow_up_attendees_email_notification|object|false|none|Send follow-up email to attendees.|
|global_dial_in_countries|[string]|false|none|List of global dial-in countries|
|hd_video|boolean|false|none|Default to HD video.|
|host_video|boolean|false|none|Start video when host joins webinar.|
|meeting_authentication|boolean|false|none|Only [authenticated](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360037117472-Authentication-Profiles-for-Meetings-and-Webinars) users can join meeting if the value of this field is set to `true`.|
|on_demand|boolean|false|none|Make the webinar on-demand|
|panelists_invitation_email_notification|boolean|false|none|* `true`: Send invitation email to panelists.<br><br>* `false`: Do not send invitation email to panelists.|
|panelists_video|boolean|false|none|Start video when panelists join webinar.|
|post_webinar_survey|boolean|false|none|Zoom will open a survey page in attendees' browsers after leaving the webinar|
|practice_session|boolean|false|none|Enable practice session.|
|question_and_answer|object|false|none|[Q&A](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/203686015-Using-Q-A-as-the-webinar-host#:~:text=Overview,and%20upvote%20each%20other's%20questions.) for webinar.|
|registrants_email_notification|boolean|false|none|Send email notifications to registrants about approval, cancellation, denial of the registration. The value of this field must be set to true in order to use the `registrants_confirmation_email` field.|
|registrants_restrict_number|integer|false|none|Restrict number of registrants for a webinar. By default, it is set to `0`. A `0` value means that the restriction option is disabled. Provide a number higher than 0 to restrict the webinar registrants by the that number.|
|registration_type|integer|false|none|Registration types. Only used for recurring webinars with a fixed time.<br>`1` - Attendees register once and can attend any of the webinar sessions.<br>`2` - Attendees need to register for each session in order to attend.<br>`3` - Attendees register once and can choose one or more sessions to attend.|
|show_share_button|boolean|false|none|Show social share buttons on the registration page.|
|survey_url|string|false|none|Survey url for post webinar survey|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|agenda|string|false|none|Meeting description.|
|duration|integer|false|none|Meeting duration (minutes). Used for scheduled meetings only.|
|password|string|false|none|Passcode to join the meeting. By default, passcode may only contain the following characters: [a-z A-Z 0-9 @ - _ *] and can have a maximum of 10 characters.<br><br>**Note:** If the account owner or the admin has configured [minimum passcode requirement settings](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360033559832-Meeting-and-webinar-passwords#h_a427384b-e383-4f80-864d-794bf0a37604), the passcode value provided here must meet those requirements. <br><br>If the requirements are enabled, you can view those requirements by calling either the [Get User Settings API](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/users/usersettings) or the [Get Account Settings](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/accounts/accountsettings) API. |
|recurrence|object|false|none|Recurrence object. Use this object only for a meeting with type `8` i.e., a recurring meeting with fixed time. |
|schedule_for|string|false|none|If you would like to schedule this meeting for someone else in your account, provide the Zoom user id or email address of the user here.|
|settings|object|false|none|Meeting settings.|
|start_time|string(date-time)|false|none|Meeting start time. We support two formats for `start_time` - local time and GMT.<br> <br><br>To set time as GMT the format should be `yyyy-MM-dd`T`HH:mm:ssZ`. Example: "2020-03-31T12:02:00Z"<br><br>To set time using a specific timezone, use `yyyy-MM-dd`T`HH:mm:ss` format and specify the timezone [ID](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/other-references/abbreviation-lists#timezones) in the `timezone` field OR leave it blank and the timezone set on your Zoom account will be used. You can also set the time as UTC as the timezone field.<br><br>The `start_time` should only be used for scheduled and / or recurring webinars with fixed time.|
|template_id|string|false|none|Unique identifier of the **admin meeting template**. To create admin meeting templates, contact the Zoom support team.<br><br>Use this field if you would like to [schedule the meeting from a admin meeting template](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360036559151-Meeting-templates#h_86f06cff-0852-4998-81c5-c83663c176fb). You can retrieve the value of this field by calling the [List meeting templates](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/meetings/listmeetingtemplates) API.|
|timezone|string|false|none|Time zone to format start_time. For example, "America/Los_Angeles". For scheduled meetings only. Please reference our [time zone](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/other-references/abbreviation-lists#timezones) list for supported time zones and their formats.|
|topic|string|false|none|Meeting topic.|
|tracking_fields|[object]|false|none|Tracking fields|
|type|integer|false|none|Meeting Type:<br>`1` - Instant meeting.<br>`2` - Scheduled meeting.<br>`3` - Recurring meeting with no fixed time.<br>`8` - Recurring meeting with fixed time.|

|---|---|

|type|2|
|type|3|
|type|8|

Meeting object.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|agenda|string|false|none|Meeting description|
