|h323_password|string|false|none|H.323/SIP room system passcode.|
|join_url|string|false|none|URL for participants to join the meeting. This URL should only be shared with users that you would like to invite for the meeting.|
|occurrences|[object]|false|none|Array of occurrence objects.|
|password|string|false|none|Meeting passcode.|
|pmi|integer(int64)|false|none|Personal Meeting Id. Only used for scheduled meetings and recurring meetings with no fixed time.|
|recurrence|object|false|none|Recurrence object. Use this object only for a meeting with type `8` i.e., a recurring meeting with fixed time. |
|settings|object|false|none|Meeting settings.|
|start_time|string(date-time)|false|none|Meeting start time in GMT/UTC. Start time will not be returned if the meeting is an **instant** meeting. <br>|
|start_url|string|false|none|<br><aside>The <code>start_url</code> of a Meeting is a URL using which a host or an alternative host can start the Meeting. <br><br>The expiration time for the <code>start_url</code> field listed in the response of [Create a Meeting API](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/meetings/meetingcreate) is two hours for all regular users. <br>	<br>For users created using the <code>custCreate</code> option via the [Create Users](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/users/usercreate) API, the expiration time of the <code>start_url</code> field is 90 days.<br>	<br>For security reasons, to retrieve the updated value for the <code>start_url</code> field programmatically (after the expiry time), you must call the [Retrieve a Meeting API](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/meetings/meeting) and refer to the value of the <code>start_url</code> field in the response.</aside><br>This URL should only be used by the host of the meeting and **should not be shared with anyone other than the host** of the meeting as anyone with this URL will be able to login to the Zoom Client as the host of the meeting.|
|status|string|false|none|Meeting status|
|timezone|string|false|none|Timezone to format the meeting start time on the .|
|topic|string|false|none|Meeting topic.|
|tracking_fields|[object]|false|none|Tracking fields|
|type|integer|false|none|Meeting Types:<br>`1` - Instant meeting.<br>`2` - Scheduled meeting.<br>`3` - Recurring meeting with no fixed time.<br>`4` - PMI Meeting<br><br>`8` - Recurring meeting with a fixed time.|

Meeting settings.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|allow_multiple_devices|boolean|false|none|Allow attendees to join the meeting from multiple devices. This setting only works for meetings that require [registration](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/211579443-Setting-up-registration-for-a-meeting).|
|alternative_hosts|string|false|none|Alternative host's emails or IDs: multiple values are separated by a semicolon.|
|alternative_hosts_email_notification|boolean|false|none|Flag to determine whether to send email notifications to alternative hosts, default value is true.|
|approval_type|integer|false|none|Enable registration and set approval for the registration. Note that this feature requires the host to be of **Licensed** user type. **Registration cannot be enabled for a basic user.** <br><br><br><br>`0` - Automatically approve.<br>`1` - Manually approve.<br>`2` - No registration required.|
|approved_or_denied_countries_or_regions|object|false|none|Approve or block users from specific regions/countries from joining this meeting. <br>|
|audio|string|false|none|Determine how participants can join the audio portion of the meeting.<br>`both` - Both Telephony and VoIP.<br>`telephony` - Telephony only.<br>`voip` - VoIP only.|
|authentication_domains|string|false|none|If user has configured ["Sign Into Zoom with Specified Domains"](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360037117472-Authentication-Profiles-for-Meetings-and-Webinars#h_5c0df2e1-cfd2-469f-bb4a-c77d7c0cca6f) option, this will list the domains that are authenticated.|
|authentication_exception|[object]|false|none|The participants added here will receive unique meeting invite links and bypass authentication.|
|authentication_name|string|false|none|Authentication name set in the [authentication profile](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360037117472-Authentication-Profiles-for-Meetings-and-Webinars#h_5c0df2e1-cfd2-469f-bb4a-c77d7c0cca6f).|
|authentication_option|string|false|none|Meeting authentication option id.|
|auto_recording|string|false|none|Automatic recording:<br>`local` - Record on local.<br>`cloud` -  Record on cloud.<br>`none` - Disabled.|
|breakout_room|object|false|none|Setting to [pre-assign breakout rooms](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360032752671-Pre-assigning-participants-to-breakout-rooms#h_36f71353-4190-48a2-b999-ca129861c1f4).|
|close_registration|boolean|false|none|Close registration after event date|
|cn_meeting|boolean|false|none|Host meeting in China.|
|contact_email|string|false|none|Contact email for registration|
|contact_name|string|false|none|Contact name for registration|
|custom_keys|[object]|false|none|Custom keys and values assigned to the meeting.|
|encryption_type|string|false|none|Choose between enhanced encryption and [end-to-end encryption](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360048660871) when starting or a meeting. When using end-to-end encryption, several features (e.g. cloud recording, phone/SIP/H.323 dial-in) will be **automatically disabled**. <br><br>The value of this field can be one of the following:<br><br>`enhanced_encryption`: Enhanced encryption. Encryption is stored in the cloud if you enable this option. <br><br><br>`e2ee`: [End-to-end encryption](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360048660871). The encryption key is stored in your local device and can not be obtained by anyone else. Enabling this setting also **disables** the following features: join before host, cloud recording, streaming, live transcription, breakout rooms, polling, 1:1 private chat, and meeting reactions.|
|enforce_login|boolean|false|none|Only signed in users can join this meeting.<br><br>**This field is deprecated and will not be supported in the future.**  <br><br>As an alternative, use the "meeting_authentication", "authentication_option" and "authentication_domains" fields to understand the [authentication configurations](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360037117472-Authentication-Profiles-for-Meetings-and-Webinars) set for the meeting.|
|enforce_login_domains|string|false|none|Only signed in users with specified domains can join meetings.<br><br>**This field is deprecated and will not be supported in the future.**  <br><br>As an alternative, use the "meeting_authentication", "authentication_option" and "authentication_domains" fields to understand the [authentication configurations](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360037117472-Authentication-Profiles-for-Meetings-and-Webinars) set for the meeting.|
|global_dial_in_countries|[string]|false|none|List of global dial-in countries|
|global_dial_in_numbers|[object]|false|none|Global Dial-in Countries/Regions|
|host_video|boolean|false|none|Start video when the host joins the meeting.|
|in_meeting|boolean|false|none|Host meeting in India.|
|jbh_time|integer|false|none|If the value of "join_before_host" field is set to true, this field can be used to indicate time limits within which a participant may join a meeting before a host. The value of this field can be one of the following:<br><br>*  `0`: Allow participant to join anytime.<br>*  `5`: Allow participant to join 5 minutes before meeting start time.<br> * `10`: Allow participant to join 10 minutes before meeting start time.|
|join_before_host|boolean|false|none|Allow participants to join the meeting before the host starts the meeting. Only used for scheduled or recurring meetings.|
|language_interpretation|object|false|none|none|
|meeting_authentication|boolean|false|none|`true`- Only authenticated users can join meetings.|
|mute_upon_entry|boolean|false|none|Mute participants upon entry.|
|participant_video|boolean|false|none|Start video when participants join the meeting.|
|registrants_confirmation_email|boolean|false|none|Send confirmation email to registrants upon successful registration.|
|registrants_email_notification|boolean|false|none|Send email notifications to registrants about approval, cancellation, denial of the registration. The value of this field must be set to true in order to use the `registrants_confirmation_email` field.|

Used for recurring meeting with fixed time only. <br>`1` Attendees register once and can attend any of the occurrences.<br>`2` Attendees need to register for each occurrence to attend.<br>`3` Attendees register once and can choose one or more occurrences to attend.|
|show_share_button|boolean|false|none|Show social share buttons on the meeting registration page.<br>This setting only works for meetings that require [registration](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/211579443-Setting-up-registration-for-a-meeting).|

|recurrence|object|false|none|Recurrence object. Use this object only for a meeting with type `8` i.e., a recurring meeting with fixed time. |
|settings|object|false|none|none|

|template_id|string|false|none|Unique identifier of the meeting template. <br><br>Use this field if you would like to [schedule the meeting from a meeting template](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360036559151-Meeting-templates#h_86f06cff-0852-4998-81c5-c83663c176fb). You can retrieve the value of this field by calling the [List meeting templates]() API.|
|timezone|string|false|none|Time zone to format start_time. For example, "America/Los_Angeles". For scheduled meetings only. Please reference our [time zone](#timezones) list for supported time zones and their formats.|
|topic|string|false|none|Meeting topic.|
|tracking_fields|[object]|false|none|Tracking fields|
|type|integer|false|none|Meeting Types:<br>`1` - Instant meeting.<br>`2` - Scheduled meeting.<br>`3` - Recurring meeting with no fixed time.<br>`8` - Recurring meeting with a fixed time.|

Recording file object.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|deleted_time|string|false|none|The time at which recording was deleted. Returned in the response only for trash query.|
|download_url|string|false|none|The URL using which the recording file can be downloaded. **To access a private or password protected cloud recording of a user in your account, you can use a [Zoom JWT App Type](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/guides/getting-started/app-types/create-jwt-app). Use the generated JWT token as the value of the `access_token` query parameter and include this query parameter at the end of the URL as shown in the example.**  <br><br><br>Example: `https://api.zoom.us/recording/download/{{ Download Path }}?access_token={{ JWT Token }}`<br><br>**Similarly, if the user has installed your OAuth app that contains recording scope(s), you can also use the user's [OAuth access token](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/guides/auth/oauth) to download the Cloud Recording.**<br><br><br>Example: `https://api.zoom.us/recording/download/{{ Download Path }}?access_token={{ OAuth Access Token }}`<br><br>|
|file_size|number|false|none|The recording file size.|
|file_type|string|false|none|The recording file type. The value of this field could be one of the following:<br><br>`MP4`: Video file of the recording.<br>`M4A` Audio-only file of the recording.<br>`TIMELINE`: Timestamp file of the recording in JSON file format. To get a timeline file, the "Add a timestamp to the recording" setting must be enabled in the [recording settings](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/203741855-Cloud-recording#h_3f14c3a4-d16b-4a3c-bbe5-ef7d24500048). The time will display in the host's timezone, set on their Zoom profile.<br><br> `TRANSCRIPT`: Transcription file of the recording in VTT format.<br> `CHAT`: A TXT file containing in-meeting chat messages that were sent during the meeting.<br>`CC`: File containing closed captions of the recording in VTT file format.<br>`CSV`: File containing polling data in csv format.<br><br><br><br><br>A recording file object with file type of either `CC` or `TIMELINE` **does not have** the following properties:<br><br>	`id`, `status`, `file_size`, `recording_type`, and `play_url`.|
|id|string|false|none|The recording file ID. Included in the response of general query.|
|meeting_id|string|false|none|The meeting ID. |
|play_url|string|false|none|The URL using which a recording file can be played.|
|recording_end|string|false|none|The recording end time. Response in general query.|
|recording_start|string|false|none|The recording start time.|
|recording_type|string|false|none|The recording type. The value of this field can be one of the following:<br>`shared_screen_with_speaker_view(CC)`<br>`shared_screen_with_speaker_view`<br>`shared_screen_with_gallery_view`<br>`speaker_view`<br>`gallery_view`<br>`shared_screen`<br>`audio_only`<br>`audio_transcript`<br>`chat_file`<br>`active_speaker`<br>`poll`|
|status|string|false|none|The recording status.|

|---|---|
|status|completed|

|end_date_time|string(date-time)|false|none|Select the final date on which the meeting will recur before it is canceled. Should be in UTC time, such as 2017-11-25T12:00:00Z. (Cannot be used with "end_times".)|
|end_times|integer|false|none|Select how many times the meeting should recur before it is canceled. (Cannot be used with "end_date_time".)|
|monthly_day|integer|false|none|Use this field **only if you're scheduling a recurring meeting of type** `3` to state which day in a month, the meeting should recur. The value range is from 1 to 31.<br><br>For instance, if you would like the meeting to recur on 23rd of each month, provide `23` as the value of this field and `1` as the value of the `repeat_interval` field. Instead, if you would like the meeting to recur every three months, on 23rd of the month, change the value of the `repeat_interval` field to `3`.|
|monthly_week|integer|false|none|Use this field **only if you're scheduling a recurring meeting of type** `3` to state the week of the month when the meeting should recur. If you use this field, **you must also use the `monthly_week_day` field to state the day of the week when the meeting should recur.** <br>`-1` - Last week of the month.<br>`1` - First week of the month.<br>`2` - Second week of the month.<br>`3` - Third week of the month.<br>`4` - Fourth week of the month.|
|monthly_week_day|integer|false|none|Use this field **only if you're scheduling a recurring meeting of type** `3` to state a specific day in a week when the monthly meeting should recur. To use this field, you must also use the `monthly_week` field. <br><br><br>`1` - Sunday.<br>`2` - Monday.<br>`3` - Tuesday.<br>`4` -  Wednesday.<br>`5` - Thursday.<br>`6` - Friday.<br>`7` - Saturday.|
|repeat_interval|integer|false|none|Define the interval at which the meeting should recur. For instance, if you would like to schedule a meeting that recurs every two months, you must set the value of this field as `2` and the value of the `type` parameter as `3`. <br><br>For a daily meeting, the maximum interval you can set is `90` days. For a weekly meeting the maximum interval that you can set is  of `12` weeks. For a monthly meeting, there is a maximum of `3` months.<br><br>|
|type|integer|true|none|Recurrence meeting types:<br>`1` - Daily.<br>`2` - Weekly.<br>`3` - Monthly.|
|weekly_days|string|false|none|This field is required **if you're scheduling a recurring meeting of type** `2` to state which day(s) of the week the meeting should repeat. <br> <br> The value for this field could be a number between `1` to `7` in string format. For instance, if the meeting should recur on Sunday, provide `"1"` as the value of this field.<br><br> **Note:** If you would like the meeting to occur on multiple days of a week, you should provide comma separated values for this field. For instance, if the meeting should recur on Sundays and Tuesdays provide `"1,3"` as the value of this field.<br><br> <br>`1`  - Sunday. <br>`2` - Monday.<br>`3` - Tuesday.<br>`4` -  Wednesday.<br>`5` -  Thursday.<br>`6` - Friday.<br>`7` - Saturday.|

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|agenda|string|false|none|Webinar description.|
|duration|integer|false|none|Webinar duration (minutes). Used for scheduled webinars only.|
|password|string|false|none|Webinar Passcode. Passcode may only contain the following characters: [a-z A-Z 0-9 @ - _ *]. Max of 10 characters.|
|recurrence|object|false|none|Recurrence object. Use this object only for a webinar of type `9` i.e., a recurring webinar with fixed time. |
|settings|object|false|none|Webinar settings.|
|start_time|string(date-time)|false|none|Webinar start time. We support two formats for `start_time` - local time and GMT.<br> <br><br>To set time as GMT the format should be `yyyy-MM-dd`T`HH:mm:ssZ`.<br><br>To set time using a specific timezone, use `yyyy-MM-dd`T`HH:mm:ss` format and specify the timezone [ID](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/other-references/abbreviation-lists#timezones) in the `timezone` field OR leave it blank and the timezone set on your Zoom account will be used. You can also set the time as UTC as the timezone field.<br><br>The `start_time` should only be used for scheduled and / or recurring webinars with fixed time.|
|timezone|string|false|none|Time zone to format start_time. For example, "America/Los_Angeles". For scheduled meetings only. Please reference our [time zone](#timezones) list for supported time zones and their formats.|
|topic|string|false|none|Webinar topic.|
|tracking_fields|[object]|false|none|Tracking fields|
|type|integer|false|none|Webinar Types:<br>`5` - Webinar.<br>`6` - Recurring webinar with no fixed time.<br>`9` - Recurring webinar with a fixed time.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|5|
|type|6|
|type|9|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|agenda|string|false|none|Webinar description.|
|duration|integer|false|none|Webinar duration (minutes). Used for scheduled webinar only.|
|password|string|false|none|[Webinar passcode](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360033559832-Meeting-and-webinar-passwords). By default, passcode may only contain the following characters: [a-z A-Z 0-9 @ - _ * !] and can have a maximum of 10 characters.<br><br>**Note:** If the account owner or the admin has configured [minimum passcode requirement settings](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360033559832-Meeting-and-webinar-passwords#h_a427384b-e383-4f80-864d-794bf0a37604), the passcode value provided here must meet those requirements. <br><br>If the requirements are enabled, you can view those requirements by calling either the [Get User Settings API](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/users/usersettings) or the  [Get Account Settings](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/accounts/accountsettings) API. <br><br>If "**Require a passcode when scheduling new meetings**" setting has been **enabled** **and** [locked](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/115005269866-Using-Tiered-Settings#locked) for the user, the passcode field will be autogenerated for the Webinar in the response even if it is not provided in the API request. <br><br><br><br><br><br><br><br><br><br>|
|recurrence|object|false|none|Recurrence object. Use this object only for a meeting with type `8` i.e., a recurring meeting with fixed time. |
|settings|object|false|none|none|
|start_time|string(date-time)|false|none|Webinar start time, in the format "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'." Should be in GMT time. In the format "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss." This should be in local time and the timezone should be specified. Only used for scheduled webinars and recurring webinars with a fixed time.|
|timezone|string|false|none|Time zone to format start_time. For example, "America/Los_Angeles". For scheduled meetings only. Please reference our [time zone](#timezones) list for supported time zones and their formats.|
|topic|string|false|none|Webinar topic.|
|tracking_fields|[object]|false|none|Tracking fields|
|type|integer|false|none|Webinar Types:<br>`5` - webinar.<br>`6` - Recurring webinar with no fixed time.<br>`9` - Recurring webinar with a fixed time.|

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|5|
|type|6|
|type|9|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|allow_live_streaming|boolean|false|none|Allow live streaming.|
|annotation|boolean|false|none|Allow participants to use annotation tools.|
|attendee_on_hold|boolean|false|none|Allow host to put attendee on hold.<br><br>**This field has been deprecated and is no longer supported.**|
|auto_saving_chat|boolean|false|none|Auto save all in-meeting chats.|
|breakout_room|boolean|false|none|Allow host to split meeting participants into separate breakout rooms.|
|chat|boolean|false|none|Enable chat during meeting for all participants.|
|closed_caption|boolean|false|none|Enable closed captions.|
|co_host|boolean|false|none|Allow the host to add co-hosts.|
|custom_data_center_regions|boolean|false|none|If set to `true`, you can [select data center regions](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360042411451-Selecting-data-center-regions-for-hosted-meetings-and-webinars) to use for hosting your real-time meeting and webinar traffic. These regions can be provided in the `data_center_regions` field. If set to `false`, the regions cannot be customized and the default regions will be used.|
|custom_live_streaming_service|boolean|false|none|Allow custom live streaming.|
|custom_service_instructions|string|false|none|Custom service instructions.|
|data_center_regions|[string]|false|none|If you have set the value of `custom_data_center_regions` to `true`, specify the data center regions that you would like to opt in to (country codes from among: ["DE", "NL", "HK", "AU", "IN", "LA", "TY", "CN", "US", "CA"]).<br>|
|e2e_encryption|boolean|false|none|Zoom requires encryption for all data between the Zoom cloud, Zoom client, and Zoom Room. Require encryption for 3rd party endpoints (H323/SIP).|
|entry_exit_chime|string|false|none|Play sound when participants join or leave:<br>`host` - When host joins or leaves.<br>`all` - When any participant joins or leaves.<br>`none` - No join or leave sound.|
|far_end_camera_control|boolean|false|none|Allow another user to take control of the camera.|
|feedback|boolean|false|none|Enable option to send feedback to Zoom at the end of the meeting.|
|file_transfer|boolean|false|none|Indicates whether [in-meeting file transfer](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/209605493-In-meeting-file-transfer) setting has been enabled for the user or not.|
|group_hd|boolean|false|none|Enable group HD video.|
|non_verbal_feedback|boolean|false|none|Enable non-verbal feedback through screens.|
|polling|boolean|false|none|Add polls to the meeting controls.|
|private_chat|boolean|false|none|Enable 1:1 private chat between participants during meetings.|
|record_play_voice|boolean|false|none|Record and play their own voice.|
|remote_control|boolean|false|none|Enable remote control during screensharing.|
|remote_support|boolean|false|none|Allow host to provide 1:1 remote support to a participant.|
|request_permission_to_unmute|boolean|false|none|Indicates whether the [**Request permission to unmute participants**](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/203435537-Muting-and-unmuting-participants-in-a-meeting#h_01EGK4XFWS1SJGZ71MYGKF7260) option has been enabled for the user or not.|
|screen_sharing|boolean|false|none|Allow host and participants to share their screen or content during meetings<br>|
|share_dual_camera|boolean|false|none|Share dual camera (deprecated).|
|show_meeting_control_toolbar|boolean|false|none|Always show meeting controls during a meeting.|
|virtual_background|boolean|false|none|Enable virtual background.|
|virtual_background_settings|object|false|none|Settings to manage virtual background.|
|waiting_room|boolean|false|none|Enable Waiting room - if enabled, attendees can only join after host approves.|
|who_can_share_screen|string|false|none|Indicates who can share their screen or content during meetings. The value can be one of the following: <br><br>`host`: Only host can share the screen.<br><br>`all`: Both hosts and attendees can share their screen during meetings. For Webinar, the hosts and panelists can start screen sharing, but not the attendees.<br>|
|who_can_share_screen_when_someone_is_sharing|string|false|none|Indicates who is allowed to start sharing screen when someone else in the meeting is sharing their screen. The value can be one of the following:<br><br>`host`: Only a host can share the screen when someone else is sharing.<br><br>`all`: Anyone in the meeting is allowed to start sharing their screen when someone else is sharing. For Webinar, the hosts and panelists can start screen sharing, but not the attendees.<br>|
|workplace_by_facebook|boolean|false|none|Allow livestreaming by host through Workplace by Facebook.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|audio_type|string|false|none|Determine how participants can join the audio portion of the meeting:<br>`both` - Telephony and VoIP.<br>`telephony` - Audio PSTN telephony only.<br>`voip` - VoIP only.<br>`thirdParty` - Third party audio conference.|
|default_password_for_scheduled_meetings|string|false|none|Passcode for already scheduled meetings<br>|
|embed_password_in_join_link|boolean|false|none|If the value is set to `true`, the meeting passcode will be encrypted and included in the join meeting link to allow participants to join with just one click without having to enter the passcode.<br> |
|force_pmi_jbh_password|boolean|false|none|Require a passcode for personal meetings if attendees can join before host.|
|host_video|boolean|false|none|Start meetings with host video on.|
|join_before_host|boolean|false|none|Join the meeting before host arrives.|
|meeting_password_requirement|object|false|none|Account wide meeting/webinar [passcode requirements](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/360033559832-Meeting-and-webinar-passwords#h_a427384b-e383-4f80-864d-794bf0a37604).|
|participants_video|boolean|false|none|Start meetings with participants video on.|
|personal_meeting|boolean|false|none|Personal Meeting Setting.<br><br><br>`true`: Indicates that the **"Enable Personal Meeting ID"** setting is turned on. Users can choose to use personal meeting ID for their meetings. <br><br><br>`false`: Indicates that the **"Enable Personal Meeting ID"** setting is [turned off](https://support.zoom.us/hc/en-us/articles/201362843-Personal-meeting-ID-PMI-and-personal-link#h_aa0335c8-3b06-41bc-bc1f-a8b84ef17f2a). If this setting is disabled, meetings that were scheduled with PMI will be invalid. Scheduled meetings will need to be manually updated.<br>For Zoom Phone only:If a user has been assigned a desk phone, **"Elevate to Zoom Meeting"** on desk phone will be disabled.<br><br><br>|
|pmi_password|string|false|none|PMI passcode<br>|
|pstn_password_protected|boolean|false|none|Generate and require passcode for participants joining by phone.|
|require_password_for_instant_meetings|boolean|false|none|Require a passcode for instant meetings. If you use PMI for your instant meetings, this option will be disabled. This setting is always enabled for free accounts and Pro accounts with a single host and cannot be modified for these accounts.<br>|
|require_password_for_pmi_meetings|string|false|none|Require a passcode for Personal Meeting ID (PMI). This setting is always enabled for free accounts and Pro accounts with a single host and cannot be modified for these accounts.<br>|
|require_password_for_scheduled_meetings|boolean|false|none|Require a passcode for meetings which have already been scheduled<br>|
|require_password_for_scheduling_new_meetings|boolean|false|none|Require a passcode when scheduling new meetings.This setting is always enabled for free accounts and Pro accounts with a single host and cannot be modified for these accounts.<br>|
|use_pmi_for_instant_meetings|boolean|false|none|Use Personal Meeting ID (PMI) when starting an instant meeting<br>|
|use_pmi_for_scheduled_meetings|boolean|false|none|Use Personal Meeting ID (PMI) when scheduling a meeting<br>|

|audio_type|telephony|
|audio_type|voip|
|audio_type|thirdParty|
|require_password_for_pmi_meetings|jbh_only|
|require_password_for_pmi_meetings|all|
|require_password_for_pmi_meetings|none|

Use the **country** field of the **phone_numbers** object instead to select the country for the phone number.<br><br><br><br>[Country ID](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/other-references/abbreviation-lists#countries) of the phone number. This URL should only be used by the host of the meeting and should not be shared with anyone other than the host of the Webinar. <br><br>The expiration time for the <code>start_url</code> field listed in the response of [Create a Webinar API](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/webinars/webinarcreate) is two hours for all regular users. <br>	<br>For users created using the <code>custCreate</code> option via the [Create Users](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/users/usercreate) API, the expiration time of the <code>start_url</code> field is 90 days.<br>	<br>For security reasons, to retrieve the latest value for the <code>start_url</code> field programmatically (after expiry), you must call the [Retrieve a Webinar API](https://marketplace.zoom.us/docs/api-reference/zoom-api/webinars/webinar) and refer to the value of the <code>start_url</code> field in the response.</aside><br><br><br>|

|on_demand|boolean|false|none|Make the webinar on-demand|
|panelists_invitation_email_notification|boolean|false|none|* `true`: Send invitation email to panelists.<br><br>* `false`: Do not send invitation email to panelists.|
|panelists_video|boolean|false|none|Start video when panelists join webinar.|

<a id="tocsrecurrence-webinar"></a>

```json
{
  "end_date_time": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "end_times": 1,
  "monthly_day": 0,
  "monthly_week": -1,
  "monthly_week_day": 1,
  "repeat_interval": 0,
  "type": 1,
  "weekly_days": "string"
}
```

Recurrence object. Use this object only for a webinar of type `9` i.e., a recurring webinar with fixed time.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|end_date_time|string(date-time)|false|none|Select a date when the webinar will recur before it is canceled. Should be in UTC time, such as 2017-11-25T12:00:00Z. (Cannot be used with "end_times".)|
|end_times|integer|false|none|Select how many times the webinar will recur before it is canceled. (Cannot be used with "end_date_time".)|
|monthly_day|integer|false|none|Use this field **only if you're scheduling a recurring webinar of type** `3` to state which day in a month, the webinar should recur. The value range is from 1 to 31.<br><br>For instance, if you would like the webinar to recur on 23rd of each month, provide `23` as the value of this field and `1` as the value of the `repeat_interval` field. Instead, if you would like the webinar to recur once every three months, on 23rd of the month, change the value of the `repeat_interval` field to `3`.|
|monthly_week|integer|false|none|Use this field **only if you're scheduling a recurring webinar of type** `3` to state the week of the month when the webinar should recur. If you use this field, **you must also use the `monthly_week_day` field to state the day of the week when the webinar should recur.** <br>`-1` - Last week of the month.<br>`1` - First week of the month.<br>`2` - Second week of the month.<br>`3` - Third week of the month.<br>`4` - Fourth week of the month.|
|monthly_week_day|integer|false|none|Use this field **only if you're scheduling a recurring webinar of type** `3` to state a specific day in a week when the monthly webinar should recur. To use this field, you must also use the `monthly_week` field. <br>`1` - Sunday.<br>`2` - Monday.<br>`3` - Tuesday.<br>`4` -  Wednesday.<br>`5` - Thursday.<br>`6` - Friday.<br>`7` - Saturday.|
|repeat_interval|integer|false|none|Define the interval at which the webinar should recur. For instance, if you would like to schedule a Webinar that recurs every two months, you must set the value of this field as `2` and the value of the `type` parameter as `3`. <br><br>For a daily webinar, the maximum interval you can set is `90` days. For a weekly webinar, the maximum interval that you can set is `12` weeks. For a monthly webinar, the maximum interval that you can set is `3` months.|
|type|integer|true|none|Recurrence webinar types:<br>`1` - Daily.<br>`2` - Weekly.<br>`3` - Monthly.|
|weekly_days|string|false|none|Use this field **only if you're scheduling a recurring webinar of type** `2` to state which day(s) of the week the webinar should repeat. <br> The value for this field could be a number between `1` to `7` in string format. For instance, if the Webinar should recur on Sunday, provide `"1"` as the value of this field.  <br><br> **Note:** If you would like the webinar to occur on multiple days of a week, you should provide comma separated values for this field. For instance, if the Webinar should recur on Sundays and Tuesdays provide `"1,3"` as the value of this field.<br><br><br>`1`  - Sunday. <br>`2` - Monday.<br>`3` - Tuesday.<br>`4` -  Wednesday.<br>`5` -  Thursday.<br>`6` - Friday.<br>`7` - Saturday.<br><br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|monthly_week|-1|
|monthly_week|1|
|monthly_week|2|
|monthly_week|3|
|monthly_week|4|
|monthly_week_day|1|
|monthly_week_day|2|
|monthly_week_day|3|
|monthly_week_day|4|
|monthly_week_day|5|
|monthly_week_day|6|
|monthly_week_day|7|
|type|1|
|type|2|
|type|3|
